32816874.takeaway: In 695 adults with type 2 diabetes on metformin, the 104-week HbA1c reduction was greater with exenatide plus dapagliflozin (-1.70%) than with exenatide plus placebo, though these analyses were exploratory.

32817582.takeaway: In pooled pharmacokinetic data from 116 youths and adults, the same liraglutide dose gave comparable exposure in children and adults with type 2 diabetes, supporting one dosing regimen.

32817583.takeaway: In rural Pakistan, self-assessed puberty using a modified Pubertal Development Scale agreed substantially with physician Tanner staging (kappa 0.73 girls, 0.61 boys).

32818164.takeaway: Tanner stage-adjusted height-for-age curves were developed from 13,358 US children aged 8-18, capturing pubertal and ethnic differences that CDC age-based charts miss.

32818236.takeaway: In 373 Pima Indians, a DAO nonsense variant (Cys264Ter) was strongly associated with substantially lower 24-hour energy expenditure.

32818257.takeaway: An infant with very low birth weight and neonatal diabetes from a recessive NKX2-2 mutation developed severe obesity and paradoxical glucose-induced ghrelin secretion.

32820875.takeaway: Of 668 children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, 15.4% had positive celiac serology, and 23.3% of those normalised spontaneously.

32820876.takeaway: In 16 patients with neonatal diabetes from 12 Turkish families, the median age at diagnosis was 5 months, and genotype and phenotype were heterogeneous.

32822318.takeaway: Of 204 children with congenital hypothyroidism in the United Arab Emirates, 39% had associated extrathyroidal anomalies.

32822601.takeaway: This Personal View summarises the long-term risks of gestational diabetes for mothers and offspring, and notes that current diagnostic criteria focus mainly on short-term risks.

32827026.takeaway: Of 138 young patients from Fukushima operated on for thyroid cancer, 98.6% had papillary carcinoma and 69.6% carried the BRAFV600E mutation.

32827034.takeaway: After sleeve gastrectomy in adolescents with obesity, lumbar volumetric BMD fell relative to controls and marrow fat rose, with the bone change tied to weight and muscle loss.

32827035.takeaway: A transcriptome-wide association study linking gene expression and splicing to large GWAS datasets identified novel candidate genes for total body BMD and fracture.

32827441.takeaway: Mendelian randomisation suggested that serum PTH is causally and inversely associated with BMD at the forearm, femoral neck and lumbar spine, in adults aged 30 and over.

32827594.takeaway: Italian paediatric endocrine statements on COVID-19 note that infection is less severe in children than adults, and children were 1-5% of diagnosed cases.

32829316.takeaway: In 544 adolescents aged 12-13, 30.2% had elevated blood pressure or hypertension, and waist circumference above the 85th percentile was strongly linked to it, more so in boys.

32829317.takeaway: Among 51 children with familial hypercholesterolaemia, all carrying heterozygous LDLR mutations, LDL cholesterol fell 14.5% with dietary intervention and 80.4% adhered well to the diet.

32829528.takeaway: Of 341 youth who started subsidised CGM in Australia, about 28-33% stopped using it during follow-up.

32830475.takeaway: A 9-month-old girl with Kabuki syndrome and hyperinsulinaemic hypoglycaemia had a seizure during a fasting test, showing Kabuki syndrome as a rare cause of hyperinsulinism.

32832823.takeaway: In early-pubertal transgender youth starting GnRH agonists, 30% of those designated male and 13% of those designated female at birth had at least one BMD Z-score below -2.

32833299.takeaway: Among 61,445 South Australian children, 162 with type 1 diabetes had grade 5 literacy and numeracy outcomes that differed negligibly from children without it.

32833544.takeaway: In 48 people with type 1 diabetes, phone-app meal estimates were accurate for low-protein and low-fat meals but not high-protein or high-fat meals, and large carbohydrate meals were underestimated.

32835363.takeaway: In 28 children in DKA, copeptin fell from 95 to 9.7 pmol/L during rehydration, with a 7.1-hour half-recovery time, while serum osmolality fell from 321 to 294 mOsm/kg.

32835366.takeaway: In 57 Japanese patients with lipoid congenital adrenal hyperplasia (median age 23.7 years), the study revisits the criteria for the nonclassic form.

32835378.takeaway: In 11 French men with Bardet-Biedl syndrome, genitourinary malformations such as cryptorchidism were frequent, alongside impaired reproductive function.

32836222.takeaway: Based on a review of 192 children with isolated GH deficiency, the authors question whether routine brain MRI is worth doing in this group.

32838426.takeaway: No QTc prolongation was found on 12-lead ECG in 352 girls and women with Turner syndrome.

32839347.takeaway: In 61 adults with long-duration type 1 diabetes, multimodal brain MRI showed structural alterations in deep brain structures compared with 54 matched controls.

32840095.takeaway: A child with osteopetrosis developed a viridans streptococci temporal lobe brain abscess after convulsions, and was treated with drainage and intravenous antibiotics.

32840097.takeaway: A 15-year-old 46,XX girl with Denys-Drash syndrome and undisclosed biotin use was misdiagnosed with hyperandrogenism and then had prophylactic gonadectomy.

32840120.takeaway: A 13-year-old girl started a Minimed 670G hybrid closed-loop system through a virtual training programme, raising time in range from 39% to 69% in two weeks and 86% in a month.

32840311.takeaway: In 573 children with biopsy-confirmed NAFLD, lower SHBG was linked to more steatosis, and higher testosterone to better steatosis and fibrosis in boys but worse outcomes in girls.

32841161.takeaway: Twin infants with transcobalamin II deficiency carried a novel TCN2 variant and presented with failure to thrive, severe anaemia and hypogammaglobulinaemia.

32841162.takeaway: Two children with holocarboxylase synthetase deficiency, one with recurrent hypoglycaemia, were found to carry a novel HLCS pathogenic variant.

32841163.takeaway: Reference intervals for TSH and free T4 were defined in term infants aged 14-30 days with breast milk jaundice, and follow-up TSH was reviewed for those with values of 10-20 mIU/L.

32841164.takeaway: All six patients from four Spanish families with polycystic kidney disease and hyperinsulinaemic hypoglycaemia carried a PMM2 promoter variant plus a second PMM2 missense variant.

32841165.takeaway: A 4-year-old Indian girl with hypoglycaemic seizures had non-classical lipoid CAH from a homozygous StAR R188C mutation.

32841326.takeaway: In 904 obese youth, a NAFLD genetic risk score raised NAFLD prevalence by about 20% per unit, and NAFLD was associated with HOMA-IR.

32841328.takeaway: In 129 men with apoA-I Leu75Pro amyloidosis, testicular involvement was progressive and is a hallmark of the disease.

32841335.takeaway: In 466 children, whether levothyroxine started before or after conception did not change neurodevelopment scores at 6-24 months, apart from slightly lower motor scores.

32841355.takeaway: Three newborn-screened children with thyroid hypoplasia carried novel truncating PAX8 mutations outside the paired domain, which were characterised functionally.

32844178.takeaway: A 1-hour OGTT risk score predicted type 1 diabetes 5 years ahead about as well as the 2-hour DPTRS (AUC 0.805 vs 0.794 in DPT-1; 0.832 vs 0.847 in TNPTP).

32844222.takeaway: Vitamin D insufficiency was common (74.4%) in 22 children with T1D and 33 siblings, and siblings with 25(OH)D below 25 nmol/L had higher Th17 and Treg/ICOS+ percentages.

32845865.takeaway: In 146 Iranian people (76 with diabetes), the NeuroD1 Ala45Thr A allele and AA genotype were more frequent in diabetes, suggesting a possible risk factor for type 1 diabetes.

32845866.takeaway: In 40 obese prepubertal children compared with 29 healthy peers, urinary NGAL and KIM-1 were measured as early kidney injury markers alongside metabolic measures.

32845867.takeaway: Among 60 children with chronic arthritis given intra-articular corticosteroid injections, adrenal insufficiency occurred in 30%, and the injected dose was linked to its development.

32846114.takeaway: In 1,435 people using Control-IQ who completed questionnaires and had glucose data, time in range was 78.2% at baseline and 79.2% at follow-up, with high device satisfaction.

32846418.takeaway: Reviews how birth size, including small and large for gestational age, shapes later cardiometabolic risk, with catch-up or catch-down growth and early weight gain.

32847828.takeaway: In CARDIA, the largest 20-year rise in plant-centred diet quality was linked to 48% lower diabetes risk over the next decade and to smaller BMI gains.

32849256.takeaway: In 3,843 Iranian children and adolescents aged 7-18, each unit rise in ALT raised the odds of being metabolically unhealthy obese by 2% relative to healthy non-obese children.

32849262.takeaway: Reviews evidence that bisphenol A disrupts Leydig cell development and function through oestrogenic and anti-androgenic effects, linked to testicular dysgenesis, delayed puberty and subfertility.

32849264.takeaway: In 62,132 neonates screened in Abruzzo, Italy, 2.3% had elevated initial TSH, and a second test confirmed it in 7% of those.

32849265.takeaway: Among 233 gastric bypass patients with nadir BMI below 30 who had abdominoplasty, weight regained over five years averaged 17.8% of maximal weight loss.

32849271.takeaway: Methyl farnesoate and 20-hydroxyecdysone affected larval mortality and metamorphosis in kuruma prawn larvae in laboratory experiments.

32849272.takeaway: Among 493 children diagnosed with type 1 diabetes in 2010-2018, the co-occurrence of other autoimmune disorders at diabetes onset increased over the study period.

32849288.takeaway: In a propensity-matched cohort from 1,313 vitrified blastocyst transfer cycles, day 6 and day 5 transfers were compared for obstetric and neonatal outcomes.

32849304.takeaway: In 2,387 euthyroid adults followed for 5 years in rural China, a rise in thyroid peroxidase antibody tier was associated with a higher risk of abnormal TSH.

32849305.takeaway: Reviews the auxological and endocrine features of McCune-Albright syndrome in children, including precocious puberty, GH excess, hypercortisolism and hypophosphataemic rickets.

32849307.takeaway: In 25 patients with prolactinomas diagnosed before age 19, median age at diagnosis was 16.9 years, macroadenomas made up 56%, and 56% responded to dopamine agonists.

32849313.takeaway: Reviews neurosteroid synthesis in the pineal gland, particularly in birds, including sex steroids and allopregnanolone made de novo from cholesterol.

32853167.takeaway: A 16-year-old boy with delayed puberty and micropenis had combined pituitary hormone deficiency caused by a nonsense FGFR1 variant.

32853168.takeaway: In 67 children with type 1 diabetes, vitamin D insufficiency at onset was linked to age, HbA1c and creatinine, and baseline 25(OH)D above 30 ng/mL was linked to HbA1c improvement.

32860693.takeaway: People diagnosed with type 1 diabetes within a year had more stool IgA-bound bacteria than healthy controls, and this proportion rose with GAD antibody titre.

32860695.takeaway: In 17 overweight or obese women with PCOS and 15 matched controls, gut microbial diversity did not differ at baseline or after 3 months of oral contraceptives.

32864545.takeaway: Reviews the limited evidence on sex-steroid hormones and COVID-19 incidence in children, and the unclear role children play in transmission.

32864990.takeaway: In a 6-month RCT of 166 teens with type 1 diabetes, daily text-message education with lottery incentives was compared with standard care for self-care and HbA1c.

32865200.takeaway: Compared with 22 age-matched girls, 23 girls with premature adrenarche had enhanced 17,20-lyase and 17β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase activities in their urinary steroid profiles.

32866120.takeaway: Two brothers with pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1A carried a novel maternally inherited GNAS variant, and the proband also developed TSH resistance.

32866121.takeaway: A 10-year-old girl with primary hypoparathyroidism and systemic lupus erythematosus is described, a rare combination in children with limited treatment options.

32866122.takeaway: Among 35 adolescents and young adults with Turner syndrome aged 13-22, 80% accurately reported their medical history, but only a third knew the screening guidelines.

32866123.takeaway: Two siblings with idiopathic infantile hypercalcaemia carried mutations in both SLC34A1 and CYP24A1, a combination not previously reported in one patient.

32866124.takeaway: Methylation analysis of 58 children with idiopathic short stature found no imprinting disorders, suggesting they are rare in this group.

32866125.takeaway: Of 62 preterm infants, 24% had sufficient 25(OH)D at birth and 83% by discharge after supplementation, though daily intake fell below recommendations in many.

32869320.takeaway: In infants under 12 months with Prader-Willi syndrome, adjusted free T4 was lower than in controls (11.2 vs 14.3 pmol/L).

32869847.takeaway: In adults exposed to first-trimester dexamethasone for CAH risk, brain activation during working memory did not differ from controls.

32869850.takeaway: In 112 craniopharyngioma patients followed for a median of 10 years, BMI and fat-free mass rose, and total-body and spine bone density Z-scores also increased.

32870266.takeaway: Women with hypothalamic amenorrhea carried a higher burden of rare sequence variants in GnRH-associated genes than control women.

32871644.takeaway: Two infants with severe ABCC8 hyperinsulinism: one developed midgut volvulus on diazoxide and needed bowel resection, and carried a homozygous p.Val601Ile variant.

32871645.takeaway: Reviews CGM types, metrics and availability in Korea for children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, noting they improve control and reduce hypoglycaemia.

32871646.takeaway: A 6-year-old boy with Cushing syndrome developed acute kidney injury from ureteral stones, showing urolithiasis can complicate glucocorticoid excess in children.

32871647.takeaway: In HEK293 cells, the novel CASR p.Tyr825Phe variant from a neonate with hypoparathyroidism raised MAPK signalling and intracellular calcium at low extracellular calcium compared with wild-type CaSR.

32871648.takeaway: In 97 girls with central precocious puberty on GnRH agonists, height SDS, IGF-1 and IGFBP-3 SDS fell, and the change in IGF-1 SDS correlated with height change (r=0.405).

32871649.takeaway: In 310 short-stature children, the best sensitivities for isolated GH deficiency were only 22.6% for IGF-1 SDS and 30.0% for IGFBP-3 SDS, both adjusted for chronological age.

32871650.takeaway: Reviews the GnRH stimulation test for precocious puberty, noting its limits in early puberty, in girls with overlapping pictures, in obesity and with inconsistent cut-offs.

32871651.takeaway: Among 719 Korean youths aged 10-17, metabolic syndrome occurred in 12.7% of overweight or obese participants and in none of the normal-weight ones; age-specific insulin resistance cut-offs tracked it more closely than fixed cut-offs.

32871652.takeaway: A 15-year-old boy with short stature and advanced bone age carried a heterozygous ACAN mutation, consistent with aggrecanopathy, reported with a literature review.

32871653.takeaway: In 53 children with type 1 diabetes trained in carbohydrate counting, adherence to the method was tracked over 6 months and compared with metabolic control.

32871654.takeaway: In 82 preterm infants, those born small for gestational age had length SDS rising to -1.30 at 6 months and -0.97 at 24 months of corrected age.

32871655.takeaway: In 55 young survivors of childhood acute lymphocytic leukaemia, adipokine levels were examined against adiposity, sex and cranial radiotherapy exposure.

32871656.takeaway: A 15-year-old boy with primary hyperparathyroidism had an intrathymic ectopic parathyroid adenoma, located by SPECT/CT and removed by thoracoscopic surgery.

32871657.takeaway: In 17 prepubertal Korean children with Noonan syndrome treated with GH for at least 3 years, height SDS rose from -2.93 to -1.51.

32871658.takeaway: Dizygotic twin sisters with normosmic idiopathic hypogonadotropic hypogonadism carried an FGFR1 variant and presented with short stature and incomplete pubertal development.

32873588.takeaway: Among 6,738 people followed from childhood, 6.5% reported adult-onset type 2 diabetes, and higher childhood BMI, fasting glucose and insulin predicted it.

32877364.takeaway: In 80 children and adolescents with differentiated thyroid carcinoma, prognostic factors and long-term outcomes were reviewed retrospectively after thyroidectomy and mostly radioiodine.

32880687.takeaway: Circulating MAIT cell frequency and phenotype were compared across 51 children with new type 1 diabetes, 27 autoantibody-positive at-risk children and 113 controls.

32882033.takeaway: Among 1,006 HLA-susceptible children followed from birth, 35 (3.5%) had progressed to type 1 diabetes by age 15.5 years.

32886190.takeaway: Among 161 adults with long-duration type 1 diabetes, gut microbiota and plasma metabolites were compared by albuminuria level with 50 healthy controls.

32887708.takeaway: In 1,079 patients with thalassaemia major, those with normal glucose metabolism had higher pancreatic T2* values, meaning less pancreatic iron, than those with impaired glucose metabolism.

32888021.takeaway: In 18 children aged 0-6 with CAH or hypopituitarism, hydrocortisone granules were used for a median of 795 days, with dose changes mostly guided by salivary 17-OHP.

32892177.takeaway: Ten Chinese children with glycogen storage disease type VI, confirmed by sequencing, showed that the disease can progress to cirrhosis.

32893419.takeaway: In 181 Indian patients with permanent neonatal diabetes, KATP channel gene defects explained 22% (39 of 181), with KCNJ11 and ABCC8 variants.

32893856.takeaway: Thirty patients with diabetes from PTF1A enhancer mutations were followed for a median of 4 years across 12 paediatric centres to characterise their phenotype.

32893939.takeaway: In diverse children with type 1 diabetes, diabetes distress was examined against socioeconomic status, race/ethnicity and HbA1c.

32894307.takeaway: Reviews the transcription factors that control endocrine and exocrine pancreas development in mice and humans, with relevance to stem-cell therapies for diabetes.

32894314.takeaway: Reviews endotypes within type 1 and type 2 diabetes, linked to age, genetics, immunology and metabolism, with implications for prediction, prevention and treatment.

32894855.takeaway: A retrospective review of paediatric thyroid nodule biopsies examined whether ultrasound TI-RADS can identify Bethesda III nodules with lower malignancy risk.

32898218.takeaway: In a prospective cohort, an early OGTT at 18-20 weeks was compared with the standard OGTT at 24-28 weeks for diagnosing gestational diabetes and its adverse outcomes.

32900786.takeaway: Among 1,338 Danish children who developed type 1 diabetes, school absences rose by about 4 months before diagnosis, compared with 6,690 matched controls.

32900788.takeaway: In TrialNet antibody-positive individuals, 298 progressors to type 1 diabetes showed characteristic glucose response curve changes compared with 2,216 non-progressors.

32901267.takeaway: In 49 neonates given low-dose ACTH stimulation, cortisol peaked at 60 minutes in 69% and at 30 minutes in 27%, so the 60-minute sample was most informative.

32901291.takeaway: ARMC5 germline variants were found in 68.4% of 111 patients with sporadic neuroendocrine tumours or MEN1, and loss of heterozygosity co-occurred in about two-thirds of tumours.

32902076.takeaway: In 75,615 Danish children followed for about 14 years, early-childhood antibiotic exposure was not associated with type 1 diabetes risk (HR 1.26, 95% CI 0.89-1.79).

32902080.takeaway: Among 222 youth and young adults with type 1 diabetes, those with lower socioeconomic profiles were more likely to have high-risk glycaemic control (HbA1c above 9%).

32902875.takeaway: In the RISE study, youth with impaired glucose tolerance or early type 2 diabetes secreted more insulin and were more responsive than adults with similar conditions.

32902884.takeaway: In caregivers of children aged 4-18 with type 1 diabetes in British Columbia, diabetes-specific family conflict was examined against patient and family characteristics.

32902901.takeaway: Multilevel models linked sleep characteristics with glucose variability in adolescents with type 1 diabetes monitored for 3-7 days with actigraphy and CGM.

32902910.takeaway: A survey of 78 SWEET paediatric diabetes centres examined office, ambulatory and home blood pressure methods, devices and antihypertensive treatment preferences.

32909025.takeaway: In 199 transgender adolescents, bone mass development was tracked on GnRH analogues and then with gender-affirming hormones, by pubertal stage.

32910247.takeaway: Among 1,050 women in the PANDORA cohort, hyperglycaemia in pregnancy, including type 2 diabetes, was examined against breastfeeding at discharge and up to 6 months.

32910779.takeaway: A meta-analysis of 151 cohorts, about 32 million people, assessed whether the observational link between type 2 diabetes and cancer holds up to unmeasured confounding.

32912083.takeaway: In a California nested case-control study with 1,012 cases of pediatric thyroid cancer, birth characteristics were examined as risk factors.

32915520.takeaway: Confirmatory factor analysis of the AADQ and DAAS in 181 youth with type 1 diabetes supported one-factor structures for these psychological flexibility measures.

32917775.takeaway: Exome analysis in up to 57,232 people identified novel variants that influence adiposity-adjusted leptin, including a missense variant in LEP (Val94Met).

32920552.takeaway: Two family members with osteogenesis imperfecta carried a novel COL1A2 variant and had elevated bone density despite minimal-trauma fractures.

32921532.takeaway: French paediatric expert guidelines on children at risk of secondary bone fragility were built from a PubMed review of 2008-2018 literature and validated by external groups.

32924380.takeaway: Peripheral blood lymphocyte subsets were compared across 141 children with Graves' disease, grouped by ALT levels, orbitopathy and hematuria.

32924381.takeaway: A child with 3-M syndrome-1 and a CUL7 mutation received recombinant IGF-1 with minimal height gain, and developed morbid obesity and severe sleep apnoea.

32929477.takeaway: Girls aged 10-16 with type 1 diabetes had impaired hip geometry compared with 61 controls, despite similar age, puberty, height and lean mass.

32930718.takeaway: At one US centre, baseline features that predicted reaching dopamine agonist withdrawal were examined in prolactinoma patients seen from 2000 to 2018.

32930785.takeaway: In 113 patients with somatotroph adenomas treated with fractionated IMRT from 2009 to 2019, treatment outcomes and their predictors were analysed.

32935435.takeaway: ISPAD consensus guidance on DKA during COVID-19 and in resource-limited settings explores subcutaneous insulin, since intravenous insulin usually requires ICU admission.

32935887.takeaway: In 654 children with type 1 diabetes, the agreement of CGM metrics from shorter sampling periods with a full 12-week period was assessed to find the optimal duration.

32935921.takeaway: In a 6-month RCT of youth aged 13-20, cutaneous adverse events from flash glucose monitoring sensors were compared with self-monitoring, along with premature sensor loss.

32936762.takeaway: Promoter methylation of LEP, IRS2 and GLP2R was compared between SGA children with and without catch-up growth in a prospective observational study.

32936763.takeaway: Three siblings with isolated GH deficiency type 1A from a 6.7 kb GH1 deletion showed different growth responses to recombinant GH.

32936764.takeaway: In 156 adolescents with type 1 diabetes and 80 healthy controls, TGF-β1 and RAGE gene expression and protein levels were compared.

32936765.takeaway: A monomolecular function described catch-up growth in 20 children with juvenile hypothyroidism and 18 with GH deficiency treated with conventional or high-dose GH.

32936766.takeaway: Three siblings with obesity, intellectual disability and hypogonadotropic hypogonadism carried a carboxypeptidase E (CPE) mutation, adding a new cause of syndromic obesity.

32936915.takeaway: A GWAS of HbA1c in nondiabetic Malay adults identified an SLC4A1 deletion that influenced HbA1c independently of glycaemia.

32938577.takeaway: Of 73 children with primary adrenal insufficiency at one centre over 21 years, CAH caused 69.9%, and non-CAH genetic causes were examined in detail.

32938578.takeaway: Childhood type 1 diabetes incidence in Tlemcen, Algeria, was estimated by capture-recapture for children under 15 from 2015 to 2018, reporting a very high rate.

32938579.takeaway: In 62 children and adolescents with disorders of sex development aged 2-18, quality of life and psychological difficulties were measured with PedsQL, SDQ and psychiatric interviews.

32938580.takeaway: Homozygosity mapping and exome sequencing in four consanguineous Turkish families with incomplete Wolfram syndrome 1 identified three novel and one known WFS1 mutation.

32938731.takeaway: Reviews clinical evidence that people with diabetes have poorer COVID-19 outcomes than those without, including children and pregnant women.

32938745.takeaway: In U.S. and German youth registries of over 56,000 children, the socioeconomic gap in diabetes technology use was examined alongside HbA1c disparities over a decade.

32939436.takeaway: Exome data from the EPIGROW cohort of children with short stature of undefined aetiology were screened for novel candidate mutations in growth-related genes.

32939893.takeaway: In 90 Latino adolescents with obesity completing a 3-month lifestyle intervention, three distinct insulin sensitivity response phenotypes emerged over one year.

32939906.takeaway: Cardiovascular risk factor prevalence and its associations were analysed by age in 2,021 Italian children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes.

32939954.takeaway: In a national survey of Norwegian students, 324 with type 1 diabetes (mean age 23) had a mean HbA1c of 7.65%.

32939969.takeaway: Extended family history of type 1 diabetes was compared between 343 HLA-susceptible Finnish children with islet autoantibodies and 343 matched autoantibody-negative controls.

32944774.takeaway: In a longitudinal pilot study, 31P nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy measured how thyroid hormone levels affect phosphorus metabolites in skeletal muscle and liver.

32946562.takeaway: In 23 growth-restricted fetuses without brain sparing and 23 controls, inferior adrenal artery pulsatility index was studied as a marker of early blood redistribution and steroid response.

32946574.takeaway: In a phase 1 randomised placebo-controlled study in healthy men, the NK3 receptor antagonist SJX-653 was assessed for safety, pharmacokinetics and LH and testosterone reduction.

32946608.takeaway: Cardiac function was compared in 47 children with 21-hydroxylase-deficient CAH and 47 controls, with patients grouped by glucocorticoid treatment duration.

32946820.takeaway: In a multicentre international RCT, metformin added to insulin was tested against placebo for neonatal morbidity and mortality in pregnant women with type 2 diabetes.

32946821.takeaway: In a post-hoc pooled analysis of DEPICT-1 and DEPICT-2, dapagliflozin added to insulin in adults with type 1 diabetes was assessed for effects on albuminuria and eGFR over 52 weeks.

32947644.takeaway: A Mendelian randomisation analysis in 473,818 UK Biobank participants tested whether hyperthyroid states causally affect bone mineral density and fracture.

32949016.takeaway: In 142 craniopharyngioma patients (34% childhood-onset) treated from 1951 to 2015, management trends across four time quartiles were examined alongside long-term endocrine outcomes.

32950993.takeaway: In 85 Japanese children with type 1 diabetes using FreeStyle Libre over 3 months, time below range and extreme hypoglycaemia were assessed as glycaemic markers.

32954812.takeaway: The analytical accuracy of the second-generation FreeStyle Libre 2 CGM was compared with venous reference glucose in children aged 4-17 and adults.

32955743.takeaway: Periprocedural subcutaneous PTH was used in APS-1/APECED patients with hypoparathyroidism and malabsorption undergoing invasive procedures, as an alternative to high-dose IV calcium.

32959490.takeaway: The first European Academy of Andrology guidelines on Klinefelter syndrome, built by an expert group using GRADE, address the low diagnosis rate and lack of international guidance.

32961557.takeaway: Using EHR-based algorithms and clinical note keywords, the clinical and genetic spectrum of PCOS was characterised within and across racial and ethnic groups.

32961560.takeaway: In 601 healthy Norwegian girls aged 6-16, hormone reference values were paired with ultrasound breast staging to test endocrine profiles for predicting thelarche.

32962981.takeaway: In 758 children presenting with DKA in a randomised IV-fluid trial, cognitive change after a single DKA episode was assessed in new-onset and previously diagnosed type 1 diabetes.

32968804.takeaway: In a secondary analysis of a randomised trial, oral contraceptives, lifestyle change or both were compared for effects on incretin and TGF-β superfamily hormones in women with PCOS.

32969044.takeaway: In 184 children with peripubertal growth delay, auxological outcomes were compared between sex-steroid-primed and unprimed GH stimulation tests, and low-dose sex steroid treatment was evaluated.

32973676.takeaway: Reviews autoimmune thyroid disease in childhood and adolescence in specific genetic syndromes, including the presentation of Hashimoto's thyroiditis and Graves' disease.

32973687.takeaway: In a 6-year prospective study of 3,133 thyroid-nodule-free Chinese adults aged 18-65, changes in metabolic syndrome status were examined against new thyroid nodules.

32973688.takeaway: Reviews how hormonal contraception may affect bone accrual in adolescents, a critical period for peak bone strength, unlike in mature premenopausal women.

32981187.takeaway: In 138 youth with type 1 diabetes followed for 24 months on intermittently scanned CGM, satisfaction was high but HbA1c and weight increased.

32981192.takeaway: In 122 adolescents with type 1 diabetes in the FLEX trial, calorie and carbohydrate intake were compared on days with and without hypoglycaemia, to test a common perception.

32981196.takeaway: In 4,001 youth with incident diabetes in the SEARCH registry, provider-assigned diabetes type from medical records was checked against etiologic criteria using autoantibodies and insulin sensitivity.

32982959.takeaway: In 759 German children and adolescents with thyroid disease, quality of life and mental health did not differ from 7,293 healthy peers.

32982961.takeaway: CRLF1 bound MYH9 to enhance proliferation and metastasis of papillary thyroid carcinoma cells through the ERK/ETV4 axis, shown in vitro and in vivo.

32982963.takeaway: In a retrospective study of 293 patients with papillary thyroid microcarcinoma, the incidence of lymph node metastasis and its predictive factors were assessed.

32982993.takeaway: Whole-exome sequencing of seven Cypriot patients with congenital hypogonadotropic hypogonadism identified novel variants in ANOS1, RNF216, WDR11, FGFR1, CHD7 and POLR3A.

32985057.takeaway: Skin disorders and skin-related quality of life were assessed in 369 children, adolescents and young adults with type 1 diabetes at one centre.

32985060.takeaway: Among 80 youths aged 10-18 with type 1 diabetes, device self-management, including logged blood glucose checks, was linked to HbA1c and time in range.

32985262.takeaway: Consensus panel recommendations on using continuous glucose monitors and automated insulin dosing in hospitalized patients, covering continuation, initiation, and data management.

32985775.takeaway: After medication withdrawal, youth with impaired glucose tolerance or recent type 2 diabetes had worse OGTT measures than during treatment.

32990648.takeaway: Three Greek children with ROHHAD syndrome presented with rapid-onset obesity that was initially misdiagnosed; the authors propose a questionnaire to aid recognition.

32994272.takeaway: A new Ins2 mutant mouse develops diabetes with beta-cell endoplasmic reticulum stress, modeling human mutation-linked neonatal diabetes.

32995889.takeaway: Across 518 children with classic CAH in 34 centers, sick-day episodes were common and adrenal crises rare, with more sick-day episodes in low- and middle-income countries.

32995892.takeaway: A randomized trial compared exenatide, metformin, and their combination for sustained remission of prediabetes in women with PCOS; 150 of 183 enrollees completed.

32998133.takeaway: In a 4-month-old with transient postoperative SIADH, serial copeptin levels fell as the syndrome resolved and tracked the infant's urine-diluting ability.

32998142.takeaway: In a 16-year-old with life-threatening hypercalcemia from primary hyperparathyroidism, denosumab rapidly lowered serum calcium, allowing genetic testing before parathyroidectomy.

32998988.takeaway: In Finnish children under 15, type 1 diabetes incidence fell from 2003 to 2018, mainly in the youngest age group, while median age at diagnosis rose.

32998989.takeaway: In 36 adults using hybrid closed-loop systems, higher daily carbohydrate intake was linked to lower time in range and more time above range.

33000173.takeaway: In 200 patients with medullary thyroid cancer, TIM-3 was the most common immune co-inhibitory receptor, present in 48% of tumors.

33001476.takeaway: In 100 Tokyo neonates with classical 21-hydroxylase deficiency, severe salt-wasting occurred in 37%, and apart from one case developed in or after the second week of life.

33001853.takeaway: In 104 children with congenital heart disease exposed to iodinated contrast, thyroid dysfunction developed in 15.4% during a median three years of follow-up.

33005949.takeaway: An international cross-sectional study of 150 patients with 4H leukodystrophy systematically characterized endocrine and growth abnormalities and tested genotype-phenotype links.

33006547.takeaway: Papilledema developed in 5 of 289 children starting growth hormone (1.7%), all asymptomatic and all with GH deficiency.

33006550.takeaway: In a cross-sectional study of 56 children with obesity and 38 healthy controls, thyroid autoantibodies were compared with waist-height ratio and fat mass.

33006553.takeaway: In obese adolescents with normal glucose tolerance, a late glucose peak and a monophasic glucose curve were each linked to lower oral disposition index, suggesting early beta-cell dysfunction.

33006554.takeaway: An expert discussion reviews digital tools for short stature assessment, including referral algorithms, coding programs, safer cranial imaging, and deep-learning bone age methods.

33009690.takeaway: Monthly video consultations added to regular care gave a non-significant 0.11% HbA1c reduction at 6 months in 240 children with type 1 diabetes using CGM.

33012254.takeaway: Meta-analysis of 22 studies found menstrual irregularities in 12% to 31% of women in the first year after radioactive iodine for thyroid cancer.

33013678.takeaway: Dose-titrated glucagon infusions, added to dextrose and medical therapy, were studied as a way to stabilize glucose in 33 children with congenital hyperinsulinism.

33013680.takeaway: In 87 cystic thyroid nodules treated with microwave ablation, intracystic hemorrhage occurred in 10.3% and prolonged ablation, with a negative effect on outcome.

33013688.takeaway: In 479 children with obesity, a higher android-to-gynoid fat ratio was strongly associated with lower insulin sensitivity across sex and pubertal stages.

33013690.takeaway: An Italian expert panel and survey of pediatric endocrinologists and nephrologists assessed adherence to guidelines for starting growth hormone in children with chronic kidney disease and growth failure.

33013695.takeaway: In 8,107 pregnant women in Wuhan, maternal TSH and FT4 within normal ranges were negatively associated with birth weight, and this depended on gestational weight gain.

33013696.takeaway: In ovariectomized rats, calcitonin increased bone formation by raising Wnt10b expression in osteoclasts, suggesting an indirect effect on osteoblasts.

33013698.takeaway: A review of AMH in pediatric DSD explains how AMH levels help distinguish gonadal dysgenesis, androgen insensitivity, and ovotesticular DSD in newborns.

33013701.takeaway: In juvenile prawns, eyestalk transcriptomics identified 148 GPCR transcripts and showed salinity acclimation changed mRNA levels of seven neuropeptides and one GPCR.

33013704.takeaway: In 18 obese women with PCOS and 15 without, fecal metabolites and gut microbiota differed, with lower microbial richness and diversity in the PCOS group.

33013709.takeaway: Perinatal methoxychlor exposure in mice altered anogenital distance and advanced female puberty, with increased hypothalamic kisspeptin cell expression.

33013711.takeaway: A Chinese family with MODY12 caused by a rare ABCC8 missense variant is described to raise clinician awareness of this monogenic diabetes.

33017824.takeaway: In a retrospective pilot of 38 children with 21-hydroxylase deficiency, expressing steroid hormones as SD scores was proposed as a tool for CAH management and research.

33017828.takeaway: A narrative review of pediatric metabolic syndrome treatment favors lifestyle change first, with drugs or bariatric surgery reserved for selected cases.

33017885.takeaway: A review of low bone mineral density in childhood cancer survivors covers steroid, radiation, and hormonal causes, with calcium, vitamin D, activity, hormone, and bisphosphonate management.

33017886.takeaway: In 75 boys with central precocious puberty, BMI standard deviation scores were tracked by weight group before and during two years of GnRH agonist therapy.

33021691.takeaway: In 345 mother-child pairs, higher maternal HbA1c in mid-pregnancy was associated with offspring glucose and insulin measures at ages 4 to 7; the study tested whether offspring adiposity mediates this link.

33025823.takeaway: In 16 critically ill children on continuous glucose monitoring, glucose rose more after interventions when patients were awake than when sedated (4.8 vs -2.2 mg/dL).

33026463.takeaway: In 2074 children at risk for type 1 diabetes, offspring of affected mothers had a lower hazard of multiple beta-cell autoantibodies than children with an affected sibling (HR 0.54).

33026680.takeaway: A cross-sectional study of 192 children with type 1 diabetes tested the measurement properties of PROMIS patient-reported functioning domains, including validity, reliability, and parent-child agreement.

33027050.takeaway: Among 100 pediatric and young adult patients with differentiated thyroid cancer, BRAF V600E was found in 14 of 98 papillary cancers, and no TERT promoter mutations were found.

33027051.takeaway: A 14-year-old boy with pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1B had severe hypocalcemia and loss of GNAS methylation, confirming the diagnosis without an STX16 deletion.

33027052.takeaway: In 249 children and adolescents, type 2 diabetes was associated with higher LDL-C and non-HDL-C than controls and with type 1 diabetes remitters.

33027054.takeaway: A pediatric thyroidectomy pathway cut IV calcium gluconate use from 68% to 48% over 15 months, short of the target of under 40%, across 27 patients.

33029631.takeaway: Nine children with congenital hypothyroidism and a eutopic thyroid gland were screened for PAX8 variants, and mutant PAX8 proteins were tested in vitro.

33029656.takeaway: Among 166 infants diagnosed with type 1 diabetes before 6 months without a monogenic variant, 38% had high type 1 diabetes genetic risk scores, versus about 5% expected if monogenic.

33030293.takeaway: In 29 youth with type 1 diabetes and elevated depressive symptoms, 55% of parents were unaware of the symptoms, and 28% accepted a mental health referral.

33031051.takeaway: In eight children with osteogenesis imperfecta, switching from pamidronate to monthly IV alendronate kept BMD Z-scores rising, non-inferior to pamidronate, with no change in fracture rates.

33031052.takeaway: In 16 Colombian children with thyroid carcinoma, most were girls who presented with cervical adenopathy, and most underwent total thyroidectomy with lymphadenectomy.

33031053.takeaway: Two children with osteogenesis imperfecta type VI and novel SERPINF1 variants had widely varying responses to long-term bisphosphonate therapy.

33031054.takeaway: In two unrelated infants with hyperinsulinism from HNF4A variants, genetic testing also revised the mothers' diagnosis to MODY.

33031055.takeaway: Targeted exome sequencing identified monogenic diabetes in 16 of 27 (59%) Korean children suspected of having it.

33034075.takeaway: At a summer camp, a 2019 FreeStyle Libre algorithm was compared with the 2016 version for accuracy against fingerstick glucose in children with type 1 diabetes.

33034097.takeaway: Interviews with 62 emerging adults with type 1 diabetes identified social, cognitive, and behavioral protective factors that help them overcome management challenges.

33034623.takeaway: In 94 girls, serum irisin was compared across central precocious puberty, its variants, and prepubertal controls, to test it as a marker.

33034649.takeaway: Reference ranges for the bone biomarker CXM were built from 302 healthy children and 10 adults, supporting its use as a real-time marker of height velocity.

33035187.takeaway: A male infant with neonatal diabetes from a novel homozygous ABCC8 variant switched from insulin to glimepiride at five months, with metabolic control achieved.

33035188.takeaway: A retrospective two-year study of children starting growth hormone examined changes in thyroid function and whether the TRH stimulation test helps identify central hypothyroidism.

33035189.takeaway: A meta-analysis of studies in children with idiopathic short stature examined rhGH effects on linear growth and adult height.

33035190.takeaway: In a survey of 39 families of children with type 1 diabetes, location, cost, and concern about overnight camp were the most common barriers to camp attendance.

33035191.takeaway: Newborns of mothers who smoked in pregnancy had increased anogenital distance in female infants compared with controls.

33035311.takeaway: Among 113 young children diagnosed with type 1 diabetes (57 from TEDDY, 56 community controls), factors linked to C-peptide decline over two years were analyzed.

33035320.takeaway: In a claims-based nested case-control study of 353,917 hypertensive women, prior ACE inhibitor use was associated with lower uterine fibroid odds.

33037887.takeaway: Urinary podocyte-derived microparticle excretion, normalized to creatinine, was higher in youth with type 1 diabetes than type 2 diabetes (median 7.88 vs 1.84).

33038056.takeaway: The SWEET registry compared childhood type 1 diabetes indicators across five world regions, adjusting for age, sex, and diabetes duration.

33040066.takeaway: In 617 overweight children, thyroid volume and thyroid function were independently associated with weight status in a cross-sectional study.

33040071.takeaway: A 2.8-year-old girl with a novel heterozygous INSR deletion had recurrent postprandial and fasting hypoglycemia, with markedly raised insulin during oral glucose testing.

33042001.takeaway: In 145 Chinese children, serum adiponectin and IL-6 were higher during acute febrile seizures than in febrile controls and healthy children.

33042004.takeaway: In a randomized pilot in patients with obesity, a two-month very low-calorie ketogenic diet was compared with a standard low-calorie diet for effects on visceral and liver fat by MRI.

33042005.takeaway: Review of severe hypoglycemia in children with type 1 diabetes: its frequency has declined, yet it still causes deaths in a reported 4-10% and neurocognitive and psychosocial harm.

33042006.takeaway: In 409 Chinese patients with obesity undergoing bariatric surgery, BMI plateaued at about 12 months after a mean decrease of 8.8 kg/m2.

33042019.takeaway: Infliximab may lower the risk of thyroid disorders in pediatric Crohn disease, per thyroid ultrasound and antibody comparison with untreated controls.

33042024.takeaway: In newborn rats, maternal high-fat diet and diabetes together altered cardiac transcription pathways governing metabolism and cell fate.

33045800.takeaway: A family with IGSF1 deficiency syndrome showed central hypothyroidism with normal free T4 in one case, severe obesity, and premature testicular growth, expanding its clinical spectrum.

33047169.takeaway: An EASD and ISPAD position statement gives guidance on glucose management during exercise in type 1 diabetes using CGM and intermittently scanned CGM systems.

33047481.takeaway: An EASD and ISPAD position statement gives guidance on glucose management during exercise in type 1 diabetes using CGM and intermittently scanned CGM systems.

33048835.takeaway: In 174 children treated for congenital hypothyroidism after neonatal screening, puberty began at 11.5 years in boys and 9.7 in girls, with about a third having high TSH at puberty onset.

33048836.takeaway: Day-3 neonatal TSH was compared between 249 babies of hypothyroid mothers and 2154 babies of euthyroid mothers.

33055295.takeaway: Array CGH in 53 patients with GH insensitivity and 10 with IGF-1 insensitivity found rare copy number variants in 13% and 30%, suggesting candidate growth genes.

33055312.takeaway: In 13 studies of 11,641 children and adolescents, higher muscle strength was associated with lower metabolic syndrome risk or fewer risk factors in 11 of 13.

33057663.takeaway: In 816 women with GDM, offspring of those treated with glyburide or insulin had higher birthweight than those given nutritional therapy alone.

33065059.takeaway: A population-based cohort in Olmsted County, Minnesota, 1995 to 2017, measured incidence, malignancy, and hormone-excess rates of adrenal tumors.

33068383.takeaway: In 70 children with CKD stages 1 to 5, serum sclerostin and osteoprotegerin did not correlate with CKD stage.

33068384.takeaway: In 55 female childhood cancer survivors, ovarian reserve markers were compared with treatment gonadotoxicity risk to identify those at higher infertility risk.

33071962.takeaway: In a cross-sectional study of Danish young adults with type 1 diabetes, CGM glycemic variability was examined against distal polyneuropathy and cardiovascular autonomic neuropathy.

33071964.takeaway: In children with obesity, the FGF21-to-adiponectin ratio was higher with NAFLD at baseline and was tracked against MRI liver fat over six months.

33071971.takeaway: In 51 people from T1D multiplex-sib families (40 affected), enterovirus antibodies, monocyte TLR expression, and cytokine profiles were similar between affected and unaffected siblings.

33071972.takeaway: In a mouse model of mild traumatic brain injury, chronic-phase hippocampal expression of genes for brain glucose utilization was reduced compared with sham-operated mice.

33071973.takeaway: A retrospective case series with literature review describes silent corticotroph adenomas that later became functional, including their clinical, biochemical, imaging, and treatment profiles.

33071981.takeaway: In 286 youths aged 6 to 16, carotid extra-media thickness was examined against obesity, cardiometabolic risk factors, and endothelial function.

33075770.takeaway: In adolescents with obesity, adipocytes showed impaired Rab5 expression within the adiponectin signaling pathway compared with lean controls.

33075784.takeaway: A GLP-1 agonist was used to treat diabetes in a 15-year-old with autosomal dominant WFS1-related disorder identified by trio exome sequencing.

33075820.takeaway: In 1,025,796 Israeli adolescents followed about 13 years, type 2 diabetes developed in 1.9% of those with NAFLD versus 0.3% without.

33079168.takeaway: In 44 patients with prolactinomas and visible remnant tumors who stopped low-dose cabergoline, 33 kept normal prolactin levels.

33079979.takeaway: In 27 patients with ACTH-dependent Cushing syndrome, 68Ga-CRH PET-CT was used to image CRH-1 receptors and delineate corticotropinomas.

33080613.takeaway: A 6-year-old with childhood-onset multinodular goitre and a germline DICER1 variant had a total thyroidectomy; her mother had poorly differentiated thyroid cancer and relatives had nodules.

33084177.takeaway: A nationwide Saudi survey of 632 parents and 983 teachers found 27% of students with type 1 diabetes had no help with glucose checks at school, and 12% were refused school admission.

33084185.takeaway: Prepubertal children aged 5 to 11 born very preterm had lower insulin sensitivity than term-born controls, despite improved neonatal care.

33084289.takeaway: Eight children with new-onset type 1 diabetes diagnosed during COVID-19 were followed by telemedicine, with glycemic metrics tracked over a median of 51 days.

33084351.takeaway: In 1809 children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes in the DPV registry, intermittently scanned CGM data were compared with traditional glycemic control measures.

33084373.takeaway: Commentary on a study finding improved accuracy of a second-generation 14-day factory-calibrated CGM over the first, including in hypoglycemia for adults and youth.

33087319.takeaway: In U.S. births from 2011 to 2018, maternal prepregnancy diabetes and gestational diabetes were associated with higher congenital anomaly risk; adjusted risk ratio 2.44 for prepregnancy diabetes.

33090208.takeaway: In 81 healthy men, 28 days of oral DMAU, a non-aromatizable androgen, increased the bone formation marker P1NP in a placebo-controlled trial.

33094524.takeaway: In 53 people with type 1 diabetes aged 5 to 41, left atrial strain on speckle tracking echocardiography was compared with age- and sex-matched controls.

33095039.takeaway: In 51 adults with fasting glucose above 100 mg/dL, plantar soft tissue stiffness by shear wave elastography correlated positively with fasting glucose.

33095753.takeaway: In 37 girls with Turner syndrome, urinary LH and FSH were compared with serum levels and AMH to test whether urinary FSH can indicate ovarian failure.

33095944.takeaway: In 357 Sri Lankan children with obesity aged 7 to 17, glucose intolerance and comorbidities were compared with 167 matched Swedish children to identify risk factors.

33097945.takeaway: In nine young adults with type 1 diabetes on a hyperinsulinemic clamp, the study tested whether exercise intensity has an inverted-U relationship with exogenous glucose needs.

33098093.takeaway: A retrospective review of children's MRIs from 2010 to 2018 characterized pituitary incidentalomas, including their incidence, size, location, and signal features.

33098107.takeaway: Among 1,213 patients in the GENHYPOPIT international cohort with non-acquired hypopituitarism, growth hormone deficiency affected 85.8% and was often the first deficiency diagnosed.

33098212.takeaway: A five-site RCT in children starting insulin pumps compared simultaneous pump and CGM initiation with delayed CGM, with CGM adherence over six months as the primary outcome.

33098644.takeaway: In overweight women with idiopathic intracranial hypertension, 12 weeks of the 11beta-HSD1 inhibitor AZD4017 improved lipid profiles and lean muscle mass versus placebo.

33098647.takeaway: CYP11B2 was sequenced in 62 patients with suspected aldosterone synthase deficiency to test for pathogenic variants causing congenital hypoaldosteronism.

33099993.takeaway: An overview of traditional bone age methods and newer automated AI-based programs, which reduce inter- and intra-rater variability and reading time.

33100030.takeaway: Seventeen physicians' pump setting adjustments for 15 patient datasets were compared with recommendations from the Advisor Pro decision support system.

33101191.takeaway: A 15-year-old 46,XX girl with ovarian dysgenesis carried three inherited variants in FIGLA, NOBOX, and NR5A1, and relatives showed varying residual ovarian function.

33101193.takeaway: In neonatal rats, sevoflurane's acute EEG and neuroendocrine effects were studied in relation to testosterone and estradiol, probed with pharmacologic blockers.

33101196.takeaway: Of 153 patients with MEN1-associated primary hyperparathyroidism, 1 (0.7%) had parathyroid carcinoma and 2 (1.3%) had atypical parathyroid neoplasms.

33101202.takeaway: In 10 healthy and 11 PCOS women, endocrine FGFs and fetuin-A were measured during intralipid and insulin infusions under a hyperinsulinemic clamp.

33103329.takeaway: In 229 youth with type 2 diabetes, an HbA1c above 8.5% at diagnosis carried 2.4-fold odds of uncontrolled diabetes at 5 years, and glycemic control correlated with weight loss.

33106051.takeaway: Interviews with 35 adolescents with type 1 diabetes described four social media affordances that shape how they discuss their diabetes online.

33106256.takeaway: In TEDDY children, clustering of the plasma lipidome over time identified early-onset subgroups for insulin-first and GAD-first islet autoantibody development.

33106857.takeaway: ATRX mutations were frequent in corticotroph aggressive pituitary tumors and carcinomas, based on immunohistochemistry of 30 tumors and 18 carcinomas.

33107409.takeaway: Nationwide Korean data on 1,580 patients under 20 with thyroid cancer (2004 to 2016) were analyzed for incidence trends and treatment course.

33107432.takeaway: Of 154 children with central congenital hypothyroidism found by Dutch neonatal screening, most had multiple pituitary hormone deficiencies; their clinical and genetic features were described.

33107434.takeaway: In children and young adolescents with MELAS from the m.3243A>G variant, mitochondrial DNA mutation load was measured by next-generation sequencing and related to mitochondrial diabetes.

33107435.takeaway: In a national cohort of 40 women with APECED followed to an average age of 37, pubertal development and premature ovarian insufficiency were described over time.

33107436.takeaway: Of 785 children with height below -3 SD in a screened Helsinki population, a pathological cause was found in 76% of girls and 71% of boys, most often syndromes.

33107439.takeaway: A multicentre trial in patients aged 2 to 17 compared block-and-replace with dose-titration thionamide treatment, with the primary outcome being the percentage of TSH values in range from 6 months to 3 years.

33107573.takeaway: In 172 patients with solitary T1bN0M0 papillary thyroid carcinoma treated with thermal ablation, technical success, tumor shrinkage, and safety were analyzed over follow-up up to 60 months.

33108452.takeaway: A frameshift TSH receptor variant in a child with congenital hypothyroidism was shown to be inactive because it acquires a hydrophobic degron.

33108964.takeaway: In a retrospective Alberta cohort of pregnant women on thyroid replacement before pregnancy, TSH testing and levothyroxine dose changes were examined by gestational age and linked to outcomes.

33112161.takeaway: Two statistical models estimating HbA1c from CGM and past HbA1c were developed on routinely collected data from people with type 1 diabetes in Poland and validated against the glucose management indicator.

33112259.takeaway: In 1,156 Danish women with Turner syndrome, overall cancer risk was not elevated (HR 1.04), but skin cancer risk was about doubled.

33112261.takeaway: A population-based Alberta cohort from 2012 to 2019 estimated annual incidence of pheochromocytoma and paraganglioma per 100,000 and tested case-detection algorithms.

33112263.takeaway: Seven observational studies of pubertal timing in children of mothers with gestational diabetes were narratively synthesized in this systematic review.

33112266.takeaway: In 15 adolescent boys with Duchenne muscular dystrophy on glucocorticoids, a 2-year testosterone induction regimen was acceptable, with high satisfaction and gonadotropin release.

33112267.takeaway: In two children and one adult with autosomal dominant hypocalcemia type 1, recombinant PTH(1-84) improved control of serum and urinary calcium.

33112273.takeaway: In 450 adults with benign thyroid nodules randomized to thyroidectomy or thermal ablation, the co-primary outcomes were satisfaction and thyroid-specific quality of life at 15 months.

33112274.takeaway: A review of sex steroid action in adolescence covers too little, too much, too early, and too late steroid effects, with their causes, signs, differential diagnoses, and management.

33112275.takeaway: In 73 children with Cushing syndrome, BMI z-score improved from 2.0 to 1.0 after long-term remission, but overweight or obesity persisted in many.

33112282.takeaway: In 30 patients with acromegaly after pituitary adenoma surgery, 3D facial imaging showed soft tissue improvement at 2 years, especially in those in complete remission.

33112287.takeaway: A systematic review and random-effects meta-analysis of studies on iodinated contrast before or during pregnancy assessed offspring thyroid function after neonatal exposure.

33112293.takeaway: A systematic review of 14 trials of iodine supplementation in pregnancy summarized maternal and neonatal outcomes, with pooled estimates for infant birth size and neurocognitive development.

33113160.takeaway: Adolescent boys with constitutional delay of growth and puberty grew faster than adolescents with organic GH deficiency at ages 13.4 to 14.9, and this study supplies height velocity references.

33113547.takeaway: A novel heterozygous IGF1R variant in a family with twin probands caused short stature and hypoglycemia, which improved with growth hormone and cornstarch, with altered immune phenotypes.

33117269.takeaway: In a cohort of 481 school-aged girls during puberty, TSH was associated with general and abdominal obesity.

33117274.takeaway: A review of endogenous and exogenous neurosteroids that modulate GABA-A receptors and show anticonvulsant activity in experimental seizure models, as a possible epilepsy treatment approach.

33117283.takeaway: In 60 matched trios from the Shanghai Birth Cohort, cord plasma fetuin-A was higher in both small- and large-for-gestational-age infants than in appropriate-size controls.

33117289.takeaway: In Taiwan's national insurance database, patients with hemorrhoids had a higher incidence of Hashimoto thyroiditis (5.37 vs 2.46 per 1,000 person-years) than patients without.

33117293.takeaway: A 17-year-old girl with anorexia, depression, and self-harm had primary hyperparathyroidism from a mediastinal adenoma; parathyroidectomy restored calcium and improved psychiatric symptoms.

33117295.takeaway: A review of growth faltering from emotional deprivation in children, which may involve reversible GH and HPA axis hypopituitarism, with a historical perspective.

33118654.takeaway: A Dutch guideline updated for preventive child health care gives criteria for referring short children aged 0 to 17 and tall children, using height, target height distance, and growth over time.

33119067.takeaway: A novel FSH receptor mutation found in a woman with primary ovarian failure impaired receptor activation in cell assays, compared with a trafficking-defective FSHR mutant.

33119748.takeaway: In 2,042 six-year-old children, hair cortisol concentration was tested for associations with general and organ fat at age 10.

33120384.takeaway: In 38 French children with nutritional rickets, most were young, breastfed, and lacked vitamin D supplements; bowed legs was the most common presentation.

33120421.takeaway: In 7,061 Australasian youth with type 1 diabetes followed for a median of 7.3 years, the study measured the impact of BMI on cardiovascular risk factors.

33123091.takeaway: In mildly iodine-deficient Thai pregnant women, 200 micrograms of daily iodine did not improve maternal thyroid function or child cognitive and motor development at ages 1 to 5.7 years.

33124449.takeaway: A five-year cost-effectiveness model compared AI-based retinal image screening for diabetic retinopathy in a low-income primary care clinic with standard eye examinations.

33124651.takeaway: Of 119 neonates with congenital hypothyroidism found on second newborn screening in Lombardy, 44% had TSH 5.0 to 9.9 mU/L and 56% had 10 or higher.

33124662.takeaway: Acute hypercalcemia occurred in 14 children on the ketogenic diet; the multicenter series describes presentation, treatment response, and course.

33128233.takeaway: A questionnaire survey of young people diagnosed with Graves' disease in childhood or adolescence assessed quality of life and treatment experience, using the PedsQL and a disease-specific tool.

33133020.takeaway: In 97 children with hypoglycemia, 74 hyperinsulinemic and 23 ketotic, amino acid and acylcarnitine profiles were compared with 170 euglycemic controls to identify distinct metabolic features.

33133023.takeaway: Among 1,556 TPOAb-negative Chinese pregnant women, subclinical hypothyroidism was compared across the 2011 and 2017 ATA criteria for adverse perinatal outcomes.

33135721.takeaway: In 102 patients (22.9%) with MEN1 from the Dutch MEN1 cohort, lung neuroendocrine tumors were followed for tumor growth and survival.

33135723.takeaway: In a Swedish national registry cohort, 69 of 272 women with 21-hydroxylase deficiency CAH had given birth, compared with matched controls.

33135728.takeaway: In 58 breastfeeding mother-infant pairs followed to 6 months, the brown fat-activating lipokine 12,13-diHOME in human milk was associated with infant adiposity.

33135737.takeaway: Gene expression profiling of intestinal enteroendocrine cells from 20 obese patients before and after gastric bypass identified a novel gut-derived LEAP2 fragment for metabolic study.

33136550.takeaway: In 74 acromegaly patients resistant to first-generation somatostatin analogs, the study sought predictors of response to pegvisomant and pasireotide LAR second-line therapy.

33137293.takeaway: In single-arm phase 3 trials of setmelanotide in people aged 6 and older with POMC or LEPR deficiency obesity, 12 weeks of open-label treatment was assessed for weight loss.

33140844.takeaway: In 138 neonates with random growth hormone levels, GH was lower in congenital GH deficiency, and ROC analysis was used to find a diagnostic cut-off.

33141165.takeaway: Seven males from five families with MCT8 C-terminal variants were studied functionally in cell lines and patient fibroblasts, relating variant effects to clinical phenotypes.

33141175.takeaway: In 338 adolescent and young adult cancer survivors, STRAW+10 reproductive aging stages were assessed with bleeding patterns, AMH, and FSH, and related to treatment gonadotoxicity.

33143557.takeaway: Histopathology compared radiation-associated papillary thyroid cancers from post-Chernobyl Ukraine with Fukushima and sporadic tumors, focusing on tumor architecture and invasiveness.

33145642.takeaway: A randomized placebo-controlled dose-finding study of otelixizumab in people aged 16 to 27 with new-onset type 1 diabetes assessed safety, tolerability, and beta cell function preservation.

33146763.takeaway: An equivalence RCT in people with diabetes aged 12 and older in England compared individualized, risk-based retinopathy screening intervals with usual care for safety and cost-effectiveness.

33147364.takeaway: In a retrospective review of children with congenital GH deficiency treated with rhGH, the study asked whether associated hip dysplasia or Legg-Calve-Perthes disease reflected the underlying disease or the treatment.

33147586.takeaway: A full-term neonate with severe hyperparathyroidism from a CaSR mutation was treated with cinacalcet as first-line therapy from day 2 through 18 months of age.

33150390.takeaway: In adults with aggressive prolactinomas that kept growing on dopamine agonists, six months of lapatinib 1250 mg daily was tested against a 40% tumor-shrinkage primary end point.

33150433.takeaway: In 245 long-term survivors of childhood acute lymphoblastic leukemia (median age 21.7 years), spine radiography identified vertebral deformities and their predictors.

33150438.takeaway: In 58 patients with hypoparathyroidism-retardation-dysmorphism syndrome from TBCE variants, endocrine evaluation found multiple deficiencies; all were born small for gestational age.

33151179.takeaway: A systematic review of growth hormone therapy and the cardiovascular system in Turner syndrome suggested a positive cardiovascular effect of rGH.

33156358.takeaway: In 6,337 untreated women with an OGTT at 28 weeks, continuous measures of insulin secretion and sensitivity were assessed as predictors of obstetric and neonatal outcomes.

33156813.takeaway: Of 395 children with central precocious puberty at one center over 11.5 years, 84% had isolated forms, mostly sporadic, with boys less common in the isolated group.

33162932.takeaway: A 17-year-old with Hashimoto thyroiditis had polyautoimmunity including renal tubular acidosis, celiac disease, and central pontine myelinolysis; proteinuria resolved with prednisone and potassium.

33165596.takeaway: Placentas from 24 GDM and 26 non-GDM term pregnancies showed reduced inositol in GDM, and high glucose altered placental inositol transporter and IMPA1 expression in culture.

33169899.takeaway: In 239 youth with type 1 diabetes and their parents, family-level factors such as conflict, youth autonomy, and parent support were examined as predictors of unplanned healthcare use.

33175120.takeaway: Among 95 familial papillary thyroid cancer kindreds with two affected first-degree relatives, the study compared features by whether diagnosis occurred at age 45 or younger.

33176609.takeaway: A cross-sectional survey of pregnant women taking levothyroxine at a U.S. academic center assessed their knowledge, beliefs, and treatment burden related to the medication.

33177169.takeaway: Of 1,509 children with type 1 diabetes at one center, 48% started CGM, with fewer Black children starting (31%) than White children (54%), and fewer continuing one year later.

33177174.takeaway: In 8,291 adults undergoing appendectomy or cholecystectomy in Taiwan, preoperative blood glucose was analyzed for association with hospital length of stay.

33178133.takeaway: Among 2,864 pregnant women, isolated hypothyroxinemia in the first or second trimester was not associated with significant adverse maternal or perinatal outcomes.

33178136.takeaway: A Danish couple in which the man has MEN 2A had children after preimplantation genetic testing for monogenic disorders, the first such European family.

33179818.takeaway: Fear of hypoglycemia was measured in 144 children starting pump therapy with CGM and low glucose suspend, and in their parents, at baseline and 12 months.

33179823.takeaway: Of 488 youth with type 2 diabetes or prediabetes at a tertiary clinic, 41% took immediate-release and 21% extended-release metformin, and gastrointestinal symptoms were compared across formulations.

33179853.takeaway: In TEDDY children with multiple islet autoantibodies, OGTT adherence averaged 62%, with large differences across countries and Finnish participants more adherent than those in the US and Germany.

33180035.takeaway: In 96 children with Hashimoto thyroiditis, 32 with type 1 diabetes and 64 without, the natural course and predictors of thyroid function decline were evaluated over at least three years.

33180036.takeaway: An 8.5-year-old boy with 3beta-HSD deficiency, a rare form of CAH, was diagnosed late; urinary steroid profiling and a novel homozygous HSD3B2 nonsense variant confirmed it.

33180037.takeaway: An 8-year-old girl had neonatal nonautoimmune hyperthyroidism from an inherited gain-of-function TSHR variant, D619G, and her mother had a history of hyperthyroidism.

33180038.takeaway: Using the JPA-2 model on birth-to-adult height data from 27 people with achondroplasia, the study analyzed the full postnatal growth curve, including the adolescent growth spurt.

33180039.takeaway: Medical students randomized to a simulation-based workshop on testicular volume estimation were compared with controls for accuracy and reliability on child mannequins.

33180040.takeaway: In Indian children with type 1 diabetes and their mothers, diabetes-specific distress was measured with PAID-Peds and PAID-PR and related to glycemic control and disease duration.

33180041.takeaway: In 57 women followed from early puberty to a mean age of 22.9 years, abnormal metabolic profiles were linked to obesity rather than to earlier puberty onset.

33180042.takeaway: In a retrospective single-center series of children with pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma, 68Ga-DOTATATE PET/CT sensitivity was compared with MIBG, FDG PET/CT, and contrast CT.

33180043.takeaway: In 10 patients with 19 maple syrup urine disease attacks, sodium phenylbutyrate was used in acute management, and responses were reviewed retrospectively.

33180044.takeaway: In a cross-sectional study of Colombian schoolchildren aged 6 to 10, macronutrient intake relative to dietary reference intakes was analyzed for association with cardiometabolic risk factors.

33180045.takeaway: Fractional urate excretion was used in three patients with hyponatremia to help distinguish SIADH from reset osmostat and cerebral or renal salt wasting.

33180046.takeaway: Six studies including 2,065 children with Hashimoto thyroiditis were analyzed for the frequency of papillary thyroid carcinoma.

33180047.takeaway: In 1,128 children with idiopathic short stature treated with rhGH from 1997 to 2017, scoliosis development and progression during treatment were evaluated with serial radiographs.

33180048.takeaway: A newborn with severe hyperammonemia needing hemodialysis had ATP synthase deficiency from a m.8528T>C mitochondrial variant, a previously unreported presentation.

33180049.takeaway: In 34 girls with central precocious puberty and 34 prepubertal girls, serum NPTX1 levels were independent of serum MKRN3 levels.

33180050.takeaway: An 8-year-old girl with multisystem inflammatory syndrome from COVID-19 presented with new-onset diabetes and diabetic ketoacidosis, illustrating the link between the two.

33180368.takeaway: A meta-analysis of pre-post studies of children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes at summer camps pooled changes in glycemic control, diabetes knowledge, quality of life, and anxiety.

33180907.takeaway: In 40 people with type 1 diabetes, 20 with impaired awareness of hypoglycemia and 20 with normal awareness, MRI compared structural gray and white matter.

33180931.takeaway: In a prospective cohort of 2,006 pregnant women, mild fasting hyperglycemia in early pregnancy with a normal later OGTT was linked to more neonatal intensive care admissions.

33180987.takeaway: In 107 Indian youth with type 1 diabetes diagnosed before age 21, diabetes-specific and generic quality of life were measured with PedsQL and compared with children without diabetes.

33183175.takeaway: Space-time clustering of Scottish newborn screening cases suggests that thyroid dysgenesis may be influenced by environmental factors.

33184150.takeaway: In 24 individuals with ABCC8 permanent neonatal diabetes transferred to sulfonylureas, the study assessed long-term glycemic and neurological outcomes.

33184151.takeaway: In women with gestational diabetes, a smartphone app coaching program was compared with usual care for the proportion with excessive gestational weight gain as the primary outcome.

33185480.takeaway: In 12 adolescents and young adults with type 1 diabetes, a home feasibility study tested the MiniMed advanced hybrid closed-loop system with automated correction boluses.

33185574.takeaway: A child with autistic symptoms was diagnosed with phenylketonuria years later despite a negative newborn screen, and improved on a phenylalanine-restricted diet.

33185575.takeaway: Review of how childhood obesity and metabolic disorders may impair adult male fertility, through effects on spermatogenesis, steroidogenesis, and testosterone levels.

33185576.takeaway: An online survey of 213 patients with inherited metabolic diseases during COVID-19 explored problems in accessing follow-up care after clinic suspensions.

33185577.takeaway: Two children, a 12-year-old boy and a 15-year-old girl, had Cushing syndrome from ectopic ACTH produced by thymic and appendiceal neuroendocrine tumors.

33185578.takeaway: In 77 Indian children and youth with type 1 diabetes, glycemic control, weight, and BMI were compared before and after the 2020 COVID lockdown across socioeconomic classes.

33185579.takeaway: A newborn with neonatal diabetes from a novel ABCC8 variant responded to sulfonylurea, and the same variant in two family members with type 2 diabetes showed variable phenotypes.

33185580.takeaway: Review of genetic factors in adolescent obesity, covering GWAS findings such as FTO and MC4R variants and noting that effects may differ across ethnic groups.

33185660.takeaway: The study aimed to determine the prevalence of adrenocortical carcinoma in a Spanish Lynch syndrome cohort and to characterize the tumors molecularly and histologically.

33186451.takeaway: In young Chinese men with central obesity, interrupting 6-hour prolonged sitting with walking of different intensities and durations was compared for postprandial metabolic responses in a randomized crossover trial.

33189081.takeaway: In 133 Turkish infants flagged by newborn screening for biotinidase activity, enzyme levels were compared with BTD mutation status to assess genotype-phenotype correlation.

33189082.takeaway: In 60 girls with idiopathic central precocious puberty, basal LH and FSH were measured at diagnosis and during GnRH agonist treatment to test whether a single basal LH can gauge efficacy.

33190515.takeaway: Neural network models predicting total lean and fat mass from anthropometric and demographic data were developed and validated in 18,430 US adults and children, with DXA as reference.

33191479.takeaway: In 4,155 children aged about 11 from the HAPO Follow-Up Study, newborn birthweight, adiposity, and cord C-peptide were tested for associations with childhood glucose and insulin sensitivity.

33193078.takeaway: The study examined three gene polymorphisms, IL2RA, FAIM2, and PADI4, in adolescents with autoimmune thyroid diseases to explore genetic predisposition.

33193085.takeaway: In a feasibility case-control study of 201 Belarusian women with childhood thyroid cancer (111 given radioiodine), one breast cancer occurred, in a radioiodine-treated woman.

33195955.takeaway: In two US insured claims databases, prevalence of medically managed ADHD was assessed among children and adolescents with and without congenital adrenal hyperplasia.

33195956.takeaway: Seven children and young adults with treatment-induced neuropathy of diabetes, a small fiber neuropathy triggered by rapid glucose correction, are described to raise awareness.

33196832.takeaway: A mini-review of bone effects in adolescents after sleeve gastrectomy and gastric bypass found areal BMD and BMD Z-scores decreased after all these procedures.

33197066.takeaway: Review of cerebral edema in children with diabetic ketoacidosis examines its pathophysiology, including ischemia-reperfusion injury and inflammation, and proposes a pathway for its development.

33197914.takeaway: In 79 infants with hyperinsulinism in Toronto, clinical and biochemical features at presentation were assessed for predicting transient versus persistent forms and for hospital outcomes.

33198587.takeaway: A 10-month-old girl with a de novo THRA variant was diagnosed with resistance to thyroid hormone alpha; levothyroxine produced an appropriate rise in T4 and T3 with a fall in TSH.

33203694.takeaway: The T1D candidate gene SKAP2 was linked to glycemic control and residual beta-cell function in newly diagnosed children, and knockdown increased cytokine-induced beta-cell apoptosis in cells.

33205215.takeaway: Six Chinese children with NPR2 mutations and short stature were described, with rhGH response examined alongside previously published NPR2 cases.

33205507.takeaway: In a prospective observational study of 175 children, optical coherence tomography findings were compared between children with type 1 diabetes alone and those with coexisting autoimmune thyroiditis.

33205546.takeaway: Review of pediatric diabetes practices in China, Italy, Spain, and the US reports only a single severe COVID-19 case in youth with type 1 diabetes, suggesting they are not at increased hospitalization risk.

33205572.takeaway: A structured dynamic glucose management education program was developed and evaluated at six months for time in range, hypoglycemia, and HbA1c in deprived children and young people with type 1 diabetes using CGM.

33205601.takeaway: Review of new and emerging risk factors for neuropathy in children and youth with type 1 diabetes, and the rising risk with obesity and type 2 diabetes.

33205845.takeaway: In 1,154 French children with type 1 diabetes, socioeconomic deprivation was tested as a predictor of poor glycemic control in multivariable regression.

33205857.takeaway: An online survey of 55,677 school staff in Turkey assessed knowledge and attitudes about school diabetes care, and the Diabetes Program at School's reach, with 73% having heard of it.

33215796.takeaway: In children with (n=29) and without (n=19) type 1 diabetes, accelerometer-measured physical activity was compared with pulse wave velocity, augmentation index, and heart rate variability.

33216667.takeaway: In 63 adolescents and young adults aged 14 to 24, closed-loop insulin with Tandem Control-IQ raised time in range by 13% over six months, versus a 1% decline with sensor-augmented pump therapy.

33217335.takeaway: In the EMPA-REG OUTCOME trial of adults with type 2 diabetes and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, empagliflozin's effects on first and recurrent cardiovascular events and hospital admissions were analyzed.

33219433.takeaway: In 22 adults with uncomplicated type 1 diabetes and 21 healthy adults, muscle microvascular reactivity to exhaustive exercise and circulating nitric oxide markers were compared.

33219728.takeaway: In 37 children aged 9 to 14 at a two-week summer camp, accuracy of FreeStyle Libre, Dexcom G6, and Medtronic Enlite CGM systems was compared against capillary glucose.

33220017.takeaway: A survey of 53 SWEET pediatric diabetes centers caring for 22,085 youth with type 1 diabetes found wide variation in nutrition education, which was compared with A1c and BMI.

33221858.takeaway: Whole-exome sequencing of 27 corticotroph tumors from 22 patients, enriched for aggressive behavior, identified USP8 and TP53 drivers associated with copy number variation.

33224106.takeaway: In 42,663 Uruguayan pregnancies in 2012, gestational and pregestational diabetes and maternal overweight and obesity were analyzed as risk factors for newborn macrosomia.

33226837.takeaway: In an outpatient hotel-setting study with 3 days of home use, the Tandem t:slim X2 Control-IQ system was tested for safety in children aged 2 to 5 years.
