33226840.takeaway: In a real-world prospective study of 558 adults and children aged 1 to 71 using Loop automated insulin delivery, time in range rose from 67% to 73% over six months.

33232549.takeaway: Commentary on shared socioeconomic and cultural barriers to pediatric diabetes care in South East Asia, a region with 184,100 children with type 1 diabetes.

33234054.takeaway: In 107 patients with advanced medullary thyroid cancer, Ca19.9 positivity and its doubling time were prognostic for mortality, even without RECIST progression.

33234057.takeaway: Fecal microbiota of 45 Graves' disease patients differed from 59 controls, with reduced alpha diversity and lower Firmicutes, suggesting a role in pathogenesis.

33236057.takeaway: Among 249 patients with SGA and short stature, imprinting disorders were assessed by genetic testing and clinical scoring to clarify their contribution to the Silver-Russell syndrome spectrum.

33236084.takeaway: In 278 adolescents from the EPICOM study of offspring of women with type 1 diabetes, the IGF-1 to bone mass relationship was examined, including effects of lean mass and insulin sensitivity.

33236115.takeaway: In a post hoc analysis of 316 adults with type 2 diabetes, tirzepatide's improvements in beta-cell function and insulin sensitivity were examined against weight loss.

33236116.takeaway: In 17 infants and children with pituitary blastoma, a rare DICER1-associated tumor, the study describes genetic alterations, clinical courses, outcomes, and complications across centers.

33238275.takeaway: Two siblings with acromesomelic dysplasia Maroteaux received eight years of high-dose growth hormone, and the study reports their growth velocity and final height.

33241170.takeaway: A 15-year-old with secondary amenorrhea, very low FSH, low estradiol, and an enlarged ovary was evaluated, with inhibin A testing part of the workup for an unusual cause.

33244872.takeaway: In 76 people aged 6 to 35 with new-onset type 1 diabetes, intravenous alpha1-proteinase inhibitor was tested in a randomized placebo-controlled trial for preserving C-peptide.

33245341.takeaway: In 109 children with juvenile acquired hypothyroidism matched to 100 healthy controls each, growth was tracked for five years before diagnosis to detect early abnormal growth.

33245743.takeaway: In adults with proteinuria, the risk of hypothyroidism rose directly with proteinuria severity.

33247909.takeaway: In 803 children with primary adrenal insufficiency, 85% had 21-hydroxylase deficiency CAH, and the cohort describes presentation, adrenal crises, growth, and mortality.

33247919.takeaway: In 98 adult transgender patients (65 female-to-male, 33 male-to-female), the study examined how often testosterone or estradiol alone achieved adequate gonadal suppression.

33247923.takeaway: A novel heterozygous MC4R frameshift variant found in a young boy with severe obesity was characterized functionally as a loss-of-function mutation, in screening of 209 patients with obesity.

33247926.takeaway: Experiments identified new AMH target genes in granulosa cells that promote survival, and compared their expression between control and PCOS women.

33247927.takeaway: Among 249 asymptomatic SDHx mutation carriers screened at six centers, the initial work-up detected 48 tumors in 40 patients.

33248478.takeaway: A multicentre retrospective cohort of pregnant women with pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma, combined with a systematic review, identified factors associated with maternal and fetal outcomes.

33249439.takeaway: Review of new insights into MEN1 biology, including menin's interactions with transcription factors and chromatin regulators, and clinical features, since the last guidance.

33251784.takeaway: A 2-month-old girl with Cushing syndrome from adrenocortical carcinoma was treated with etomidate after surgery left severe hypercortisolemia from liver metastases.

33252166.takeaway: In 20 children with type 1 diabetes and 20 matched controls, supraclavicular skin temperature after cold stimulation was reduced in type 1 diabetes, suggesting impaired brown adipose tissue activity.

33256547.takeaway: In Italian schoolchildren aged 11 to 13 from a national survey, the study tested whether BMI affects urinary iodine, thyroid volume, and thyroid echogenicity as iodine-status markers.

33258950.takeaway: In 26 people with cystic fibrosis and the G551D mutation, bone density and microarchitecture were studied in a prospective cohort on ivacaftor.

33259116.takeaway: A homemade water-bead insulin wallet was designed and tested for cooling efficacy as a low-cost alternative to refrigeration for insulin storage in Haiti.

33259121.takeaway: In 2,035 Swedish children with type 1 diabetes, anti-tTG antibodies at least 10 times the upper limit of normal predicted celiac disease.

33259124.takeaway: In 1,635 adolescents with type 1 diabetes and their parents, family structure was associated with HbA1c and other management outcomes, compared with living with both parents.

33259257.takeaway: In adults with type 1 diabetes, time in glucose range measured by CGM was higher on exercise days than on sedentary days during a four-week exercise trial.

33261247.takeaway: In 60 prepubertal obese children after three months of weight loss therapy, vitamin A and E status and dietary intake were analyzed alongside RBP4, leptin, and adiponectin.

33261248.takeaway: An observational cohort of Spanish girls aged 9 to 18 in primary care estimated the baseline incidence of thyroiditis before studying HPV vaccination as a possible risk factor.

33261249.takeaway: In children with autoimmune hyperthyroidism, the study described the prevalence of neutropenia before antithyroid drug therapy and tracked neutrophil counts during methimazole treatment.

33264767.takeaway: In Italian children with idiopathic premature pubarche, the study examined body weight as a factor in its onset and progression, using retrospective data from infants born 2001 to 2014.

33264775.takeaway: A 30-year-old man with McCune-Albright syndrome had severe craniofacial fibrous dysplasia aggravated by acromegaly, and died after subarachnoid hemorrhage; post-mortem findings are reported.

33267727.takeaway: In 990 Generation R mother-child pairs, maternal urinary iodine during pregnancy was examined for association with offspring brain morphology in preadolescence.

33270042.takeaway: In a retrospective international series of 544 molecularly characterized patients, the new classification of inactivating PTH/PTHrP signaling disorders was evaluated.

33271633.takeaway: In 14 children and adolescents after total pancreatectomy with islet autotransplantation, early outpatient Dexcom G6 CGM was compared with glucometer care for acceptability and glycemic control.

33272083.takeaway: An ENDO-ERN consensus update, endorsed by ESPE and ESE, graded evidence-based recommendations for neonatal screening, diagnosis, and management of primary and central congenital hypothyroidism.

33274354.takeaway: Early-treated central congenital hypothyroidism patients with multiple pituitary hormone deficiencies or isolated central CH were compared with siblings for full-scale IQ, the primary outcome, and motor outcomes.

33274355.takeaway: In 2,818 US youth aged 12 to 18 from NHANES, TSH levels were examined against cardiometabolic risk factors, and reference percentiles for thyroid function were derived.

33274381.takeaway: In a randomized placebo-controlled trial of 48 healthy young women given 10 weeks of testosterone cream, serum and urinary steroid profiles were measured to inform doping test interpretation.

33277302.takeaway: In a randomized crossover trial of 11 adolescents, an artificial pancreas with meal detection reduced 4-hour postlunch glucose exposure compared with pump therapy, detecting unannounced meals in about 40 minutes.

33277338.takeaway: In 53 newly diagnosed people with type 1 diabetes from TrialNet placebo groups, baseline circulating microRNAs were tested for association with future stimulated insulin secretion.

33278840.takeaway: In 121 newborns, the study related lymphocyte subsets to gonadotropin and sex hormone levels during minipuberty, to test an immunological role.

33280001.takeaway: In 121 mother-infant pairs, maternal and neonatal steroid hormones were examined for associations with early pregnancy endocrine disrupting chemical levels and pregnancy outcomes.

33281744.takeaway: In a population-based cohort of short children, discordance between arginine-insulin stimulation and nocturnal spontaneous GH tests depended on the cut-off level, partly due to refractoriness.

33281750.takeaway: A two-sample Mendelian randomization study using European GWAS summary statistics assessed whether maternal TSH and FT4 causally affect offspring birth weight.

33288917.takeaway: Review of how endocrine-disrupting chemicals during development alter GnRH network function, with consequences for puberty timing, fertility, and brain development.

33289242.takeaway: In 13 children aged 7 to 10 and their parents, sleep and psychobehavioral outcomes were compared between sensor-augmented pump therapy and automated insulin delivery with Control-IQ.

33290248.takeaway: Over an additional 36 months after the TODAY trial, glycemic failure and beta-cell function were tracked in 572 youth with type 2 diabetes across the three original treatment arms.

33294762.takeaway: Review of testosterone therapy in adolescent males: short-term enanthate or oral undecanoate induced puberty and growth in constitutional delay, while transdermal evidence is emerging.

33294763.takeaway: A 9-year-old girl with cystic fibrosis and five years of hyperglycemia was diagnosed with GCK-MODY from a heterozygous GCK variant.

33295608.takeaway: Review of male infertility from testicular failure, covering etiology, clinical assessment, sperm function tests, and management approaches.

33296092.takeaway: Semi-structured interviews with 15 adult women treated for craniopharyngioma in childhood or adolescence explored how the disease affected femininity and relationships.

33296095.takeaway: A systematic review of 20 papers covering 364 adults with Prader-Willi syndrome examined growth hormone effects on body composition, bone, and cardiovascular health.

33296503.takeaway: In 55 patients with mild autonomous cortisol secretion and 12 with nonfunctioning adrenal tumors, the study examined urinary free cortisol against bone formation markers and vertebral fractures.

33296519.takeaway: In 26 children aged 3 to 11 with Prader-Willi syndrome, a randomized crossover trial compared three months of intranasal oxytocin with placebo for behavior and hyperphagia.

33296530.takeaway: Sixteen 46,XX SRY-negative testicular or ovotesticular DSD patients, mostly diagnosed in the neonatal period, were described for phenotype, surgery, sex of rearing, and long-term outcomes.

33298424.takeaway: The ADA 2021 Standards of Care section on children and adolescents with diabetes provides current clinical practice recommendations for pediatric diabetes care.

33300990.takeaway: In 69 young adults, appetite-regulating hormones were reduced after oral sucrose compared with glucose, with the response shaped by obesity, insulin resistance, and sex.

33306249.takeaway: In a nationwide acromegaly cohort of 596 incident cases, sexes were similar in age at diagnosis, and a meta-analysis of 40 studies assessed sex differences at diagnosis.

33311025.takeaway: In 2,636 children from the LIFE Child study aged 2 months to 18 years, serum calcitonin was tested for age-related correlations with growth, bone turnover, and calcium homeostasis.

33313798.takeaway: Using PK/PD simulation calibrated to 26 adults and 23 children with GH deficiency, linear models for predicting weekly IGF-I from sampling days were assessed for reliability on once-weekly somapacitan.

33314616.takeaway: In Belgian and Dutch children and adolescents with T1D, executive function problems were tested as a mediator of the link between externalizing behavior and HbA1c, using parent questionnaires.

33319230.takeaway: In a population-based Catalonian cohort of 285,342 adults with hypothyroidism, comorbidity networks identified diseases that co-occur more, or less, often than expected.

33320831.takeaway: Review of gonadal dysfunction in CAH, covering testicular adrenal rest tumors in males, menstrual problems and androgen excess in females, and how hormonal control protects fertility.

33322931.takeaway: A survey of 303 parents of children with type 1 diabetes and 212 partners of adults with T1D examined whether caregiver actions with real-time CGM data sharing were linked to changes in quality of life.

33324349.takeaway: In adult male mice, antisense knockdown of ARHGAP21 increased glucose-stimulated insulin secretion, indicating it acts as an inhibitor of that process.

33325779.takeaway: In a single-arm outpatient study of 36 children aged 6 to 13.9 and adults with type 1 diabetes, tubeless Omnipod 5 with customizable glucose targets was assessed for safety and effectiveness.

33326028.takeaway: A policy perspective on gender-affirming care highlights proposed restrictions and cites Endocrine Society guidance supporting safe, effective gender-affirming interventions.

33329379.takeaway: Among 3,975 people living with HIV followed from 1999 to 2018, incident type 2 diabetes occurred at 135 per 10,000 person-years, almost twofold higher than the comparison rate.

33329382.takeaway: In 46 young people with first-episode psychosis in the UK, the cardiometabolic risk profile at onset was described in a cross-sectional study.

33329388.takeaway: Metabolic profiling of human fibroblasts distinguished glycogen storage disease subtypes I and III, showing distinct extra- and intracellular metabolic phenotypes.

33329392.takeaway: In 1,191 Chinese adolescents aged 13 to 18, higher complement C1q was associated with obesity, with analyses extended to metabolic syndrome.

33329403.takeaway: In 46 full-term neonates of mothers with or without gestational diabetes and overweight or obesity, GDM was associated with altered early gut microbiota and short-chain fatty acids.

33329405.takeaway: In 23 people with type 1 diabetes and cardiovascular autonomic neuropathy, high-dose vitamin D supplementation for 12 weeks improved heart rate variability parameters.

33331108.takeaway: In 171 Dutch adolescents with type 1 diabetes, the study estimated the prevalence of anxiety and mood disorders and examined correlates of symptom severity, including parental distress.

33331877.takeaway: In 232 people with cystic fibrosis aged 10 to 25, glucose tolerance stages were identified by a distinct pattern of beta-cell function defects.

33331893.takeaway: Systematic review of type 1 diabetes management in women across preconception, pregnancy, and postpartum, recommending near-normal glucose before and during pregnancy to reduce adverse outcomes.

33331974.takeaway: In 4,993 Finnish children with newly diagnosed type 1 diabetes, family history of type 2 diabetes was examined for links to the phenotype and genotype at diagnosis.

33334807.takeaway: In a 6-month multicenter RCT of 143 children aged 2 to under 8 with type 1 diabetes, CGM with or without a family behavioral intervention was compared with fingerstick monitoring for time in range.

33334808.takeaway: In 3,108 people with type 2 diabetes from GRADE, insulin sensitivity and beta-cell function at baseline were compared by sex and race and related to phenotypic characteristics.

33340135.takeaway: In a single-centre series of 22 patients under 20 with prolactinomas, plus a meta-analysis of published cases, tumor size at presentation was associated with management strategy.

33341813.takeaway: In 91 children undergoing growth hormone deficiency work-up, serum acid-labile subunit was evaluated alone and with IGF-I and IGFBP-3 by ROC analysis.

33343512.takeaway: Review of GDM prediction, diagnosis, management, and prevention, covering longer-term maternal and offspring risks of obesity, prediabetes, diabetes, and cardiovascular disease.

33345357.takeaway: In 69 children with syndromic features and hypoglycemia at a specialist centre from 2004 to 2018, the study estimated how often a syndromic or multisystem condition accompanied hyperinsulinaemic hypoglycaemia.

33346381.takeaway: In a prospective cross-sectional study of 108 people with CAH (52 children, 56 adults), medication adherence, endocrine knowledge, and self-management were assessed and compared with physicians' assessments.

33347563.takeaway: In a retrospective cohort of children with PTEN hamartoma tumor syndrome diagnosed before age 19, the prevalence and natural history of thyroid nodules were described.

33347565.takeaway: In a first-in-human phase 1 randomized trial of 16 healthy premenopausal women, single oral doses of the nonpeptide GnRH antagonist TU2670 were assessed for safety, pharmacokinetics, and pharmacodynamics.

33347567.takeaway: In a randomized trial of 812 term infants, vitamin D3 at 10 or 30 micrograms daily from 2 weeks to 2 years was compared for growth during the first two years of life.

33347809.takeaway: A Nordic registry-based nested case-control study examined maternal health, pregnancy complications, and birth characteristics as risk factors for thyroid cancer in offspring.

33349844.takeaway: Review of thyroid dysfunction in pregnancy covers distinguishing gestational transient thyrotoxicosis from Graves' disease, and antithyroid drug choice given teratogenicity, with propylthiouracil favored in the first trimester.

33351079.takeaway: Serum AMH measured in 271 adolescent girls was assessed as a predictor of adult PCOS in the 160 participants followed up in adulthood.

33351202.takeaway: In 31 pubertal boys with gynaecomastia followed for a median of 2.4 years, breast regression was analysed against weight change and hormone levels at presentation.

33353459.takeaway: People with thyroid hormone beta resistance had increased hepatic fat content compared with wild-type first-degree relatives, in 21 vs 22 participants.

33355258.takeaway: In an extension of a 16-week RCT in 101 children aged 6 to 13, the 22 SAP-group participants who switched to Control-IQ raised time in range from 55% to 65%.

33356514.takeaway: Among 1,334 people with type 1 diabetes across the lifespan, perceived burdens and benefits of CGM were surveyed at outpatient visits to compare nonusers and users.

33361469.takeaway: Among 63 children with primary hyperparathyroidism, infants were often asymptomatic, and about half of the cohort had a genetic cause, mostly calcium-sensing receptor gene variants in infancy.

33362708.takeaway: A mobile-app questionnaire survey of young Indian adults under 35 across 29 states assessed the risk of diabetes and its determinants, to support yoga interventions.

33362709.takeaway: In a cross-sectional study of 100 healthy first-trimester pregnant women, moderate iodine deficiency was common but did not alter maternal or neonatal thyroid function tests.

33362710.takeaway: Ten obese and ten normal-weight postmenarcheal adolescent girls aged 13 to 17 had cytokine, adipokine, and bone marker levels compared at rest and after one plyometric exercise bout.

33362711.takeaway: The study examined how biofunctional sperm parameters, such as DNA fragmentation and mitochondrial membrane potential, correlate with male age.

33362715.takeaway: Among 314 Chinese patients with pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma, 29% carried germline variants, most often in SDHB, and pathogenic variants were more likely in metastatic disease.

33362716.takeaway: In 166 children with a pathological arginine stimulation test, dexamethasone stimulation and insulin tolerance testing were compared as second-line tests for growth hormone deficiency.

33363515.takeaway: Review of chemotherapy-associated ovarian failure, covering its mechanisms, effects on ovarian endocrine and reproductive function, and fertility preservation for young cancer survivors.

33365012.takeaway: In 24 adolescents with obesity, a six-week program of endurance and resistance exercise with dietary restriction improved central hemodynamics alongside gut microbiota changes.

33365014.takeaway: In first-trimester pregnant women in Shanghai, thyroid hormone levels were compared between those enrolled before and during the COVID-19 outbreak to assess pandemic-related changes.

33367756.takeaway: Two families with germline MAX variants had pheochromocytomas and other endocrine tumors, raising the question of a new multiple endocrine neoplasia type 5 syndrome.

33367768.takeaway: Review of the approach to a virilizing girl at puberty, distinguishing premature adrenarche from other androgen sources that require exclusion.

33371796.takeaway: In a large retrospective thyroid fine needle aspiration cohort with long-term population-based follow-up, risk of malignancy was calculated for each cytology diagnostic category.

33374093.takeaway: In 121 children and adolescents with thyroid nodules, 56% of fine needle aspirates were benign and 36% indeterminate.

33374094.takeaway: The study examined initial basal and bolus rates and basal rate variability during pump treatment in children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, to inform basal setting approaches.

33374095.takeaway: In 44 patients with 46,XX CAH raised male, 95% were stage 4 to 5 virilized, and 35 underwent hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy.

33374096.takeaway: In 52 neonates with congenital hypothyroidism, time to reach target hormone levels was compared across mild, moderate, and severe groups defined by basal free T4, to guide the initial levothyroxine dose.

33374097.takeaway: Elevated pre-injection basal LH concentrations were common during GnRH agonist treatment of girls with central precocious puberty, across 587 measurements.

33377969.takeaway: Two cohorts of low-risk papillary thyroid cancer patients at an academic center compared radioiodine use before and after a policy change to defer RAI decisions for about 12 months after surgery.

33381082.takeaway: In 4,837 Chinese mother-child pairs, maternal lifestyle was examined for association with metabolic syndrome in children and adolescents, and the offspring's own lifestyle was also tested.

33381083.takeaway: In girls with Turner syndrome treated with growth hormone, insulin concentrations rose during treatment but were ameliorated by hormone replacement therapy over 10 years.

33382131.takeaway: In 128 young Black adolescents with type 1 diabetes, family conflict and neighborhood adversity were tested for association with HbA1c, including whether neighborhood adversity moderated the family-conflict effect.

33382403.takeaway: Among 148 patients with distant metastases from childhood differentiated thyroid carcinoma, 97% had papillary carcinoma, and clinical course and molecular landscape were described.

33382423.takeaway: Two children with Mitchell-Riley syndrome from RFX6 variants had protracted diarrhea associated with congenital GLP-1 deficiency; off-label liraglutide was used.

33382428.takeaway: In 111 papillary thyroid cancers, break-apart FISH for RET fusions produced false-negative and false-positive results, which were validated against RT-ddPCR and sequencing.

33383582.takeaway: In a multiethnic cohort of 716 patients with familial or idiopathic CPP, 71 had 18 different loss-of-function MKRN3 mutations, and genotype was compared with clinical and hormonal features.

33387371.takeaway: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 98 studies including 5,475 children with idiopathic central precocious puberty rated the quality of GnRH analog treatment evidence as very low to moderate.

33388776.takeaway: Review of how maternal and fetal exposure to endocrine-disrupting chemicals may disrupt the maternal-fetal environment and contribute to preterm birth and low birth weight.

33389920.takeaway: A 14-month-old with a female phenotype and 46,XY karyotype was diagnosed with 17beta-HSD3 deficiency due to a novel homozygous HSD17B3 splice-site variant.

33389921.takeaway: A 14-year-old girl had classical 21-hydroxylase deficiency together with familial hypokalemic periodic paralysis, due to CYP21A2 and SCN4A pathogenic variants.

33391179.takeaway: Review of glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis in children, drawing on the Canadian STOPP cohort to explain why pediatric recommendations should not simply follow adult guidance.

33391183.takeaway: A female infant with hypophosphatasia and few severe symptoms was treated with reduced-dose asfotase alfa, and the case reports the course of bone-targeted therapy.

33391185.takeaway: A retrospective audit at a UK teaching hospital assessed how often fasting gut hormone panels for neuroendocrine tumors gave false-positive elevated results, and their causes.

33394038.takeaway: DNA methylation haplotype block markers discriminated follicular thyroid carcinoma from follicular adenoma in a discovery set of 33 pairs and a validation cohort of 13 pairs.

33395370.takeaway: In DPV registry data from young people with type 1 diabetes, a calculated HbA1c derived from individual glycation parameters was validated for routine clinical use.

33398933.takeaway: In 77 children with type 1 diabetes, markers of periodontal disease and oral microbiota composition were examined for associations with glycemic control.

33399744.takeaway: Recommendations from the Chilean Pediatric Society's Nutrition Branch on bariatric surgery in adolescents with severe obesity, weighing developmental risks against short- and medium-term benefits.

33401879.takeaway: Narrative review of how exercise affects insulin sensitivity and beta-cell function in obese youth, to judge whether exercise alone can prevent youth-onset type 2 diabetes.

33401880.takeaway: Review of insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes in children, covering environmental and genetic drivers and how insulin resistance and beta-cell dysfunction lead to complications.

33401881.takeaway: In 54 Korean children and young adults with type 1 diabetes who started insulin pump therapy in 2016 to 2019, the durability and effectiveness of pump use were analyzed.

33401882.takeaway: In 487 overweight adolescents at a pediatric obesity clinic, the prevalence of metabolically healthy overweight was examined using metabolic syndrome criteria, along with additional metabolic indicators.

33401883.takeaway: Using Korean national survey data, the diagnostic validity of current cardiovascular risk factors for screening adolescent dyslipidemia was assessed, and non-HDL cholesterol of 145 mg/dL or more was tested as an alternative screen.

33401884.takeaway: A younger twin born at 36 weeks had subclinical nonautoimmune hyperthyroidism from an A627V activating TSHR mutation; the mother had Graves' disease treated with methimazole.

33402367.takeaway: In 284 pubertal youth aged 12 to 21 with type 1 diabetes, type 2 diabetes, or controls, the study examined how BMI relates to cardiovascular and kidney health markers.

33404325.takeaway: In 101 children aged 6 to 13 with type 1 diabetes and their parents in a 16-week randomized trial of Control-IQ closed-loop, quality of life and treatment satisfaction were compared with sensor-augmented pump therapy.

33404683.takeaway: In 7,317 genetically at-risk TEDDY children, maternal life events during pregnancy were examined for association with first-appearing islet autoantibodies, stratified by child genetic risk.

33406977.takeaway: In a cross-sectional survey of 10- to 18-year-olds across Sri Lanka, thyroid autoantibody and dysfunction prevalence was measured after 22 years of universal salt iodization.

33408220.takeaway: In a Norwegian cohort of 299 adults with childhood-onset type 1 diabetes, serum galectin-3 and other inflammation biomarkers were tested as predictors of later coronary heart disease.

33410185.takeaway: In 59 girls with Turner syndrome, leg length was disproportionately short relative to sitting height before growth hormone treatment, and this change was followed longitudinally in 30 girls.

33410917.takeaway: Across 52 US centers, DKA frequency was compared across race and ethnicity groups in people with type 1 diabetes and COVID-19.

33412749.takeaway: In 120 healthy school-aged children in Jakarta, vitamin D status and calcium, phosphate, and bone alkaline phosphatase were measured, with sun exposure and lifestyle factors assessed.

33414248.takeaway: In the ECHO Healthy Start cohort, placental insulin/IGF-1 signaling and inflammatory protein abundance were tested for association with offspring adiposity at birth and at 4 to 6 years.

33423543.takeaway: Two checklists for assessing school-aged children's insulin injection technique, built from a systematic review, were evaluated by pediatric diabetes experts for clarity, objectivity, and relevance.

33424766.takeaway: In a retrospective review of 87 children with transient or persistent congenital hyperinsulinism, adverse neurodevelopment occurred in 34.5%, and risk factors near disease onset were analyzed.

33424767.takeaway: In children from unrelated families with 46,XY DSD and MAMLD1 variants, exome sequencing and interactome analysis pointed to oligogenic inheritance.

33424771.takeaway: In Italian children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes followed by telemedicine on Dexcom G6, glycemic control improved during lockdown compared with the three months before school closure.

33424774.takeaway: In human pancreas from autoantibody-positive at-risk donors, 155 genes changed at least twofold versus controls, and 48 remained changed in established type 1 diabetes.

33431422.takeaway: Review of HbA1c targets for youth with type 1 diabetes, explaining why less stringent targets may suit children prone to hypoglycemia or without access to advanced technology.

33434161.takeaway: In a European rhIGF1 registry of 138 treatment-naive prepubertal children with severe primary IGF1 deficiency, outcomes were compared between patients with and without a Laron syndrome diagnosis.

33436401.takeaway: In RISE participants with impaired glucose tolerance or recent type 2 diabetes, OGTT glucose curve shapes were compared between 85 youth and 353 adults, with links to insulin sensitivity and beta-cell function.

33439284.takeaway: A pragmatic trial in 17- to 18-year-olds with type 1 diabetes compared a communication technology-enhanced transition coordinator with usual care on clinic attendance after transfer to adult care.

33439754.takeaway: Retrospective analysis of more than 23,000 virtual insulin pump trainings during 2020 evaluated a structured online curriculum and follow-up outcomes.

33440388.takeaway: In 84 GH-treated patients with Noonan syndrome who had at least four years of height data, long-term height gain and near-adult height were evaluated, with safety assessed in 412 patients.

33443352.takeaway: A female neonate with nonautoimmune hyperthyroidism from a sporadic germline activating TSHR V656F variant had no maternal Graves' disease and no TSHR stimulating antibodies in the mother.

33444162.takeaway: Review of why maternal ketones are avoided in pregnancy with GDM, and whether the evidence linking ketones to poor childhood outcomes, including IQ, supports that concern.

33444226.takeaway: In 325 healthy eumenorrheic women, reference intervals for 13 circulating steroids were defined across reproductive age, menstrual phases, and menopause, and compared with dysmetabolic subgroups.

33447690.takeaway: In a retrospective analysis of NIH natural history CAH laboratory data, 11-oxygenated androgens helped discriminate good from poor disease control when 17-hydroxyprogesterone and androstenedione were discrepant.

33448212.takeaway: A toddler diagnosed with papillary thyroid carcinoma at 15 months was followed long-term, and a review of published cases under five years of age accompanies the report.

33448213.takeaway: A child with fasting hyperglycemia, short stature, microcephaly, and hypoplastic kidneys had a homozygous TRMT10A variant, illustrating the value of genetic testing in syndromic diabetes.

33449080.takeaway: In 2.2 million Israeli adolescents assessed for military service, stuttering was analyzed for association with type 2 diabetes in young adulthood, using registry linkage.

33454829.takeaway: Poor glycaemic control was associated with higher risk of neurodevelopmental disorders in 8,430 Swedish people with childhood-onset type 1 diabetes.

33460392.takeaway: Across 31 centers in 16 countries, the I-CAH registry showed wide variation in glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid replacement for 461 children with classic 21-hydroxylase deficiency.

33460435.takeaway: In a population-based study of 14,993 consecutive fine needle aspirates, DICER1 hotspot mutations were analyzed in adult-onset thyroid nodules with indeterminate cytology.

33460480.takeaway: In 102 girls with idiopathic central precocious puberty who reached final height, chronological age at treatment start was the most important factor for height gain on GnRH agonist treatment.

33460482.takeaway: Review of how obesity and genetic susceptibility interact in PCOS, which often becomes apparent after weight gain in adolescence, with insulin resistance amplifying its metabolic features.

33464630.takeaway: Young women with Turner syndrome had different transition readiness than 26 controls with type 1 diabetes or a rheumatic disease.

33465046.takeaway: Over 13 years at one pediatric center, neonates at high risk of hyperthyroidism from maternal Graves' disease or nonautoimmune hyperthyroidism were studied for prevalence and course of thyroid dysfunction.

33469445.takeaway: Review of thyroid radiation doses from iodine-131 after Chernobyl, which underpin epidemiological studies of thyroid cancer and other thyroid diseases in exposed populations.

33470004.takeaway: In a Finnish register-based case-cohort study of 7,754 children diagnosed with type 1 diabetes before age 16, cow's milk allergy in infancy was examined as a risk factor.

33470020.takeaway: Providers at nine international pediatric diabetes clinics described COVID-19 adaptations to roles, workload, and care delivery, along with patient and provider challenges.

33470021.takeaway: An interdisciplinary team developed a clinical protocol for monitoring children with type 1 diabetes on low-carbohydrate or ketogenic diets, focusing on growth and bone mineralization safety.

33470492.takeaway: In 80 youth with islet autoimmunity or type 1 diabetes and controls, diet, gut microbiome composition, and short-chain fatty acids were analyzed for associations.

33470512.takeaway: In DPV registry data, 1,325 youth with type 1 diabetes and anxiety disorders had higher HbA1c (8.5% vs 8.2%) than peers without anxiety, along with more DKA and hospitalizations.

33471388.takeaway: Adding LC-MS/MS steroid profiling as a second-tier test in New Zealand newborn screening for CAH improved screening performance.

33474583.takeaway: In 2,149 genetically at-risk children in an infant feeding trial, growth measures were studied for association with islet autoimmunity and type 1 diabetes risk, including the effect of childhood overweight.

33475139.takeaway: In a Finnish population-based cohort of 238 children with persistent or transient congenital hyperinsulinism, treatment and long-term outcomes, including diabetes and neurodevelopment, were examined.

33476074.takeaway: In 179 youth with type 1 diabetes aged 12 to 18 and caregivers, a six-item short form of the diabetes family conflict scale was developed and validated in a diverse sample.

33476193.takeaway: Report of an international virtual summit on protecting people with diabetes from serious COVID-19 outcomes, bringing together clinical, regulatory, pharmaceutical, and device stakeholders.

33479058.takeaway: The first genome-wide association study of youth-onset type 2 diabetes, combining 3,006 youth cases with 6,061 adult controls across three studies, analyzed about 10 million imputed variants.

33479160.takeaway: In a prospective study, a point-of-care autonomous AI system was implemented for diabetic eye exams in youth with diabetes, assessing diagnostic efficacy, safety, and equity.

33479747.takeaway: In a nationwide Danish cohort of 567 patients with pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma diagnosed from 1977 to 2015, incidence and clinical presentation over time were analyzed.

33482002.takeaway: In 66 unrelated Argentine CAH patients carrying the CYP21A2 deletion, TNXB gene analysis was used to estimate the prevalence of an Ehlers-Danlos syndrome phenotype.

33482107.takeaway: A population-based study across 49 countries and territories examined incidence and 27-country mortality trends for thyroid cancer in children and adolescents aged 0 to 19.

33484127.takeaway: An epigenome-wide study in two Australian cohorts identified methylation sites associated with free T3, including KLF9 and DOT1L, extending knowledge of thyroid function genetics.

33484131.takeaway: In 268 patients undergoing neurological evaluation, paired serum and CSF samples were used to quantify the adipokines RBP4, PEDF, and clusterin, to assess their passage across the blood-brain barrier.

33486469.takeaway: Two unrelated patients with early-onset syndromic diabetes had DNAJC3 variants, and DNAJC3 silencing in beta cells triggered mitochondrial apoptosis.

33486470.takeaway: Pregnancies in women with a history of Cushing's disease were studied for preterm birth and other pregnancy comorbidities across French referral centers.

33486483.takeaway: Review of rapid telemedicine adoption in pediatric endocrinology during COVID-19, covering benefits, barriers, and adaptations for managing endocrine conditions.

33486538.takeaway: In a population-based Ontario cohort, the study examined how BMI influences the association between South Asian or Chinese ethnicity and gestational diabetes risk.

33488516.takeaway: In 33 unrelated Italian families with familial non-medullary thyroid cancer, the DUOX2 p.Y1203H variant reported in another family was tested for co-segregation, along with clinical and genetic features.

33488525.takeaway: In 15 women with idiopathic intracranial hypertension treated with acetazolamide, pituitary morphology and function were assessed, and both were found to be preserved.

33491925.takeaway: In parents of children with type 1 diabetes, fear of hypoglycemia and general anxiety were examined alongside attitudes toward glucagon administration.

33492396.takeaway: In a retrospective cohort of children under 19 undergoing cardiopulmonary bypass surgery, preoperative thyroid dysfunction was analyzed for its relationship to surgical outcomes.

33495291.takeaway: In a Danish register study of 1,081,993 children born from 1980 to 1998, age-specific type 1 diabetes incidence was compared across five trajectory groups of childhood adversity.

33495292.takeaway: In 157 pregnant women with type 1 diabetes from CONCEPTT, HbA1c, CGM metrics, and alternative glycemia markers were compared for predicting obstetric and neonatal outcomes.

33495846.takeaway: In children exposed to gestational diabetes in the SWIFT cohort, infant breastfeeding and sugar-sweetened beverage intake in the first year were examined for association with overweight and obesity at ages 2 to 5.

33496819.takeaway: In 354 autoantibody-positive TrialNet participants with peri-diagnostic OGTT results, those identified by Index60, 2-hour glucose of 11.1 mmol/L or more, or both were compared for T1D-relevant characteristics.

33498041.takeaway: In 15 individuals with diabetes diagnosed before 6 months of age, clinical features, molecular causes, and long-term follow-up were described from a single center.

33502018.takeaway: In 122 patients with familial partial lipodystrophy, those with LMNA variants had a higher prevalence of cardiac events.

33502062.takeaway: A quality improvement program used educator follow-up calls two weeks after starting Control-IQ hybrid closed-loop, to guide insulin dosing and behavior at a pediatric diabetes clinic.

33503638.takeaway: Review of the immunological profile and autoimmune disease risk in Turner syndrome, linking X-chromosome gene dosage and karyotype to higher autoimmunity.

33504264.takeaway: A meta-analysis of 17 studies pooled the proportion of pediatric thyroid nodules classified by Bethesda System categories, examining sources of heterogeneity.

33506160.takeaway: Three children with postprandial hypoglycemia after gastric surgery were evaluated with continuous glucose monitoring for late dumping syndrome.

33507261.takeaway: In a 31-year Finnish cohort of 1,007 youths, dietary pattern trajectories from youth to adulthood were examined for associations with adult impaired fasting glucose.

33508822.takeaway: Among 309 children given zoledronic acid, 228 for bone fragility, lumbar spine BMD Z-scores with follow-up rose a median of 2.0 SD over up to five years.

33509032.takeaway: Ten people with resistance to thyroid hormone alpha at one center were assessed for skin lesions, and the study proposes that germline TRalpha mutations predispose to cutaneous tags and melanocytic nevi.

33512267.takeaway: Review of CGM use in pregnancy with type 1 diabetes, summarizing evidence that CGM improves maternal glycemia and obstetric and neonatal outcomes.

33512496.takeaway: In 98 underweight and 56 normal-weight young Japanese women, oral glucose tolerance tests were used to compare impaired glucose tolerance and its features.

33512531.takeaway: In a large fibrous dysplasia/McCune-Albright syndrome cohort, the study tested whether the common GNAS variants R201C and R201H correlate with specific clinical phenotypes.

33513241.takeaway: A transgender woman followed in an endocrinology clinic achieved milk production in just over one month of lactation induction, which the report reviews alongside its embryological basis.

33513243.takeaway: Seven boys with aromatase excess syndrome were retrospectively followed to assess the long-term effect of aromatase inhibitor treatment.

33514269.takeaway: Using Korean national insurance data, a population-based study estimated the incidence and familial risk of Hashimoto thyroiditis among first-degree relatives by age, sex, and relationship.

33515070.takeaway: In a phase I/II randomized trial of 44 islet autoantibody-negative children at risk for type 1 diabetes, oral insulin was given from 6 months of age to assess safety and immune responses.

33515072.takeaway: Beta cells from donors with type 1 diabetes show impaired autophagy and lysosome function, with telolysosome build-up in autoantibody-positive donors; similar defects appear in NOD mice.

33516295.takeaway: In a national English audit of pregnancies with type 1 or type 2 diabetes, HbA1c and BMI were the key modifiable risk factors, and no maternity clinic clearly outperformed the others.

33519708.takeaway: Girls with beta-thalassemia or sickle cell disease who had ovarian tissue cryopreserved showed follicle density and follicle-health protein expression comparable to reference girls, supporting this fertility option.

33519711.takeaway: In living human pancreas slices from non-diabetic donors, norepinephrine and endothelin-1 constricted islet feeding arterioles while adenosine dilated them, with changes coupled to mural-cell calcium.

33519712.takeaway: A pregnant woman with non-classical CAH and acute COVID-19 was managed with stress-dose hydrocortisone and a multidisciplinary team, then had a postpartum pulmonary embolism and was discharged well.

33519715.takeaway: Pooled data from seven studies found no meaningful association between prenatal triclosan exposure and maternal free T4 or TSH, though the authors call for more replication.

33524003.takeaway: Semen quality in men with 46,XY CAH was similar to controls overall, but poor current or past hormonal control was linked to lower sperm counts and more testicular adrenal rest tumours.

33524004.takeaway: NTRK fusions occurred in 6% of Middle Eastern papillary thyroid cancers, enriched in BRAF wild-type and pediatric tumours; pan-Trk immunohistochemistry screened for them with 74% sensitivity.

33524006.takeaway: About one-third of patients with suprasellar germ cell tumours regained HPG axis function after treatment; larger tumours, panhypopituitarism and diagnostic delay predicted failure to recover.

33524127.takeaway: In 6-year-old children, higher fat mass was linked to higher BMI z-score, metabolic syndrome risk and fatty liver index; higher lean mass offset some of these markers, but only in girls.

33524128.takeaway: Higher third-trimester urinary oxidative stress markers were associated with lower birth weight, higher weight and BMI at age 4, and a higher-weight growth trajectory.

33524131.takeaway: In type 1 diabetes with asymptomatic celiac disease, a 12-month gluten-free diet did not change quality of life or self-perceived wellness compared with a gluten-containing diet.

33524144.takeaway: In children of mothers with obesity or gestational diabetes, ascending early growth was associated with higher body fat and BMI at age 5, even after adjustment for lifestyle.

33524149.takeaway: With aging, the zona fasciculata and total adrenal cortex enlarge, while the zona glomerulosa declines in men only, possibly contributing to sex differences in cardiovascular risk.

33526907.takeaway: Immune changes in intrauterine growth restriction, including altered IL-1beta, IL-4, TGF-beta and leptin signalling, may drive later type 2 diabetes, and immunomodulation may help.

33528086.takeaway: In 74 youths with type 1 diabetes in Congo, anxiety and depression symptoms were common, and quality of life was lower with low socioeconomic status, poor glycaemic control or depression.

33528087.takeaway: In 42 children with persistent congenital hyperinsulinism, over half had neurodevelopmental impairment; delayed referral and delayed diagnosis predicted worse neurological outcome.

33530089.takeaway: 11-oxygenated androgens were elevated in both premature adrenarche and premature pubarche versus controls; the two groups differed only in DHEAS, not in 11-oxygenated androgens or insulin sensitivity.

33533545.takeaway: CGM use among Czech children with type 1 diabetes rose from 38% in 2017 to 75% in 2019, and more time on CGM was associated with lower HbA1c.

33533571.takeaway: In a large DPV registry of youth with type 1 diabetes, each DKA episode was an independent risk factor for recurrence, and elevated risk persisted about four years after an episode.

33534727.takeaway: Across 18 randomized trials, vitamin D supplementation did not improve insulin sensitivity in people with or at risk for insulin resistance.

33534730.takeaway: Pooling eight trials, vitamin D supplementation reduced new-onset type 2 diabetes in people with prediabetes, with benefit seen in non-obese but not obese participants.

33535224.takeaway: Very-low-birthweight children had higher cortisol-to-cortisone ratios than term-born children, and early insulin treatment was linked to higher cortisol and cortisone, possibly reflecting lower 11beta-HSD2 activity.

33535730.takeaway: A 5-year-old boy with a 671 kb Xq23 microdeletion had microsomia, midface hypoplasia, kidney dysplasia and mild motor delay; the authors review nine similar deletions.

33537700.takeaway: Among 83 women with type 1 diabetes, 49% met Rotterdam criteria for PCOS; prepubertal diabetes onset did not change PCOS prevalence, while earlier menarche was associated with diagnosis and higher HbA1c with lower odds.

33538381.takeaway: In 43 children with diabetic ketoacidosis, optic nerve sheath diameter was highest in severe DKA at admission and fell with treatment, suggesting bedside ocular ultrasound may help flag cerebral oedema risk.

33538814.takeaway: In autoantibody-negative, low-genetic-risk families with clinically diagnosed type 1 diabetes, exome sequencing found actionable monogenic variants in 41-48%, including WFS1 variants, supporting broader screening.

33539513.takeaway: In 494 Chilean boys followed from birth, obesity at ages 4 to 7 and higher childhood BMI were associated with precocious gonadarche, and higher BMI with earlier testicular enlargement.

33541031.takeaway: In 10 healthy children and adolescents, high-dose cosyntropin raised plasma VEGF, while low-dose did not, a finding the authors suggest may bear on ACTH's protective effects on bone.

33542703.takeaway: Morning salivary cortisol was lower in children with obstructive sleep apnoea than in healthy controls, while cortisol did not differ between adults with and without sleep apnoea.

33542704.takeaway: In 180 women aged 18 to 40, detectable urinary bisphenol C was linked to smaller thyroid volume and higher TSH, while other bisphenol analogues showed no thyroid associations.

33543815.takeaway: In the TRIGR birth cohort, higher proportions of pentadecanoic, heptadecanoic, stearic and conjugated linoleic acids in serum were associated with greater risk of islet autoimmunity; n-3 fatty acids were not consistently associated.

33544017.takeaway: In Colorado in 2020, SARS-CoV-2 antibody prevalence in children and adults with type 1 diabetes did not differ from the general population, with no sign of higher infection in new-onset youth.

33544169.takeaway: In a Swedish national case-control study, children born large for gestational age had higher odds of type 1 diabetes (adjusted OR 1.16), and those born small for gestational age had lower odds (OR 0.76).

33544418.takeaway: Among 47 children with secondary adrenal insufficiency, comorbid diabetes insipidus was linked to more admissions, longer stays and less stress-dose steroid use during acute illness.

33544498.takeaway: A girl born small for gestational age with a 15q26 terminal deletion including IGF1R had no catch-up growth on recombinant GH despite elevated IGF-1, suggesting IGF-1 resistance.

33544538.takeaway: In U.S. pediatric admissions for DKA or severe diabetes, adolescents with comorbid depression or anxiety had longer stays and higher mean charges than those without.

33544539.takeaway: In 267 children with diabetes, more frequent electronic or telephone contact with the team between visits was associated with lower HbA1c, with a threshold near three contacts a year.

33544540.takeaway: In 596 rural middle-school students in Hangzhou, thyroid volume correlated most strongly with body surface area, and the authors recommend BSA as a reference standard.

33544541.takeaway: A patient with compound heterozygous SLC25A19 variants had bilateral striatal necrosis and polyneuropathy; the authors recommend early high-dose thiamine for any patient with Leigh-like features.

33544542.takeaway: Abdominal obesity by waist circumference among Chinese children aged 6 to 17 rose from 5.0% in 1993 to 19.3% in 2015, based on repeated national survey data.

33544543.takeaway: In 25 obese children compared with 18 healthy controls, foveal thickness and foveal and choriocapillaris vessel densities were higher, while corneal endothelial morphology was similar.

33544544.takeaway: Serbia's nationwide data for 2000 to 2019 gave a youth type 1 diabetes prevalence of 135 per 100,000, with 36% presenting in DKA and a yearly rise in new DKA cases.

33544545.takeaway: In 42 Indian school teachers, a structured education program lowered fear-of-hypoglycaemia scores and increased willingness to have a child with type 1 diabetes in class, though gains partly faded by 3 months.

33544546.takeaway: In 368 rural youths with type 1 diabetes, living farther from the clinic was linked to lower odds of quarterly visit adherence, though distance was not associated with HbA1c.

33544547.takeaway: In 105 children diagnosed before age 5, those on insulin pump therapy had lower HbA1c and higher height SDS at puberty completion than those on injections, without higher BMI.

33544860.takeaway: In 50 preterm infants, higher leptin intake from breast milk was associated with greater weight gain and higher weight z-scores at 36 weeks, while insulin intake showed no association with growth.

33548099.takeaway: In 224 children with obesity, abdominal adiposity and fat mass tracked more closely with insulin resistance than BMI or body fat percentage, suggesting waist circumference and fat mass deserve more attention.

33550441.takeaway: The DCCT showed intensive insulin therapy markedly reduced early complications, and EDIC follow-up showed a metabolic memory effect that lowered later cardiovascular events and mortality.

33550442.takeaway: This review summarises evidence on glucose control and quality of life for hybrid and dual-hormone closed-loop insulin systems, along with issues in training and clinical adoption.

33550653.takeaway: In 45 patients with 45,X/46,XY mosaicism, growth hormone treatment was associated with better adult height than pre-treatment height, and patients with genital anomalies had a germ cell tumour risk.

33551988.takeaway: In 485 Kazakh patients with papillary thyroid cancer and 1,008 controls, five of eight common SNPs were associated with risk, with the genetic component estimated at 30 to 40%.

33551995.takeaway: In 211 medical students with a mean age of 20, most had vitamin D deficiency, females had poorer calcaneal bone quality, and body and visceral fat percentages were the main negative predictors.

33563657.takeaway: Virgin beta cells at the islet periphery proliferate at rates similar to mature beta cells and turn over slowly, so they do not disproportionately sustain adult beta-cell mass.

33564173.takeaway: This review updates management of MEN1-related tumours, including tailored biochemical and imaging screening for carriers, and covers MEN1 manifestations in children and adolescents.

33565749.takeaway: In six patients with genetically confirmed familial hypomagnesemia with secondary hypocalcaemia, long-term outcome was good with early diagnosis and adherence, though learning difficulties and ADHD were observed.

33565750.takeaway: In 52 Turkish children with Prader-Willi syndrome, growth hormone started in 40% raised height SDS over two years without changing BMI SDS, possibly because treatment began at an older age.

33565751.takeaway: Serum midkine was higher in children with type 1 diabetes with or without microalbuminuria than in controls, and a 1512 pg/mL cutoff predicted microalbuminuria with 96% sensitivity and 92% specificity.

33565752.takeaway: Targeted sequencing of 20 monogenic diabetes genes in 61 Turkish patients found pathogenic variants in 47.5%, with GCK the leading cause of MODY and many novel variants.

33566134.takeaway: Across 383 hyperinsulinaemic-hypoglycaemic clamp studies, insulin dose, hypoglycaemic steps, nadirs and duration varied widely, and key methodological information was missing in 62% of articles.

33566729.takeaway: Across 22 SWEET centres, mean HbA1c in youth with type 1 diabetes improved from 8.4% to 7.9% over 10 years, alongside rising pump and sensor use and less severe hypoglycaemia.

33567069.takeaway: Among 1775 young adults aged 18 to 30 in the T1D Exchange registry, five HbA1c trajectories emerged, with low or declining HbA1c linked to male sex, higher education, nonsmoking and more frequent glucose checks.

33567430.takeaway: In 38 adolescent monozygotic twin pairs with birthweight differences, the formerly smaller twins had lower psychological well-being on self-report and more psychological difficulties per parents.

33567442.takeaway: In 512 short children, starting with the clonidine stimulation test gave fewer divergent results and a lower error rate than starting with glucagon, which may spare a second provocative test.

33568403.takeaway: Children with early-onset type 1 diabetes had smaller brain volumes and lower IQ than controls at ages 6 to 12, with gaps persisting or widening and linked to lifelong hyperglycaemia.

33569631.takeaway: Variants impairing beta-cell insulin secretion appear to lower birthweight and raise adult type 2 diabetes risk, while maternal intrauterine effects are being examined as an alternative explanation.

33570564.takeaway: Likely pathogenic collagen gene variants were found in 11.5% of 87 children with familial short stature treated with GH, and affected children's growth velocity rose from 5.3 to 8.7 cm/year.

33571362.takeaway: In 37,702 children treated with growth hormone in Europe and the USA, the authors found no indication of increased mortality or of adverse event incidence rising with dose.

33576551.takeaway: In 36 children aged 3 to 14 who switched to AndroidAPS hybrid closed loop, time in range rose and HbA1c fell, with no severe hypoglycaemia or DKA; the authors call for prospective validation.

33577728.takeaway: A 16-month-old girl with COVID-19 developed transient benign hyperphosphatasemia, with alkaline phosphatase normalising within a month, so the authors advise considering it when ALP rises in COVID-19.

33579715.takeaway: In people with type 1 diabetes aged 7 to 80, the MiniMed hybrid closed loop raised time in range by 12.5 points over predictive low-glucose suspend, with less time below 3.9 mmol/L.

33581701.takeaway: In 11 children with 19 episodes of non-diabetic ketoacidosis, most needed intensive care, six had death or neurodevelopmental impairment, and inborn errors of metabolism accounted for seven cases.

33581702.takeaway: In 1411 adolescents aged 10 to 17, overweight or obesity was the main cardiometabolic risk factor regardless of sleep or TV time, and the association was strongest in younger adolescents.

33581703.takeaway: Among 201 Ghanaian adolescent students, obesity prevalence was 15.8% overall and 27.7% in females, and diastolic blood pressure was the only cardiometabolic risk factor significantly associated with obesity.

33581704.takeaway: In 80 obese youths aged 10 to 18, copeptin was associated with masked hypertension but not with metabolic syndrome, suggesting it may help identify masked hypertension.

33581705.takeaway: In 148 obese children, acanthosis nigricans was present in 40% and was strongly associated with metabolic syndrome, making this skin sign a useful clinical marker.

33581706.takeaway: In 114 patients with phenylketonuria, tyrosine was subnormal, and switching to slow-release amino acid therapy normalised morning fasting tyrosine while phenylalanine control was unchanged.

33581707.takeaway: In 60 youths with type 1 diabetes, those who developed microvascular complications had higher long-term HbA1c variability than matched patients without complications, despite similar mean HbA1c.

33584534.takeaway: In a secondary analysis of a trial of 480 African American women, a conversational agent produced more progress on nutrition and supplement risks than a letter alone at 6 months.

33584538.takeaway: In female mice, adrenal androgen receptor signalling was dispensable for X-zone regression during pregnancy but limited post-partum corticosterone elevation and protected cortex integrity.

33584539.takeaway: This review summarises evidence that pituitary stem cells may contribute to hormone-cell remodelling during growth, puberty, ageing, lactation and stress, though the evidence remains fragmentary.

33584540.takeaway: In 105 patients with silent corticotroph adenomas, ACTH-negative tumours had lower ACTH levels, more multiple microcysts and lower Ki-67 expression than ACTH-positive tumours.

33584544.takeaway: In 23 patients diagnosed under age 21 with pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma, tumours were often extra-adrenal and bilateral, seven had pathogenic mutations, and all underwent complete surgical excision.

33586301.takeaway: In Mali, registered type 1 diabetes incidence in under-25s rose from 0.12 to 0.74 per 100,000 per year from 2007 to 2016, likely reflecting better diagnosis and care, though true incidence may be underestimated.

33586921.takeaway: An 11-year-old boy with central hypothyroidism had a silent corticotroph pituitary tumour with an adrenocortical choristoma, the youngest reported case of this combination.

33595665.takeaway: Most of 185 children with new-onset type 1 diabetes had acute kidney injury or renal tubular damage, especially with DKA, and these parameters normalised within 14 days and 2 months.

33595668.takeaway: Among 1,166 Japanese junior high students, frequent passive smoking was linked to lower HDL cholesterol in boys but not in girls, with no link to total or LDL cholesterol.

33595677.takeaway: This review outlines beta-cell rescue approaches, including antigen vaccination and agents such as verapamil and GLP-1 receptor agonists, alongside management of cardiometabolic complications in established type 1 diabetes.

33596309.takeaway: In 4,312 Danish children and adolescents aged 6 to 19, fasting GLP-1 was higher with obesity and was associated with insulin resistance, dyslipidaemia and hypertension.

33597921.takeaway: In 78 patients with 82 benign thyroid nodules treated by radiofrequency ablation, the initial ablation ratio was reproducible and predicted 5-year volume reduction and retreatment, but not regrowth.

33599731.takeaway: In 1,073 adult trans men on testosterone, erythrocytosis (haematocrit above 0.50) occurred in 11%, with higher risk linked to smoking, BMI, long-acting injections and older age at starting therapy.

33600687.takeaway: In 121 children aged 6 to 11 with type 1 diabetes, inhaled insulin gave HbA1c reductions comparable to subcutaneous insulin over 12 weeks, but cough was more common with inhaled insulin.

33604962.takeaway: In a US national survey of 548 children with diabetes, those with gaps in insurance coverage were less likely to have seen a specialist in the past year (adjusted OR 0.27).

33604976.takeaway: Universal psychosocial screening of 232 adolescents with type 1 diabetes found common concerns, and psychosocial factors predicted HbA1c and insulin non-adherence; 83% completed the screener.

33605786.takeaway: Among 96 youths starting CGM, use between weeks 5 and 12 fell into sustained high, declining and sustained low patterns, with low or declining use more common in those using a receiver.

33605790.takeaway: Interviews with 18 adolescents and 19 parents on closed-loop data sharing showed that parental use of data shifted with age, and the authors recommend ground rules tailored to family dynamics and maturity.

33606014.takeaway: Among over 1,000 Chinese children with short stature, ACAN variants were found in 1.2% overall, rising to 35.7% in those with advanced bone age and a family history of short stature.

33606028.takeaway: A random forest model using sex and height at ages 3.4 to 6 years predicted adult height accurately (r = 0.87 to 0.88) in validation cohorts from Gothenburg and Edinburgh.

33606661.takeaway: Among 930 adults with NAFLD, moderate-to-advanced liver fibrosis was far more common with type 2 diabetes (31% vs 9%), and atherogenic dyslipidaemia was linked to fibrosis only in those with diabetes.

33606663.takeaway: In 34 Italian patients with transient neonatal diabetes, KATP-related cases often responded to sulfonylurea and had longer remissions than 6q24 cases; KATP genes should be tested first unless macroglossia or umbilical hernia is present.

33608768.takeaway: Among 28,245 people with type 1 diabetes in Scotland, each extra prescribed drug was linked to higher hazard of hospital admission for falls, hypoglycaemia and death, but not DKA.

33609438.takeaway: In 32 girls with central precocious puberty on GnRH analogue treatment, adiposity rose and muscle mass fell over two years, and physical functioning declined, changes not explained by self-reported diet or activity.

33613443.takeaway: Two immunocompetent patients with primary pituitary lymphoma had hypopituitarism and sellar masses; a review of 40 cases found hypopituitarism and headache most common, with diabetes insipidus in 43%.

33613448.takeaway: In 8,985 Chinese mother-child pairs, maternal TSH above 4.0 mIU/L was linked to about twice the risk of low birth weight, while TSH of 2.5 to 4.0 with negative TPO antibodies was protective.

33613452.takeaway: Among 1,226 Chinese oldest-old women, centenarians had fewer children and later childbearing than women aged 80 to 99, consistent with less and later childbearing being linked to longevity.

33613456.takeaway: A clinical prediction rule based on pituitary dysgenesis, other pituitary deficiencies and risk factors identified GH deficiency with 99.2% specificity in a validation cohort, without stimulation tests.

33616653.takeaway: In 419 mother-child pairs, greater fat mass gain from birth to about 5 years was associated with higher insulin, insulin resistance and beta-cell function at age 4.8, with glucose effects varying by ethnicity.

33617655.takeaway: Among 32 Turner syndrome patients with spontaneous menarche, about 37% developed premature ovarian insufficiency afterwards, including all with structural X-chromosome abnormalities.

33618442.takeaway: In 499 children with GH deficiency, pathogenic brain MRI findings were uncommon (7%) and rare with peak GH of 7 to 10 ng/mL (1.5%), suggesting routine MRI may be of low value there.

33618443.takeaway: In 201 children aged 7 to 15, IGF-1 SDS and total body fat predicted nutritional status, and fasting glucose and uric acid predicted insulin resistance.

33618445.takeaway: In 90 youths with type 1 diabetes, mean HbA1c fell from 8.7% before to 8.27% 9 to 12 months after CGM start, with significant falls in subgroups on injections or with baseline HbA1c above 9%.

33619125.takeaway: In 4,832 mother-offspring pairs from the HAPO study, newborn adiposity was independently linked to childhood adiposity and partly mediated effects of maternal glucose and BMI on childhood fat mass.

33619548.takeaway: In Dallas Heart Study participants, plasma ANGPTL8 varied widely and tracked with BMI, glucose and triglycerides, but a common variant that changed levels did not change these metabolic traits.

33624806.takeaway: In 33 healthy women, the NK1,3 receptor antagonist elinzanetant lowered estradiol and luteal progesterone in a dose-dependent way and prolonged cycles, without vasomotor symptoms.

33626548.takeaway: Two siblings with ambiguous genitalia carried novel CYB5A variants causing isolated 17,20-lyase deficiency; urine steroid profiling can give a pre-pubertal diagnosis, and one had testicular microlithiasis.

33626602.takeaway: Ultrasound thyroid volumes in 513 children from newborn to 18 years in the Aegean region of Turkey were mainly predicted by age and weight SDS, providing new age-based reference values.

33626630.takeaway: A survey of 72 Korean pediatric endocrinologists found transition to adult care impeded by long therapeutic relationships and few adult T1D specialists, and most called for transition protocols.

33627365.takeaway: In 133 Chinese pregnant women with type 1 diabetes, a comprehensive preconception-to-pregnancy plan was linked to a 6% severe adverse pregnancy outcome rate, versus 18% to 25% in comparison cohorts.

33627366.takeaway: In 8,556 genetically at-risk children followed from birth, the risk of multiple islet autoantibodies fell exponentially with age, from 4.3% at 7.5 months to 1.1% at 6.25 years, informing screening timing.

33628199.takeaway: In newborn lambs, delayed udder access and an oxytocin receptor antagonist both delayed preference for the mother, suggesting central oxytocin released during suckling aids early attachment.

33629571.takeaway: In 171 children undergoing thyroid fine-needle aspiration, malignancy was 23% in Bethesda III and 36% in IV, and ultrasound guidance and on-site adequacy testing cut non-diagnostic samples from 38% to 7%.

33629572.takeaway: Among 59 patients with suspected mitochondrial disease, whole-exome sequencing gave a diagnosis in 61% and targeted exome panels in 15%, and the authors favour exome sequencing as the first test.

33630047.takeaway: In 90 girls followed for 4 years, higher total body fat was linked to slower breast maturation but earlier menarche, with reproductive hormone patterns diverging by body fat in late puberty.

33630995.takeaway: A 10-year-old girl with Cushing syndrome from bilateral adrenal hyperplasia had a novel germline KCNJ5 variant and was controlled on low-dose ketoconazole, though symptoms recurred within six weeks of stopping.

33632743.takeaway: The authors advocate staged resumption of type 1 diabetes immunotherapy trials during the COVID-19 pandemic, citing precedent from oncology and rheumatology and steps to limit infection risk around infusions.

33633681.takeaway: Whole-exome sequencing of 200 Northern Chinese patients with diabetes found a rare FOXM1 variant in MODY, suggesting FOXM1 may contribute to MODY and could reduce misdiagnosis.

33633685.takeaway: In 1,167 infants, maternal gestational diabetes was linked to overweight or obesity at 1 year only in female offspring (OR 1.61).

33635825.takeaway: In 62 patients with symptomatic hyponatraemia, 150 mL 3% saline boluses gave a steadier sodium rise than conventional treatment, but overcorrection was frequent in severely symptomatic patients.

33635830.takeaway: In 87 indeterminate pediatric thyroid nodules, malignancy was 53% overall; solitary, irregular or calcified nodules and higher TI-RADS risk were associated with cancer, but these features are unlikely to change management.

33639044.takeaway: Among 63 prepubertal children with obesity and 34 controls, urinary bisphenol A was higher in obese children, and highest in those with metabolic syndrome.

33639045.takeaway: In 29 children with acute lymphoblastic leukaemia, adding vitamin K2 and D3 to chemotherapy improved bone markers such as the OPG/RANKL ratio and PICP early on, suggesting an early bone benefit.

33639046.takeaway: Among 36 children after haematopoietic stem cell transplant, metabolic syndrome was no more common than in healthy adolescents, but myeloablative conditioning and older age at transplant were linked to insulin resistance.

33640968.takeaway: In 613 pregnancies, higher third-trimester maternal DLK1 was linked to the paternally inherited fetal allele, greater maternal insulin resistance and secretion, and higher offspring birth weight.

33641278.takeaway: In Swedish infants with rib fractures, most abuse-diagnosed cases were asymptomatic and healing, and a substantial share had metabolic risk factors, suggesting some abuse diagnoses may be false positives.

33643219.takeaway: This review argues that neuroendocrine circuits timing puberty in mammals and metamorphosis in insects may share a single evolutionary origin, with many functions conserved across species.

33644620.takeaway: In 101 adolescent girls with PCOS and obesity, metabolic patterns varied by race and ethnicity: hepatic steatosis was most common in Hispanic girls and prediabetic HbA1c most common in Black girls.

33647194.takeaway: A 6-year-old girl from a consanguineous family carried two homozygous mutations, in SMPD1 and HPSE2, giving a dual diagnosis of Niemann-Pick disease type B and Ochoa syndrome.

33647195.takeaway: Of 46 girls with Turner syndrome in a Glasgow transition clinic, 72% of those transferred before 2015 remained in endocrine follow-up at 3 years, and early adult-clinic attendance predicted continued follow-up.

33647196.takeaway: In 294 US children treated with Omnitrope, height SDS rose by 1.0 over three years, with no evidence of excess diabetes, new malignancy or unexpected adverse events.

33647242.takeaway: This review presents Prader-Willi syndrome as a model of hypothalamic dysfunction, covering growth hormone deficiency, hypogonadism, thyroid, adrenal and glucose disorders, and their standard hormone replacement.

33650298.takeaway: In eight adolescent boys with type 1 diabetes, continuous and intermittent aerobic exercise lowered plasma glucose by about 5 mmol/L, while resistance exercise did not significantly change it.

33650387.takeaway: In 79 women with Turner syndrome, ovarian failure came earlier with a higher share of 45,X cells (median age 10 with 45,X vs 15 for other karyotypes), and only 9% were referred for fertility counselling.

33651452.takeaway: In 121 youths with type 1 diabetes, those with ADHD had higher HbA1c (8.3% vs 7.7%) and less time in range, with the worst control in untreated ADHD.

33653821.takeaway: In 25,654 youths in the SWEET registry, pump and/or sensor users had lower HbA1c and fewer DKA episodes than injection users, with the lowest HbA1c in those using both a pump and a sensor.

33655737.takeaway: In 18 girls with central precocious puberty, 20 weeks of GnRH analogue treatment raised fat mass index and serum leptin, while ghrelin and PYY did not change.

33658981.takeaway: This historical review traces the minimal model of glucose regulation and how insulin sensitivity, insulin secretion and their product, the disposition index, were derived and linked to diabetes risk.

33659978.takeaway: In adults with DKA, end-stage kidney disease was linked to lower beta-hydroxybutyrate, so a level above 3 mmol/L may help confirm DKA in that group.

33660485.takeaway: A 16-month-old boy with precocious puberty had been exposed to his grandfather's testosterone gel, a cause that is easily overlooked and can avoid unnecessary testing.

33662190.takeaway: A 15-year-old boy with genetic generalised epilepsy had late-onset hyperinsulinaemic hypoglycaemia; diazoxide controlled his seizures and normalised his EEG, allowing antiepileptic withdrawal.

33662191.takeaway: An 11-month-old girl with 2p duplication had severe hypercalcaemia not explained by common causes, and the authors propose the duplication as its underlying cause.

33662192.takeaway: In girls with Turner syndrome treated with rhGH, height velocity fell significantly after thyroid autoantibodies appeared, suggesting autoimmunity blunts the growth response.

33662193.takeaway: In 725 children and adolescents diagnosed in Dhaka from 2011 to 2018, type 1 diabetes was most common, and type 2 diabetes incidence rose about 12% a year.

33662195.takeaway: Among 95 youths with type 1 diabetes, lipohypertrophy was common (45%) and was linked to poor injection-site rotation, higher cytokines and antibodies, and higher HbA1c and hypoglycaemia.

33667194.takeaway: In 26 boys with constitutional delay of growth and puberty, circulating miR-30b rose about 2.4-fold over 12 months of testosterone or letrozole, a change that did not track reproductive hormone changes.

33674408.takeaway: In 11 people with severe obesity, gastric bypass changed brain responses to hypoglycaemia, with attenuated counterregulatory hormone responses and improved cognition during low glucose.

33674860.takeaway: Among 124 women aged 16 to 35 with lung metastases from thyroid cancer, pregnancy after treatment did not change progression-free or overall survival.

33675204.takeaway: An 11-year-old girl with IgG4-related hypophysitis had normal pituitary function, a biopsy confirmed the diagnosis, and prednisolone with mycophenolate gave a good response.

33675205.takeaway: In a 9-month-old with a congenital portosystemic shunt, oral sodium phenylbutyrate three times daily brought venous ammonia to acceptable levels for most of the day.

33675206.takeaway: New extended height charts for Indian children add -2.25, -2.5 and -3 z-score lines and a BMI quick-screening inset, to help define height cutoffs and screen for overweight without calculation.

33675207.takeaway: Using 1978 to 1981 national survey data for 9,695 Japanese children aged 0 to 6, the authors built the first age- and sex-specific waist circumference reference curves for that population.

33675208.takeaway: A 5-month-old infant with Graves' disease and chronic hepatitis needed thyroidectomy at 9 months, and exome sequencing suggested a possible underlying mitochondrial disorder.

33675209.takeaway: A 15-year-old girl with type 1 diabetes and Hashimoto's presented with simultaneous new adrenal insufficiency and hyperthyroidism, with severe multisystem dysfunction that improved after thyroidectomy.

33675210.takeaway: This review argues that inborn errors of metabolism can cause immune deficiency, so recurrent infections or autoimmunity in a patient with suspected metabolic disease should prompt immunological evaluation.

33675211.takeaway: In 70 infants followed through minipuberty, MKRN3 and KISS1 correlated strongly and trended upward as gonadotropins and sex steroids fell, while neurokinin B was higher in full-term than preterm infants.

33675212.takeaway: Of 46 children with newly diagnosed celiac disease, 78% had low bone density, and after six months of strict gluten-free diet with calcium and vitamin D, nine of 20 with low density normalised.

33675213.takeaway: Among 61 children aged 7 to 18, those with obesity drank less fluid, had higher urine density and more sugary-drink intake than healthy-weight peers, and were less well hydrated.

33677504.takeaway: In 57 people with classic CAH followed from childhood into adulthood, obesity, hypertension and insulin resistance were more common than in the US population, and many began before age 10.

33677588.takeaway: In a family with autosomal dominant PHP1B lacking the known STX16 deletion, the authors found incomplete loss of GNAS methylation plus a novel gain of methylation at the GNAS-AS2 region.

33679599.takeaway: In 11,875 9- and 10-year-olds in the ABCD study, perceived physical maturation and salivary hormone levels corresponded only partly, with more mature scores in children with overweight or low household income.

33679600.takeaway: In mice lacking Fgfr1 in GnRH neurons, pubertal onset and the GnRH system were unaffected, with only transient gonadal disruption at 25 days that resolved in older mice.

33679602.takeaway: A sensitive insulin assay separated congenital hyperinsulinism from ketotic hypoglycaemia with an AUC of 1.0, with optimal cut-offs of 12.3 pmol/L at glucose below 3.2 mmol/L and 10.6 pmol/L below 3.0.

33679607.takeaway: Maternal serum melatonin rose through pregnancy and fell sharply within 24 hours of delivery, suggesting the placenta is a major source of circulating melatonin.

33684919.takeaway: In 35 short prepubertal children randomised to three growth hormone doses for two years, higher doses produced a dose-dependent fall in insulin sensitivity, with higher fasting insulin and HOMA-IR.

33685073.takeaway: A boy with hyperphosphatemic familial tumoral calcinosis from a novel homozygous FGF23 mutation had deep soft-tissue calcifications successfully treated with topical sodium thiosulphate and acetazolamide.

33686483.takeaway: In 4,684 people with type 1 diabetes in Scotland who started insulin pumps, HbA1c fell by about 5.5 mmol/mol, most in those with the highest baseline levels, and DKA and severe hypoglycaemia rates fell.

33687063.takeaway: In a SEER-linked survey of 989 people with low-risk thyroid cancer, receipt of radioiodine tracked with the treating physician's stated willingness to use it and was lower when the physician saw high patient volumes.

33687345.takeaway: Primary amenorrhea warrants evaluation at age 15 without menarche, or 3 years after thelarche; hypothalamic, pituitary, gonadal and uterine causes each guide a different management path.

33687487.takeaway: In 251 treatment-naive Chinese patients with type 2 diabetes, once-weekly PB-119 lowered HbA1c by 0.7 to 1.2 percentage points more than placebo over 12 weeks, with no treatment-emergent serious adverse events.
