33689454.takeaway: In 100 children aged 6 to 13 using a closed-loop system, baseline time in range was the strongest predictor of time in range on the system, and those with the lowest baseline gained most.

33690157.takeaway: Of 12 children with autosomal recessive pseudohypoaldosteronism seen over 37 years, three died and two had severe neurological impairment, but normal outcomes were possible with intensive electrolyte management.

33691315.takeaway: In 42 youth with classical CAH, an earlier adiposity rebound predicted higher BMI, central obesity and total body fat in later childhood and adolescence, so it may flag children at higher cardiometabolic risk.

33692749.takeaway: Targeted sequencing of 19 patients with congenital hypothyroidism from dyshormonogenesis identified likely causal variants in 53%, most often in TG, giving a rapid genetic diagnosis.

33692750.takeaway: In primary human hepatocytes, chenodeoxycholic acid reduced bile acid synthesis without depending on FGF19, likely through the regulator SHP, as shown by FGF19 knockdown.

33692751.takeaway: Among English women of childbearing age with diabetes, most had at least one modifiable factor for pregnancy in 2017, and only a third of women with type 1 diabetes were prescribed hormonal contraception.

33692753.takeaway: An m6A RNA-regulator signature built from TCGA data was an independent prognostic factor in adrenocortical carcinoma, and a nomogram combining it with clinical factors predicted survival well.

33692754.takeaway: In plppr5 knockout mice with hypoxic-ischaemic brain injury, the knockout worsened injury and blunted melatonin's neuroprotective effect in some behavioural tests.

33693703.takeaway: In 33 young women with anorexia nervosa completing a 12-month trial, adding IGF-1 to transdermal estradiol gave no extra bone benefit, and lumbar BMD gain was greater with estradiol alone.

33693708.takeaway: Mendelian randomisation found no causal association between circulating galectin-3 and NAFLD, or with more than 800 other disease traits, suggesting galectin-3 is unlikely to drive NAFLD.

33693710.takeaway: Among 132 men, former anabolic steroid users had lower serum INSL3 than never-users, a difference that persisted after adjustment for testosterone, suggesting lasting impaired Leydig cell capacity.

33693776.takeaway: In 16 people with type 2 diabetes, a single 20 mg dose of gliclazide lowered glucose during an oral glucose load, augmented the incretin effect and increased beta-cell glucose sensitivity.

33693987.takeaway: In adults with cystic fibrosis, a peak glucose above 8 mmol/L during a 2-hour OGTT predicted future CFRD, and no one with a peak below 8 mmol/L developed CFRD over a decade.

33704813.takeaway: In 16 children and young adults with thyroid cancer, rhTSH preparation for radioiodine ablation gave time to progression similar to thyroid hormone withdrawal in 29 historical controls.

33704891.takeaway: In TEDDY, parents of children at genetic risk for type 1 diabetes monitored their children more after a positive islet autoantibody result, and first-degree-relative parents kept up glucose monitoring for up to four years.

33706312.takeaway: Among 94 patients with persistent hypoparathyroidism after total thyroidectomy, recovery occurred at identical rates in children and adults, and serum calcium above 2.25 mmol/L at one month predicted recovery.

33710302.takeaway: In 100 pregnancies, maternal sclerostin and sRANKL concentrations correlated with fetal abdominal fat and birthweight, with sclerostin the best positive predictor of birthweight.

33713406.takeaway: In 165 healthy pregnancies, placental weight was the main mediator linking pre-pregnancy BMI and gestational weight gain to birthweight and neonatal fat mass; metabolic mediators explained only a small part.

33715298.takeaway: Among 150 youths with type 1 diabetes in Qatar, about 10% had clinically significant depressive symptoms and 36% anxiety symptoms, rates comparable to Western countries, supporting systematic screening.

33716951.takeaway: In 196 patients with differentiated thyroid cancer, a non-stimulated thyroglobulin below 0.1 ng/mL signalled very low recurrence risk without stimulation, while stimulated thyroglobulin helped reclassify those at 0.1 to 2 ng/mL.

33716961.takeaway: This review explains how upstream regulators, including iron deficiency and inflammation, change FGF23 transcription and its cleavage, which matters for treating disorders of FGF23 biology.

33716964.takeaway: In 457 Chinese patients with primary hyperparathyroidism, bone pain was the commonest symptom, bone density rose after parathyroidectomy, and bone markers helped separate parathyroid carcinoma from benign disease.

33716969.takeaway: In 188 indeterminate thyroid nodules, ultrasound risk guided management well for TIR3A nodules, whereas for TIR3B nodules neither ultrasound nor the seven-gene panel reliably classified cancer risk.

33716971.takeaway: This editorial proposes that islet-associated B lymphocytes, whose share varies with age at onset, may interact with CD8+ T cells at sites of contact and influence beta-cell killing.

33716976.takeaway: In 50 patients with metastatic adrenocortical carcinoma given second-line gemcitabine plus capecitabine, poor performance status and a high neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio predicted shorter progression-free survival.

33716984.takeaway: This review covers diagnosing and treating growth hormone deficiency during transition, including whether deficiency persists after final height, which patients need retesting, and the relationship between GH therapy and cancer survival.

33716988.takeaway: This review finds long-acting GH analogues non-inferior to daily GH for growth velocity and body composition, but dose initiation, monitoring, safety and cost questions need long-term surveillance.

33719622.takeaway: Among 1,292 patients receiving subspecialty diabetes care during COVID-19 shelter-in-place orders, older patients, those with a non-English primary language and those with public insurance were less likely to use telemedicine.

33720320.takeaway: In 34,930 Chinese pregnancies, prepregnancy overweight or obesity and first-trimester isolated maternal hypothyroxinaemia each raised macrosomia risk, and together they acted synergistically.

33720358.takeaway: In the Odense Child Cohort, detectable butylparaben in mothers' third-trimester urine was linked to higher total and android fat percentage at age 7 in boys, but not girls.

33721341.takeaway: In 129 Chinese boys with central precocious puberty, brain MRI was abnormal in only 16%, and the rising incidence was mainly idiopathic rather than due to brain lesions.

33725720.takeaway: Men with congenital hypogonadotropic hypogonadism or Kallmann syndrome still had lower bone density and impaired trabecular microarchitecture despite long-term hormone treatment, with better trabecular bone when treatment began before age 19.

33728428.takeaway: In 44 youths with obesity in early puberty, two years of metformin improved BMI and body fat versus placebo but did not preserve insulin sensitivity or beta-cell function.

33729509.takeaway: Targeted panel sequencing of 170 children with congenital hypopituitarism in Argentina found pathogenic or uncertain variants in 15%, including in known genes and new candidates.

33729833.takeaway: Among 888 young adults with type 1 diabetes, CGM users had lower HbA1c, and the benefit was greatest in those on simpler insulin regimens without carbohydrate counting.

33730719.takeaway: In 2,657 German children, lower socioeconomic status was linked to earlier breast development and longer puberty in overweight girls, and serum LH of 0.56 IU/L best predicted gonadarche in boys.

33733019.takeaway: In young female mice on a high-fat diet, longer proestrus and estrus phases with raised progesterone appeared to limit weight gain and metabolic abnormalities.

33733020.takeaway: In a two-year randomised trial of boys with Klinefelter syndrome aged 4 to 12, oxandrolone raised bone health index above placebo, although a quarter of boys had low bone mass at baseline.

33735390.takeaway: Among 259 premenopausal women, low intake of vegetable protein, though not animal protein, was linked to lower luteal progesterone, higher FSH and about 2.5-fold higher risk of anovulation.

33735391.takeaway: Updated NHANES-based T-score references changed osteoporosis and low bone mass classification, with more femoral neck osteoporosis but fewer lumbar spine osteoporosis cases than under existing guidelines.

33737909.takeaway: In a 4-year cohort of 188 children with type 1 diabetes, pump therapy gave HbA1c about 0.7% lower than injections, with no excess of long-term complications or delayed puberty.

33737910.takeaway: Human follicular fluid and granulosa cells contained several AMH isoforms that varied between follicles of the same size, suggesting complex intrafollicular processing that complicates antibody-based AMH assays.

33738477.takeaway: Compared with 155 appropriately grown infants, SGA infants who were both short and thin had lower cord proinsulin and higher ghrelin, while wasting alone was linked to low HMW adiponectin.

33738832.takeaway: Treatment-naive boys with congenital hypogonadotropic hypogonadism had lower trabecular bone density than boys with constitutional delay, suggesting timely low-dose sex steroid replacement may help later skeletal health.

33740056.takeaway: In 537 children in the Project Viva cohort, some childhood PFAS levels were linked to slower lean and fat mass gain to early adolescence, while PFDA and PFNA were linked to more visceral fat.

33745191.takeaway: Of 25 Brazilian children with pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma, 72% had germline variants, most often in VHL, and most tumours were hereditary and multifocal.

33745199.takeaway: In 140 Egyptian children with type 1 diabetes and 90 controls, the AA genotype and A allele of IL-10 rs1518111 were linked to higher risk of type 1 diabetes and diabetic nephropathy.

33745202.takeaway: A survey of Dutch paediatric diabetes clinics found none followed all ISPAD screening recommendations, and about a third still started complication screening at age 10.

33745203.takeaway: In a 12-week study of 40 adolescent boys with type 1 diabetes, football combined with caloric control lowered HbA1c by 0.9% versus control, with no clear lipid or blood pressure changes in any group.

33745208.takeaway: Among 72 adolescents with type 1 diabetes in Dubai, mean HbA1c was 9.6%, girls reported more distress, and distress and depressive symptoms predicted each other.

33745226.takeaway: At two Alberta paediatric hospitals, DKA at type 1 diabetes diagnosis rose from 46% in 2019 to 68% during the 2020 pandemic period, and severe DKA rose from 13% to 27%.

33746902.takeaway: In SGA rats with catch-up growth, lower Lactobacillus and higher short-chain fatty acids were linked to greater body weight, insulin and cholesterol, and lower liver IGF-2 expression.

33746905.takeaway: In 484 patients with papillary thyroid microcarcinoma, central neck metastases occurred in 50% and lateral ones in 9%, with male sex, age under 40, tumours of 5 mm or more and bilaterality as risk factors.

33749217.takeaway: In 767 children treated with GH over 2009 to 2018, height SDS rose most in isolated GH deficiency and multiple hormone deficiency, treatment started late, compliance was 92%, and side effects occurred in 2.7%.

33749218.takeaway: Bisphenol A in breast milk from 80 Turkish women was low, estimated infant exposure was within accepted limits, and fast food and carbonated drink intake were linked to higher levels.

33755732.takeaway: Among 18,617 Korean children and young adults with thyroid cancer, radioactive iodine use fell from 61% to 39% over 2008 to 2018, and treatment was linked to a 1.5-fold higher risk of secondary cancer.

33755745.takeaway: In 103 women with prior gestational diabetes, a postpartum plasma miR-369-3p level improved prediction of later type 2 diabetes, raising the AUC from 0.83 to 0.92 alongside traditional risk factors.

33756487.takeaway: Two siblings with a homozygous PLK4 frameshift variant had a Seckel-spectrum syndrome with short stature, microcephaly, intellectual disability and variable eye and skeletal features.

33761284.takeaway: In interviews with 40 young adults with type 1 diabetes in the Bronx, providers acting as gatekeepers of technology access and not using shared decision-making were key barriers, while adequate Medicaid coverage helped.

33761291.takeaway: In a feasibility study of 23 Asian Indian girls aged 10 to 17, a 10-minute high-intensity dance routine reached about 80% of maximum heart rate, and participants found it enjoyable and socially acceptable.

33763027.takeaway: Among 167 patients with COVID-19, those with fatty liver disease had higher serum IL-6, and higher IL-6 at admission carried more risk of severe illness in people with fatty liver.

33763028.takeaway: In 119 Malaysian children with type 1 diabetes, 39% had been misdiagnosed first, most often as respiratory illness, and misdiagnosed children more often presented in DKA and to intensive care.

33765130.takeaway: Among 770 Turkish girls with central precocious puberty, 13.5% had abnormal cranial MRI but only two neoplasms were found, and age and LH/FSH ratio were weak predictors of CNS lesions.

33765181.takeaway: In porcine neonatal islet clusters and adult human islets, fetuin-A blocked the gain of glucose-responsive insulin secretion and suppressed beta-cell proliferation, possibly through TGF-beta signalling.

33765678.takeaway: Among 153 children with central precocious puberty, 13% had a prepubertal ultrasensitive LH, and 74% of those girls already had at least breast stage 3, so a prepubertal value does not exclude the diagnosis.

33769952.takeaway: In 43 young adults with Prader-Willi syndrome, total body BMD stayed stable over three years of GH with sex steroid replacement, though men's total body BMD declined, probably from insufficient sex steroid replacement.

33769953.takeaway: Among 2,694 people with adrenal insufficiency in the European registry, 5.5% had adrenal crises; these were not linked to cardiovascular risk factors but were linked to more infectious events.

33769962.takeaway: This systematic review of 13 studies found that pesticide exposure was linked to altered puberty timing in some studies, but evidence quality was generally low and longitudinal studies are needed.

33772303.takeaway: In a 12-month trial of 14 children with anorexia nervosa and severe growth failure, growth hormone gave greater height gain than placebo, although the difference had wide uncertainty.

33774631.takeaway: Among 194 women treated with triptorelin for precocious puberty in childhood, 1.7% reported fertility problems, and 84% of pregnancies occurred within a year of trying, similar to women without precocious puberty.

33776912.takeaway: In juvenile rats, low-dose glyphosate or Roundup increased blood-testis barrier permeability, but the effect appeared reversible, with normal sperm production in adulthood.

33776914.takeaway: An expert panel recommends insulin degludec/insulin aspart for insulin-naive type 2 diabetes with HbA1c above 8.5% despite oral drugs, and for switching regimens, citing less nocturnal hypoglycaemia and fewer injections.

33776916.takeaway: A patient with hyperthyroidism and a suprasellar mass was diagnosed with ectopic TSH-secreting pituitary adenoma, a diagnosis easily missed; somatostatin suppression testing and MRI helped, and resection gave good outcomes.

33776931.takeaway: This review describes how ghrelin, klotho and nesfatins modulate pituitary GH secretion, with GH treatment restoring klotho and nesfatins counteracting ghrelin's stimulation of GH.

33776935.takeaway: In a pilot RCT of 47 adolescents with poorly controlled type 1 diabetes, motivational interviewing by physicians did not improve HbA1c, time in range or variability more than standard education.

33776939.takeaway: In juvenile brown trout, both bisphenol A and its substitute bisphenol S caused endocrine and genotoxic effects, through different mechanisms.

33776940.takeaway: In 97 Mexican youths with pediatric-onset type 2 diabetes and 84 controls, a 10-variant genetic risk score modestly improved prediction, but BMI and maternal diabetes history predicted risk better.

33780351.takeaway: Of 668 people with DSD in the International DSD Registry, 53% of reporting centres' cases had gonadectomy, mostly for tumour risk, and it occurred later in low- and middle-income countries.

33780538.takeaway: In 115 children with differentiated thyroid cancer, tumour multifocality in the primary lobe was the only independent predictor of bilateral disease, and unifocal, node-negative children had a low risk of contralateral disease.

33780542.takeaway: In 26 patients with pseudohypoparathyroidism, 72% had intracerebral calcification regardless of subtype, PHP1A more often had Albright features and hypertension, and no renal calcifications were found.

33780546.takeaway: In a nationwide study of 88 patients with early-detected central congenital hypothyroidism, self-reported quality of life matched siblings, but parents rated quality of life lower for those with multiple pituitary hormone deficiencies.

33780640.takeaway: Across 89,834 Belgian people with type 1 diabetes treated in specialised centres, mean HbA1c fell from 8.1% in 2010 to 7.7% in 2017 to 2018, and LDL cholesterol also decreased.

33780934.takeaway: In 12 patients with steroid 17-alpha-hydroxylase/17,20-lyase deficiency, those with hypertension, atypical genitalia or family history presented early, at median age 7, while others presented in late puberty with amenorrhoea.

33782086.takeaway: In 1,729 women planning pregnancy, preconception myo-inositol, probiotics and micronutrients did not lower gestational glycaemia, although they reduced preterm births.

33783172.takeaway: In two patients with X-linked hypophosphataemia treated with burosumab, one with left ventricular hypertrophy had stable heart findings and recovered function, and both had better biochemistry and quality of life.

33783586.takeaway: In TEDDY, maternal intake of gluten-containing and other tested foods in late pregnancy was not associated with offspring islet autoimmunity or type 1 diabetes.

33784187.takeaway: In 52 people with type 1 diabetes upgraded to an advanced hybrid closed-loop system, time in range rose from 67% to 80% within a month, with no severe hypoglycaemia or DKA.

33786936.takeaway: In 73 children with newly diagnosed type 1 diabetes and 105 matched controls from Africa and Asia, detection of eukaryotic viruses in stool did not differ, with only borderline signals for endogenous retroviruses.

33788944.takeaway: In fibrous dysplasia/McCune-Albright syndrome, denosumab reduced fluoride-PET lesional bone burden in eight treated patients and lowered bone turnover markers, while untreated patients showed no significant change.

33788946.takeaway: This review explains adrenarche as an ACTH-driven rise in adrenal androgens, links premature adrenarche to obesity, insulin resistance and possibly PCOS, and notes that 5 to 10% of premature pubarche is virilizing.

33788949.takeaway: A polygenic risk score for adult height identified children who became short as adults with an AUROC of 0.84, close to mid-parental height, and combining the two improved discrimination to at most 0.90.

33788951.takeaway: Among 1,115 patients with medullary thyroid cancer, distant metastases were exceptional when thyroidectomy was done before nodal metastases developed, in both hereditary and sporadic disease.

33789280.takeaway: A critically ill adolescent with obesity, type 2 diabetes and COVID-19 presented with hyperglycaemic hyperosmolar syndrome, illustrating how hard it can be to separate COVID-19 complications from HHS.

33789298.takeaway: Post-transplant diabetes affects 3 to 20% of paediatric solid organ recipients, and its management parallels type 2 diabetes while accounting for immunosuppressant interactions and comorbidities.

33789302.takeaway: A first national peer review of 22 UK paediatric endocrine centres was feasible and gave a quality benchmark, with 43 of 54 standards met in the combined evaluation and 95% of centres finding it useful.

33794526.takeaway: This review covers fluid and electrolyte disturbances after craniopharyngioma surgery and long-term hypopituitarism, hypothalamic obesity, cardiovascular and bone complications, stressing timely treatment for quality of life.

33796066.takeaway: A 9-year-old with a suprasellar germ cell tumour and hypothalamic-pituitary failure had mild, asymptomatic SARS-CoV-2 infection without any change to replacement doses.

33796072.takeaway: This review summarises how severe, prolonged neonatal hypoglycaemia damages vulnerable brain regions through glutamate excitotoxicity and zinc-mediated cell death, and considers strategies to reduce it.

33796081.takeaway: In rats raised under constant light, Leydig cell steroidogenic and mitochondrial capacity fell most around puberty, slowing Leydig cell maturation and reproductive development.

33797780.takeaway: This review of central precocious puberty describes hypothalamic regulatory abnormalities, the role of MKRN3 and DLK1 mutations in familial and sporadic cases, and the syndromic and CNS causes that need evaluation.

33815275.takeaway: In a family with a deleterious MAX variant, four members had pheochromocytoma, and one son also had a synchronous neuroblastoma, the first such combination reported in MAX carriers.

33815276.takeaway: Among 253 children with non-CNS solid tumours, 30% developed endocrine complications, most often growth failure, obesity and gonadal failure, with high alkylating agent doses and transplantation as risk factors.

33815280.takeaway: Screening 273 Chinese children with primary congenital hypothyroidism found novel compound heterozygous SLC5A5 variants in one patient, which reduced sodium-iodide symporter expression and iodide transport in vitro.

33815293.takeaway: In 65 Chinese children with obesity, insulin-resistant children had a different gut microbiota from insulin-sensitive peers, with lower Firmicutes and higher Bacteroidetes, and some bacteria correlated with adropin and ANGPTL4.

33815294.takeaway: A Belgian expert consensus recommends wider awareness of XLH across specialties, multidisciplinary care led by metabolic bone experts, and burosumab for children with severe or refractory symptoms.

33818036.takeaway: In a survey of 75 people with lysosomal storage disorders, 35 missed enzyme replacement doses during COVID-19, mostly from fear of hospital visits, and 60% of those reported physical effects.

33818037.takeaway: In 69 healthy adolescents, a monophasic OGTT glucose curve was linked to a lower disposition index, reflecting reduced insulin secretion relative to insulin resistance, without most other cardiometabolic differences.

33818038.takeaway: On contrast brain MRI in 365 children, 21% had incidental pituitary non-enhancing lesions, most under 3 mm, with no difference in detection by field strength or sequence.

33818040.takeaway: Among 55 young people with gender dysphoria on GnRH analogue treatment, 69% exercised over an hour a week, but 74.5% reported barriers to sport, most often feeling not as good as others.

33818042.takeaway: A 14-year-old girl with Cushing's disease had asymptomatic pituitary apoplexy after a CRH stimulation test, which the authors report as the first paediatric case after such a test.

33818043.takeaway: An 11-year-old boy with autoimmune primary adrenal insufficiency had very long-chain fatty acids that suggested adrenoleukodystrophy at presentation, but normalised on repeat testing.

33818044.takeaway: A young woman had SHOX deficiency with Léri-Weill dyschondrosteosis, pseudohypoparathyroidism 1B and Hashimoto's thyroiditis, the first report of these three disorders coexisting.

33818045.takeaway: An 8-year-old boy with unilateral prepubertal gynecomastia from marked dietary soy intake fully resolved after soy-containing foods were excluded.

33818046.takeaway: Among 161 Turkish children aged 8 to 17, obese children had more social jetlag, shorter sleep and greater evening preference, and a higher Morningness-Eveningness score was linked to obesity after adjustment.

33819414.takeaway: In 33 patients with idiopathic congenital hypogonadism, exome sequencing found likely pathogenic variants in about 15% of hypogonadotropic cases and rare variants in about half, pointing to oligogenic inheritance.

33819415.takeaway: Two siblings in Turkey with infantile GM2 activator deficiency shared a novel likely pathogenic GM2A variant, and the authors warn this disease can be missed when beta-hexosaminidase activity is normal.

33819416.takeaway: Among 151 nondiabetic children aged 10 to 14, 9% had raised GGT, linked to BMI at or above the 95th percentile and acanthosis nigricans, suggesting GGT may mark type 2 diabetes risk.

33819417.takeaway: Two boys, one with type 1 diabetes and one without a diabetes history, had cutaneous or pulmonary mucormycosis treated with surgery and antifungals; the authors advise examining diabetic children with respiratory or skin lesions.

33819418.takeaway: An 8-year-old girl with familial hyperphosphatemic tumoral calcinosis had painful lesions and hyperphosphatemia improve after sevelamer and topical sodium thiosulfate were added to acetazolamide.

33819954.takeaway: This review traces how obesity-induced inflammation, driven largely by visceral adipose immune cells, promotes insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes, and lists the open questions on early immune events.

33819955.takeaway: Across 456 people with complete androgen insensitivity who had gonadectomy or biopsy, malignancy occurred in 1.3%, all after puberty, so gonadectomy may be delayed until puberty is complete with close follow-up.

33819956.takeaway: In 34 prepubertal children born small for gestational age without catch-up growth, GH raised height velocity, and younger age and lower bone age predicted a better response.

33819957.takeaway: Comparing national school health surveys of 2010 and 2018, mid-childhood heights were greater in 2018, final height in high school seniors was unchanged, and weight was higher in most grades.

33819958.takeaway: In 19 children under 7 with suspected thyroid dysgenesis, ultrasound was better at confirming a normal gland and scintigraphy at detecting ectopia, so ultrasound should be the first-line test.

33819959.takeaway: Two phenotypic females with 17-alpha-hydroxylase/17,20-lyase deficiency, one 46,XX with primary amenorrhoea and one 46,XY with a DSD, carried CYP17A1 variants including p.His373Leu, common in Koreans.

33820761.takeaway: In 1,057 CARDIA participants, older and accelerated GrimAge predicted 10-year type 2 diabetes, especially in people with obesity, and partly mediated the effect of cumulative obesity.

33822093.takeaway: Fetal zone steroid excretion in preterm infants was highest in the most immature babies, approached term levels at term-equivalent age, and fell faster in more mature preterm infants.

33822100.takeaway: In a matched cohort of 206 people with generalised or partial lipodystrophy, metreleptin was associated with a 65% lower mortality risk, though the number of deaths was small.

33823088.takeaway: In 318 Italian adolescents with obesity, girls with early menarche had higher insulin resistance and more fatty liver disease than other girls with obesity.

33823096.takeaway: In 1,175 Chinese adolescents, trunk fat mass was linked to a higher clustering of cardiometabolic risk factors, while leg fat mass was protective.

33823098.takeaway: In 19 transgender female adolescents, blood pressure did not change significantly after GnRH analogue treatment or after adding oestradiol, in a small retrospective pilot.

33823099.takeaway: In a US national cohort, continuous cardiometabolic risk Z-scores from adolescence predicted adult metabolic syndrome at seven years, with areas under the ROC curve of 0.61 to 0.75.

33823100.takeaway: In 100 children with idiopathic growth hormone deficiency, pituitary hypoplasia was the best MRI predictor of severe GHD (OR 10.8) and of multiple pituitary hormone deficiency (OR 9.2).

33823101.takeaway: In seven adolescent girls with severe obesity, liraglutide with a multidisciplinary lifestyle programme cut weight by about 5.4 kg over three months and resolved complications such as raised intracranial pressure and steatohepatitis.

33823102.takeaway: In 27 children with type 1 diabetes using intermittently scanned CGM, time in range correlated strongly with HbA1c, but individual variability was high, so CGM targets need individual interpretation.

33823103.takeaway: A 15-year-old boy first thought to have osteogenesis imperfecta was found to have lysinuric protein intolerance, identified by a multigene panel after reverse phenotyping of atypical findings.

33823104.takeaway: Nine children with vitamin D-dependent rickets type 1A carried a novel compound heterozygous CYP27B1 variant, and their clinical and laboratory features varied even among patients with the same mutation.

33823105.takeaway: Among 707 prepubertal children in Istanbul, overweight and obesity were associated with about 1.6 to 1.7 times higher odds of atopic allergic disease, with no link for underweight.

33823107.takeaway: Among 479,786 newborns screened in Quanzhou, six had multiple acyl-CoA dehydrogenase deficiency, and one atypical profile was identified only by genetic testing, supporting genetic confirmation in newborn screening.

33824142.takeaway: In Swedish and Danish registers, people with type 1 diabetes had about twice the risk of eating disorders, and a full sibling with type 1 diabetes was linked to eating disorders only in Sweden.

33826420.takeaway: Two capillary blood kits for home HbA1c testing gave results within 5% of venous samples in 96 to 99% of 240 participants aged 4 to 80, including after mailing.

33827804.takeaway: In 159 children aged 7 to 11, prenatal GDM exposure was linked to higher daily energy intake, greater food-cue reactivity in the orbitofrontal cortex when diagnosed before 26 weeks, and larger waist-to-hip ratio.

33828529.takeaway: This review examines rising obesity in youth with type 1 diabetes, how adiposity may contribute to pathogenesis and cardiovascular complications, the concept of double diabetes, and the treatment options available.

33828534.takeaway: Among 206 children who had 278 stimulation tests in one year, single basal hormone measurements could have spared many tests, up to 88% of standard-dose Synacthen tests.

33829730.takeaway: A 41-day-old girl with autosomal recessive pseudohypoaldosteronism type 1 had recurrent adrenal crises and a novel SCNN1A frameshift variant, and needed mineralocorticoid therapy.

33830237.takeaway: In 102 children with 11-beta-hydroxylase deficiency, classic cases were diagnosed earlier and had lower adult height, and steroid profiles, notably the 11-deoxycortisol/cortisol ratio, distinguished classic from nonclassic disease.

33832185.takeaway: An Eritrean infant with fetal goitre and congenital hypothyroidism carried a novel homozygous thyroglobulin splice-site variant, and levothyroxine gave normal growth and development.

33832344.takeaway: In 107 children with thyroid nodules, lowering the Korean ultrasound size thresholds for biopsy improved accuracy and reduced unnecessary biopsies, especially in children with cancer risk factors.

33837680.takeaway: In eight relatively well-controlled XLH children, switching from conventional therapy to burosumab improved renal phosphate reabsorption and reduced urine calcium, and may help prevent nephrocalcinosis.

33837779.takeaway: In 363 children with Kawasaki disease, higher triglycerides and lower LDL cholesterol and apolipoprotein A predicted IVIG resistance, and low apolipoprotein A predicted coronary artery lesions.

33837985.takeaway: In Swedish children under 7 with type 1 diabetes, mean HbA1c fell from 7.4% (2008) to 6.7% (2018) while CGM use rose to 98% and pump use to 82%.

33837995.takeaway: Among 99 Sudanese youths with recently diagnosed type 1 diabetes, 55% presented in DKA, and HLA-DRB1*03:01 showed the strongest association with the disease (OR 5.0).

33838078.takeaway: In a randomised trial of 86 youths aged 11 to 13 with type 1 diabetes, the Team Clinic shared-appointment model limited rises in emotional problems and reduced family conflict over diabetes, with HbA1c unchanged.

33838084.takeaway: Ten children with mucopolysaccharidosis differed from nine healthy peers on sensory and adaptation posture tests, supporting exercise programmes and objective balance and vestibular testing.

33838085.takeaway: Mexican males with nonsyndromic cryptorchidism had longer CAG repeat tracts in the androgen receptor gene (25.0 vs 22.7) than healthy controls, and a codon 57 deletion was found for the first time.

33838090.takeaway: This review argues provocative GH tests have low sensitivity and specificity for diagnosing GH deficiency, that obesity and sex steroids affect results, and that clinicians should weigh these factors until better tests exist.

33838091.takeaway: Among 76 boys with Duchenne muscular dystrophy, 57% of those scanned had low lumbar spine BMD, nearly all were vitamin D deficient, and longer glucocorticoid therapy was linked to lower BMD.

33838092.takeaway: Among 324 Norwegian university students with type 1 diabetes, mental and somatic health matched peers, but quality of life was lower, and good metabolic control brought it up to the level of peers.

33838095.takeaway: Among 107 million Chinese newborns screened, tetrahydrobiopterin deficiency had a prevalence of 3.8 per million, higher in eastern and northern regions, and accounted for 15% of hyperphenylalaninaemia cases in the south.

33838097.takeaway: In 50 children treated for acute lymphoblastic leukaemia, obesity developed in 43% and high blood pressure in 26% during therapy, and 14% had hyperglycaemia below diabetes criteria, so fasting glucose may suffice for monitoring.

33839769.takeaway: In 1,387 Taiwanese participants followed from ages 13 to 18, a persistently rising tri-ponderal mass index trajectory was linked to a 2.85-fold higher hazard of diabetes in early adulthood, while BMI trajectories were not.

33839787.takeaway: In a pilot RCT of 20 patients with pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma, preoperative amlodipine prevented intraoperative hemodynamic instability better than prazosin, with less hypertension during surgery.

33839801.takeaway: In 157 pregnant women with type 1 diabetes, the link between placental growth factor and birthweight depended on glycaemic control, with healthy placentas linked to heavier babies when glucose control was suboptimal.

33840156.takeaway: Among 395 children with type 1 diabetes, 23% had hypogammaglobulinaemia, and IgA deficiency was linked to infection-related hospitalisation, a first-degree relative with type 1 diabetes and neurological comorbidity.

33841332.takeaway: Across ten studies of about 7,700 pregnancies, treating mild gestational diabetes reduced macrosomia, large-for-gestational-age births, shoulder dystocia, caesarean section and preeclampsia, while raising induced labour and not changing hypoglycaemia.

33841334.takeaway: In an online survey of 1,031 women of reproductive age, 46% reported menstrual cycle changes and 53% worsening premenstrual symptoms since the pandemic began, alongside rises in low mood and anxiety.

33846745.takeaway: In 810 outpatients without pheochromocytoma, about 20% of those with high urine metanephrines also had high seated plasma metanephrines, but meticulously collected supine plasma had a false-positive rate under 3%.

33849266.takeaway: A 2-year-old girl with precocious pseudopuberty from bilateral ovarian enlargement progressed to a unilateral juvenile granulosa cell tumour, raising questions about its relation to McCune-Albright syndrome.

33849938.takeaway: Across 28,977 type 1 diabetes visits at one centre, non-English-speaking and Medicaid-insured paediatric patients were less likely to have telemedicine visits, while most groups saw little change in access.

33851524.takeaway: A 12-year-old girl with new-onset type 1 diabetes and mild DKA was found to have a Streptococcus intermedius brain abscess, and her seizures emerged as insulin treatment and ketosis improved.

33851526.takeaway: A boy with Barth syndrome and dilated cardiomyopathy had a growth hormone resistance pattern and constitutional growth delay, and his strength and body composition improved by age six with arginine, cornstarch and exercise.

33851527.takeaway: In the Rampasasa population of Flores, Indonesia, children of mixed ancestry had progressive growth failure, delayed bone age and female puberty, with low IGF-I and IGF-I/IGFBP-3 ratio.

33851794.takeaway: Among 551 children with short stature at a Jordanian referral hospital, 56% had pathological causes, most often growth hormone deficiency (32%), while constitutional delay was the commonest normal variant.

33851796.takeaway: In 73 physically active lean adolescent girls, serum sclerostin was predicted mainly by fat mass, with leptin, irisin and CTx also linked, suggesting interactions among bone, fat and muscle tissue.

33851797.takeaway: Normative Tanner-stage data from western Indian children show median thelarche at 9.4 years and menarche at 12.6 years, with menarche earlier than in their mothers' generation.

33851873.takeaway: Across 13 T1D Exchange clinics, telemedicine rose from under 1% of visits before the pandemic to an average of 95% in April 2020, then fell to 45% by August 2020.

33852230.takeaway: In 160 people with suspected monogenic diabetes, tiered testing confirmed a MODY variant in 37.5%, mostly in GCK or HNF1A, and family cascade testing found 75 additional carriers.

33852231.takeaway: Next-generation sequencing diagnosed all 35 consecutive patients with hereditary hypophosphataemic rickets in one centre, with PHEX variants in half, and the authors favour single-gene testing first when a clue exists.

33852427.takeaway: A genome-wide association study of 1,501 adults identified three loci linked to fasting ghrelin, including WWOX and GHRL, and transcriptome analysis linked ghrelin levels to GFRAL, a receptor for GDF15.

33853374.takeaway: In 212 pediatric and 114 adult insulin pump users with type 1 diabetes, frequent daily basal insulin adjustments were linked to lower HbA1c in children, but not in adults.

33854482.takeaway: In 66 women referred for oligomenorrhoea or hirsutism, SHBG below 33.4 nmol/L identified those with higher NAFLD liver fat scores, a finding replicated in 233 women referred for sexual dysfunction.

33854485.takeaway: Serum miR-375 was about 100 times higher in 68 patients with medullary thyroid carcinoma than in other patients and controls, with 93% sensitivity and 98% specificity at a cut-off of 2.1.

33855806.takeaway: In a survey of 192 pediatric endocrine providers, most relied on subjective factors rather than objective criteria when prescribing insulin pumps, and only 22% followed written guidelines.

33856747.takeaway: In 48 girls with central precocious puberty on leuprolide, predicted adult height improved in most, including those started after age 7 or treated past bone age 12, so no absolute cut-off should set treatment.

33858206.takeaway: In a vignette-based assessment of 39 US pediatric diabetes providers, 85% showed bias toward recommending technology by insurance type, and bias rose with years in practice.

33859613.takeaway: In 1,093 very preterm infants born before 32 weeks, TSH and FT4 reference ranges changed with postmenstrual age, supporting age-related cut-offs rather than a single reference range.

33859614.takeaway: In children with type 1 diabetes in Qingdao, CSII gave lower HbA1c and insulin doses than MDI, and a simulation model estimated 0.41 extra years of life expectancy at about 161,815 yuan per QALY.

33860132.takeaway: In 71 children with nonsyndromic short stature on long-term GH, bone age showed an initial catch-up of about 1.5 months a year over 6.5 years and then plateaued, with no overall advancement.

33860651.takeaway: Among 36 neonates with transient hyperinsulinism, nearly all had perinatal stress and most were diagnosed on day 1, and diazoxide was effective, although withdrawal criteria remain unstandardised.

33860652.takeaway: A girl admitted with suspected diabetic ketoacidosis was diagnosed with type C pyruvate carboxylase deficiency from a homozygous PC variant, the first type C case reported to present with DKA.

33863802.takeaway: In 199 children who developed islet autoimmunity in the DAISY study, specific phosphatidylcholine, sphingomyelin and carnitine levels at seroconversion were associated with later resolution of autoimmunity.

33864279.takeaway: This review explains that hypothyroxinaemia of prematurity is common and mostly transient, that gestation and illness affect thyroid tests, and that careful monitoring is needed to separate transient from permanent hypothyroidism.

33866697.takeaway: In 27 neonates with transient hyperinsulinism, fetal distress and higher mean daily glucose predicted a shorter time to resolution, suggesting early glucose trends may predict disease duration.

33866699.takeaway: In 332 children with overweight or obesity, an HbA1c of 5.5% or more flagged an abnormal OGTT, and adding family history and raised ALT lifted the positive predictive value from 34% to 62%.

33866703.takeaway: Two children with severe obesity who did not respond to lifestyle programmes lost significant weight and improved comorbidities after foster placement with smaller portions and more activity.

33866705.takeaway: Four children with nutritional rickets developed craniosynostosis, and those presenting late needed emergency craniotomy, so the authors urge early treatment of rickets and early identification of craniosynostosis.

33868165.takeaway: In 93 children with GH deficiency, testicular volume grew significantly during rhGH treatment but not in untreated peers of similar age, with treatment duration and dose predicting the increase.

33868167.takeaway: This review finds that non-nutritive sweeteners can alter sweet perception, gut microbiota and glucose homeostasis, but paediatric data are limited and it is unclear whether weight benefits outweigh metabolic risks.

33868180.takeaway: In 2,981 healthy Qatari adults, higher serum uric acid was associated with higher bone mineral density at several skeletal sites, although adjustment for BMI and other factors attenuated the link.

33868185.takeaway: During the Saudi lockdown, 106 children were admitted with new-onset type 1 diabetes or DKA, compared with 154 in 2019, and DKA at admission rose from 73% to 83%.

33870630.takeaway: Among 493 girls with PCOS and obesity, 23 developed type 2 diabetes over about 1,000 person-years, roughly 18 times published rates for youth without PCOS; prediabetic HbA1c at diagnosis carried a 14.6-fold hazard.

33871154.takeaway: Among 1,331 children with type 1 diabetes at a US centre, Black children had higher HbA1c, more emergency visits and hospitalisations, and less pump or CGM use than white children, regardless of insurance.

33872399.takeaway: In 388 Turkish patients with thyroid cancer and COVID-19, mortality matched age- and sex-matched controls without cancer, and radioactive iodine did not worsen severity or death.

33872421.takeaway: In 103 Japanese young adults with Turner syndrome, starting oestrogen-progestin therapy at an older age was linked to lower lumbar bone mineral density, independent of age and BMI.

33880853.takeaway: In 230 youths aged 13 to 20, those with high-risk type 1 diabetes went to bed later and slept less than controls and rated their sleep as poor, although objective actigraphy showed similar patterns.

33882198.takeaway: Three sisters with the same WFS1 mutation had different Wolfram syndrome features, and one sister's insulin need fell sharply after linagliptin was added, the first reported DPP-4 inhibitor trial in this syndrome.

33882200.takeaway: Among 36 children with diabetes hospitalised in Cairo during the first COVID-19 wave, 34 presented in DKA, half of them severe, after a delay of about three days from symptom onset.

33882204.takeaway: This systematic review of 25 studies found that delivery mode and labour pain affect neonatal TSH and thyroid hormone levels, with vaginal deliveries giving higher cord TSH than elective caesarean sections.

33882721.takeaway: Among 21,633 patients with newly diagnosed Graves' disease, women were more likely to achieve remission on antithyroid drugs, recurrence fell with each decade of age, and severity peaked in men in their 20s and 30s.

33885932.takeaway: In 8,350 Chinese adults, fetal-period famine exposure was linked to 47% higher odds of diabetes, and famine exposure and genetic risk acted additively, with the highest-risk group having about 2.6 times the odds.

33885933.takeaway: Among 156,593 people in Singapore with incident type 2 diabetes, Malay patients had the highest rates of diabetes-related lower-extremity complications, and older age, male sex and poorer HbA1c raised risk.

33886496.takeaway: In 103 children with Prader-Willi syndrome treated with GH for eight years, scoliosis prevalence of 78% matched that of 23 untreated age-matched children, so GH did not worsen scoliosis to age 11.

33886498.takeaway: A three-generation family with combined pituitary hormone deficiency carried a POU1F1 variant that drove dominant PIT-1-beta expression, a mechanism not previously linked to disease, and one member had a prolactinoma.

33886499.takeaway: In 305 patients undergoing thyroid surgery, preoperative ultrasound was highly specific and accurate for gross extrathyroidal extension (sensitivity 78%, specificity 99.7%) but poor at detecting minimal extension.

33887065.takeaway: Among 43,307 births at two Israeli hospitals, only 1.2% were small for gestational age, about half the expected rate, and most SGA children followed reached a height above -2 SDS without GH treatment.

33887095.takeaway: In 413 emerging adults with type 1 diabetes, financial stress and diabetes distress explained part of the variation in HbA1c and quality of life, with distress the strongest predictor of quality of life.

33887129.takeaway: In 38 adolescents with PCOS and 40 controls, fetuin-A was higher in PCOS and tracked with androgen levels within PCOS, independent of insulin resistance.

33887724.takeaway: This review explains that fertility preservation for prepubertal children given gonadotoxic treatment is limited mainly to cryopreserving immature gonadal tissue, and it sets out the challenges still to solve.

33887726.takeaway: Among 81 children with PTEN hamartoma tumour syndrome, all six thyroid cancers arose in children over 10, and 71% of those under 10 had normal ultrasounds, so surveillance could start at age 10.

33887744.takeaway: A meta-analysis of 11 studies, including 316 girls with central precocious puberty and 251 controls, found higher blood kisspeptin in CPP, though the authors caution it is not yet a diagnostic tool.

33887813.takeaway: In 26 patients with X-linked hypophosphataemia during the COVID-19 lockdown, burosumab patients kept hospital follow-up without infection, and telemedicine supported those on conventional treatment, though 41% of them had complications.

33889132.takeaway: This review summarises that NAFLD affects an estimated 3 to 10% of children worldwide, that insulin resistance and abnormal glucose tolerance are common in affected youth, and that NAFLD reflects metabolic syndrome.

33890108.takeaway: In children with constitutional delay, pubertal entry occurred at ages up to beyond 16 in girls and 17 in boys, challenging the view that constitutional delay is merely an extreme of normal variation.

33890111.takeaway: In 699 young adults from the Faroe Islands, life-course PFOS exposure was associated with decreased insulin sensitivity and increased beta-cell function, with the prenatal exposure association strongest.

33893822.takeaway: In a DAISY nested case-control study of 72 children who developed type 1 diabetes and 71 matched controls, linoleic and alpha-linolenic acid-derived oxylipins were protective, while arachidonic acid-derived profiles raised risk after seroconversion.

33894068.takeaway: Among 213 children with Hashimoto thyroiditis, 19% developed thyroid nodules, usually after puberty, and 22.5% of those nodules were papillary cancers, with a family history of thyroid disease predicting nodules.

33894111.takeaway: In six males with congenital hypogonadotropic hypogonadism and cryptorchidism beyond infancy, combined gonadotropin treatment brought most testes into the scrotum within about five months, with sperm counts adequate in those tested.

33900843.takeaway: In a national survey of school nurses, 46% had no prior knowledge of do-it-yourself automated pancreas systems, 82% felt children should be allowed to use them at school, and staff called for guidelines and training.

33901270.takeaway: In 279 patients with primary severe insulin resistance, hyperandrogenaemia and PCOS-like ovarian changes were common, and GnRH analogue treatment improved symptoms and lowered testosterone in all six patients treated.

33901290.takeaway: The authors argue that off-label antiobesity medication can help adolescents who fail lifestyle therapy, since few drugs are approved for adolescent obesity, illustrated by one patient developing obesity complications.

33901387.takeaway: In 113 children with obesity, those with metabolic syndrome had higher left ventricular mass index, concentric remodelling and atherogenic indices than those without it.

33902033.takeaway: A survey of 61 obesity centres found no common definition of insulin resistance: EU centres favoured the OGTT and non-EU centres HOMA-IR, and no centre used an accepted HOMA-IR cut-off.

33905344.takeaway: In SEARCH, youth with type 2 diabetes had lower fluid cognition than youth with type 1 diabetes, but this difference disappeared after adjustment for receptive language, central adiposity and depressive symptoms.

33905347.takeaway: At a US children's hospital, the share of new-onset type 2 diabetes presenting in DKA rose to 20% in March to August 2020, from 3% in 2019 and 9% in 2018.

33906420.takeaway: Age- and sex-specific reference intervals for TSH, fT3 and fT4 in 3,140 healthy children showed that puberty and BMI shift thyroid hormone levels, so both should be considered when interpreting results.

33909322.takeaway: A culturally sensitive shared-appointment programme for 57 Latino children with type 1 diabetes was linked to fewer hospitalisations and an estimated saving of about $2,077 per patient in the first year.

33909591.takeaway: A patient with Weiss-Kruszka syndrome and Kallmann syndrome carried a de novo 9q31.2 deletion that explained the craniofacial features through ZNF462 but not the hypogonadism.

33912130.takeaway: Four Chinese boys with Laron syndrome carried GHR variants, two of them novel, and these reduced GHR protein levels and STAT5 signalling in vitro.

33912131.takeaway: This review argues that endocrine-disrupting compounds may impair maternal immune tolerance, including regulatory T cell generation, and so contribute to pregnancy complications such as preeclampsia and preterm birth.

33912137.takeaway: Across 843 children in two Chinese hospitals and a review of published data, mean HbA1c rose as national income fell, from 8.2% in high-income countries to 10.1% in low-income countries.

33912981.takeaway: Tertiary lymphoid organs were found in human type 1 diabetes pancreases, resembling those in NOD mice; 12 of 21 donors with insulitis had them, mostly near insulin-containing islets.

33913305.takeaway: Urinary LH measured by a luminometric assay correlated well with Tanner stage in healthy girls and boys and detected the transition from prepuberty to puberty, as a possible alternative to the immunofluorometric assay.

33914700.takeaway: In a nested cohort, large-for-gestational-age infants had similar insulin resistance and beta-cell function to controls at two years, but decelerated length growth in early infancy was linked to lower beta-cell function.

33914928.takeaway: In 136 children with papillary thyroid cancer and nodal involvement, a lymph node ratio above 0.34 carried about a threefold higher risk of persistent disease after initial treatment.

33915553.takeaway: In a Pediatric Endocrine Society survey of 124 clinicians, only 25% reported that girls with Turner syndrome received both neurodevelopmental and mental health screening, though over 93% would use a brief validated tool.

33927697.takeaway: This perspective argues that lifestyle weight loss in children with NAFLD often fails, that pharmacotherapy deserves wider use, and that NAFLD should be a secondary endpoint in obesity trials.

33927698.takeaway: Serum ANGPTL3 fell from the first to the third trimester in healthy pregnancies and did not differ in women who developed mild preeclampsia, which may favour lipid uptake by maternal tissues.

33928201.takeaway: A 12-year-old boy with severe Hashimoto hypothyroidism had rapid puberty and bone age advance after levothyroxine, and adding anastrozole slowed bone age maturation and improved near-final height by 2.4 cm.

33928203.takeaway: In 320 healthy children aged 4 to 16, a bedtime salivary cortisol threshold of 2.4 nmol/L by LC-MS/MS identified children with pituitary Cushing syndrome, and age- and sex-specific cut-offs appeared unnecessary.

33928205.takeaway: A patient with childhood-onset BRAF-V600E papillary craniopharyngioma, refractory to several surgeries, had tumour shrinkage on vemurafenib that allowed radiotherapy and tumour control.

33929074.takeaway: In Swedish children with type 1 diabetes from 2011 to 2016, HbA1c with insulin pumps was only about 0.1 percentage point lower than with injections, and severe hypoglycaemia rates did not differ.

33930937.takeaway: In 1,041 Danish pregnant women, lower free T4 in early pregnancy independently predicted higher HbA1c in the third trimester, while TSH did not.

33933181.takeaway: In 241 low-income Latinx children with overweight or obesity, a three-year community systems intervention did not change BMI trajectory compared with health education, though BMI gain was lower at one and two years.

33934092.takeaway: This historical review traces how the concept of insulin resistance emerged and why its measurement needs careful attention to assumptions, methods and clinical context.

33934456.takeaway: In a phase 3 double-blind trial of 42 children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, dasiglucagon restored plasma glucose in a median 10 minutes during insulin-induced hypoglycaemia, versus 30 minutes with placebo.

33934464.takeaway: In 150 children and youths with type 1 diabetes, corneal nerve measures were lower than in 51 controls, and HbA1c and blood pressure were the main factors linked to these early nerve changes.

33935963.takeaway: In 181,786 Chinese children, preterm birth was linked to about three times higher odds of type 1 diabetes, while high birth weight was linked to risk in girls but not boys.

33935965.takeaway: A 14-year-old boy with osteogenesis imperfecta type V and a hyperplastic femoral callus was nearly amputated for suspected osteosarcoma, but genetic testing and follow-up confirmed the diagnosis and the limb was saved.

33935973.takeaway: A boy with a homozygous GLIS3 deletion had neonatal diabetes, congenital hypothyroidism, cholestasis and transient anaemia, and pancreatic enzyme and antioxidant vitamins seemed to help his cholestasis and TSH resistance.

33939897.takeaway: In a triple-blind trial of 55 children with NAFLD, l-carnitine supplementation did not change liver enzymes or ultrasound fatty liver grades compared with placebo.

33939902.takeaway: A 7-year-old boy with Joubert syndrome presented with hyperglycaemic hyperosmolar state and new type 1 diabetes, with a glucose of 115 mmol/L, and recovered without HHS complications after 10 days.

33942077.takeaway: US paediatric DKA admissions rose by about 40% between 2006 and 2016, with the highest rates in older adolescents and young adults, Black youth, and those without private insurance.

33942084.takeaway: In 121 patients with primary aldosteronism taking canrenone, the aldosterone-to-renin ratio fell and false-negative screening rose to 72.5% after 7 to 12 months, so mineralocorticoid antagonists should be avoided before screening.

33944971.takeaway: In 12 recreationally active young people with type 1 diabetes, acute hyperglycaemia at higher insulin levels modestly lowered maximal aerobic capacity, but overall exercise performance was not clinically meaningfully impaired.

33945304.takeaway: In CONCEPTT pregnancies with type 1 diabetes, few met CGM or HbA1c targets, though attainment rose through gestation and with real-time CGM, and meeting the ADA HbA1c target was linked to better perinatal outcomes.

33950185.takeaway: This editorial reviews why fasting GLP-1 rises in children with obesity, possibly as IL-6-driven compensation for insulin resistance, and calls for experiments to clarify its relevance to human disease.

33950234.takeaway: In 37 adults with Prader-Willi syndrome, growth hormone for up to three years improved sleep efficiency with no clinically significant negative effect on breathing, though breathing disorders remain common.

33950863.takeaway: Screening 409 patients with congenital hypopituitarism found OTX2 mutations rarely cause hypopituitarism without eye abnormalities, and the endocrine phenotype appears to be of hypothalamic origin.

33952607.takeaway: In 10,681 children followed from birth in the DIPP study, living near agricultural land in the first year of life was linked to lower type 1 diabetes risk, possibly through microbial exposure.

33953696.takeaway: In 12 children with hypercortisolaemia and inconclusive pituitary MRI, bilateral inferior petrosal sinus sampling reached 75% diagnostic accuracy at baseline and 83% after CRH, though its localisation value was limited.

33953699.takeaway: In rats fed a high-sucrose diet from weaning, puberty came earlier and insulin resistance and ovarian cysts developed, and Brazilian state data linked sugary drink intake to PCOS prevalence.

33954780.takeaway: In 10 young people with type 1 diabetes, a high-protein high-fat meal nearly doubled the insulin needed over five hours versus a low-protein low-fat meal, with about half the extra needed in two hours.

33954789.takeaway: In a randomised trial of 62 boys with glucocorticoid-dependent Duchenne muscular dystrophy, zoledronic acid raised lumbar spine BMD Z-score by 1.2 SD over 12 months versus calcium and vitamin D, with fewer vertebral fractures.

33960957.takeaway: In 30 patients with unilateral cortisol-producing adrenal tumours, 65% of benign adenomas accumulated FDG on PET, and the high-uptake black adenomas showed raised lysosomal, autophagy and glycolytic gene expression.

33961029.takeaway: This review updates congenital adrenal hyperplasia with new insights into steroidogenic pathways, neonatal screening, steroid profiling by mass spectrometry, genotyping, alternative treatments and long-term registry outcomes.

33966091.takeaway: In Scottish adults with type 1 diabetes, starting insulin pump therapy was associated with less diabetic retinopathy progression than continuing injections over about 2.3 years, with the greatest protection in those with high baseline HbA1c.

33967952.takeaway: A meta-analysis of 7.85 million Chinese newborns estimated CAH incidence at about 1 in 23,000, with a screening positive rate of 0.66%, and salt-wasting cases outnumbering simple virilising cases 3.25 to 1.

33967953.takeaway: In 67 men, frequent fries intake was linked to higher methylation of an imprinted gene site in sperm, while frequent vegetable and fruit intake tracked with higher sperm motility and lower methylation at another site.

33971706.takeaway: A boy with severe diazoxide-resistant congenital hyperinsulinism from a homozygous ABCC8 mutation had only slight glycaemic improvement on off-label pasireotide and still needed near-total pancreatectomy at 11 months.

33971707.takeaway: In Korean adolescents aged 10 to 18, the prevalence of fasting hyperglycaemia rose from 5.4% in 2007 to 2009 to 11.7% in 2016 to 2018, and it was linked to higher blood pressure and triglycerides.

33972313.takeaway: This lecture argues that hyperglycaemia present before or early in pregnancy warrants its own diagnostic thresholds and treatment criteria, separate from GDM diagnosed at 24 to 28 weeks, and calls for trials of early management.

33974051.takeaway: Among 673 patients with medullary thyroid carcinoma, sporadic and hereditary forms had different ages at onset but similar stage-dependent survival and outcomes, with stage and age predicting worse survival.

33978300.takeaway: In Hong Kong, childhood type 2 diabetes incidence rose to 3.4 per 100,000 a year over 2008 to 2017, from 1.3 previously; most cases were found on screening and 38% had fatty liver.

33978305.takeaway: Among 237 Swedish children admitted with new-onset type 1 diabetes and DKA, parents suspected diabetes in 39%, and delayed primary-care referral in 43% of those with earlier contact was linked to lower pH.

33978986.takeaway: Among 829 commercially insured youths with type 2 diabetes starting metformin, one quarter escalated treatment within five years, with adherence, older age at diagnosis, Hispanic ethnicity and complications predicting escalation.

33982055.takeaway: In 1,036 mother-child pairs, higher maternal glucose at 24 to 28 weeks, even below diabetes thresholds, was linked to failing communication and personal-social developmental screens at 12 months, with C-peptide mediating the communication link.

33982091.takeaway: In Nigerian children with and without nutritional rickets, a serum alkaline phosphatase above 350 U/L discriminated the two groups well, with 93% sensitivity and 92% specificity.

33982678.takeaway: In 514 prepubertal children with isolated GH deficiency, baseline IGF-I and peak GH on stimulation testing predicted first-year height velocity on rhGH, supporting them as enrichment markers.

33982679.takeaway: In 68 prepubertal children with GH deficiency, baseline IGF-I above 30 ng/mL and a peak GH of at least 5 ng/mL after one oral dose marked children likely to respond better to LUM-201.

33986725.takeaway: Among 681 children diagnosed with type 1 diabetes in Hangzhou over ten years, half presented in DKA, most often under age 2, and annual diagnoses rose about 2.5-fold while DKA rates stayed unchanged.

33989173.takeaway: This review reports that 88% of the global population uses iodised salt, that countries with adequate iodine intake nearly doubled since 2003, and that 21 countries remain deficient and 13 excessive.

33990377.takeaway: In German registry data, the share of autoantibody-negative new type 1 diabetes in youth during the first COVID-19 wave (6.6%) did not exceed prior years (7.2%), and ketoacidosis rose similarly in both groups.

33995269.takeaway: Three Chinese children from two families with INSR variants had type A or Donohue-type severe insulin resistance; in vitro work showed the novel p.Thr250del variant was pathogenic, while p.Val1224Met appeared tolerated.

33995270.takeaway: Software-derived ultrasound features and ATA/TI-RADS patterns helped stratify malignancy risk in Bethesda category IV thyroid nodules.

33995279.takeaway: In 14 patients with juxtaglomerular cell tumors, small superficial lesions suggest laparoscopic partial nephrectomy is a preferred surgical option.

33995280.takeaway: Women with diminished ovarian reserve after IVF had more hypertensive pregnancy disorders, suggesting stricter antenatal care may be needed.

33995282.takeaway: Declining vitamin D and renal function had additive effects on PTH without vitamin D deficiency; age raised PTH only with normal renal function.

33995287.takeaway: Pilot study links urinary tubular and oxidative stress markers and blood pressure patterns to early diabetic nephropathy in youth with T1D; glycemic variability may contribute.

33999151.takeaway: Two patients with FOXA2 defects had syndromic hypopituitarism; one had a novel nonsense variant and the other a deletion with pancreatic dysgenesis and diabetes.

33999183.takeaway: Fetal growth showed an inverse linear relationship with HPA axis stress response at age 18, unlike the inverted-U pattern reported in older adults.

34000022.takeaway: Youth with presymptomatic stage 1 T1D had lower insulin sensitivity, beta-cell responsiveness, and insulin clearance than healthy peers during an OGTT.

34000049.takeaway: In this phase 2a RCT, fezolinetant 60 or 180 mg/day reduced hyperandrogenism and the LH-to-FSH ratio in women with PCOS and was well tolerated.

34003304.takeaway: In ten adults with established type 1 diabetes, peripheral immune cells and cytokines varied circadianly, suggesting dysrhythmia may be an effect rather than a cause.

34010394.takeaway: Stimulated FSH-inhibin B predicted pubertal onset in delayed puberty with high accuracy in a validation cohort; larger studies are needed.

34012420.takeaway: Coordinate-based meta-analysis of DTI studies found subtle white matter microstructural changes in adults with type 2 diabetes, possibly linked to cognitive and mood symptoms.

34012423.takeaway: This review of SDH-deficient tumors describes distinct genetic mechanisms in Carney triad and Carney-Stratakis syndrome, with GIST presenting early in life.

34013335.takeaway: Reproductive hormone trajectories were similar in soy- and cow-milk-formula-fed infant boys, though an early anogenital growth difference was seen.

34013709.takeaway: Free and bioavailable vitamin D were lower in obese children than controls in winter, and PTH was higher in obese children in both seasons.

34013710.takeaway: Vitamin D deficiency was highly prevalent among term neonates with late neonatal hypocalcemia in this Turkish multicenter study.

34013711.takeaway: Among 82 boys with precocious puberty at a northern Chinese center, most central cases were idiopathic; peripheral causes included CAH and germ cell tumors.

34013712.takeaway: Turkey's 10-year Diabetes at School Program offers a national model, including an individual school treatment plan for each child and an action plan for each school.

34013713.takeaway: Epicardial and perihepatic fat thickness emerged as cardiometabolic risk markers in girls with Turner syndrome, possibly more informative than total adiposity.

34013756.takeaway: Obese children with insulin resistance had higher urinary NGAL than obese controls, suggesting early renal injury may precede diabetes.

34013836.takeaway: An infant with Sotos syndrome and central precocious puberty did not respond fully to leuprolide, but adding cyproterone acetate controlled pubertal progression.

34015117.takeaway: Gut microbiota composition in early pregnancy was associated with later gestational diabetes risk, with opportunistic pathogens linked to higher risk.

34015178.takeaway: In 111 children and adolescents, a year on hybrid closed-loop therapy improved time in range and other glycemic measures, though not HbA1c.

34015897.takeaway: Three pediatric patients with primary hyperparathyroidism from parathyroid adenomas normalized calcium after surgical resection without medication.

34015898.takeaway: In 98 children with Graves' disease on antithyroid drugs, earlier TBII normalization predicted remission, with a 2.35-year cutoff.

34015899.takeaway: In 18 boys with idiopathic central precocious puberty, GnRH agonist treatment left final adult height near the target height range.

34015900.takeaway: In rat RIN-5F beta cells, alloxan and high glucose raised sphingosine 1-phosphate, and MAPK/ERK signaling regulated insulin secretion and S1P expression.

34015901.takeaway: In 78 children aged 8 to 16, higher FGF21 levels were associated with metabolic syndrome and worse endothelial function.

34015902.takeaway: A 14-year-old girl with DKA developed severe hypertriglyceridemia and acute pancreatitis after stopping insulin, highlighting the need to consider pancreatitis in such cases.

34015903.takeaway: In 115 short children, higher BMI SDS was independently associated with lower peak GH on stimulation testing, so BMI should inform interpretation.

34015904.takeaway: In 39 girls with central precocious puberty treated with GnRH agonist, more advanced breast Tanner stage and bone age predicted a shorter time to menarche.

34015905.takeaway: The first genetically confirmed Myhre syndrome case in Korea, with a SMAD4 variant, improved in height with combined GH and GnRH agonist treatment.

34015906.takeaway: A single random urinary LH measurement, with a cutoff of 0.725 IU/L, predicted stimulation-test positivity for central precocious puberty in girls.

34015907.takeaway: A 10-year-old girl with a left ventricular assist device had immobilization-induced hypercalcemia that resolved after zoledronate when hydration and furosemide failed.

34015908.takeaway: In 150 girls with central precocious puberty, 3-month GnRH agonist depots gave short-term growth and pubertal suppression comparable to 1-month depots.

34017312.takeaway: A systematic review and Italian society recommendations suggest early insulin may benefit children with cystic fibrosis and prediabetes once OGTT and glycemic patterns are assessed.

34017934.takeaway: A pregnant woman with multiple sclerosis and alemtuzumab-induced severe Graves' disease needed high-dose antithyroid drugs, with close multidisciplinary follow-up of the newborn.

34018288.takeaway: Type 1 diabetes incidence in Auckland children aged 0-4 has plateaued since 2003, unlike older children; the overall plateau reflected changing ethnic makeup.

34018289.takeaway: Endothelin-1 was lower in adolescents with type 1 diabetes and correlated with carotid intima-media thickness, possibly reflecting early endothelial impairment.

34018301.takeaway: Islet autoantibody type at diagnosis was associated with differing demographic, clinical and laboratory features in 711 children with new-onset type 1 diabetes.

34018306.takeaway: Most pediatric endocrinology providers surveyed used GLP-1 receptor agonists in children, mainly for type 2 diabetes and obesity, and called for more education on their use.

34021277.takeaway: An international consensus sets an algorithm for initial screening and follow-up of asymptomatic SDHx mutation carriers, including imaging and biochemical tests.

34022156.takeaway: China's obesity prevalence has risen sharply; 2015-2019 estimates were 7.9% in children aged 6-17 and 16.4% in adults, with wide differences by sex, age and region.

34023005.takeaway: Across 15 years of nitisinone treatment in hereditary tyrosinaemia type 1, no new safety signals emerged, and early treatment prevented life-limiting liver disease.

34024156.takeaway: A scoping review identified seven game mechanisms in serious games teaching children with T1D self-management; games combining several mechanisms seemed most effective.

34025573.takeaway: A researcher's guide to ABCD Study pubertal variables describes their strengths and weaknesses and offers recommendations for interpreting them in adolescent research.

34025584.takeaway: The authors propose a practical service evaluation model with key performance indicators for multidisciplinary thyroid eye disease services, supporting national audit.

34027406.takeaway: Two patients referred as acromegaly were diagnosed with pachydermoperiostosis, which can mimic acromegaly despite normal GH, so it belongs in the differential.

34028586.takeaway: In a Danish case-cohort study, neonatal vitamin D from dried blood spots was not associated with lower risk of early-onset type 2 diabetes in adulthood.

34031907.takeaway: UK Society for Endocrinology guidance advises that a child with suspected DSD be assessed by an experienced clinician and discussed early with the regional DSD service.

34036349.takeaway: In 42 patients with POMC or MC4R defects, cardiac muscle mass was lower without hypertrophy and more sodium was stored in subcutaneous fat, supporting cardiac assessment.

34042523.takeaway: CGM metrics in youth with T1D improved during shelter-in-place orders in Northern California, with opposite changes in publicly insured participants.

34044395.takeaway: Young patients with 21-hydroxylase deficiency had reduced bone mineral density, especially in the lumbar spine; higher glucocorticoid doses were linked to lower BMD.

34044405.takeaway: Infants with absent scintigraphy uptake often had a sonographically visible gland and transient hypothyroidism, so ultrasound should be added before presuming athyreosis.

34044499.takeaway: Two siblings with the same hemizygous FOXP3 mutation had IPEX syndrome with different initial manifestations, showing variable phenotype.

34044500.takeaway: In four gender minority adolescents, menstrual suppression succeeded in three and improved distress, though one stopped because side effects increased dysphoria.

34044626.takeaway: Investigators designed a video game for Brazilian children with T1D using health behavior change determinants and user-centered design to support self-management.

34046012.takeaway: During puberty in iodine-sufficient East China, girls' TSH and FT3 fell while FT4 rose, and changes related to pubertal stage and pace.

34048365.takeaway: Juvenile hypoglycemia in growth hormone receptor deficiency resolves in adulthood; the authors hypothesize reduced gluconeogenesis and propose testing in GHR-knockout pigs.

34049438.takeaway: Dried blood spot reverse T3 and the T3/rT3 ratio at birth distinguished infants with MCT8 deficiency from other groups, offering a potential early biomarker.

34050756.takeaway: In 1164 mother-child pairs, maternal second-trimester and cord blood leptin were not linked to autism, while prepregnancy BMI and prenatal adiponectin were noted as possible markers.

34050759.takeaway: In a nationwide Israeli cohort of 1.38 million adolescents, thyroid disorders diagnosed in adolescence were associated with higher type 2 diabetes risk in young adulthood.

34050761.takeaway: In 2598 six-year-olds, hair cortisol was not independently associated with cardiometabolic risk factors at ages 6 or 10 once BMI was accounted for.

34054738.takeaway: Unlike adult thyroid cancer in Korea, childhood thyroid cancer incidence kept rising through 2017, possibly reflecting iodine intake, radiation, obesity and screening.

34058748.takeaway: Birth-weight- or gestational-age-adjusted second-tier cutoffs in New Zealand CAH newborn screening could raise positive predictive value from 10.8% to 80% without losing sensitivity.

34060603.takeaway: Young adult women with premature adrenarche had no evident ovarian dysfunction but lower SHBG and higher bioavailable androgens than controls.

34061767.takeaway: A systematic review finds one pediatric metabolic syndrome definition most practical, using easily measured components, though it needs validation with newer cut-offs.

34061770.takeaway: A pooled intention-to-treat analysis gives an overall methimazole remission rate of 28.8% in pediatric Graves' disease; longer treatment may help, but evidence is limited.

34061946.takeaway: In the DPV registry, type 1 diabetes with Addison's or Hashimoto's needed more insulin, and neuropathy was more frequent with Hashimoto's or Graves' disease.

34061954.takeaway: In euthyroid adults, serum TSH within the reference range was independently and inversely associated with renal plasma flow, suggesting a direct thyroid-renal link.

34061962.takeaway: A second POMC promoter, regulated by methylation, was identified in ACTH-secreting pituitary tumors and may be a target to suppress excess ACTH in Cushing disease.

34061965.takeaway: In papillary thyroid cancer without aggressive features, tall cell percentage did not change recurrence risk, so it alone should not guide management.

34075436.takeaway: This review of youth-onset type 2 diabetes describes heterogeneous pathophysiology, poor glycemic control and higher complication risk, calling for new treatments and diverse trials.

34079518.takeaway: Animal models of placental insufficiency show reduced mitochondrial energy production and metabolic rate in fetal liver and skeletal muscle, which may underlie later metabolic dysfunction.

34081616.takeaway: Women born late preterm had about three times the odds of PCOS of term-born women, and very or moderately preterm women had more hyperandrogenic profiles.

34083323.takeaway: In Taiwan, T1D incidence rose among children aged 0-6 and fell among adolescents aged 13-19, and enterovirus infection before age 7 carried higher T1D risk.

34084150.takeaway: In five children and adolescents with papillary thyroid cancer, radiofrequency ablation of cervical nodal metastases was described as a less invasive, effective alternative.

34084151.takeaway: In youth with obesity, NMR-derived LPIR, GlycA, BCAA and glycine tracked cardiometabolic risk, and LPIR may be explored as a non-insulin predictor of insulin resistance.

34085361.takeaway: Three neonates with hyperglycemia from heterozygous GCK mutations had benign GCK-MODY, supporting genetic testing to avoid an unneeded diabetes label.

34086503.takeaway: Across 82 centers, glycemic control in youth with T1D was maintained during COVID-19's first wave, while DKA rose in countries with the highest COVID mortality.

34086900.takeaway: This review of childhood-onset craniopharyngioma covers presentation with pituitary and hypothalamic deficits and visual symptoms, plus long-term consequences of treatment.

34086903.takeaway: In 166 children, cord blood bile acids and small polar metabolites did not predict type 1 diabetes, while the HLA risk group performed far better.

34091447.takeaway: This review of short children with low IGF-I and a normal GH peak covers GH neurosecretory dysfunction, GH1 or GHSR variants, and GH insensitivity.

34093431.takeaway: In French Guiana, where GDM is very common, universal screening and monitoring were associated with rare neonatal complications, including 2.8% macrosomia and 2.8% hypoglycemia.

34093432.takeaway: Among 683 children aged 8 to 15, the relative lipid accumulation product predicted metabolic syndrome better than BMI, waist-to-height ratio and other indices.

34093435.takeaway: Screening for isolated central hypothyroidism found a novel frameshift in IRS4 in two brothers, supporting IRS4's role in this condition.

34093438.takeaway: In pubertal girls, thyroid volume tracked physical growth, so reference values should account for age and body measures; HVI and BSAV may be better indicators.

34093443.takeaway: Non-identical twins with neonatal diabetes from a novel GLIS3 nonsense mutation extend the known phenotype and show the challenge of genetic diagnosis for management.

34093448.takeaway: In children with glycogen storage disease, neurological harm was mainly linked to poor metabolic control, especially hypoglycemia; six previously unknown variants were reported.
