34505129.takeaway: In a nationwide Israeli cohort of 1.3 million adolescents, myopia at age 16 to 19 was linked to higher type 2 diabetes incidence in young women, rising with severity; no association was found in men.

34506697.takeaway: A woman with tyrosinemia type 1 took nitisinone through two pregnancies and breastfeeding without adverse effects in herself or her two infants, who showed age-appropriate development.

34512541.takeaway: In 12 youths with type 1 diabetes, algorithm-based insulin and carbohydrate adjustments improved average glucose over 15 hours after real exercise, though hypoglycemia rose in one window.

34512550.takeaway: At transition to adult care, 29 young adults with type 1 diabetes had no cardiovascular autonomic neuropathy but showed sensory impairment on tuning-fork and Tiptherm tests versus 30 healthy volunteers.

34512552.takeaway: Girls with Turner syndrome not treated with growth hormone had higher BDNF and lower MMP-2 than short-stature controls; the authors say these findings need further study.

34514279.takeaway: Lipoprotein(a) correlated with LDL-C in 700 youths with type 1 or type 2 diabetes, and Black youths had a higher relative risk of elevated levels than White youths.

34514857.takeaway: Bone density stayed normal and stable over 5 years in adult survivors of childhood thyroid cancer, though 13% had low BMD at 23.5 years; routine bone monitoring is not clearly supported.

34514877.takeaway: In 217 children and young adults with papillary thyroid cancer, 86% had nodal metastasis and 13% recurred; coexisting Hashimoto's thyroiditis was linked to nodal metastasis and recurrence.

34515128.takeaway: Prepubertal boys exposed to maternal gestational diabetes had more android and gynoid fat than control boys, while girls showed no difference; overall body composition differences were minimal.

34516402.takeaway: Variants were found in 19.4% of 108 probands with short stature and mild skeletal anomalies, most often in ACAN and IHH; a raised sitting-to-height ratio was the only feature linked to a finding.

34517439.takeaway: In a 9-month-old, COVID-19 triggered an encephalopathic crisis that was the first sign of glutaric aciduria type 1, a presentation the authors report for the first time.

34519276.takeaway: In 124 female survivors of childhood blood cancer or transplant, premature ovarian insufficiency was common after transplant, and higher cyclophosphamide dose was linked to lower AMH without transplant.

34519823.takeaway: In 30 people with osteogenesis imperfecta, fat percentage and resting energy expenditure matched controls overall, but those with non-COL variants had more fat and lower energy expenditure.

34519830.takeaway: Obesity in pregnancy increased adiponectin ubiquitination and lowered adiponectin in visceral fat; insulin prevented, and inflammation and ER stress promoted, adiponectin degradation in cultured adipocytes.

34520640.takeaway: In 40 children with persistent hypoglycemia, CGM agreed well with finger-prick readings but was only 54% sensitive for severe hypoglycemia, with many false positives; parents preferred it.

34523156.takeaway: In 72 boys with Klinefelter syndrome, puberty began and progressed within normal limits, and testosterone was not needed for initial pubertal progression in most.

34523293.takeaway: In nine prepubertal children with CAH, reverse circadian hydrocortisone dosing did not lower morning 17-OHP, so the authors do not support its use.

34524000.takeaway: In pregnancies with type 1 diabetes, large-for-gestational-age infants were linked to higher first-trimester HbA1c, time above target and glycemic fluctuation; CGM and SMBG users had similar outcomes.

34524007.takeaway: Among 128 remote pediatric patients using clinic-to-clinic telemedicine, CGM use was 29.7% versus 56.0% in the main clinic, and CGM use was linked to lower HbA1c in both groups.

34524008.takeaway: In 648 youths with type 1 diabetes during the pandemic year versus 641 the year before, mean CGM glucose was 6.3 mg/dL lower and more youths reached a GMI below 7%.

34524023.takeaway: In 132 people with type 1 diabetes starting the MiniMed 670G, fear of hypoglycemia fell over 12 months, though many reported night-time alarm disruption and frequent exits from auto mode.

34524026.takeaway: HbA1c from 2011 to 2017 rose in the United States, fell in Sweden and held steady in Germany/Austria overall, with age-specific patterns; the authors link US trends to unequal access to care and technology.

34524976.takeaway: In 2,854 Australian adolescent twins, heritability was 49 to 71% for thyroid function traits and TPOAb, and genome-wide analysis linked variants near NCOA3 and SERPINA7.

34525271.takeaway: Conventional phosphate and calcitriol did not achieve metabolic or radiographic recovery in X-linked hypophosphatemic rickets, and adult height remained short; the authors suggest burosumab may be an alternative after infancy.

34526968.takeaway: Thyroid cancer incidence in China rose from 1990 to 2019, and mortality fell in women but rose in men, with the male burden growing faster than the female burden.

34526969.takeaway: In six adolescents with complete androgen insensitivity, lumbar bone density was low and fell in those followed up despite hormone therapy, while lean mass was normal.

34529060.takeaway: Higher pregnancy serum PFAS concentrations were linked to a 14 to 20% higher risk of terminating breastfeeding, but PFAS levels did not correlate with prolactin.

34529909.takeaway: In Turkish adolescents aged 10 to 17, a more pro-inflammatory diet index was associated with higher blood pressure and BMI, and modestly with fasting insulin and glucose.

34529910.takeaway: A point-of-care mobile app for short-stature work-up matched the clinical diagnosis in 99% of 412 validation children, guiding evaluation by age, height and skeletal maturation.

34531293.takeaway: In 1,105 people with prediabetes, intensified lifestyle intervention in high-risk individuals improved postchallenge glucose, liver fat and cardiovascular risk more than conventional intervention.

34531309.takeaway: In 677 youths with type 2 diabetes followed about 10 years, each 1% rise in HbA1c increased the risk of micro- and macroalbuminuria, hyperfiltration and rapid eGFR decline.

34531310.takeaway: In 367 young adults with youth-onset type 2 diabetes, higher HbA1c was the dominant factor in retinopathy progression, and 49% already had some retinopathy.

34531821.takeaway: In 33 children with 21-hydroxylase deficiency, principal component endocrine profiles predicted treatment efficacy and separated classical from non-classical CAH.

34531830.takeaway: Offspring of mothers with hypothyroidism had a 23% higher hazard of cardiovascular disease in a Danish registry cohort of over one million, strongest when hypothyroidism occurred during pregnancy.

34534317.takeaway: In 32 healthy young men, transdermal estradiol improved creative verbal fluency and short-term verbal memory, combined estradiol and insulin improved delayed recognition, and insulin alone had no effect.

34536247.takeaway: Among 2,438 Western Australian children diagnosed with diabetes before age 15, those with type 2 had higher risk of hypertension, high cholesterol and microalbuminuria than those with type 1.

34536254.takeaway: Nine adolescents with early-onset type 1 diabetes developed sight-threatening retinopathy after poor control, some rapidly, so repeated retinal screening is advised even after a normal first exam.

34536343.takeaway: Earlier-than-expected pubertal onset occurred in about 30% of short children with delayed bone age at one Japanese hospital, versus 13 to 15% in a historical cohort, and may be increasing.

34537773.takeaway: Next-generation sequencing suggests oligogenic inheritance contributes to the broad range of DSD phenotypes, using NR5A1 as an example, but its role remains unproven and hard to interpret.

34537845.takeaway: In 120 people aged 6 to 25 with and without cystic fibrosis, greater CGM glucose variability tracked lower beta-cell function, but CGM performed poorly at identifying prediabetes or CFRD.

34537849.takeaway: AMH is a useful pediatric marker of testicular tissue in disorders of sex development and cryptorchidism and of ovarian reserve, but results need interpretation by age, sex, puberty and assay.

34538045.takeaway: Children with type 1 diabetes should be screened for celiac disease with tTG-IgA and/or EMA regardless of age; endoscopy should not rest on tTG-IgA alone unless it is seven times the upper limit or more.

34538047.takeaway: Children with diabetic ketoacidosis had higher arrhythmia-risk ECG markers (P, QT and Tp-e dispersion) before treatment than 40 healthy controls, and these improved after treatment.

34538048.takeaway: Six families of children with Prader-Willi syndrome felt a multidisciplinary pilot clinic offered integrated care, social signposting and community connection, and was superior to usual care.

34538049.takeaway: In 16 children with Cushing disease, bilateral petrosal sinus sampling predicted disease and lateralization in 14, outperforming MRI, which showed a microadenoma in only half.

34539567.takeaway: Exome sequencing found variants in 29 of 42 Chinese newborns with congenital hypothyroidism, most often in DUOX2, pointing to dyshormonogenesis as the main mechanism.

34539573.takeaway: Many children with childhood-onset non-acquired GH deficiency still do not reach a normal adult height on recombinant GH, so the authors call for renewed height-outcome evaluation.

34539574.takeaway: In 298 patients with ACTH-dependent Cushing syndrome, a pathway using low-dose dexamethasone suppression with BIPSS only for unsuppressed cases with small adenomas reached 97.7% sensitivity.

34539578.takeaway: The authors argue that bombesin receptor targeting should be considered for some CNS and neural tumors, such as neuroblastoma and medulloblastoma, which have poor survival with current treatment.

34539579.takeaway: Pelvic ultrasound helps separate precocious puberty from premature thelarche; a uterine length cutoff of 3.2 cm gave pooled sensitivity and specificity of about 82% against the GnRH stimulation test.

34539581.takeaway: Most of 19 children diagnosed with Hashimoto's thyroiditis before age 3 had hypothyroidism at presentation; some with developmental delay or short stature improved on levothyroxine.

34541035.takeaway: A girl with a homozygous TRMT10A mutation had early hypoglycemia, then diabetes, GH deficiency and primary ovarian failure, expanding the syndrome and supporting monogenic diabetes testing in similar patients.

34541890.takeaway: Across 574 thyroid surgery patients with 1000 nerves at risk, 23% of recurrent laryngeal nerves followed an abnormal course, and loss of nerve signal was more likely with abnormal anatomy.

34542646.takeaway: Genetically predicted higher maternal adiposity with a favourable metabolic profile was linked to lower offspring birthweight, whereas higher maternal BMI was linked to higher birthweight.

34543539.takeaway: Calcitonin is the most-studied biomarker for hereditary medullary thyroid carcinoma in children, but age-specific reference ranges are recent and complementary markers still rely largely on adult data.

34544220.takeaway: A 46,XX girl with Nijmegen breakage syndrome and pure gonadal dysgenesis developed bilateral ovarian germ cell tumors, the first such case reported in this syndrome.

34544729.takeaway: In male mice, a high-fat diet throughout life caused the most diabetes, and switching to chow after puberty was protective; females were protected from hyperglycemia regardless of diet timing.

34545167.takeaway: SLC26A4 variants were found in 10 of 273 Chinese patients with congenital hypothyroidism (3.7%), and five of the seven variants impaired protein location or ion transport in vitro.

34546079.takeaway: A budget impact model found flash CGM saved money per patient for Medicaid beneficiaries on intensive insulin therapy, with a projected $19.4 million first-year decrease in costs if 10% more adopted it.

34547194.takeaway: Congenital hyperinsulinism, the most frequent cause of persistent neonatal hypoglycemia, arises from mutations in at least 16 genes; the review covers genetics, PET-based diagnosis and newer therapies, including laparoscopic pancreatectomy.

34547195.takeaway: A 13-year-old girl with Down syndrome presented with myxedema crisis from untreated hypothyroidism; the authors suggest oral levothyroxine and liothyronine when IV drug is unavailable and advise annual thyroid screening.

34549602.takeaway: Age as a continuous variable did not predict outcome in 288 patients under 21 with thyroid cancer, but those under 15 had distinct features; the authors suggest a cutoff of 15, not 18.

34551418.takeaway: In one 11-year-old with Rabson-Mendenhall syndrome, adding empagliflozin lowered HbA1c by almost 3% and insulin dose by about 30%, with no adverse effects reported.

34551461.takeaway: Screening alkaline phosphatase results in 6,731 children found three with heterozygous ALPL variants, one of whom was diagnosed with childhood hypophosphatasia; the authors propose an AP-based diagnostic algorithm.

34552554.takeaway: No single metabolite predicted preterm delivery consistently across studies; a combination of metabolomic biomarkers may have potential and needs evaluation in future studies.

34552559.takeaway: Less extensive surgery for low-risk papillary thyroid cancer gave 5-year disease-free survival similar to historical controls, with no significant difference in early recurrent nerve paresis.

34553783.takeaway: In 35 girls with Turner syndrome aged 12 to 25, patients rated their transition readiness higher than their parents did, and older age, education and life skills were linked to higher scores.

34553987.takeaway: In a German survey of 3,427 people with diabetes or their parents, 83% were positive about digitization; the most-cited drawbacks were app error-proneness (36%) and misuse of patient data (32%).

34556497.takeaway: Among 1,676 patients referred for MODY testing, 307 had a molecular diagnosis, and 18% of those carried syndrome-associated genes such as HNF1B and WFS1, often without syndromic features at referral.

34557162.takeaway: Among 61 youths with type 1 diabetes, CGM users reported far more vigorous physical activity than meter users, and higher hypoglycemia fear was linked to more activity and fewer lows.

34557165.takeaway: A web-based ultrasound and clinical nomogram predicted central lymph node metastasis in node-negative papillary microcarcinoma, with an area under the curve of 0.77 in the validation set of 220 patients.

34561224.takeaway: CD8+ T cells recognized native or citrullinated GRP78 peptides separately, without cross-reactivity, and thymic citrullination was impaired in NOD mice, suggesting modifications may not always favour autoimmunity.

34561948.takeaway: Adolescents and emerging adults with type 1 diabetes had a higher risk of substance use disorder than matched peers, with the excess seen in males but not females.

34561974.takeaway: In 89 children with type 1 diabetes, lockdowns did not significantly change HbA1c or lipid levels, but diabetes-related emergency admissions increased.

34561975.takeaway: In a 7-month-old with CRIM-negative infantile Pompe disease, concomitant immune tolerance induction and desensitization allowed enzyme replacement to continue, with clinical improvement and lower antibody levels.

34563105.takeaway: Six-hourly subcutaneous regular insulin was safe and effective for 224 DKA episodes in 161 children in Ethiopia, with ketones clearing in a median of 24 hours and no deaths.

34563107.takeaway: A standardized 3-bag fluid protocol after pediatric suprasellar surgery was associated with lower odds of hypernatremia within 48 hours, although the difference in sodium range was not significant.

34564073.takeaway: In 737 youths diagnosed with diabetes during the first pandemic year, T1D incidence rose modestly, T2D cases rose 182%, and DKA at presentation became more common, especially among Black youth.

34565054.takeaway: Trio exome sequencing found NPR2 variants in 2 of 16 children with familial short stature, and both grew faster on recombinant growth hormone, though final height is not yet known.

34565130.takeaway: An adolescent with PCOS developed life-threatening angioedema 16 days after starting an estrogen oral contraceptive, later traced to an F12 variant; the authors advise asking about family angioedema before prescribing estrogen.

34565138.takeaway: A 12-year-old girl with Hashimoto's thyroiditis had primary thyroid diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, diagnosed by core biopsy and treated with chemotherapy without thyroidectomy, with no relapse at 14 months.

34566884.takeaway: Evidence that early-life PFAS exposure affects childhood growth, adiposity and puberty is suggestive but inconsistent, and the authors judge human evidence limited.

34566885.takeaway: Central congenital hypothyroidism occurs in about 1 in 13,000 births, often within combined pituitary hormone deficiency; up to 90% of isolated cases may have a genetic cause, and neonatal diagnosis is often missed.

34566892.takeaway: In Vietnamese neonates with KATP-channel diabetes, 26 of 27 mutation carriers were switched from insulin to sulfonylureas, with HbA1c falling from 7.6% to 5.8%.

34566895.takeaway: In 149 men aged 18 to 77, lower testosterone was associated with higher acute-phase inflammatory markers and a worse lipid profile, independent of age, and with less physical activity.

34566898.takeaway: In 344 children from a Shanghai birth cohort, higher cord thyroxine and free T4 were linked to lower anogenital index in girls, while TSH was positively associated with it in boys.

34568709.takeaway: A genome-wide study of 1,076 youths with type 2 diabetes identified a novel triglyceride locus at a chromosome 3 deletion and confirmed a CETP-region association with HDL cholesterol.

34569220.takeaway: Ectopic adrenal tissue occurs in kidneys, gonads, pituitary and lungs, and a simple migration defect does not explain its remote locations, the review concludes.

34570215.takeaway: Among 43 women with APECED, most of 83 pregnancies ended in delivery and birth weights were normal in over 80%, though one case of primary adrenal insufficiency led to adrenal crisis and stillbirth.

34581790.takeaway: Among 767 people with type 1 diabetes and COVID-19, those over 40 had about four times the odds of hospitalization compared with those aged 0 to 18.

34582635.takeaway: Stopping asfotase alfa for two weeks during ECMO in a girl with severe perinatal hypophosphatasia was followed by hypercalcemia and hyperphosphatemia after restart, so the authors advise close monitoring.

34584129.takeaway: An adolescent with an MC4R variant lost 19% of body weight on liraglutide over 32 weeks, but gastrointestinal side effects led to stopping, and weight returned within 13 weeks.

34585425.takeaway: Most of 86 adolescents with PCOS were diagnosed within a year, but many were dissatisfied with the information they received on lifestyle, long-term complications and emotional support.

34586080.takeaway: In 27 patients with acromegaly in remission, relatives judged body image accurately but differed sharply from patients on self-esteem, suggesting relatives need education about the disease.

34589054.takeaway: Nutrient intake and the type and timing of physical activity in childhood shape peak bone mass, and most of the supporting evidence still comes from adult studies, the review notes.

34589056.takeaway: Exome sequencing of 109 short-stature patients with suspected GH deficiency gave a molecular diagnosis in 19, and the authors identified four candidate genes linked to the GH axis.

34589657.takeaway: A boy with cryptorchidism had low FSH and AMH before puberty, and his central hypogonadism was confirmed at 14 with an FGFR1 variant, suggesting early FSH and AMH testing may help diagnosis.

34592068.takeaway: A pictogram-based adrenal insufficiency action plan was rated 85% for quality by 120 caregivers and 90% for suitability by 33 clinicians, and reads at about a fifth-grade level.

34592078.takeaway: Hereditary medullary thyroid cancer in children is usually found by RET genetic testing, which guides prophylactic surgery timing, while multikinase and RET inhibitors treat advanced disease.

34593928.takeaway: A 665 g preterm boy with transient hypothyroxinemia of prematurity and short bowel syndrome was treated with rectal levothyroxine, which the authors present as an alternative route.

34596265.takeaway: In 136 children who had ACTH stimulation tests, 11-deoxycortisol levels were not significantly elevated above pediatric or commercial cut-offs in suspected non-classic 11β-hydroxylase deficiency.

34596269.takeaway: In 28 boys with constitutional delay of growth and puberty, growth velocity tracked serum testosterone on both testosterone and letrozole, and oestradiol above 10 pmol/L was needed for growth above 8 cm/year on letrozole.

34597384.takeaway: Healthy middle-aged and older men with low testosterone had worse endothelial function than those with higher testosterone, and vitamin C improved it in that group, pointing to oxidative stress.

34598376.takeaway: In 90 asthmatic children, insulin resistance correlated with lower spirometry values, but the association was not significant after adjusting for age, sex and BMI.

34599587.takeaway: In 41 children with classic CAH, those with accelerated bone age during adrenarche were predicted to be shorter, but adult heights were similar in both groups, so bone age alone should not guide treatment.

34599655.takeaway: An estimated 234,710 people developed type 1 diabetes in 2017 and about 9 million lived with it, with high-income countries accounting for 49% of incident cases; estimates may deviate by about 15%.

34600607.takeaway: Overweight and obesity are rising in type 1 diabetes, likely driven by insulin replacement that causes peripheral hyperinsulinaemia and defensive snacking, and they raise cardiovascular and cancer risk.

34601607.takeaway: Among 714 Swedish people with 21-hydroxylase CAH matched to 71,400 controls, fracture odds were 1.6 times higher, but the excess was not seen in those born after neonatal screening.

34603197.takeaway: In 25 patients with a solitary hypothalamic mass, pituitary deficiencies were common, with central hypogonadism in 95% and central diabetes insipidus in 90%, and hyperlipidemia in 81%.

34603200.takeaway: Serum soluble Klotho was lower in 80 children with type 1 diabetes than in 34 healthy controls, correlating inversely with HbA1c and positively with HDL cholesterol.

34603203.takeaway: In 2,295 Bogotá schoolchildren, girls reached peak height velocity at about 10.4 years versus 12.7 years in boys, with final heights of 157.9 cm and 170.8 cm.

34603204.takeaway: Serum C1QA and C1QB, identified by proteomics, formed a diagnostic model for idiopathic short stature with 75% sensitivity and 91% specificity against 80 controls.

34603205.takeaway: In 901 women in Tehran, repeated AMH measurements modestly improved prediction of age at menopause, with a 3% gain in the C-statistic over a single measurement.

34603214.takeaway: In 976 pregnant women, higher CRH, progesterone and free T4 at 18 weeks were linked to earlier delivery in male fetuses only, and effects differed by hormone timing.

34603216.takeaway: In 73 patients with low-risk papillary microcarcinoma, microwave ablation shrank tumors by a median of 80%, and no serious permanent complications were reported over short follow-up.

34605694.takeaway: A 20-expert panel reviewed ten topics on continuous ketone monitoring for DKA prevention and adopted 30 conclusions to support safe device development for people with diabetes.

34606470.takeaway: In 153 parathyroid tumors, cytoplasmic filamin A was higher in carcinomas than in benign tumors, and low FLNA with positive parafibromin staining strongly indicated a benign tumor.

34607328.takeaway: In 18 children with Kabuki syndrome, two years of growth hormone raised height SDS by 1.1 without signs of metabolic syndrome, and LDL cholesterol fell while VCAM-1 rose.

34607330.takeaway: Environmental chemicals, lifestyle factors and drugs can affect fetal testis development and are linked to cryptorchidism, hypospadias and testicular cancer; the review calls for human studies to confirm animal findings.

34607833.takeaway: Among 19,717 youth and young adults diagnosed with diabetes before age 20, standardized mortality ratios were 1.5 for type 1, 2.3 for type 2 and 28 for secondary diabetes.

34610231.takeaway: Of 20 children with nutritional rickets seen at one clinic, 85% were immigrants and all had vitamin D below 20 ng/mL; the authors argue clinically evident cases are only the tip of the iceberg.

34610594.takeaway: In 72 prepubertal children, 47 with obesity had higher thrombin generation and fibrinogen and more dyslipidemia than 25 healthy-weight peers, suggesting a prothrombotic state develops in childhood obesity.

34610701.takeaway: Mutations in P450 electron-transfer partners such as POR, cytochrome b5 and ferredoxin reductase cause steroidogenic disorders, and POR deficiency can present with Antley-Bixler features and genital ambiguity.

34610702.takeaway: Primary adrenal insufficiency in children is more often genetic than in adults, and its diagnosis and glucocorticoid dosing remain challenging, the review states.

34610703.takeaway: Air pollution has been linked to childhood type 1 diabetes, obesity, insulin resistance, thyroid dysfunction and puberty timing, but the studies are mixed and do not prove causality.

34610704.takeaway: In 99 children with Graves disease, higher initial methimazole doses above 0.7 mg/kg/day were linked to more adverse events, including neutropenia, without faster normalization of free T4.

34610751.takeaway: In 72 men, adipose and muscle expression of thyroid-hormone-related genes was altered in overweight or obese men and did not rise with insulin or fatty-acid infusion as it did in normal-weight men.

34610922.takeaway: In 619 Indians followed from birth, glucose intolerance at age 18 was preceded by smaller birth size, maternal pregnancy hyperglycemia, higher childhood fasting glucose and lower compensatory insulin secretion.

34614160.takeaway: In a meta-analysis of 1,368 patients with pituitary stalk thickening, 45% had a neoplasm, most often germ cell tumor, and 18.5% of indeterminate cases progressed on follow-up.

34616360.takeaway: A 15-year-old girl with hyperthyroidism developed atrial fibrillation at 141 beats per minute; methimazole and synchronized cardioversion restored euthyroidism and sinus rhythm.

34616361.takeaway: In 37 Chinese people with type 2 diabetes, 13 days of imigliptin or alogliptin improved beta-cell function and lowered glucose, though HOMA-based indices did not change significantly.

34616364.takeaway: Adrenals and adrenal rest tumors in congenital adrenal hyperplasia shared expression profiles and lymphocytic infiltration, suggesting a common origin shaped by the abnormal hormonal milieu.

34617446.takeaway: Among 2,297 patients after lobectomy for papillary thyroid cancer, mean TSH was not associated with recurrence, supporting a normal TSH reference range after lobectomy.

34617463.takeaway: Among 131 infants with congenital hypothyroidism, mothers had more vacuum deliveries, cesareans and oxytocin use, with oxytocin need about threefold higher when hypothyroidism was permanent.

34617615.takeaway: Delayed puberty often runs in families, and next-generation sequencing has identified genetic regulators of pubertal timing that may aid diagnosis.

34618177.takeaway: In 14,682 people with type 1 diabetes in Scotland, starting flash monitoring was linked to a median 0.2% HbA1c fall, larger in those with high baseline HbA1c, and a 41% lower DKA rate.

34618900.takeaway: In 450 Danish newborns, cord blood lipoprotein(a) closely matched neonatal venous levels, and birth levels at or above the 90th percentile predicted high levels at 15 months.

34621244.takeaway: In a case-control study of 153 newborn pairs, gestational diabetes was linked to higher cord FABP4 and estradiol only in males, with estradiol partly mediating the FABP4 association.

34630333.takeaway: Two siblings with a homozygous DNAJC3 mutation had hypothyroidism, short stature, hearing loss, ataxia and diabetes from age 11 with a small atrophic pancreas; the authors propose DNAJC3 as a cause of monogenic diabetes.

34630334.takeaway: In 56 children with central precocious puberty, MKRN3 pathogenic variants were found in 12 girls, with rare DLK1, KISS1 and MAGEL2 variants in others, supporting MKRN3's key role in pubertal timing.

34633133.takeaway: Lipid hydroperoxides and protein-bound oxidation markers were 50 to 130% higher in 50 children with type 1 diabetes than in 21 controls, and the authors propose them as diagnostic markers.

34633450.takeaway: Higher maternal 2-hour glucose after a 75-g challenge was associated with global hypomethylation of cord-tissue DNA, while fasting glucose had different effects, suggesting the two GDM measures reflect distinct pathophysiology.

34633981.takeaway: Among 1,623 infants with hyperinsulinism diagnosed before 6 months, high birth weight plus diazoxide unresponsiveness predicted KATP-channel mutations well (AUC 0.88), so those infants should be prioritised for genetic testing.

34634866.takeaway: Among 1,511 children with new diabetes in Houston, type 2 was linked to older age, obesity and minority ethnicity, but no diagnostic feature was unique to either type, complicating classification.

34634867.takeaway: Y-chromosome markers were found in 12.8% of 109 girls with Turner syndrome, and oral mucosa cells gave results as reliable as blood, with a less invasive collection.

34636401.takeaway: In 336 adults with X-linked hypophosphatemia, 43 to 47% reported a fracture and over half had osteoarthritis, with musculoskeletal features beginning as early as the twenties.

34636892.takeaway: Fetal and neonatal thyroid disorders include congenital hypothyroidism found by screening and neonatal Graves disease from maternal antibodies, and early diagnosis and treatment are key to prognosis.

34636896.takeaway: After three decades of use, long-term data on recombinant growth hormone in children are largely reassuring, though cancer and cerebrovascular concerns still merit counselling, the review says.

34636899.takeaway: Over 160 weeks in children with X-linked hypophosphatemia, burosumab kept serum phosphorus in the normal range, reduced rickets severity and was well tolerated.

34638127.takeaway: The 2021 European training requirements set standards for training programmes, trainers and trainees in paediatric endocrinology and diabetes, with a syllabus of core content.

34641706.takeaway: In 12 healthy adults, poly-zinc-liothyronine gave about 30% lower peak T3 than liothyronine, with a delayed, longer plateau that the authors say may give steadier T3 levels.

34642772.takeaway: In 6,446 autoantibody-positive TrialNet participants, low HOMA2-B beta-cell function predicted faster progression to type 1 diabetes, though discrimination was modest (AUC about 0.67 to 0.72).

34643356.takeaway: A 10-year-old boy with type 1 diabetes, deafness, optic atrophy and short stature had a single de novo WFS1 variant, confirming Wolfram-like syndrome rather than Wolfram syndrome.

34643546.takeaway: Four children from one consanguineous family with a homozygous CAV1 null variant had generalized lipodystrophy from infancy with insulin resistance and dyslipidemia, and two developed achalasia.

34645113.takeaway: Two related infants with X-linked NSIAD caused by an AVPR2 variant were first mistaken for hyporeninemic hypoaldosteronism; fludrocortisone caused hypertension, and fluid restriction corrected one infant's sodium.

34646234.takeaway: Among 2,847 women with a single fresh blastocyst transfer, an endometrial thickness of 7.5 mm or less was an independent risk factor for low birth weight, which occurred in 24.9% of those births.

34646241.takeaway: In 43 adolescents and adults with X-linked hypophosphatemia, gait quality was lower than in 76 healthy adults, with a waddling gait in about half, linked to higher BMI and limb malalignment.

34652236.takeaway: Among 301 teens with type 1 diabetes, pump use (65%) and CGM use (27%) were linked to higher household income, private insurance and more frequent glucose checks.

34653252.takeaway: In 18 adults with 21-hydroxylase deficiency, 14 days of crinecerfont at 100 mg twice daily lowered ACTH by 66% and 17-hydroxyprogesterone by 64%, with androgen reductions.

34653322.takeaway: Two Japanese siblings shared a novel frameshift ARG1 variant causing arginase-1 deficiency, with short stature in the older sister and spastic paraparesis in the younger.

34653327.takeaway: Among 80 Sudanese children with primary adrenal insufficiency, genetic causes such as Allgrove syndrome outweighed autoimmune ones, hyperpigmentation was present in 94%, and missing diagnostic tests left 42.5% of causes unknown.

34653328.takeaway: In 36 children with congenital hypothyroidism, liquid levothyroxine was non-inferior to tablets, with free T4 within normal range in both groups and fewer dose adjustments needed.

34657042.takeaway: Among 60 girls with Turner syndrome compared with 60 matched controls, 35% had prediabetes and beta-cell dysfunction was present despite normal HbA1c, so the authors suggest serial OGTT screening.

34659108.takeaway: Two brothers with paternally inherited familial hypocalciuric hypercalcemia had severe neonatal hyperparathyroidism that improved on cinacalcet, so the authors advise monitoring pregnancies in affected families.

34659109.takeaway: Across 19 papers on 27 patients, subacute thyroiditis followed COVID-19 in 83% of cases with neck pain common and most remitting completely; the evidence is limited to case reports and series.

34659111.takeaway: In 48 children who had thyroidectomy, permanent hypocalcemia occurred only after lymph node dissection for thyroid cancer, while permanent recurrent nerve injury was rare.

34659117.takeaway: A 17-year-old transgender male who could not start testosterone grew pigmented facial hair after three months of topical minoxidil, with dry skin the only side effect; this is a single case.

34659121.takeaway: In a review of 36 xanthomatous hypophysitis cases, recurrence was 57% after partial resection or biopsy but 0% after total resection, and surgical histology is needed for diagnosis.

34659122.takeaway: In 149 mother-infant pairs, preterm infants had lower cord adiponectin, leptin and ghrelin than term infants, and small-for-gestational-age infants had lower adiponectin and higher ghrelin.

34659124.takeaway: A preterm girl with neonatal adrenal insufficiency and thrombocytopenia had a de novo SAMD9 variant confirming MIRAGE syndrome, and later recurrent intussusception was treated with high-dose steroids.

34659125.takeaway: Serum Hsp90α was higher in fatty liver disease and, with BMI, HbA1c and ALT, predicted it with an AUC of 0.94; teprenone lowered Hsp90α and improved steatosis in a diet-induced mouse model.

34659126.takeaway: In 1,075 papillary thyroid cancer patients, skip metastasis occurred in 3.4%, and a nomogram using capsular invasion, multifocality, tumor size over 1 cm and upper location predicted it with a concordance index of 0.886.

34662877.takeaway: Among 10,125 children evaluated for short stature at one centre, boys were more often tested with GH stimulation testing, a difference the authors say contributes to male predominance in GH treatment.

34665570.takeaway: In 711 Norwegian patients with autoimmune Addison's disease, 21-hydroxylase autoantibodies stayed positive in over 90% after 30 years, so a negative test in long-standing disease does not exclude autoimmunity.

34666334.takeaway: Three children with hereditary hypophosphatemic rickets with hypercalciuria, caused by SLC34A3 variants, presented differently, with bone, renal or no symptoms, so an accurate diagnosis is critical.

34668209.takeaway: In 41 children with Cushing disease, cognitive scores declined one year after remission, mostly in nonverbal skills, with younger age and earlier puberty linked to the largest declines.

34668366.takeaway: Two siblings with a novel homozygous ACBD5 nonsense variant were diagnosed with a peroxisomal disease by clinical exome sequencing.

34668586.takeaway: Among 179 boys with nonspecific DSD, 30% of those born small for gestational age had insufficient catch-up growth at 2 years, and infant LH was higher and stimulated testosterone lower, though puberty was normal.

34668782.takeaway: In 30 people with type 1 diabetes in Argentina starting the MiniMed 670G, time in range rose from 65% to about 75% and stayed there at 6 months, with time above range falling.

34670035.takeaway: Across 1,980 African patients with disorders of sex development, presentation was late, about 22% needed sex reassignment, and few studies reported medical or multidisciplinary management.

34670067.takeaway: A 5-year-old girl with adrenocortical carcinoma developed neurological and endocrine complications on low-dose mitotane, suggesting such doses need individualized monitoring of drug levels.

34670068.takeaway: A Korean boy with severe obesity and fatty liver was found by targeted gene panel sequencing to have early Wilson disease, showing it should not be overlooked in obesity-related liver disease.

34670069.takeaway: A 21-year-old man with Prader-Willi syndrome developed obstructive sleep apnea and cor pulmonale from severe obesity, recovered with intensive care, and the authors stress controlling hyperphagia.

34670070.takeaway: An adolescent boy whose first presentation was hyperosmolar hyperglycemic state, with glucose of 1,456 mg/dL, was diagnosed with type 1 diabetes and recovered with fluids and insulin.

34670071.takeaway: In 492 Japanese 12- to 13-year-olds, low serum 25(OH)D was associated with higher BMI and less favourable atherogenic lipids in boys only.

34670785.takeaway: More than half of new type 1 diabetes cases occur in adults, who have lower HLA risk and higher C-peptide than children, and may be misclassified as type 2 and treated inappropriately.

34671316.takeaway: Among 23,961 adults in China with diabetes, each 5-year-earlier type 2 diagnosis was linked to 14% higher odds of cardiovascular disease, with a stronger effect in people with obesity.

34673639.takeaway: The authors model gender dysphoria in young people as a chronic stressor that activates stress axes and minority stress, and argue care should combine psychosocial support with individualised treatment.

34673643.takeaway: An infant with neonatal hypophosphatasia died at 5 months of neurological complications despite early enzyme replacement, with postmortem cortical lesions suggesting an encephalopathy that ERT does not prevent.

34674406.takeaway: In 28 children with adrenocortical tumors, five-year overall survival was 100% for stages I to II but 51% for stages III to IV, and higher DHEAS was seen in more advanced disease.

34674409.takeaway: Two Indian children with short stature, skeletal anomalies and prominent heels had 3-M syndrome from novel CUL7 variants identified by exome sequencing, which allowed counselling and prenatal diagnosis.

34674413.takeaway: Two brothers with prepubertal gynaecomastia and macro-orchidism, without typical Peutz-Jeghers features, carried a paternally inherited pathogenic STK11 variant, so such presentations merit genetic testing.

34675057.takeaway: Across 38,053 California admissions for diabetic ketoacidosis or severe hypoglycemia, type 1 admission rates rose from age 17 to 19, with Black young adults and public insurance overrepresented.

34675883.takeaway: In Akita mice, a model of insulin-gene-mutation diabetes, IRE1α RNase inhibitors lowered glucose, protected beta-cell mass and reduced ER stress, pointing to a possible therapeutic target.

34676425.takeaway: Across 73 studies covering over 70 million births, gestational diabetes was not significantly associated with stillbirth in cohort or case-control studies, though heterogeneity was high.

34677618.takeaway: In a cohort of infants, posterior cervical brown fat was more active in girls, was negatively associated with adiposity only in girls, and CXCL14 levels were higher in girls at 12 months.

34679181.takeaway: In 67 patients with MCT8 deficiency treated with Triac for up to six years, serum T3 fell from 4.6 to 1.7 nmol/L, weight-for-age and heart rate improved, and no severe drug-related adverse events occurred.

34686905.takeaway: In 1,093 children from seven Turkish diabetes clinics, 41% of monogenic diabetes cases had recessive causes that conventional MODY criteria missed, so recessive genes should be included in testing.

34687316.takeaway: In a single-arm trial of 27 young people with Graves hyperthyroidism, adjuvant rituximab with 12 months of antithyroid drugs gave a 48% remission rate at 24 months, above the prespecified threshold.

34689140.takeaway: Seven children with 16p11.2 microdeletions including SH2B1 had severe early-onset obesity by age 5, often with insulin resistance and fatty liver, supporting early genetic testing in such children.

34690931.takeaway: Thyroid cancer incidence in China rose from 1.01 to 2.05 per 100,000 between 1990 and 2019 and is projected to reach 3.37 by 2039, while mortality is expected to decline slightly.

34693706.takeaway: A 7-year-old girl with biallelic PREPL variants, including a whole-gene deletion, had early growth impairment and GH deficiency, and responded well to recombinant GH.

34693966.takeaway: In 31 people with non-classical CAH, the clamp showed insulin resistance linked to longer and long-acting glucocorticoid use, with lower adiponectin and HDL cholesterol than controls.

34694022.takeaway: In 278 children, copeptin below 3.53 pmol/L identified central diabetes insipidus with 100% sensitivity and 87% specificity, supporting its use in polyuria-polydipsia workup.

34694409.takeaway: Among 678 pregnancies in women with type 1 diabetes, higher HbA1c in the first and third trimesters was associated with a composite of prematurity, pre-eclampsia, large or small for gestational age, or cesarean delivery.

34694909.takeaway: In 157 adolescents and adults with type 1 diabetes, the MiniMed advanced hybrid closed-loop system cut HbA1c from 7.5% to 7.0% and raised time in range to 74.5%, with no severe hypoglycemia or DKA.

34695822.takeaway: Screening 336 patients with idiopathic hypogonadotropic hypogonadism identified rare DLG2 variants in five patients from three families, supporting DLG2 as a contributor to delayed puberty.

34697032.takeaway: Among 1,144 German families of children with type 1 diabetes, mothers reduced paid work in the first year after diagnosis, 15% stopped working, and nearly half of families reported financial losses.

34698348.takeaway: In 42 young adults with type 1 diabetes, lower sleep efficiency predicted more glucose variability within individuals, and higher variability predicted poorer sleep, a reciprocal relationship.

34700371.takeaway: A 5-month-old girl with drug-resistant congenital hyperinsulinism also carried biallelic BLM variants causing Bloom syndrome, and her pathology showed an atypical CHI form despite a PET suggesting focal disease.

34703958.takeaway: Epigenetic mechanisms at several levels of the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis, including Kiss1 neurons, help control puberty and may link nutrition and environment to reproductive function.

34704687.takeaway: Among 120 Brazilian youths with type 1 diabetes, ultra-processed foods supplied 24% of energy intake, more so with lower household income and fewer years of parental schooling.

34704794.takeaway: In 752 Korean children with type 1 diabetes, CGM use rose from 1.4% to 39.3% over 2010 to 2019, mean HbA1c fell from 8.56% to 8.01%, and CGM users had fewer DKA episodes.

34704825.takeaway: Among 17,536 Chinese patients with diabetes, islet autoantibody positivity was higher under age 35, and adding ZnT8A testing raised detection in older LADA patients from 70% to 92%.

34706368.takeaway: A 23-year-old woman with two truncating CTC1 variants had primary ovarian failure alongside classic Coats plus features, the first reported patient with both, possibly from telomere shortening.

34706403.takeaway: Among 75 children with type 1 diabetes and 49 controls, children with diabetes slept less and were sleepier by day, and their sleep problems correlated with behaviour difficulties and maternal sleep and mood.

34707566.takeaway: In 1,300 members of Chinese families with girls, variants in the LGR4 gene were associated with peak bone density at the hip and spine, and with trunk fat and BMI.

34707569.takeaway: In human muscle cells from women with and without PCOS, short-term TGF-β1 increased glucose uptake without changing insulin signalling, so it does not appear to drive insulin resistance in the short term.

34707574.takeaway: A 7.3-year-old girl with central precocious puberty had a tuber cinereum lipoma that mimicked a pituitary abnormality on routine MRI, which fat-suppressed imaging clarified.

34708486.takeaway: Standardized DKA management with a two-bag fluid system and order set cut visits with glucose below 80 mg/dL from 32% to 5% between 2017 and 2021, with small length-of-stay gains.

34710315.takeaway: A toddler with benign hereditary chorea from a de novo NKX2-1 variant also had subclinical hypothyroidism and growth hormone deficiency, a combination the authors describe as unusual.

34711639.takeaway: A machine learning model using glucose, insulin, diet and gut microbiome data predicted meal glucose responses in 121 people with type 1 diabetes better than standard care (R 0.59 vs 0.40).

34712203.takeaway: In 62 girls with obesity aged 6 to 10, 12 weeks of decaffeinated green tea polyphenols reduced body fat percentage and ovarian volume more than placebo, with no side effects reported.

34713537.takeaway: Among 105 Black single parents of children with type 1 diabetes, the most problematic barriers were lack of social support, managing diabetes-related stress and difficulty obtaining supplies, with cost and school problems also common.

34713540.takeaway: An evaluation of a public-private insulin programme for children with type 1 diabetes in Kenya and Bangladesh found a stable free insulin supply, but donor-to-government transition and indirect costs threaten sustainability.

34714169.takeaway: Gross recurrent laryngeal nerve invasion by papillary thyroid tumors of 2 cm or less was rare, occurred with subcapsular paratracheal tumors, and was not seen below 0.9 cm, arguing against active surveillance for those tumors.

34714171.takeaway: Among 110 children who had thyroid lobectomy, 28% developed postoperative hypothyroidism, most recovered within a year, and a higher preoperative TSH was an independent risk factor.

34714772.takeaway: In 254 children with congenital hypothyroidism, oral solution and tablet levothyroxine were both effective, but solution gave lower TSH early on, raising overtreatment risk, with no overall difference in developmental quotient.

34714774.takeaway: A homozygous PPP2R3C variant caused gonadal dysgenesis in four people with 46,XX or 46,XY karyotypes, and knockout mouse embryos died early, indicating an essential developmental role.

34716210.takeaway: Among 674 youths with type 2 diabetes followed for about 10 years, neuropathy appeared early and increased over time, was more common in males, and was linked to higher HbA1c and BMI.

34716736.takeaway: In 4,643 children with type 1 diabetes in the SWEET registry, switching from injections to pump therapy was linked to lower HbA1c but higher BMI-SDS over time.

34718612.takeaway: Whole-exome sequencing of 291 women with primary ovarian insufficiency found candidate heterozygous variants, and functional tests supported seven new risk genes.

34718643.takeaway: In 120 pregnancies, 11-ketoandrostenedione rose through pregnancy and dominated cord-blood 11-oxygenated androgens, reflecting placental enzyme activity, and the authors provide normative values.

34718649.takeaway: In 145 Italian children with craniopharyngioma, diagnosis was often late, transcranial surgery was more common, nearly all developed hypopituitarism, and BMI rose over time.

34718650.takeaway: In 76 women with early GDM versus 1,185 with classical GDM, early GDM needed more medication and carried more postpartum metabolic syndrome, prediabetes and diabetes, with more large-for-gestational-age infants.

34719089.takeaway: In 30 youths with type 1 diabetes, fat without carbohydrate raised glucose 4 to 8 hours after eating, about 0.28 mmol/L per 10 g of fat, which may matter for insulin dosing.

34721288.takeaway: Children with short stature had lower 25(OH)D3 and free vitamin D than healthy controls, and mass spectrometry showed that total 25(OH)D can overestimate vitamin D stores in children.

34721293.takeaway: Geometric and inertial measures of 60 adult Chinese metatarsal bones estimated sex with 88 to 98% accuracy, a forensic rather than endocrine application.

34721295.takeaway: In 9,559 Chinese children aged 7 to 18, weekend sleep under 9 hours was linked to higher odds of abdominal obesity, especially in boys and children aged 7 to 12.

34721296.takeaway: Next-generation sequencing of 185 patients suspected of CYP24A1 disease found biallelic CYP24A1 or SLC34A3 variants in 15%, mostly with kidney stones or nephrocalcinosis, and no single pattern.

34721297.takeaway: In male rats, triclosan at 2.4 mg/kg/day reduced sperm viability and motility in the F1 generation, which the authors link to exposure during development.

34721301.takeaway: After epiphysiodesis at age 12, a girl with Tatton-Brown-Rahman syndrome from a de novo DNMT3A variant had a modest height gain, and the authors suggest considering the syndrome in extreme tall stature.

34721302.takeaway: In adult female mice lacking preproghrelin, pulsatile growth hormone secretion was reduced and more irregular, while growth, feeding and metabolism were unchanged, showing sex-specific effects.

34721304.takeaway: Of 127 children with adrenal insufficiency, 38 had been admitted with adrenal crisis; among 20 responders, parents gave oral hydrocortisone but only two gave intramuscular hydrocortisone despite reported confidence.

34721306.takeaway: Among 813 transmen who had one-stage metoidioplasty, 89.5% had complication-free urethroplasty, and 79% were totally satisfied at follow-up of up to 15 years.

34726229.takeaway: In 469 Ontario infants with congenital hypothyroidism, levothyroxine below 3 µg/kg at ages 1 and 2 predicted transient disease, and a risk score at age 1 can guide an earlier trial off.

34726357.takeaway: Hepcidin was higher in 42 obese prepubertal children than in 33 controls, and higher again in those with fatty liver disease, suggesting an early step in iron and metabolic disturbance.

34727590.takeaway: A 3-year-old boy with liver cirrhosis was found by targeted sequencing to carry a novel PHKA2 splice variant, suggesting such variants may be a rare cause of childhood cirrhosis.

34728528.takeaway: In 978 youths with type 1 diabetes, giving non-White youth the treatment mix of White youth was modelled to lower HbA1c by 0.33%, explaining about 35% of the 0.9% gap.

34738771.takeaway: A term neonate had congenital hyperinsulinism together with maple syrup urine disease, both confirmed genetically, and needed near-total pancreatectomy at 4 months; he was growing normally at 29 months.

34741521.takeaway: An expert Delphi consensus proposes individualized timelines for moving adolescents and young adults with X-linked hypophosphatemia from paediatric to adult care, covering education, genetic counselling, family planning and self-advocacy.

34741569.takeaway: In a survey of 209 health professionals from 33 countries, most reported telemedicine rising from under 10% of diabetes visits to over 50% during the pandemic, and 83% were satisfied.

34743368.takeaway: In 11 patients with medullary thyroid cancer and ectopic Cushing syndrome, hypercortisolism was controlled, but median survival was 87 months versus 190 months in matched patients without it.

34743977.takeaway: Across 1,215 subjects, stimulated 17-hydroxyprogesterone after a standard synacthen test identifies CYP21A2 carriers, with cut-offs of about 10.5 nmol/L in asymptomatic and 13.5 nmol/L in symptomatic heterozygotes.

34744995.takeaway: Across 32 studies, the tri-ponderal mass index predicted body fat in children at least as well as BMI, but it did not outperform BMI for metabolic syndrome or specific cardiovascular risk factors.

34744997.takeaway: In 17 patients with Marfan syndrome, estrogen height control started before age 10.5 was linked to a larger shortfall versus predicted final height (10.6 cm vs 0.6 cm) than later starts.

34745010.takeaway: Growth hormone deficiency is common in childhood cancer survivors, and GH therapy has not been shown to raise tumor recurrence risk, though cranial irradiation raises meningioma risk.

34747479.takeaway: In 1,742 Hispanic/Latino adults, Mediterranean diet adherence was linked to diverse gut microbes, and its association with lower diabetes odds was stronger in people without Prevotella.

34747488.takeaway: In 760 participants, autoantibodies to truncated GAD65 were more specific (46%) and had a higher positive predictive value (30%) for type 1 diabetes than full-length GAD antibodies alone.

34748635.takeaway: A genome-wide study of 788 Chilean children found one variant near GALR1 associated with serum DHEAS at genome-wide significance, plus suggestive variants that may regulate adrenarche.

34748636.takeaway: In 96 placentas, preterm birth and chorioamnionitis were linked to higher expression of drug efflux transporters and altered IL-6, while maternal BMI had no effect.

34750858.takeaway: Lifestyle change remains the mainstay of childhood obesity treatment, with medication and surgery reserved for refractory cases, while newer drugs are still lagging in paediatric trials.

34750859.takeaway: In 65 very young children with Prader-Willi syndrome, IGF-1 was lower than in 111 matched controls, independent of body size and nutrition, suggesting hypothalamic GH dysfunction.

34751387.takeaway: A child with hypocalcemic seizures and a homozygous KCNJ1 variant had Bartter syndrome type 2, with six affected relatives, two with hypocalcemia linked to vitamin D deficiency; phosphate-containing soft drinks were also flagged.

34752621.takeaway: Girls aged 8 to 14 related to a glucose-intolerant woman with PCOS had lower beta-cell function and higher free testosterone and 17-OHP than girls related to a normal-glucose-tolerant proband.

34754289.takeaway: In US adolescents aged 12 to 19, impaired glucose tolerance was linked to lower bone mineral density, with 2-hour plasma glucose, not fasting glucose, independently correlated.

34757702.takeaway: Scrotal ultrasound found testicular adrenal rest tumors in 5 of 46 Saudi boys with CAH, all with classical 21-hydroxylase deficiency and poor adherence, supporting routine screening.

34757705.takeaway: In 4,149 Chinese adolescents, 75% were vitamin D deficient, and serum 25(OH)D was inversely associated with metabolic syndrome, though the relationship was complex and concentration-dependent.

34757942.takeaway: In 262 patients with solitary low-risk papillary thyroid cancer who declined or were unfit for surgery, radiofrequency ablation gave similar progression rates for T1a and T1b tumors, with disappearance more common in T1a.

34758085.takeaway: In 95 girls with suspected progressive puberty, repeated first-voided urinary LH tests correlated well, and using the higher of two results may reduce the need for GnRH stimulation testing.

34758245.takeaway: In 118 overweight or obese South Indian children, a wrist circumference above the 97th percentile identified metabolic syndrome with 87% sensitivity and 38% specificity, a modest screening tool.

34758466.takeaway: Adolescents with severe obesity had about 37% weight loss in year one after bariatric surgery, but weight regain occurs in about half over time and bone or nutrient deficiencies in up to 90%.

34758467.takeaway: The review traces growth-promoting treatments that target growth plate physiology, from GH and IGF-I to local FGF and CNP pathways, and their growing efficacy and specificity.

34758469.takeaway: Maternal pre-pregnancy BMI and gestational weight gain independently predict infant adiposity, and early feeding, including breastfeeding, is linked to later body composition, the review concludes.

34758977.takeaway: Among 1,604 children with confirmed islet autoantibodies in prospective cohorts, type-specific titer thresholds separated 5-year diabetes risk from 6% to 75% and identified children with at least 50% risk.

34761429.takeaway: In 298 girls in early puberty and matched controls, the rs12935153 variant allele was linked to higher early-puberty risk after BMI adjustment, though the unadjusted association did not survive multiple-comparison correction.

34762538.takeaway: In Fukushima's thyroid screening of children, applying Japanese guidelines cut needle biopsies for small nodules and missed no carcinoma above 10 mm, though malignancy detection in smaller nodules rose.

34762596.takeaway: Between national surveys in 2009 and 2015, as iodine intake fell from more than to adequate, overt and subclinical hyperthyroidism, Graves disease and goitre declined, while thyroid nodules increased.

34763385.takeaway: A 7-year-old girl with central precocious puberty developed drug-induced vasculitis with a purpuric rash after a second dose of triptorelin, which resolved with steroids and allowed a switch to leuprolide.

34764940.takeaway: In 122 children with obesity, those with insulin resistance had higher 5α-reductase activity, a finding limited to boys, while 20α/20β-HSD activity was reduced only in insulin-resistant girls.

34766429.takeaway: Among 3,866 Danish children with type 1 diabetes, mean HbA1c differed by 11.6 mmol/mol between centers, case-mix explained only about 7% of the gap, and more frequent glucose monitoring was linked to lower HbA1c.

34766432.takeaway: Of 64 US pediatric endocrinologists who see youth with diabetes and ask about nicotine, 98% routinely asked about combustible tobacco, but 18% never asked about e-cigarettes, which they felt less confident discussing.

34766743.takeaway: In 103 children with new-onset type 1 diabetes, the pandemic year brought longer symptom duration, more weight loss and more severe ketoacidosis than the years before.

34773333.takeaway: Among 200 New Zealanders aged 15 to 24 with type 1 diabetes, about one in five had low wellbeing, 24% had diabetes distress and 31% had disordered eating, with Māori more often in clinical ranges.

34773338.takeaway: Of 398 Indian children with type 1 diabetes who were screened for celiac disease, 22 (5.5%) had biopsy-proven celiac disease, most of them symptomatic and younger at diabetes onset.

34773339.takeaway: Among 932 youth, those with a parent with type 2 diabetes reported more anxiety, depression and eating in the absence of hunger than peers, after adjusting for adiposity and insulin resistance.

34773353.takeaway: In 108 children with type 1 diabetes, homozygosity for the AKR1B1 Z-2 promoter variant was linked to more abnormal nerve conduction (83% vs 35%) and autonomic testing than in heterozygous or negative patients.

34775677.takeaway: In 6,826 US youth without diabetes, glycated albumin correlated poorly with HbA1c and fasting glucose and was inversely associated with BMI, so it did not identify youth at high cardiometabolic risk.

34776708.takeaway: In 88 adolescents, serum neudesin was lower in those with obesity and correlated inversely with BMI z-score, tending to rise with metabolic disorders without reaching significance.

34777239.takeaway: In seven patients with McCune-Albright syndrome and GH excess with precocious puberty, early control reduced growth velocity, and final height was not impaired, including in those with gigantism.

34777242.takeaway: Among 278 pregnant women with prior thyroidectomy for cancer, levothyroxine supplementation raised free T4 and was associated with lower neonatal birth weight, suggesting such doses may need monitoring.

34777246.takeaway: In 58 young adult offspring of women with type 1 diabetes, high amniotic fluid erythropoietin, a marker of late-pregnancy fetal hypoxia, was linked to higher BMI, adiposity and 2-hour glucose and insulin.

34777247.takeaway: Oxytocin regulates labour onset and progress, breastfeeding and the mother-infant bond, and stress during childbirth can impair these effects, the review concludes.

34777248.takeaway: In gingival fibroblasts from four patients with enamel-renal syndrome, TGF-β2 and its signalling targets were increased, pointing to TGF-β-driven extracellular matrix changes in gingival fibromatosis.

34777257.takeaway: In 31 gestational diabetes pregnancies compared with 30 controls, fetal aortic propagation velocity was lower and cord-blood von Willebrand factor higher, suggesting a non-invasive marker of fetal endothelial dysfunction.

34777260.takeaway: Age-standardized diabetic kidney disease mortality in China held roughly steady from 1990 to 2019, but deaths are projected to reach 88,803 by 2030 because population aging offsets falling age-specific rates.

34779087.takeaway: In 190 youths aged 10 to 17 with type 2 diabetes, sitagliptin as initial oral therapy did not significantly lower HbA1c versus placebo at 20 weeks and was well tolerated.

34779090.takeaway: In SWEET youth with type 1 diabetes, HbA1c was highest at diagnosis, lowest around months 4 to 5, then rose steadily to 18 months, and was highest in North American, Australian and NZ youth.

34779099.takeaway: In the German-Austrian DPV cohort, medium-sized centers best achieved glycemic targets, very small centers had the highest HbA1c and DKA rates, and the largest centers had the fewest severe hypoglycemia and DKA events.

34779100.takeaway: Depressive symptoms in 1,714 adolescents with type 1 diabetes were linked to 18% higher risk of HbA1c of 7.5% or more, 42% higher risk of 9.0% or more, and 82% higher DKA risk.

34779103.takeaway: In 220 youths with type 2 diabetes on metformin with or without insulin, adding sitagliptin lowered HbA1c 0.49% more than placebo at 20 weeks, but the benefit was not durable at 54 weeks.

34780103.takeaway: In 20 children with and 17 without type 1 diabetes, reallocating time to moderate-to-vigorous activity was predicted to improve cardiovascular measures, and the same activity intensity appeared more potent in children with diabetes.

34780306.takeaway: Early baseline and device-use data predicted 12-month success with the MiniMed 670G in 85 people with type 1 diabetes (AUC about 0.89 to 0.90), with external validation at 0.72 in 55 others.

34781289.takeaway: The review recommends earlier, stepwise genetic testing in children with differences of sex development, since a molecular diagnosis enables more individualized management and monitoring, though many still lack one.

34781296.takeaway: The review sets out an age-based workup for suspected DSD, stressing detailed genital anatomy, imaging or surgical exploration, hormone levels including AMH and testosterone, and karyotyping.

34782353.takeaway: Among 536 people with childhood-onset type 1 diabetes followed for 30 years, those with persistently high HbA1c had about three times the cardiovascular disease risk, with different risk factors in each HbA1c pattern.

34787382.takeaway: In 74 children with systemic lupus erythematosus, the osteoprotegerin rs2073617 T allele, longer illness duration and higher disease activity were linked to lower bone mineral density.

34788756.takeaway: Among 38 Chilean children aged 8 to 18, transgender youth scored lower on quality of life than cisgender peers, especially in mood and psychological well-being; parents rated them higher.

34788830.takeaway: In a 6-week crossover study of 39 children with 21-hydroxylase deficiency, giving the highest hydrocortisone dose in the morning or evening produced comparable daily hormone levels, with no clear schedule benefit.

34789498.takeaway: Among 1,513 pregnant women of four ancestries, a high type 2 diabetes genetic risk score was linked to higher fetal and birth weight in European Americans from mid-pregnancy, but not in other groups.

34789499.takeaway: Genetic testing of 1,280 people suspected of MODY confirmed monogenic diabetes in 23%, and syndromic genes, mainly mtDNA m.3243A>G and HNF1B, accounted for 19% of cases, so they should be routinely tested.

34792267.takeaway: In 44 people with genetically confirmed Wolfram syndrome, C-peptide declined with diabetes duration, most steeply in the first 2.3 years, making it a useful marker for early trials.

34792304.takeaway: Among 114 Japanese patients with Prader-Willi syndrome over age 10, 29% developed type 2 diabetes at a median age of 18 with BMI 33.7, and food-related problems were the only behavioural measure that differed.

34792487.takeaway: Of 320 consecutive Chinese children with diabetes, three had non-syndromic diabetes from recessive WFS1 variants, about 0.94%, suggesting such cases are often misdiagnosed as type 1 diabetes.

34793669.takeaway: In 121 children with type 1 diabetes, about 29% had associated autoimmunity and 6% had multiple autoimmunity, predicted by diagnosis before age 5, ketoacidosis at onset and family history.

34793670.takeaway: Among 196 Ukrainian adolescents, vitamin D sufficiency was rare with overweight or obesity, and metabolic syndrome was found in 64% of obese adolescents with vitamin D deficiency versus 26% of overweight ones.

34794973.takeaway: In an 80-person randomized trial of people using injections, adding a CGM decision support system did not significantly improve time in range over CGM alone, though active users had less hypoglycemia.

34799431.takeaway: Among 2,561 youth and young adults with diabetes, household food insecurity affected 31% with type 2 and 18% with type 1 diabetes, and 14% used SNAP, a higher rate than the general US population.

34801996.takeaway: Gene therapy, which can give durable benefit from one intervention, is being explored for type 1 diabetes, growth hormone deficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia and diabetes insipidus, though clinical use in endocrinology remains challenging.

34802201.takeaway: Among 187 children with obesity, 72% were metabolically unhealthy, and serum uric acid and HOMA-IR predicted that phenotype.

34803902.takeaway: In 64 women with early-onset primary ovarian insufficiency, targeted sequencing found variants in 48, most with several, and the most severe phenotypes tracked with more variants, suggesting an oligogenic cause.

34803908.takeaway: A survey of 131 pediatric endocrine centers in 51 countries found diabetes the hardest endocrine condition to manage during COVID-19, with 44% reporting more DKA in new cases and 30% in established cases.

34803913.takeaway: In 12 young men, quercetin raised IGF-I and brought forward the IGF-II peak after muscle-damaging exercise, and lowered muscle-damage markers and IL-6 during recovery versus placebo.

34803914.takeaway: Among 19 patients with calcitonin-negative medullary thyroid cancer, outcomes were favorable, with no recurrence and 95% overall survival over a median 71 months, so MTC should not be ruled out when calcitonin is normal.

34803919.takeaway: Six children with adrenocortical tumors and wild-type TP53 carried paternal 11p15 uniparental disomy, and all were alive 8 to 21 years later, so the authors advise screening such children for 11p15 changes.

34803923.takeaway: In grass carp, PrRP peptides were anorexigenic and stimulated luteinizing hormone release, suggesting they couple feeding metabolism to reproduction in teleosts.

34806114.takeaway: In 33 children with new-onset type 1 diabetes, FABP4 was higher in those with DKA, with a 7.2 ng/mL cut-off giving 86% sensitivity, and knockout mice were protected from ketoacidosis.

34806437.takeaway: In a national survey of 78,470 adults across China, median urinary iodine was 178 µg/L and goiter prevalence 1.2%, with 95% salt iodization coverage, suggesting iodine deficiency has been eliminated.

34806438.takeaway: A novel homozygous sodium-iodide symporter variant, S356F, caused congenital hypothyroidism in four siblings from one Indian family, with impaired membrane localization and iodide transport in vitro.

34809477.takeaway: Reviewing downloaded glucose data was not by itself linked to better HbA1c among 191 caregivers, but each extra data-driven insulin adjustment was linked to 0.24 percentage points lower HbA1c.

34809493.takeaway: A review traces a century of diabetes technology, from insulin's discovery to modern devices, that has let people with type 1 diabetes take part in sport at every competitive level.

34814150.takeaway: In five children with hyponatraemia, copeptin was elevated in four, indicating non-osmotic vasopressin release, and in one child with Schaaf-Yang syndrome it fluctuated, pointing to dysregulated vasopressin.

34814153.takeaway: Chronic stress and hypercortisolism suppress the growth hormone, gonadal and thyroid axes and disrupt growth, puberty and metabolism, while early-life adversity has long-term effects, the review concludes.

34815552.takeaway: Trials of more than 30,000 vitamin D-replete adults found supplementation did not prevent cancer, cardiovascular events, falls or type 2 diabetes, though severe deficiency should still be corrected.

34817083.takeaway: Among 240 women with prior gestational diabetes, dysglycemia was linked to lower bone microarchitecture, with diabetes carrying nearly three-fold odds of low trabecular bone score and lower osteocalcin.

34819917.takeaway: Among 78 healthy reproductive-age women, oral contraceptive users had a cortisol awakening response 61% lower than non-users and higher waking cortisol, with no working memory difference.

34819918.takeaway: In national samples of 57,201 Chinese and 10,441 American children, sex-specific tri-ponderal mass index cut-points identified metabolic syndrome with good accuracy, with AUCs up to 0.93 in US children.

34820964.takeaway: In South Australia, starting CGM at diagnosis was feasible and taken up by 84%, but continued wear above 75% at 24 months did not differ significantly from children started later (78% vs 66%).

34820965.takeaway: Despite free insulin in Cameroon, mortality among children with type 1 diabetes was 33 per 1,000 person-years, higher in rural clinics and among children without formal education.

34820972.takeaway: Two infants diagnosed with type 1 diabetes at 7 and 18 months started a hybrid closed-loop system from diagnosis, with HbA1c near 49 to 50 mmol/mol and no severe hypoglycemia over six months.

34821121.takeaway: A 16-year-old with new-onset type 1 diabetes presented with ketoacidosis and severe hyponatremia from isolated hypoaldosteronism of primary adrenal insufficiency, showing that a random cortisol can mislead.

34837063.takeaway: A 55-expert international consensus, built by modified Delphi, sets recommendations for diagnosis and lifelong care of achondroplasia to standardize care across life stages.

34837310.takeaway: Among 24 children with neonatal diabetes in Israel, 88% had a genetic cause, a switch to sulfonylureas succeeded in 56% of candidates, and chronic complications appeared after more than 10 years.

34837504.takeaway: In HLA-susceptible children followed to age 3, breastfeeding for 6 months or longer was linked to lower levels of several immune markers between 6 and 24 months, though the clinical meaning is unclear.

34839286.takeaway: In 80 obese adolescents, serum spexin was lower than in 80 healthy peers and lowest in those with metabolic syndrome, where a 49.5 pg/mL cut-off predicted it with 75% sensitivity.

34841451.takeaway: An umbrella meta-analysis found type 2 diabetes prevalence of 40% in sleep disorders, 21% in binge eating, 16% in substance use and 14% in anxiety, and about 9 to 11% in several others.

34842489.takeaway: In 89 adults with painful diabetic neuropathy treated with 10 kHz spinal cord stimulation, 80% of those assessed reported at least 50% pain relief in a real-world review, with improved sleep and function.

34845532.takeaway: In 953 healthy adults, poor sleep efficiency and a later sleep midpoint were associated with higher glucose responses to the next morning's standard breakfast, highlighting sleep as a modifiable target.

34845885.takeaway: Among 100 very-low-birth-weight infants, 38 had early adiposity rebound before age 5, and these children had a higher BMI percentile at age 7 (median 44.6 vs 14.4), predicting future obesity.

34847552.takeaway: Consanguineous families have helped identify genes in paediatric endocrinology, because recessive single-gene causes are more likely there, as illustrated by congenital hyperinsulinism, monogenic diabetes and short stature.

34850003.takeaway: In 1.1 million Israeli adolescents, obesity was more common with severe ADHD (13.5% vs 7.5%), and both severe and mild ADHD carried raised adjusted odds of obesity.

34850011.takeaway: Among 24,479 Shanghai deliveries, women with intermediate fasting hyperglycemia in early pregnancy but normal later glucose tolerance had higher adjusted risks of primary cesarean, preterm birth and neonatal distress.

34850014.takeaway: In 602 TrialNet relatives positive for diabetes autoantibodies, electrochemiluminescence GAD antibody positivity tracked HLA-DR3 and DR4 haplotypes, while ECL insulin antibody positivity tracked DR4.

34850017.takeaway: In 814 Chinese children with short stature, exome sequencing found a genetic cause in 361, most often RASopathies, and short stature with skeletal, facial or intellectual features raised the chance of a monogenic cause.

34850024.takeaway: In 135 youth with new-onset type 1 diabetes, a team-based program with early CGM and remote data review lowered HbA1c by about 0.5% versus a historical cohort at 6 to 12 months.

34850038.takeaway: Among 471 French children with congenital hypothyroidism and an eutopic gland, one-third had transient disease, linked to premature birth, low screening TSH, lower levothyroxine dose at 12 months and cardiac malformations.

34850915.takeaway: In 239 propensity-matched adults with metastatic adrenocortical carcinoma, those without primary-tumor surgery had 3.2 times the risk of death, though this observational analysis cannot prove benefit.

34851564.takeaway: Among 1,125 Chinese children aged 10 to 18, metabolically healthy overweight or obesity was uncommon (7%) and was linked to a more favourable hs-CRP profile than unhealthy overweight or obesity.

34852347.takeaway: GLP-1 receptor agonists are effective and safe as an adjunct to lifestyle treatment in adolescents with obesity who respond poorly to lifestyle alone, and liraglutide was FDA-approved for ages 12 to 17 in 2020.

34856538.takeaway: Because GH deficiency is rare among short children, most positive GH stimulation tests are false positives; the authors estimate a true-positive probability of about 0.028, or 1 in 36.

34856543.takeaway: Among 160 children aged about 8 to 15, those born preterm had lower circulating irisin and higher leptin and central adiposity than full-term peers, a possible marker of later cardiometabolic risk.

34858328.takeaway: In 25 prepubertal children with Noonan syndrome and 40 girls with Turner syndrome, both had higher GH secretion than controls, but only Noonan children had low IGF-I and a greater growth response to rhGH.

34858334.takeaway: In SEER data on 1,484 children with papillary thyroid cancer, classical subtype carried more distant metastasis than follicular variant at ages 2 to 16, with extrathyroidal extension and nodal spread as risk factors.

34858336.takeaway: In 92 patients with basal ganglia germ cell tumors, delayed diagnosis, focal radiotherapy and non-pure germinoma independently predicted a poorer prognosis.

34858339.takeaway: In 44 children and adolescents, the advanced hybrid closed-loop system lowered HbA1c to 7.1% after six months versus 7.7% with the standard system, with most benefit in those under 14.

34858344.takeaway: Sperm selected by zona pellucida binding showed lower DNA methylation and more autism-gene differences than manually selected sperm, suggesting that sperm choice in ICSI may influence autism risk.

34858347.takeaway: Across human biomonitoring studies, bisphenol A, DDE and PFOA showed consistent positive associations with obesity measures, while phthalate and other persistent pollutant findings were inconsistent.

34861785.takeaway: In silico, with 20 virtual adults and adolescents, the bio-inspired controller kept more time in range than the DIY Loop algorithm in the more variable scenario; both beat a standard suspend algorithm.

34863037.takeaway: A European expert consensus gives recommendations for diagnosing and managing primary hyperparathyroidism and chronic hypoparathyroidism in adults, including in pregnancy and lactation, and flags areas of uncertainty.

34864951.takeaway: Delayed puberty from hypogonadism needs prompt hormone therapy to induce puberty, reach target height and protect bone and psychosexual development, though larger randomized trials are still lacking.

34865241.takeaway: Among 1,139 Iranian mother-offspring pairs, early maternal menarche was linked to taller sons, while late maternal menarche was linked to lower obesity odds in daughters, with no link to metabolic markers.

34865288.takeaway: During Israel's first COVID-19 lockdown, 58% of children presenting with new type 1 diabetes had ketoacidosis, roughly double the adjusted odds of earlier years, and 20% had severe DKA.

34866369.takeaway: A meta-analysis of 15,874 children found the Indonesian growth reference chart identified fewer stunted children than the WHO standards, which the authors argue over-represent stunting in Indonesia.

34866370.takeaway: A 7-year-old girl developed clitoromegaly from clitoral priapism after appendectomy, a non-hormonal cause, which improved with pseudoephedrine and aspiration.

34866371.takeaway: In 16 children with salt-wasting CAH, a 4-hour 17-hydroxyprogesterone profile did not predict hyperandrogenemia, and low hydrocortisone doses were linked to poorer metabolic control.

34867773.takeaway: In 387 women with asynchronous follicles during IVF stimulation, switching to a flexible progestin-primed protocol retrieved fewer oocytes and embryos than the fixed antagonist protocol, with similar pregnancy rates.

34867776.takeaway: Drawing on nine cases, the review argues aggressive pituitary adenomas need multidisciplinary, individualized care combining surgery, radiotherapy, temozolomide, somatostatin ligands and targeted drugs, since evidence is thin.

34867779.takeaway: Retinal nerve fibre layer was thinner than reference ranges in nine patients with Triple A syndrome, most in the temporal optic nerve, suggesting OCT could track neurodegeneration.
