34867780.takeaway: Transcriptome analysis of blood cells in partial androgen insensitivity found 725 differentially expressed genes, with seven candidates proposed as possible diagnostic markers pending validation.

34867792.takeaway: Among 422 Chinese patients with Cushing's disease, children more often had growth retardation and weight gain, and boys made up a larger share of children (50%) than adults (17%) with earlier, more severe disease.

34867796.takeaway: Untargeted metabolomics of 30 newly diagnosed children with Graves disease and 30 matched controls found 48 altered metabolites, with changes in amino acid and purine pathways.

34867800.takeaway: In mice lacking collagen-II-specific Sirt1, reduced catch-up growth came with more anxiety, lower activity and poorer spatial learning, suggesting a link between linear growth and brain function.

34867803.takeaway: In 1,492 Chinese children aged 6 to 11, waist-to-height ratio identified left ventricular hypertrophy and remodelling as well as or better than BMI or waist circumference.

34867806.takeaway: In 7,644 pregnant women, higher manganese and zinc before 24 weeks were linked to larger neonatal head and chest circumference, with about 10% to 26% of these associations running through fasting plasma glucose.

34867807.takeaway: In rat stem Leydig cell cultures, low midazolam concentrations slightly raised testosterone output and high concentrations lowered it, a possible pubertal effect that needs testing in human cells.

34872983.takeaway: After Australia's universal CGM subsidy for people under 21, CGM uptake rose from 5% to 79% in two years, with higher odds of HbA1c below 7% and fewer DKA episodes among frequent users.

34877761.takeaway: In 2,455 healthy German children aged 0.5 to 18, HbA1c rose with age, BMI and puberty and was higher in boys, giving age- and sex-specific reference values.

34880068.takeaway: Among 141 young women with youth-onset type 2 diabetes in TODAY, 260 pregnancies had pregnancy loss in 25%, preterm birth in 33%, and complications in 65% of women.

34880069.takeaway: In 91 autoantibody-positive children, time above 140 mg/dL over 10% predicted an 80% one-year risk of progression to type 1 diabetes, suggesting CGM could help select children for prevention trials.

34880833.takeaway: In a Guadeloupe birth cohort, third-quartile in utero chlordecone exposure was linked to higher TSH in girls and higher DHEA, testosterone and DHT in both sexes at age seven, in an inverted-U pattern.

34881493.takeaway: In mainland France, 97 children aged 1 to 14 died of type 1 diabetes from 1987 to 2016, mostly from ketoacidosis; mortality fell except in ages 1 to 4, still about five-fold higher.

34881532.takeaway: In one tertiary clinic, 58 girls were diagnosed with idiopathic central precocious puberty in the pandemic year, more than double the rate of any of the previous three years.

34881539.takeaway: Among 139 Korean children aged 6 to 12 followed for a year during the pandemic, BMI z-scores rose, mostly in the first three months, and the share overweight or obese rose from 24.5% to 38.1%.

34882579.takeaway: Across nine trials with 462 adults with overweight or obesity, adding exercise to a low-calorie diet did not change testosterone, estradiol or SHBG beyond diet alone.

34882803.takeaway: Among 389 small-for-gestational-age children on growth hormone, insulin resistance rose in the first year and then stayed within normal range over 10 years, while height SDS improved from -3.0 to -1.1.

34883003.takeaway: Four Chinese children with maple syrup urine disease carried seven mutations, including three novel ones in BCKDHA, BCKDHB and DBT, which may help prenatal diagnosis.

34883004.takeaway: Three cousins from a consanguineous Turkish family had visceral-neurodegenerative Niemann-Pick type C, all with a novel homozygous NPC1 intronic variant that causes skipping of exon 9.

34888998.takeaway: In 805 children with type 1 diabetes, HbA1c and glucose management indicator differed by 0.5% or more in a third, so they should not be compared directly, and the authors derived a youth-specific GMI equation.

34890170.takeaway: After a switch from a polyclonal to a monoclonal cortisol assay, the share of 1-microgram cosyntropin tests passing the 18 µg/dL cut-off fell from 74% to 29%, so adrenal insufficiency diagnoses rose.

34890172.takeaway: Eight growth-restricted preterm infants with hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia were asymptomatic, often had cholestasis, and four needed diazoxide, so the authors advise confirming euglycemia before stopping glucose monitoring.

34893832.takeaway: Among 37 girls with Turner syndrome aged about 17, appearance orientation and self-classified weight scores were lower than population norms, while body satisfaction was similar, with classic 45,X and overweight girls least satisfied.

34894265.takeaway: Using the day-3 TSH from congenital hypothyroidism screening, a cut-off of 0.18 mIU/L detected severe neonatal hyperthyroidism with 71% sensitivity and 99% specificity, allowing earlier treatment.

34894357.takeaway: Across 31 longitudinal studies with 28,316 women, PCOS was linked to a higher risk of type 2 diabetes, while BMI change and coronary heart disease risk resembled controls, and most other outcomes were inconsistent.

34894365.takeaway: In 5,798 Finnish children with type 1 diabetes, high-risk HLA genotypes were linked to younger age at diagnosis, more affected relatives and distinct autoantibody profiles, while DKA was more common with lower-risk genotypes.

34897472.takeaway: A maternal serum metabolite ratio at 36 weeks predicted large-for-gestational-age birth with an AUC of 0.82 in 281 women and was inversely associated with birth weight across the range, with weaker validation in 2,366 women.

34897924.takeaway: The Italian versions of the Hypoglycemia Fear Survey for children and parents showed good reliability and validity in 174 children with type 1 diabetes and 178 parents.

34899591.takeaway: In 1,182 adults with MRI-measured liver fat, lipid and apolipoprotein profiles related to liver fat differently by MAFLD phenotype, with dose-response patterns in overweight people and in those with type 2 diabetes.

34899593.takeaway: A 14-year-old girl with recurrent daytime sleepiness and abnormal night-time behaviour was found to have an insulinoma, and her symptoms resolved after tumour removal, showing insulinoma can mimic sleep disorders.

34899594.takeaway: Across 161 patients with maternally inherited diabetes and deafness, most carried the m.3243A>G mutation and had young-onset diabetes with low or normal BMI and multisystem involvement, supporting earlier genetic testing.

34899597.takeaway: The review argues that endometriosis lesions vary in aromatase activity and progesterone resistance, so surgery and medical therapy should be individualized, with early intervention considered during adolescence.

34899601.takeaway: Among 6,223 Chinese pregnant women, underweight women with high second-trimester total cholesterol had about twice the odds of large-for-gestational-age infants, especially with gestational weight gain above guidelines.

34899612.takeaway: In 585 children with growth hormone deficiency, biweekly PEG-rhGH gave a smaller height gain than weekly PEG-rhGH or daily rhGH and failed the non-inferiority threshold, though it still raised height velocity.

34904249.takeaway: In 504 Chilean girls followed from birth through puberty, high DHEAS at about age 7 was linked to more central fat, higher androgens and IGF-I, and more metabolic syndrome after menarche, especially with overweight.

34904651.takeaway: The pooled prevalence of sarcopenia among adults with diabetes was 18%, higher in men and in Asia, with age, HbA1c, visceral fat, nephropathy, diabetes duration and hs-CRP as risk factors.

34905667.takeaway: Screening 429 Pakistani children with intellectual disability found classical homocystinuria in nine, including three novel CBS mutations, and early treatment brought behavioural improvement.

34909515.takeaway: In Hong Kong mothers and newborns, 3-epi-25(OH)D3 was detected in over 90% and contributed up to about 20% of total 25(OH)D3, so it should be considered when interpreting vitamin D status.

34909516.takeaway: Obesity does not change the core approach to precocious puberty: obese girls with confirmed thelarche should be evaluated for central puberty, basal LH remains first-line, and GnRH analogues do not worsen weight.

34912297.takeaway: Among 1,755 subfertile women with PCOS who had frozen embryo transfer, a thinner endometrium was linked to higher risks of preterm birth, low birthweight and small-for-gestational-age infants.

34912300.takeaway: In 131 organ donors with type 1 diabetes and 111 controls, alcohol or cocaine use was linked to more exocrine pancreas damage and islet amyloid in those with diabetes.

34913019.takeaway: Using pharmacokinetic simulations from 105 children on once-weekly lonapegsomatropin, the authors derived a formula that estimates average IGF-1 from one sample taken about 4.5 days after dosing.

34913020.takeaway: In 36 youths with new-onset type 1 diabetes, ergocalciferol did not significantly change stimulated C-peptide but lowered TNF-α and blunted the rise in HbA1c over 12 months versus placebo.

34913548.takeaway: Across 15 randomized studies of digital health interventions for youth with type 1 diabetes, self-efficacy improved in two of three studies, but other outcomes showed no consistent benefit.

34913553.takeaway: In 63 children with obesity, 20 with prediabetes had higher peak GLP-1 during an oral glucose test than 43 with normal glucose tolerance, but overall incretin effect did not differ between groups.

34914631.takeaway: Whole blood DNA methylation distinguished glucocorticoid excess, adrenal insufficiency and normal cortisol states, with excess linked to hypomethylation that recovered after treatment, and a predictor validated in two independent cohorts.

34915486.takeaway: New testosterone formulations are not approved for children and evidence-based guidance is lacking, though some may suit pubertal induction and penile enlargement, and long-acting forms may serve adolescents.

34915489.takeaway: The review describes a continuum from insulin resistance to type 2 diabetes in children with obesity, largely preventable through early identification and control of modifiable risk factors.

34915493.takeaway: Among 805 children with type 1 diabetes, only 31% met the glycemic variability target (CV at or below 36%), and time below range and time above 250 mg/dL predicted high variability.

34915504.takeaway: In 75 normoalbuminuric children with type 1 diabetes, urinary VEGF-A, angiotensinogen and transferrin were higher than in 55 controls, suggesting early kidney changes before albuminuria.

34915753.takeaway: Among 71 children with differentiated thyroid cancer tested with molecular panels, over 90% had a genetic alteration, and BRAF-like fusions were linked to more advanced stage, multifocal disease and nodal spread.

34915754.takeaway: In 62 children with benign thyroid nodules, radiofrequency ablation reduced nodule volume and symptoms over four years, though 23% regrew, and bilateral nodules responded less well.

34915766.takeaway: In 37 children with thyroid carcinoma, radiation-induced papillary cancers carried gene fusions in 86% versus 56% of primary cases, and radiation-induced follicular cancers more often had copy number changes.

34915770.takeaway: At age two, children of mothers with TPO-antibody-negative subclinical hypothyroidism had lower developmental quotients than controls only when untreated maternal TSH was 4 to 10 mIU/L, with TSH level and maternal education linked to development.

34917035.takeaway: Among 19 women with APECED, 84% had premature ovarian insufficiency and most had very low androgen levels, and asymptomatic genital infections were common, though cervical atypia was rare.

34918072.takeaway: Obese or overweight boys aged 5 to 19 had lower inhibin B and testosterone than 652 healthy boys from age 12 to 14, with 18% to 31% below the 5th percentile in late puberty.

34918112.takeaway: In 221 children with brain tumors, GH deficiency affected about 80%, and hypothyroidism (76%) and ACTH deficiency (70%) were common after suprasellar tumors, prompting the authors to recommend endocrine follow-up for all.

34918116.takeaway: Among 9,131 atomic bomb survivors followed from 1969 to 2015, radiation dose was associated with diabetes incidence, strongest in Hiroshima and in those exposed at younger ages, though results differed between cities.

34918373.takeaway: Among 48 girls with premature adrenarche and 49 matched controls, breast gland tissue was seen in 30% versus 5%, with higher uterine volume and endometrial thickness that tracked with insulin.

34922359.takeaway: In 10 treatment-naïve children with aggrecan deficiency, one year of growth hormone raised height velocity from 5.2 to 8.3 cm per year and height SDS by 0.62, without inappropriate skeletal advancement.

34925239.takeaway: In 369 children and adolescents with obesity, serum uric acid partly mediated the link between BMI and insulin resistance as measured by HOMA-IR, though not fasting glucose.

34925243.takeaway: A scoping review found only four studies on health-related quality of life in children with congenital hyperinsulinism, with inconsistent results, so larger longitudinal studies using generic and condition-specific tools are needed.

34927274.takeaway: Australian and New Zealand societies advise minimally invasive parathyroidectomy for most patients with concordant imaging, bilateral exploration for discordant imaging, and calcium and PTH checks within 24 hours after surgery.

34927407.takeaway: In 90 Egyptian children with type 1 diabetes and 90 matched controls, six plasma microRNAs were dysregulated, and two of them correlated with HbA1c, suggesting possible biomarkers.

34927408.takeaway: Targeted sequencing found a genetic cause in 24 of 44 Iranian children with congenital hyperinsulinism, mostly ABCC8, and those with genetic causes were more often diazoxide-unresponsive and needed pancreatectomy.

34932134.takeaway: In organ donors, beta cells from people with type 1 diabetes expressed HLA class II in about 28% of beta cells versus under 1% in controls; cytokines induced this in healthy islets in vitro.

34933304.takeaway: In 49 girls with central precocious puberty or premature thelarche, a single stimulated LH of 4.29 IU/L at 60 minutes after leuprolide distinguished the two, offering a practical single-sample test.

34935944.takeaway: In 32 people after gastric bypass, a mixed meal test detected hypoglycemia with 71% sensitivity and 100% specificity, better than free-living CGM at 47% and 88%.

34935958.takeaway: A nationwide survey of 32,025 Japanese schoolchildren found median urinary iodine of 269 µg/L, within the WHO adequate range, but 5% to 14% exceeded the tolerable upper limit, with regional differences.

34937025.takeaway: Children with type 1 diabetes show altered bone mass and microarchitecture, with low bone turnover, high sclerostin and microvascular disease implicated, the review finds.

34937037.takeaway: The authors argue GH stimulation testing produces many false-positive idiopathic GHD diagnoses, so diagnosis should sit on a continuum, with provisional diagnoses re-examined at puberty and clinical judgment kept central.

34951040.takeaway: Among 50,217 Chinese women with a routine TSH test before conception, subclinical hypothyroidism was linked to higher rates of composite adverse pregnancy outcomes, with a nonlinear association across TSH levels.

34951936.takeaway: Among 128,113 Suzhou students aged 6 to 17, 13.6% had hypertension, which was 2.3 to 2.8 times more common in those with obesity than in those of normal weight.

34952557.takeaway: Among 961 boys aged 1 to 18 on thoracic CT, gynecomastia occurred in 52% of breasts at a 5 mm threshold, 37% at 10 mm and 11% at 20 mm, varying significantly with age.

34954856.takeaway: Over 50 years in Canterbury, New Zealand, childhood type 1 diabetes incidence rose more than fivefold, from 5.3 to 29.0 per 100,000 person-years, with rising numbers among Māori.

34954930.takeaway: In 101 adolescents with pubertal gynecomastia and 88 controls, androgen receptor CAG repeat length was not directly associated with gynecomastia, though short repeats were linked to lower BMI SDS.

34954931.takeaway: A 10-year-old girl with ROHHAD-NET achieved meaningful weight loss through lifestyle change and three anti-obesity drugs, and was ultimately referred for bariatric surgery.

34954934.takeaway: Among 23 Saudi children with osteogenesis imperfecta, most had type III or IV disease, with hearing loss in 53%, restrictive lung disease in 70%, and a high yield of genetic variants.

34956073.takeaway: Across 133 reports covering 15.6 million pregnancies in Europe, GDM prevalence was about 11%, highest in Eastern Europe at 31.5%, and nearly seven-fold higher in obese women.

34956076.takeaway: In 17 people with cartilage-hair hypoplasia, the jaws and clivus were shorter than in 34 healthy controls, but craniocervical pathology such as basilar invagination was not seen.

34956079.takeaway: In 29 children with distal forearm fractures, closed reduction with Kirschner-wire fixation caused a smaller rise in IL-6 than the fracture itself, and HMGB-1 and HSP-70 were not raised afterwards.

34956083.takeaway: In 1,458 Chinese newborns, fetal weight and abdominal circumference in late pregnancy were positively linked to cord insulin and inversely to triglycerides, with associations differing by gestational period.

34956087.takeaway: A girl with 18q- syndrome and growth hormone deficiency gained 2.8 height SDS over seven years of rhGH, and a review of 16 similar patients showed a comparable average height gain.

34956092.takeaway: The review argues that some children labelled idiopathic short stature have mild GH resistance, such as PAPP-A2 deficiency, which would respond to IGF-I rather than GH, so careful investigation matters.

34956101.takeaway: Across six studies with 7,955 pregnant women with subclinical hypothyroidism, levothyroxine treatment was associated with lower risks of pregnancy loss, preterm birth and gestational hypertension.

34962164.takeaway: Among 35 children aged 6 to 13 on closed-loop control, 17 had an HbA1c rise of at least 0.5% during extended use; they started with higher baseline HbA1c.

34962573.takeaway: Guideline for endocrine surveillance in childhood cancer survivors: at-risk survivors should receive regular clinical and laboratory screening for hypothalamic-pituitary dysfunction, with timely specialist referral.

34963118.takeaway: Reviews recently proposed monogenic causes of 46,XX and 46,XY DSD and recommends practices for interpreting genomic data to improve diagnostic yield.

34964458.takeaway: Over 3 years, once-weekly somapacitan gave height velocity and height gains similar to daily GH in children with GH deficiency, with similar safety and tolerability.

34964865.takeaway: Annual ADA Standards of Care chapter on diabetes care in children and adolescents; the abstract itself states no specific recommendations.

34965699.takeaway: A male infant with congenital insulin resistance from a novel homozygous INSR missense variant had severe hyperinsulinemia, glycemic swings and progressive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.

34965700.takeaway: Two siblings with osteoporosis-pseudoglioma syndrome shared a novel homozygous LRP5 nonsense variant but differed in osteoporosis severity and fractures.

34966357.takeaway: Among 4.9 million Chinese adults, higher outdoor concentrations of six air pollutants were associated with higher odds of thyroid nodules, more strongly in men, younger adults and people with low urine iodine.

34967089.takeaway: In 113 young adults with type 1 diabetes, efficacy beliefs and self-compassion were linked to better self-care and HbA1c, partly through self-care behaviours.

34967858.takeaway: Reviews stem-cell and organ-on-chip approaches to restore gametogenesis in patients with reproductive failure, gonadal dysgenesis or cancer survivorship, and the barriers to clinical use.

34968016.takeaway: In 134 children with gonadal tumors or cysts, AFP and beta-hCG were unelevated in cysts and benign tumors and elevated in most germ cell tumors, but did not predict recurrence.

34970219.takeaway: Prepubertal children with type 1 diabetes had lower urinary glucocorticoid metabolites and altered cortisol-metabolizing enzyme activity than matched controls, suggesting greater nocturnal cortisol bioavailability.

34970226.takeaway: In 172 patients with large or giant pituitary adenomas, BMI of 25 or more, Knosp grade 4, partial resection and Ki-67 of 3% or more predicted recurrence after transnasal surgery.

34975744.takeaway: Protocol for a hybrid implementation-effectiveness trial scaling up an early-life healthy eating and active play program across Victoria, Australia, with infant BMI z-score outcomes at 12 and 18 months.

34975745.takeaway: Among 1,104 women with intermediate hyperglycemia in early pregnancy, an early OGTT was not linked to lower large-for-gestational-age risk and was associated with more neonatal hyperbilirubinemia.

34975750.takeaway: In pediatric brain tumor patients, nuchal skinfold thickness on routine MRI tracked BMI and waist-to-height ratio and was highest in craniopharyngioma, a possible marker of nuchal adiposity.

34975751.takeaway: In 289 TgAb-positive thyroid cancer patients treated by surgery and radioiodine, a falling TgAb at 6 months and 2 years predicted tumour-free survival and improved ATA risk stratification.

34975773.takeaway: Reviews evidence that delaying puberty with GnRH analogues or aromatase inhibitors, alone or with growth hormone, may raise adult height in selected short children, with limited data and incompletely established safety.

34981619.takeaway: In 295 children with type 1 diabetes over 5 years, good glycemic control was achieved with BMI SD scores near their pre-diagnosis trajectory, though HbA1c rose from year 1 to year 5.

34981624.takeaway: Across 12 studies of 1,895 parents, more frequent or severe hypoglycemia in children with type 1 diabetes was linked to greater parental fear, distress and family burden; overall quality-of-life effects are unclear.

34981748.takeaway: Recommends prolonged first-line methimazole or carbimazole (3 years or more) with dose titration, avoiding propylthiouracil, and definitive treatment by thyroidectomy or RAI, with RAI avoided under age 10.

34986667.takeaway: In 329 people with type 1 diabetes, 10 to 14 days of CGM gave biased estimates of 3-month glycemic control, while about 30 days reduced bias and improved target classification.

34989216.takeaway: Of 55 Pakistani patients with hepatic glycogen storage disease, GSD III was most common, and molecular testing found 19 variants in eight genes, including five novel variants.

34991299.takeaway: Evaluating short stature should weight clinical, endocrine and genetic assessment equally, using targeted sequencing for suspected monogenic disorders and exome sequencing for complex unexplained phenotypes.

34991300.takeaway: Reviews the natural history and mechanisms of hyperphagia and obesity in Prader-Willi syndrome, with updated obesity treatments and screening for its endocrine complications.

34991301.takeaway: Reviews the history of insulin treatment for children and adolescents with diabetes in Korea since insulin was first used in 1922.

34991302.takeaway: A 16-year-old with a pathogenic PPARG variant had pancreatitis from severe hypertriglyceridemia and early type 2 diabetes; a low-fat diet and fenofibrate lowered triglycerides. Consider PPARG lipodystrophy in lean children.

34992577.takeaway: In 15,214 Japanese girls, paternal separation throughout early childhood was associated with peak height velocity about 0.4 years earlier, a small difference.

34993537.takeaway: Practical review of diagnosing and managing central diabetes insipidus in children, stressing MRI of the pituitary stalk and close follow-up of apparently idiopathic cases, where an underlying disease may emerge.

34994970.takeaway: In 75 adolescents and adults with 21-hydroxylase deficiency CAH, poor adherence to glucocorticoid therapy, rather than the type of glucocorticoid, was linked to impaired quality of life.

34995346.takeaway: Among 6,369 youth and young adults with diabetes, HbA1c in 2014-2019 was worse than in earlier cohorts for several type 1 diabetes age groups despite newer technologies and medications.

34995381.takeaway: Girls with Turner syndrome had higher diastolic blood pressure than 1,888 healthy Danish girls, and 55% had at least one reading above the hypertension threshold; routine childhood BP monitoring is advised.

34997821.takeaway: A revised genetic risk score for type 1 diabetes works in African American children, but population-specific thresholds are needed for different ancestry groups.

34999583.takeaway: An Italian child with permanent neonatal diabetes from a novel KCNJ11 variant (Tyr330His) had a gain-of-function defect that reduced sulfonylurea sensitivity, so sulfonylurea therapy was ineffective.

34999790.takeaway: In 1,860 mother-child pairs, maternal thyroid hormone trajectories in pregnancy were associated with behavioural problems in 4-year-old boys, suggesting a sex-specific effect.

35000899.takeaway: Italian expert position statement gives 15 diagnostic and 54 treatment recommendations for prolactinomas, noting that medical therapy often controls them and endoscopic surgery can cure some patients.

35001468.takeaway: In 79 Latino adolescents with obesity, hepatic and pancreatic fat were the only adiposity measures independently linked to glycemia, though they explained little of the variance.

35001473.takeaway: In a pilot study, youth with type 2 diabetes had lower global cerebral blood flow than 19 obese peers without diabetes, and blood flow was inversely related to carotid intima-media thickness.

35001477.takeaway: In 46 children aged 2 to 6 with type 1 diabetes, Auto Mode on the MiniMed 670G lowered HbA1c from 8.0% to 7.5% and raised time in range, with no severe hypoglycemia or DKA.

35001490.takeaway: Using the Behaviour Change Wheel, a Canadian working group chose education-based interventions from 27 identified options to prevent DKA at diagnosis, targeting symptom recognition and urgent referral.

35002951.takeaway: In 3,402 Chinese children, diet, exercise and several gene variants were linked to adiponectin differently at each pubertal stage, suggesting puberty-specific lifestyle advice may matter.

35002953.takeaway: In 4,749 patients with papillary thyroid microcarcinoma, both younger (30 or under) and older (over 45) age at diagnosis carried a higher risk of distant metastasis than middle age, though only 21 metastases occurred.

35002955.takeaway: In a Chinese family with suspected MODY, a novel ABCC8 missense variant was carried by seven members with diabetes or impaired glucose tolerance, and they responded to glimepiride.

35002956.takeaway: In 228 children with Noonan syndrome, GH treatment for coexisting GH deficiency raised height SD score from -3.10 to -2.31, and adult height was similar to untreated children.

35002961.takeaway: Adolescent-onset TSH-secreting adenomas (20 cases) had higher thyroid hormone levels, larger tumors, lower treatment remission and more recurrence than adult cases.

35002963.takeaway: Screening 219 Chinese patients with congenital hypothyroidism found TPO variants in 7.8%, mostly single heterozygous ones; four missense variants reduced peroxidase activity to 8-32% of normal.

35002983.takeaway: Reviews long-term safety studies of childhood rhGH therapy for cancer, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular disease and diabetes, highlighting conflicting evidence and the need for ongoing surveillance.

35006272.takeaway: In 161 Pima Indians with type 2 diabetes who had kidney biopsies, youth onset (under 25) was associated with more severe structural kidney lesions than adult onset.

35007209.takeaway: In 34 adolescent boys with severe obesity, bariatric surgery raised total and free testosterone over 5 years, with declines in those who regained weight.

35007320.takeaway: In 5 progressors vs 5 non-progressors with islet autoantibodies, progression to type 1 diabetes was linked to expanded cytotoxic CD4+ T cells, with findings validated in a separate cohort.

35007330.takeaway: In 41 children after total pancreatectomy with islet autotransplantation, 29% were insulin independent at 1 year; younger age, higher islet dose per kilogram and higher peak C-peptide predicted less insulin need.

35014243.takeaway: Serum CTRP-13 was lower in 60 children with obesity than in 45 controls and correlated with BMI and HDL cholesterol, but did not differ by metabolic syndrome or binge eating disorder.

35014244.takeaway: A child with type 1 diabetes had unfavorable effects on a low-carbohydrate diet; the authors stress that diet in childhood diabetes should also support optimal growth.

35014245.takeaway: Childhood type 1 diabetes incidence in Diyarbakir, Turkey rose from 7.2 to 9.14 per 100,000 over a decade, and 65% of 2020 cases presented in ketoacidosis.

35015056.takeaway: Among 438 young adults with youth-onset type 2 diabetes, 24% had high diabetes distress, linked to female sex, higher HbA1c, anxiety symptoms and lack of health coverage.

35015860.takeaway: In a US national survey of 20,326 adults with diabetes, cost-related medication nonadherence affected 17.6% of those under 65 and 6.9% of those 65 or older.

35018440.takeaway: In 11 patients with WFS1 variants, 9 were homozygous for pathogenic variants, and a novel frameshift variant showed a founder effect in three southern Indian families; multigene panel testing is advised.

35020476.takeaway: In 13 adults and adolescents with cystic fibrosis-related diabetes, starting Control-IQ hybrid closed-loop insulin delivery raised time in range and lowered glucose variability, with no change in hypoglycemia.

35021220.takeaway: In 48 exposed and 50 control cord blood samples, maternal anemia in early pregnancy altered expression of 137 genes and lowered cord insulin, suggesting programmed beta-cell dysfunction.

35023257.takeaway: In a Canadian cohort of 630 children with parental obesity, up to 75% of those with dysglycemia reverted to normal glucose tolerance during puberty; higher fasting and 2-hour glucose predicted progression.

35026061.takeaway: In three families with phenylketonuria, a primer-site variant caused allelic dropout that falsely showed a homozygous c.331C>T result, so genotyping errors can produce genotype-phenotype mismatches.

35026881.takeaway: In 171 Brazilian adolescents, 12 months of sports participation gave greater improvements in glucose, HDL cholesterol and metabolic syndrome score than in non-sport peers.

35026882.takeaway: Among 860 Turkish children with overweight or obesity, 14.4% had impaired glucose tolerance, 3.7% had type 2 diabetes, and 70.5% had insulin resistance.

35026884.takeaway: Of 33 children with new-onset type 1 diabetes in Gran Canaria, only one had evidence of past SARS-CoV-2 infection, and ketoacidosis at onset was no more common than in prior years.

35028661.takeaway: In 41 children with primary adrenal insufficiency of unknown cause, targeted gene panels found a genetic diagnosis in 71%, and steroid profiles were highly sensitive but did not identify a specific cause.

35032176.takeaway: In 168,871 UK adults with type 2 diabetes, none of 22 cardiovascular risk scores discriminated well; SCORE performed best, and recalibration improved calibration.

35037935.takeaway: In 181 SDHB variant carriers, surveillance detected tumors in 20% of non-probands; these were smaller and had better metastasis-free and overall survival than tumors in probands.

35038310.takeaway: In 202 young adults moved to adult care with endocrine or metabolic disease, a case-management transition program did not significantly reduce loss to follow-up but improved kept consultations and appeared cost-effective.

35038313.takeaway: A novel homozygous GCM2 R67C variant that cannot bind DNA caused hypoparathyroidism in two families, and two other GCM2 variants increased PTH promoter activity in familial hyperparathyroidism.

35038337.takeaway: In 95 adolescents with overweight or obesity, six months of supervised exercise changed several circulating inflammatory markers, with low-to-moderate intensity and combined programs showing the most change.

35038814.takeaway: In 25 patients with liver glycogen storage disease type IX, presentations varied from hypotonia and neurodevelopmental delay without liver involvement to short stature, with some having cardiac or bone involvement.

35038833.takeaway: A 5-year-old Korean girl with short stature and developmental delay had a novel RPS6KA3 frameshift variant causing Coffin-Lowry syndrome, with advanced bone age and central precocious puberty.

35038834.takeaway: Two sisters aged 16 and 19 with primary amenorrhea had novel compound heterozygous FSHR variants; combined oral contraceptives induced regular menses and improved bone density.

35038835.takeaway: In 692 prepubertal children treated with GH, growth after 1 and 2 years did not differ between idiopathic short stature and partial or complete GH deficiency, though predictors of response varied by group.

35038836.takeaway: In 9 adolescents with obesity and type 2 diabetes, hyperglycemic hyperosmolar state had features overlapping with DKA, making diagnosis hard; early recognition of hyperosmolality guided fluid treatment and no patient died.

35038837.takeaway: A 3-year-old girl who presented with precocious puberty had adrenocortical carcinoma and a sporadic MEN1 mutation that neither parent carried.

35038838.takeaway: In 81 children with type 1 diabetes, nondipper blood pressure was not a significant predictor of microvascular complications; glycemic control was the main factor linked to retinopathy.

35038839.takeaway: At a South Korean growth clinic, the overweight or obesity rate rose during the 2020 social distancing period from 25.3% to 31.4% in girls and from 23.3% to 45.8% in boys.

35041021.takeaway: In TrialNet at-risk participants aged 1 to 45, several type 1 diabetes predictors changed in strength with age, and the Index60 risk score predicted progression better at younger ages.

35041752.takeaway: Clinical update on gestational diabetes: rising prevalence, fetal overgrowth before diagnosis and lasting cardiometabolic risk for mothers and offspring argue for longer-term management.

35043145.takeaway: In German children and adolescents, new-onset type 1 diabetes incidence from 2020 to mid-2021 was 15% above expected, peaking about three months after COVID-19 peaks, suggesting indirect pandemic effects.

35043162.takeaway: In 379 TEDDY children who developed type 1 diabetes, DKA at onset was uncommon (6.1%), rarest in those with a first-degree relative, and clinical features varied by age at onset.

35043173.takeaway: In streptozotocin-induced diabetic mice, methazolamide lowered blood glucose and reduced cardiac hypertrophy by promoting AXIN1-mediated degradation of beta-catenin.

35044245.takeaway: In mouse models and children with congenital hypothyroidism, thyroid hormone excess or deficiency altered adrenal X-zone development and steroidogenic gene expression, and TSH correlated with adrenal steroids in patients.

35045418.takeaway: Ten surveys of patients with somatic intersexuality mostly favored early genital surgery, so mandatory delay until consent would disregard most patients' wishes; individualized decisions are more appropriate.

35045421.takeaway: Reviews osilodrostat trials in Cushing disease, approved for adults when surgery fails, and notes that pediatric trials are lacking, with one small phase II trial in under-18s planned.

35046888.takeaway: In 34 children with type 1 diabetes and 15 controls, NGAL carried in urinary extracellular vesicles was detected only in patients and may serve as an early marker of tubular kidney injury.

35046890.takeaway: In porcine prepubertal Sertoli cells, titanium dioxide nanoparticles at subtoxic and toxic doses caused oxidative DNA damage, inflammation and reduced AMH and inhibin B expression; in vivo confirmation is needed.

35047716.takeaway: A boy with central precocious puberty had continuous gonadotropin suppression for 7 years after one histrelin implant and reached a final height within 1 SD of his mid-parental height.

35047717.takeaway: In 130 young children with classic CAH, alcohol-free hydrocortisone suspension gave lower bone age z-scores and about 30% lower cumulative doses than tablets, with similar growth at 4 years.

35058879.takeaway: Across 20 studies of 3,609 COVID-19 patients, severe illness was linked to lower FT3 and TSH, and abnormal thyroid hormone levels were associated with higher mortality.

35058880.takeaway: In 73 children with Down syndrome, subclinical hypothyroidism was the commonest thyroid dysfunction (87%), and levothyroxine did not improve growth or BMI z-score.

35061023.takeaway: UK monogenic diabetes diagnoses rose threefold from 2009 to 2019 to 3,860 confirmed cases, likely from targeted sequencing, nurse education and the MODY calculator; estimated prevalence doubled to 248 per million.

35061033.takeaway: A birth-weight genetic score had similar fetal effects in South Asian and European babies, yet South Asian newborns were much smaller, suggesting non-genetic fetal growth factors play a larger role.

35061034.takeaway: Screening 126 young adults with severe obesity from a consanguineous Pakistani population found 13 with pathogenic variants in melanocortin-pathway genes, plus novel homozygous stop-gain variants in ASNSD1 and IFI16.

35064955.takeaway: In a German/Austrian registry of 92,633 children with type 1 diabetes, early cataract was linked to older age at onset, higher HbA1c and lower growth SDS, and late cataract to higher HbA1c.

35066499.takeaway: In 50 children with obesity compared with 50 matched controls, DNMT3A was higher and TET2 lower, most markedly with insulin resistance, and both were associated with blood pressure and HOMA-IR.

35069436.takeaway: In neonatal rats, maternal fat-content diets altered cardiac insulin receptor, Glut4 and FoxO1 expression and insulin-signaling genes in a sex-specific way, with Cebpa rising in females on high fat.

35069438.takeaway: A novel INS nonsense mutation (R46X) in two patients with early-onset diabetes did not cause ER stress but was inefficiently translocated into the endoplasmic reticulum, showing a role for the proinsulin domain.

35069452.takeaway: In 79 non-diabetic children with obesity, asprosin rose after an oral glucose load in 56%, and this rise was linked to insulin resistance and impaired fasting glucose, possibly an early marker of glucose dysregulation.

35073615.takeaway: Two siblings with neonatal severe hyperparathyroidism from homozygous CASR mutations were managed with cinacalcet alone, without parathyroidectomy, and improved in calcium, growth and development.

35073668.takeaway: In a retrospective Korean study of obese adolescents, family history of T2D, fatty liver and a low SPISE index (below 4.49) were independent risk factors for type 2 diabetes.

35073669.takeaway: Of 129 children with new type 1 diabetes, 40% presented in DKA and needed higher insulin doses for 2 years, but glycemic control and long-term outcomes were similar to those without DKA.

35073670.takeaway: In 24 patients with osteogenesis imperfecta, qualitative COL1A1/2 mutations caused more severe disease than quantitative ones, and pamidronate reduced fractures and raised lumbar BMD mainly in the qualitative group.

35075664.takeaway: In 637 Chinese men with type 2 diabetes, 31.9% had hypogonadism and 26.5% had hypogonadotropic hypogonadism or nongonadal illness, with testosterone correlated with BMI, SHBG and insulin resistance.

35078347.takeaway: In 105,483 US patients with localized papillary thyroid cancer, radioiodine use fell from 2000 to 2018, including in children under 20 (59% in 2009 to 11% in 2018), while total thyroidectomy alone rose.

35080102.takeaway: In a matched New South Wales cohort, youth hospitalized with type 1 diabetes did not differ from peers in numeracy or reading, but hospitalized females were more likely not to complete high school.

35080610.takeaway: In Geisinger adults, obesity among people with type 1 diabetes rose from 32.6% to 36.8% between 2004 and 2018, and after age adjustment low eGFR was more common in type 1 than type 2 diabetes.

35082755.takeaway: In 1,382 US children aged 6 to 19, a more inflammatory diet was linked to lower testosterone and estradiol and higher SHBG in adolescents, with little association in younger children.

35082756.takeaway: In 45,467 pregnant women, TSH above 1.33 mU/L and TPOAb positivity above 5.14 IU/mL in early pregnancy predicted preterm delivery; a nomogram built on these had modest discrimination (C-index 0.62).

35082758.takeaway: In Catalan primary care, blood pressure and lipid control in adults with type 2 diabetes improved from 2007 to 2018, but achieving all three targets together reached only about 20% and plateaued after 2013.

35084144.takeaway: In 397 Turkish patients with phenylalanine metabolism disorders, mild hyperphenylalaninemia was most common (71%), classical phenylketonuria affected 23%, and 76% of children under 8 were well controlled.

35084795.takeaway: Among 5,133 youths with type 1 diabetes starting insulin pump therapy, four distinct three-year trajectories of HbA1c, BMI SD score and total daily insulin emerged, showing heterogeneous responses.

35084805.takeaway: In 19,729 German youths with type 1 diabetes, metabolic control during the spring 2020 lockdown did not differ significantly from 2019, while hospitalizations fell.

35084809.takeaway: Childhood type 1 diabetes incidence in Sana'a, Yemen averaged 1.83 per 100,000 per year over 1989 to 2018 and fell to about 0.5 during the conflict years.

35085444.takeaway: Interviews with 19 Black adolescents with type 1 diabetes and 17 parents identified identity, stigma from device visibility, family and cultural beliefs, and mistrust of medicine as factors in device use.

35086092.takeaway: Two children with a de novo 17p13.3 deletion including CRK had intrauterine and postnatal growth failure linked to impaired GH and IGF-1 signaling, and rhGH partly reduced their height deficit.

35086098.takeaway: Reviews hydrocortisone-based CAH treatment in children, the benefits of neonatal screening, and newer adjunct and modified-release therapies, whose long-term effects in children remain unknown.

35089870.takeaway: In 34 children with HNF4A or HNF1A mutations, hyperinsulinaemic hypoglycaemia responded to diazoxide and resolved in 59%, and 15% later developed MODY.

35094464.takeaway: Nine- and three-item short forms of the Diabetes Acceptance and Action Scale showed reliability, validity and measurement invariance across race, income and glycemic groups in 179 youth with type 1 diabetes.

35095754.takeaway: In 2,796 Chinese pregnant women, pre-pregnancy obesity and gestational abnormal glucose metabolism each raised adverse outcomes, and having both raised risks further, most strongly for hypertension.

35095759.takeaway: Reviews when to monitor or stop following incidental brain MRI findings, such as pituitary or hypothalamic anomalies, in children with endocrine conditions, to avoid unnecessary investigations.

35095762.takeaway: In six patients with MC4R deficiency who had bariatric surgery, weight loss of about 18% was stable for 6 months and then varied, with glycemic improvement in those with type 2 diabetes.

35095767.takeaway: Of 146 patients with osteogenesis imperfecta, 12 had COVID-19; all had mild disease without hospitalization, and half of these patients were taking bisphosphonates.

35095777.takeaway: Among 3,043 Chinese women conceiving through ART, pre-pregnancy overweight and obesity raised the risk of cesarean section, gestational diabetes, hypertension and preeclampsia, and obesity also raised macrosomia risk.

35099281.takeaway: In 20 adults and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, reducing basal insulin 90 minutes before exercise rather than 40 minutes lessened the glucose drop and delayed hypoglycemia, with similar event counts.

35099306.takeaway: Among 4,003 people under 22 with type 1 diabetes, CGM use was linked to lower HbA1c with injections or pumps, pump use helped only with CGM, and hybrid closed-loop gave the lowest HbA1c (7.6%).

35100608.takeaway: Practical approach to evaluating and managing delayed puberty, covering differences in girls, late presentations, and whether age cutoffs for diagnosis should be lowered.

35102753.takeaway: A newborn girl with mild central congenital hypothyroidism from a novel homozygous TSHB variant was initially missed because her free T4 was misread, underlining the need for age-specific reference ranges.

35104166.takeaway: Across 22,741 infusion-set wears in 263 people aged 6 to 72, 3.3% of sets were removed early for prolonged hyperglycemia, more often in youth and with straight Teflon sets.

35104239.takeaway: In a Danish registry of 383,877 children, high-dose prenatal systemic glucocorticoids were linked to overweight or obesity at age 5 to 8 in boys only (16% vs 11%), with no link for lower doses.

35104326.takeaway: Meta-analysis of eight birth cohorts found that higher maternal glucose exposure in pregnancy was linked to lower cord blood methylation at TXNIP, a locus also tied to later metabolic traits.

35106546.takeaway: Among 1,080 US youth with Klinefelter syndrome and 4,497 matched controls, overweight, dyslipidemia and liver dysfunction were more common, and in boys overweight and liver dysfunction stayed higher after adjustment.

35107582.takeaway: In 737 pregnant and postpartum women, depression and stress scores did not differ between those with and without type 1 diabetes, and mental health was unrelated to HbA1c.

35107903.takeaway: A 16-day-old boy with transient neonatal cholestasis and a homozygous NPC1 variant had Niemann-Pick type C confirmed by elevated lysosphingomyelin biomarkers.

35108378.takeaway: In a randomized feeding trial in adults with obesity, glucose control kept improving for weeks after switching from very-low to high-carbohydrate diets, suggesting adaptation may take weeks and affect OGTT accuracy.

35108461.takeaway: In 790 Chinese children aged 7 to 15, living with two grandparents was linked to higher odds of overweight or obesity, while grandparents' knowledge of balanced diets was linked to lower risk.

35113157.takeaway: In mice, deleting the transcription factor YY1 from beta cells caused hyperglycemia and hypoinsulinemia, and YY1 was shown to directly activate Ins1 and Ins2 transcription.

35113159.takeaway: In six children with MIS-C and new-onset type 1 diabetes in severe DKA, all had cardiac involvement and shock, and the authors advise giving immunoglobulin after DKA resolves to avoid fluid overload.

35114680.takeaway: Danish neonatal screening did not raise the incidence of salt-wasting CAH (5 per 100,000), with 97% sensitivity and 100% specificity, though the positive predictive value was 55% and only 33% in preterm infants.

35114785.takeaway: Of 39 Egyptian infants with diabetes before one year, 43.6% had type 1 diabetes and 23.1% had genetically confirmed neonatal diabetes, most often from EIF2AK3, KCNJ11 or ABCC8 variants.

35116007.takeaway: In 90 Italian children and adults switching to hybrid closed-loop systems, both Minimed 780G and Tandem Control-IQ improved glycemic control; 780G raised time in range more, while Control-IQ cut hypoglycemia more.

35116009.takeaway: In 6,895 US adults, red blood cell distribution width had a J-shaped association with TSH and a negative association with free T3, and elevated RDW was more common in subclinical hypothyroidism.

35119230.takeaway: A 7-year-old boy with central diabetes insipidus and a thickened pituitary stalk was diagnosed with lymphocytic infundibulo-hypophysitis once anti-rabphilin-3A antibody became positive, supporting it as an adjunct test.

35119800.takeaway: Review of 51 DRESS cases, 12 in children, found Hashimoto's thyroiditis in 80%, with antiepileptic and sulfonamide drugs the commonest culprits in children.

35120289.takeaway: A three-year-old with asymptomatic hypoparathyroidism had a homozygous PTH missense variant, and discordant PTH results between assay generations provided the clue to its genetic cause.

35124668.takeaway: Reviews biomarkers such as glucocorticoids and catecholamines, and psychometric instruments, for measuring chronic stress in adolescents, along with confounders to consider.

35124671.takeaway: Reviews how psychological and physical stress, acting through glucocorticoids, catecholamines and insulin demand, may trigger type 1 and type 2 diabetes, with a focus on type 1 onset.

35126307.takeaway: Across 33 studies, children with more body fat had lower physical activity and poorer gross motor coordination, linking overweight and obesity to motor impairment.

35126310.takeaway: In 220 short children on rhGH, a true daily dose under 0.03 mg/kg with fewer than 3 weekly injections over a year was linked to 20% lower annual height gain; short lapses had no effect.

35126311.takeaway: Pregnant women with hypothyroidism differed from 28 controls in lipid metabolites and gut microbiota, with higher CRP and lower birth weight, suggesting a lipid-microbiome link to pregnancy outcomes.

35131037.takeaway: In 401 East Asian adults with obesity, once-weekly semaglutide 2.4 mg cut weight by 13.2% at 68 weeks versus 2.1% with placebo, with greater visceral fat loss, though gastrointestinal events were common.

35134944.takeaway: Two sisters with the same homozygous ESR1 variant (E385V) had different severities of estrogen resistance, one with primary amenorrhea and one not entering puberty, suggesting partial compensation.

35134971.takeaway: Combining clinical classification with molecular testing diagnosed 78.9% of 209 Brazilian index cases with 46,XY DSD, and first-line massively parallel sequencing simplifies the workup.

35135181.takeaway: Among 128 patients with 46,XY DSD, phenotype-associated AR or SRD5A2 variants were found in 24%, including four novel AR variants, and the testosterone/DHT ratio could mislead diagnosis.

35135182.takeaway: Of 30 studies run on Turkey's CEDD-NET pediatric endocrine research platform, 16 publications came from 14 studies, mostly in Q1 or Q2 journals.

35135183.takeaway: Turkish children aged 0 to 18 were taller after age 10 and heavier than WHO standards from 6 months, so WHO growth standards may misclassify short stature and underweight in Turkish children.

35135184.takeaway: In 70 children with papillary thyroid cancer, the ATA pediatric risk level predicted treatment response, while BRAFV600E was linked to locoregional recurrence (33% vs 3%) but not to excellent response.

35135185.takeaway: Among 3,033 Turkish children, school-aged children and adolescents had lower 25(OH)D during the pandemic's first year than before it, supporting vitamin D supplementation during restrictions.

35135186.takeaway: A 14-year-old boy with tumor-induced osteomalacia from a maxillary ossifying fibroma improved on phosphate and calcitriol and after tumor removal, and was pain-free at 21 months.

35137184.takeaway: In 47 SRC-1 variant carriers with severe obesity, children had hyperphagia, and adults had more adipose tissue fibrosis than matched controls, with features of partial thyroid hormone resistance.

35138021.takeaway: Among 183 youths with type 2 diabetes weaned off insulin onto lifestyle or metformin alone, 54% had treatment failure within a median of 1.7 years, and higher HbA1c at enrollment predicted failure.

35138695.takeaway: In 80 children with type 1 diabetes, 59% had caries and 94% had gingivitis, and tooth brushing and flossing were linked to better oral health regardless of HbA1c.

35140686.takeaway: In 25 patients with 21-hydroxylase deficiency, first-morning urinary pregnanetriol correlated strongly with pre-dose 17-hydroxyprogesterone (r=0.87), suggesting a practical monitoring tool.

35142009.takeaway: In 95 children with islet autoimmunity followed for up to 7 years, accelerometer-measured physical activity did not predict progression to type 1 diabetes.

35142845.takeaway: In a pooled analysis of 25,126 adults from 12 cohorts, circulating trans-18:2 fatty acids were not linked to type 2 diabetes, while three other trans fatty acid biomarkers were weakly inversely associated.

35142878.takeaway: In children who developed islet autoantibodies, DNA methylation differed in T-cell subsets, with IRF5 promoter changes seen before seroconversion, a preliminary early signature for type 1 diabetes.

35144259.takeaway: Reviews how chronic stress, through cortisol excess and low-grade inflammation, drives steatosis of muscle, bone, liver and pancreas, a link clinicians often overlook.

35145477.takeaway: Across 3,557 ICSI cycles, live birth rates were higher with surgically acquired sperm before adjustment (63.1% vs 51.2%), but after adjustment the odds were lower, and neonatal outcomes did not differ.

35145478.takeaway: In 551 Chinese youths aged 15 to 28 with cardiometabolic risk, ANGPTL8 and leptin were inversely associated with left ventricular mass, with cholesterol partly mediating the ANGPTL8 link.

35145481.takeaway: In a nested case-control study of 153 GDM and 153 control newborn pairs, cord FGF19 did not differ by GDM but correlated positively with birth weight in girls only.

35146976.takeaway: Reviews nephrogenic diabetes insipidus, covering hereditary and drug-induced causes, copeptin-based diagnosis, and treatment with thiazides, NSAIDs and amiloride.

35147698.takeaway: In 133 adolescents and young adults with type 1 diabetes, the PHQ-9 suicide item identified only 53% of those with suicide risk on the C-SSRS, so depression screeners alone may miss risk.

35147706.takeaway: In 6,015 Finnish children with type 1 diabetes, those diagnosed under 7 had more affected relatives and more autoantibodies, while those 13 and older had more ketoacidosis, supporting age-related endotypes.

35148399.takeaway: In 33 CAH-unaffected people prenatally exposed to dexamethasone and 54 matched controls, ambulatory blood pressure did not differ, suggesting no adverse effect on later blood pressure, pending larger studies.

35150157.takeaway: In 255 healthy volunteers aged 4 to 75, salivary androstenedione and 17-OHP fell through the day, varied with age, and stayed stable for 5 days, supporting home collection and reference values for CAH monitoring.

35150162.takeaway: In 587 children from a birth cohort, persistent weight gain from age 0 to 4 was linked to higher DHEAS at age 7, independent of birth weight and current BMI.

35150259.takeaway: In 812 Singapore newborns, cord blood kynurenine metabolites tracked birthweight, and kynurenic and quinolinic acid levels were linked to body fat at 4 years, suggesting early adiposity biomarkers.

35150573.takeaway: Clinical overview of Prader-Willi syndrome from birth to adulthood, covering hypogonadism, growth hormone deficiency, central hypothyroidism and obesity, with care focused on feeding and comorbidity screening.

35150596.takeaway: In 39 adolescents and young adults with type 1 diabetes, mRNA COVID-19 vaccination did not significantly change glycemic control or insulin doses, and side effects were mild.

35154006.takeaway: In SEER data on women with differentiated thyroid cancer, radioiodine was linked to a higher risk of second breast cancer in adolescents and young adults (hazard ratio 1.65), but only slightly in middle-aged adults.

35156126.takeaway: Bavarian presymptomatic type 1 diabetes screening cost €28 per child screened and €9,117 per child diagnosed, with projected standard-care costs of about €22 and €7,035.

35156834.takeaway: A quality improvement project in Alabama raised CGM access for children with type 1 diabetes from 50% to 82% and narrowed racial and insurance disparities.

35165722.takeaway: Two families with isolated hypoparathyroidism carried novel PTH gene variants, one with low and one with high PTH, showing that PTH mutations can mimic gland or receptor disorders.

35168232.takeaway: A 21-month-old girl with Graves' disease developed recurrent intracranial hypertension during the chronic phase, controlled by acetazolamide but recurring when the dose was reduced.

35170267.takeaway: In 20 adolescents with PCOS and 16 healthy controls, serum NPY was higher in PCOS regardless of obesity, while higher leptin and lower kisspeptin tracked obesity rather than PCOS.

35170268.takeaway: Among 879 children followed for type 1 diabetes, Addison's disease or autoimmune thyroid disease, 35 had polyglandular autoimmune syndrome, most often type 3, supporting autoantibody screening over the long term.

35170787.takeaway: Ten Indian patients with 17beta-HSD3 deficiency and a review of 152 reported probands found initial male rearing was uncommon, and gender role change to male occurred mainly in Asian patients.

35170878.takeaway: Ultrasound testicular volumes in 320 Turkish boys aged 0 to 8 averaged about 0.7 mL over the first five years, giving national reference percentiles for testicular disorders.

35171708.takeaway: In three adults with NTRK-rearranged, radioiodine-resistant thyroid cancer, larotrectinib restored radioiodine uptake in two, showing that redifferentiation occurs but not in every patient.

35171827.takeaway: Children with active endogenous Cushing syndrome had higher neutrophil-to-lymphocyte and related inflammatory ratios than controls, correlating with cortisol measures, with the NLR giving good discrimination (AUC 0.77 to 0.81).

35172300.takeaway: In 80 youths with type 1 (40) or type 2 (40) diabetes, CTRP9 was higher in type 1 and FGF21 higher in type 2, with the adipokines linked to glycemic and metabolic markers.

35173679.takeaway: Women with PCOS undergoing infertility treatment had more autistic traits than controls, linked to higher LH and testosterone and lower progesterone, and offspring traits tracked maternal traits.

35176743.takeaway: In 133 people with Noonan syndrome, puberty was delayed in 49% of girls and 28% of boys, more often in girls, with BMI and IGF-1 SD scores predicting timing of onset.

35176765.takeaway: Among 2,370 people with type 1 diabetes aged 8 to 45, 34% of adults and 22% of children reported gastrointestinal symptoms, linked to microvascular complications but not to autoimmune conditions or celiac disease.

35178492.takeaway: In 261 children with idiopathic short stature, a ZBTB38 variant (rs724016 GG) was linked to lower birth length and a weaker first-year height response to rhGH among 93 treated children.

35179010.takeaway: Six Turkish patients with fructose 1,6-bisphosphatase deficiency presented with hypoglycemia and metabolic acidosis; an exon 2 deletion was most common, and two novel FBP1 variants were found.

35182158.takeaway: In 710 normoalbuminuric adolescents with type 1 diabetes, a high urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio roughly doubled the risk of three-step retinopathy progression over 3.2 years.

35185797.takeaway: Across 125 studies from 48 countries, IA-2A was the most common islet autoantibody in new-onset type 1 diabetes in children (71%), with prevalence varying widely by region.

35185798.takeaway: In 481 adolescents aged 14 to 17, serum cystatin C had a U-shaped link with obesity in boys and a rise-then-fall link in girls, suggesting sex-specific associations.

35185800.takeaway: Brachydactyly type A3 occurred in 23% of 752 short children, more often in girls, and did not change height response to four years of growth hormone therapy.

35185801.takeaway: Reviews whether pediatric anthropometric measures such as waist-to-height ratio predict future insulin resistance better than BMI, finding only small advantages and calling for longitudinal studies.

35185803.takeaway: In 99 pubertal children with obesity, the SPISE index was lower in those with fatty liver and discriminated hepatic insulin resistance better than HOMA-IR and HIRI, with a cutoff of 5.18.

35187383.takeaway: In 28 boys with constitutional growth delay treated with letrozole or testosterone, serum LEAP2 fell as puberty progressed, tracking growth velocity and estradiol levels.

35189617.takeaway: Reviews the types of lipodystrophy in children, stressing early diagnosis of partial forms, lifestyle care first, and metreleptin for the metabolic complications.

35191150.takeaway: Across nine studies of 1,030 youths with type 1 diabetes, aortic intima-media thickness was 0.11 mm higher than in 498 controls, with longer diabetes and cardiovascular risk factors linked to greater thickness.

35192205.takeaway: Reviews Graves' disease management across preconception, pregnancy, postpartum and lactation, including antithyroid drug safety, TRAb monitoring, and avoiding radioiodine before conception.

35193430.takeaway: In the ENDIA type 1 diabetes pregnancy-birth cohort, Facebook supplied about 20% of 1,511 referrals, and its recruits withdrew less often (4.7% vs 12.3%).

35196382.takeaway: Across 228,474 US pediatric type 1 diabetes admissions, DKA was less common in pump users (39%) than nonusers (47%), and admissions for pump failure had the highest DKA rate (60%).

35196393.takeaway: Reviews how KATP channel activity drives congenital hyperinsulinism and neonatal diabetes, and proposes that loss of KATP activity may also contribute to type 2 diabetes.

35197927.takeaway: Perspective on the challenges of early childhood obesity prevention, including research waste and scale-up, and collaborative solutions that could speed up effective interventions.

35197931.takeaway: Reviews animal maternal-diet models, such as high-fat, cafeteria and undernutrition models, that reproduce offspring obesity and diabetes, and how they relate to human fetal programming.

35197933.takeaway: In 104 term infants, including 47 born to diabetic mothers, cord leptin and insulin rose with maternal diabetes, while IL-6 rose with chorioamnionitis and neonatal sepsis.

35202468.takeaway: In 49 parents who were poor sleepers of children aged 6 to 13 with type 1 diabetes, using Control-IQ improved parental sleep, fear of hypoglycemia and distress, alongside better child nocturnal glucose.

35212643.takeaway: In 26 low-birth-weight men and 22 matched controls, the low-birth-weight men had more liver fat, and those with NAFLD showed hepatic insulin resistance and dyslipidemia, a possible route to type 2 diabetes.

35213713.takeaway: In 4,012 Danish children and adolescents, fasting glucagon was higher with obesity and linked to insulin resistance, dyslipidemia and hypertension, but not to hyperglycemia.

35218122.takeaway: In a Western Australian population cohort of 2,111 children, moderate-severe DKA at type 1 diagnosis rose about 4% per year from 2000 to 2019 (25% overall), with no consistent link to long-term HbA1c.

35218124.takeaway: At seven US centers, new-onset type 1 diabetes rose to 1,399 cases in 2020 from 1,277 in 2019, and a larger share presented in DKA (42.8% vs 38.6%).

35218126.takeaway: Among 350 youths with multigenerational diabetes and negative autoantibodies, younger age, lower BMI, lower C-peptide and no acanthosis nigricans best identified those likely to have MODY.

35218654.takeaway: Among 446 Chinese people with autoantibody-positive type 1 diabetes, 42.6% still had detectable C-peptide after 7 years or more, including 60.7% of those diagnosed at 18 or older.

35218660.takeaway: Homozygous deleterious ZSWIM7 variants were found in two unrelated patients with amenorrhea and absent puberty, pointing to a role for this DNA-repair gene in ovarian development.

35218690.takeaway: A child with transient neonatal diabetes from a novel homozygous ZFP57 variant relapsed before puberty and responded poorly to sulfonylurea monotherapy.

35220302.takeaway: In 36 prepubertal children with classic CAH, twice-daily hydrocortisone gave adrenal control similar to three-times-daily dosing, without affecting growth or bone age advancement.

35220308.takeaway: Reviews long-acting growth hormone formulations, which showed efficacy comparable to daily GH in phase 3 trials, and the long-term metabolic, cancer and cost questions they still raise.

35222280.takeaway: Reviews how mesenchymal stromal cells, co-cultured or co-transplanted with islets including neonatal porcine islets, can enhance islet maturation, insulin secretion and graft survival.

35225342.takeaway: In 128 healthy boys followed for a year, gonadotropins and testosterone peaked near 1 month of age, while inhibin B, AMH and testicular volume peaked at 4 to 5 months.

35230138.takeaway: In a pilot study of 11 pregnant women with type 1 diabetes, pregnancy-specific closed-loop control raised time at 63 to 140 mg/dL from 64% to 81.5% without serious adverse events.

35234851.takeaway: Two-sample Mendelian randomization linked 22 circulating proteins to adult type 2 diabetes and 11 to youth-onset type 2 diabetes, several with colocalization support as possible drug targets.

35235537.takeaway: Two brothers with a homozygous INHA variant had hypospadias, low testosterone, high gonadotropins and azoospermia, while their heterozygous parents were unaffected.

35235641.takeaway: In 591 children with obesity followed for about two years, OGTT-derived insulin measures and low postprandial glucose did not predict greater gains in obesity, challenging the carbohydrate-insulin model.

35235937.takeaway: Reviews newer childhood bone therapies: denosumab for osteoporosis, burosumab for X-linked hypophosphatemic rickets, and vosoritide for achondroplasia, with long-term safety and dosing still uncertain.

35237736.takeaway: A female infant with Kabuki syndrome from a novel de novo KDM6A variant had hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia responsive to low-dose diazoxide, and later severe pulmonary hypertension needing ECMO.

35238618.takeaway: Describes the RESCUE Collaborative Community, an initiative to detect and reduce intentional self-injury and suicide among people with diabetes, a group with about double the general-population suicide rate.

35238620.takeaway: A six-plex electrochemiluminescence assay for islet and celiac autoantibodies matched standard radio-binding assays in 95% of children who later developed type 1 diabetes, with few false positives among 828 children.

35240684.takeaway: In 155 youths, insulin resistance tracked with atherogenic lipids and carotid thickness regardless of glucose tolerance, while youths with abnormal glucose tolerance shifted toward smaller HDL particles.

35242106.takeaway: Reviews oxytocin's roles in women's health across the menstrual cycle, pregnancy, parturition, lactation and menopause, and how its disorders contribute to maternal depression and hypogalactia.

35244713.takeaway: In 10,145 children followed from age 1 to 8, rapid height growth was linked to higher risk of islet autoimmunity (HR 1.26 to 1.48) and to progression to type 1 diabetes.

35245009.takeaway: A 4-year-old girl with isosexual precocious puberty had a feminizing adrenal oncocytoma, classed as likely benign and stable at two years after laparoscopic adrenalectomy.

35245011.takeaway: In 71 children with GH deficiency, once-weekly PEG-rhGH gave height velocity comparable to daily rhGH over 12 months and normalized IGF-1, but HbA1c and an insulin resistance index rose.

35245971.takeaway: In 26 patients on enzyme replacement for Gaucher type 1 or Fabry disease, Gaucher patients had lower calcium and magnesium, osteoporosis affected 12% to 20%, and long-term therapy appeared to benefit metabolic status.

35247315.takeaway: Reviews osteoporosis in men, including BMD diagnosis, secondary causes, lifestyle measures, and treatments such as bisphosphonates, denosumab and teriparatide.

35248171.takeaway: In pooled Finnish cohorts and UK Biobank adults, obesity was associated with about twelvefold higher hazard of complex multimorbidity, rising with degree of obesity.

35248172.takeaway: Reviews child and adolescent obesity epidemiology, causes, assessment and management, including weight gain during COVID-19 and family-based behavioral treatment as first-line care.

35249249.takeaway: Among 237 young adults with type 1 diabetes moved to adult care, the 42% with a pediatric mental health disorder had higher HbA1c beforehand, more hospitalizations, and less consistent follow-up.

35249270.takeaway: In 50 adolescents with type 1 diabetes, adding metformin to insulin over nine months lowered HbA1c and insulin dose, reduced day-to-day insulin variability and improved triglycerides.

35250848.takeaway: In 3,634 US children and adolescents, dietary intake of vitamins A, B1, B2, B12 and D was negatively associated with obesity, and combined vitamin intake above the median lowered obesity odds.

35250850.takeaway: Levothyroxine was linked to less preterm birth in euthyroid women with TPO antibodies, but only in observational studies, while randomized trials showed no benefit.

35250870.takeaway: In 213 children with severe primary IGF-1 deficiency on mecasermin, puberty started about 1.5 years later, but height SD score still rose during puberty, with a slightly lower peak height velocity.

35250876.takeaway: Gene sequencing of 106 children with short stature and skeletal abnormalities found collagen-gene variants in 24.5%, mostly COL2A1, and nine children on rhGH improved height SD score from -3.2 to -2.2.

35250887.takeaway: Reviews how pluripotent stem-cell-derived islets can model congenital hyperinsulinism, enabling study of disease mechanisms and drug screening where patient tissue is scarce.

35250894.takeaway: Reviews when growth hormone deficiency can be diagnosed without stimulation tests, such as in newborns and in children with neuroradiological abnormalities and multiple pituitary deficiencies.

35253331.takeaway: In 55 children aged 2 to 13 with type 1 diabetes, do-it-yourself real-time CGM did not reduce parental fear of hypoglycaemia but raised time in range by 5.7 points and improved satisfaction.

35254146.takeaway: Interviews with 12 women with type 1 diabetes using open-source automated insulin delivery found glucose and insulin needs shift across the menstrual cycle, puberty, pregnancy and menopause, with little clinician guidance.

35254428.takeaway: Reviews DHEA in women, finding small quality-of-life and mood benefits in adrenal insufficiency, no consistent benefit in healthy women, local benefit for vulvovaginal atrophy, and androgenic risks with long-term use.

35255729.takeaway: Among 308 German young adults with type 1 diabetes, 75% used CGM with high satisfaction, but only 19% analysed their data regularly, and those who did had lower HbA1c.

35259243.takeaway: In 567 infants, treating gestational diabetes lowered birth weight and macrosomia but did not change weight, length, BMI or skinfold measures at 3 or 12 months.

35259742.takeaway: Reviews evidence linking prenatal and early-life stress to ADHD and autism in children, and the hormonal pathways that may mediate it, while noting that prospective causal studies are needed.

35261044.takeaway: In 16,984 US deliveries to women with hyperthyroidism, gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, preterm delivery, placenta previa, venous thromboembolism, small-for-gestational-age infants and stillbirth were all more likely.

35261046.takeaway: In 71 people with molecularly confirmed Silver-Russell syndrome, those treated with GH gained more height (median 1.53 vs 0.53 SDS) and had lower adult BMI SDS, though final heights were similar.

35262170.takeaway: Over 12 months in 118 drug-naive children with ADHD, growth hormone and thyroid hormone levels did not change with low-dose methylphenidate or atomoxetine, though methylphenidate was linked to less weight gain.

35262645.takeaway: In a Quebec cohort of about one million children, prenatal gestational diabetes was linked to higher childhood cancer risk under age 2 (HR 1.47), and the association disappeared after age 6.

35262704.takeaway: Reviews managing pituitary hormone replacement through transition to adult care, illustrated by four cases, emphasizing puberty, stature, adherence and reassessment of lifelong deficits.

35263750.takeaway: Reviews metabolic and bariatric surgery in adolescents, which gives sustained weight and cardiometabolic gains with adult-like safety, and discusses indications, timing, procedure choice and comparison with new anti-obesity drugs.

35263755.takeaway: In 143 children switched from daily somatropin, once-weekly lonapegsomatropin gave an adverse event profile similar to daily therapy, with annualized height velocity of 8.7 cm/year at 26 weeks.

35265783.takeaway: At one pediatric center, new-onset type 1 diabetes rose 48% to 46 cases during COVID-19, while new type 2 diabetes rose 231%, making type 2 more than half of new pediatric diabetes cases.

35272283.takeaway: Reviews care for transgender and gender-diverse young people, including affirmation, social transition and medical therapies, and their known and unknown effects on growth, bone, cardiovascular health and fertility.

35272295.takeaway: Reviews the stress system, its HPA and noradrenergic components and hormonal regulators, and how early adversity may leave lasting epigenetic changes linked to stress-related disease.

35274069.takeaway: In 426 girls followed from birth, greater infant weight gain and birthweight predicted earlier puberty, and persistently high or rising BMI in early childhood predicted earlier menarche and breast development.

35275602.takeaway: In 17 adolescent boys with hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, corifollitropin alfa followed by added hCG for 64 weeks raised testicular volume about nine-fold, with pubertal progression and a growth spurt.

35275844.takeaway: In a laboratory serving 604,000 people, 28% had thyroid function tested in 2018, and TSH varied with age, sex and season, so recalculating reference intervals could cut costs.

35276001.takeaway: In 393 children followed from age 10 to 16, higher serum LPS and LBP predicted greater adiposity and higher insulin and leptin, though associations weakened after adjusting for prepregnancy BMI and gestational diabetes.

35276008.takeaway: In 1,017 mother-child pairs, higher third-trimester maternal free testosterone was associated with weaker handgrip strength at age 5, a possible negative prenatal androgen effect on muscle.

35279718.takeaway: In a spin-off trial of 59 healthy women, estradiol valerate with dienogest suppressed FSH less and raised SHBG far less than ethinylestradiol with dienogest, suggesting milder pituitary and hepatic effects.

35282430.takeaway: A transcriptome-wide analysis of a GWAS of 329,345 women identified 1,580 genes linked to age at menarche, and chemical enrichment analysis flagged 120 endocrine-disrupting chemicals as correlated.

35282457.takeaway: Reviews kynurenic acid as a signaling molecule that regulates energy expenditure through GPR35 and AMPK, with links to metabolic disease, exercise and infant nutrition.

35282460.takeaway: Among 2,985 adults in Port-au-Prince, Haiti, diabetes prevalence was 5.4% and rose with age and obesity, with adults aged 60 and over 17.7 times more likely to have it than those aged 18 to 29.

35282461.takeaway: In 368 pregnant Saudi women, carriers of the FokI VDR ff genotype had about four times the odds of metabolic syndrome, and 85% of participants were vitamin D deficient.

35282464.takeaway: In a pilot of 43 adolescents with obesity, CGM was worn 96% of days and proved feasible, but time-restricted eating did not change glycemic variability compared with a prolonged eating window.

35282469.takeaway: In 65,565 Shanghai pregnancies, first-trimester maternal free T4 had a U-shaped link with preterm delivery, with both low (below 11.7 pmol/L) and high (above 19.7 pmol/L) levels raising risk.

35284771.takeaway: Two sisters with papillary thyroid and breast cancers carried a monoallelic ATM mutation, suggesting it may raise risk for both cancers, possibly together with other factors.

35286052.takeaway: In 47 prepubertal children with Prader-Willi syndrome, subcutaneous fat, but not total fat mass, predicted higher bone mineral density independent of lean mass.

35290211.takeaway: In 331 infants with CAH, salt supplementation was linked to lower fludrocortisone and early hydrocortisone doses, with similar growth and blood pressure, though BMI rose in all children.

35290212.takeaway: In 108 children with adrenocortical tumors, most lacked nuclear VDR expression, and tumors with high VDR hypermethylation had more advanced disease and worse disease-free and overall survival.

35290434.takeaway: In 514 young adults with youth-onset type 2 diabetes, depressive symptoms and impaired quality of life rose over six years and were linked to higher HbA1c, hypertension and retinopathy progression.

35290445.takeaway: Among 19,379 adults with type 2 diabetes in Northern California, those with high-deductible plans had fewer primary-care visits and less HbA1c, blood pressure and retinopathy testing, with similar medication adherence.

35293987.takeaway: In a global electronic records network, insulin-requiring diabetes after COVID-19 was no more common than in matched controls up to age 18, but was higher in those aged 19 to 30.

35293989.takeaway: In 26 boys aged 8 to 10, cold-induced supraclavicular brown fat activity was lower in those with overweight or obesity and correlated inversely with BMI and visceral fat.

35294000.takeaway: In KATP gain-of-function mice modeling neonatal diabetes, reducing glucokinase activity preserved beta-cell mass and identity, lowered glucose and delayed diabetes progression.

35294086.takeaway: Of 2,011 patients referred for hyperinsulinism genetic testing, 11 had Down syndrome, more than four times the expected number, largely from non-genetic risk factors such as prematurity and growth restriction.

35294528.takeaway: In 9,400 serum samples from over 8,000 people aged 3 months to 81, obesity shifted IGF-I by age and estrogen-containing contraceptives lowered IGF-I, so BMI and contraception must be considered when interpreting results.

35295988.takeaway: In a nested case-control study of 193 small-for-gestational-age births and 370 controls, low maternal DLK1 at 26 weeks was linked to SGA, but DLK1 alone predicted SGA poorly (AUC 0.58).

35295993.takeaway: In 221 patients with Rathke's cleft cysts, 52 had abnormal pituitary function, 8 had high ACTH and cortisone, and 8 juveniles had central precocious puberty, with cyst size not clearly determining hypopituitarism.

35297136.takeaway: Among 152 adolescents with type 1 diabetes and suboptimal glycemia, each 5-point rise in mindfulness score was linked to a 0.19% lower HbA1c, though eating behavior and impulsivity did not mediate this.

35298917.takeaway: In 187 euthyroid TPO-antibody-positive women with recurrent pregnancy loss, levothyroxine did not raise live birth rates compared with placebo (50% vs 48%), so routine use is not advised.

35299255.takeaway: From 2,139 healthy Norwegian children, the authors built sex-specific z-score reference curves for 17 biomarkers across puberty, with BMI linked to breast tissue, leptin and SHBG.
