35299958.takeaway: NMR studies of peptide models of mutant proinsulins show the variants progressively disrupt early folding, a pattern the authors propose explains the variable onset age of mutant INS-gene diabetes.

35299963.takeaway: A genome-wide association study of 451 Chinese adults with prediabetes identified several variants associated with 2-hour glucose, HbA1c and BMI.

35299964.takeaway: A meta-analysis of 10 studies in children found higher gut microbiota richness (Chao1) and Actinobacteria in ADHD, but no difference in task-related heart rate reactivity.

35299969.takeaway: A systematic review of 23 publications found rhGH adherence averaged 73% to 95% in studies, with barriers such as self-injection, adolescence and device design, though adherence definitions varied widely.

35299972.takeaway: A peptide model of a proinsulin folding intermediate shows that three clinical variants cause ER stress in proportion to how much they destabilize folding, correlating with the age of diabetes onset.

35303076.takeaway: Among 101 women with preexisting diabetes delivering preterm, 27% had falling insulin requirements, mostly with type 1 diabetes and indicated delivery, but this was unrelated to fetal asphyxia or neonatal morbidity.

35303767.takeaway: A child with severe arthrogryposis multiplex congenita had a novel homozygous TOR1A variant, with additional features including spontaneous fracture, hiatal hernia and uterine prolapse.

35304840.takeaway: In 68 children with new type 1 diabetes, a lower neutrophil/lymphocyte ratio and higher lymphocyte/monocyte ratio at diagnosis were linked to low insulin need at 3 months, though not to partial remission.

35304980.takeaway: A 46,XY child with bilateral Wilms tumor and genital ambiguity had a novel WT1 frameshift variant that disrupts a nuclear localization signal, despite no nephropathy.

35304981.takeaway: Among 319 Indian children and youth with type 1 diabetes, 13.4% had diabetic nephropathy, 8 of the 43 affected were under 10, and diabetes duration and glucose disposal predicted it.

35305128.takeaway: In 30 children with obesity and 30 controls, MAIT cells produced more IL-17 and TNF-alpha, IL-17 producers correlated with HOMA-IR, and IL-17 blocked insulin-stimulated glucose uptake in cells.

35306802.takeaway: A child with newly diagnosed type 1 diabetes developed severe hemolytic anemia from G6PD deficiency, confirmed by a known missense variant, a complication reported during correction of hyperglycemia.

35307916.takeaway: Among 379 hospitalized Brazilian children with diabetes and COVID-19, mortality was 15% versus 7.6% without diabetes, with higher risk linked to obesity, kidney disorders and low oxygen saturation.

35308013.takeaway: Pooled pediatric case series found bilateral petrosal sinus sampling with desmopressin accurate for Cushing's disease (92% after stimulation), but its 50% lateralizing accuracy is unsuitable for clinical use.

35308014.takeaway: Of nine patients with PMM2-CDG, three had hypoglycemia from hyperinsulinism that responded to diazoxide, suggesting hyperinsulinism may be underreported in this disorder.

35308015.takeaway: At one clinic, children diagnosed with type 1 diabetes in the first pandemic year more often presented in DKA (68% vs 41%), with shorter symptom duration and lower pH and bicarbonate.

35308304.takeaway: A girl with a novel homozygous SGPL1 variant had primary adrenal insufficiency without nephrotic syndrome and later developed hypothyroidism; the variant reduced SGPL1 expression and cortisol production in cells.

35311229.takeaway: Among 323 preimplantation genetic testing cycles, blastocyst biopsy without laser zona drilling on day 3 gave higher pregnancy and live birth rates, making it the preferred strategy.

35311244.takeaway: In 79 girls with idiopathic premature adrenarche, adult height matched target height despite slightly early puberty, and a model including bone age explained 71% of adult height variance.

35312757.takeaway: In 2,045 diverse US youth, type 1 and type 2 diabetes genetic risk scores predicted diabetes type across racial and ethnic groups and may help classify antibody-negative children.

35313316.takeaway: Screening 92 females with Turner syndrome for anxiety with a PROMIS tool found elevated scores in 65%, supporting routine screening in endocrine clinics as guidelines recommend.

35316596.takeaway: In 8,150 children aged 7 to 17 in southern China, waist-to-height ratio was the best screen for metabolic syndrome, with an optimal cutoff of about 0.48 across age and sex.

35319130.takeaway: Reviews MEN1 management updates, including subtotal parathyroidectomy, risk-stratified neuroendocrine tumour surveillance, and pituitary and breast screening, with clinically relevant features already present in childhood.

35319491.takeaway: An international consensus finds no evidence that GH replacement raises cancer recurrence or cancer mortality in survivors, and advises caution in children with cancer predisposition syndromes.

35320640.takeaway: A girl with a novel heterozygous OTX2 frameshift variant had congenital hypopituitarism with pituitary hypoplasia and stalk atrophy but no eye abnormalities.

35323957.takeaway: In 259 Danish boys, serum testosterone at 3 months predicted total sperm count at age 18 to 20, suggesting an individual reproductive setpoint forms early in infancy.

35325164.takeaway: In 35,528 pregnant women, less strict GDM screening protocols were not inferior to IADPSG criteria for macrosomia and most cesarean outcomes, while IADPSG diagnosed the most GDM (21.9%).

35325514.takeaway: In 127 children aged 9 to 12, skeletal maturation moderated how body fat related to insulin resistance, with HOMA-IR peaking shortly before peak height velocity in girls.

35333737.takeaway: In 29 patients with TRK fusion-positive thyroid cancer pooled from three trials, larotrectinib gave a 71% response rate, 86% in papillary and follicular cancers, with mostly grade 1 or 2 adverse events.

35334193.takeaway: A survey of 52 pediatric endocrinology fellows and attendings in Turkey found 61% had no formal diabetes-technology training, and many felt under-skilled interpreting pump and CGM reports.

35334196.takeaway: In 87 prepubertal children born at term, serum spexin did not differ by birth size but was lower in children with metabolic syndrome components.

35343269.takeaway: Over 12 months in very young children with type 1 diabetes, CGM sustained lower hypoglycemia and high sensor use, but time in range and HbA1c did not improve, leaving hyperglycemia unmitigated.

35344643.takeaway: During the April 2020 lockdown, 100 children with type 1 diabetes had about five times the risk of anxiety symptoms compared with 93 healthy peers, linked to fear of severe COVID-19 and access to supplies.

35349653.takeaway: A systematic review of 46 population studies from 32 countries found adult-onset type 1 diabetes incidence lowest in Asia and highest in Nordic countries, and higher in men.

35350013.takeaway: Over 20 years of neonatal CAH screening in 862,521 newborns in north-eastern Italy, 21-hydroxylase deficiency occurred in 1 in 25,368, with 97% sensitivity, and LC-MS/MS second-tier testing reduced recalls.

35350016.takeaway: A novel IGSF1 frameshift variant caused X-linked congenital central hypothyroidism in four family members, with variable presentation and a carrier uncle diagnosed at 34.

35350392.takeaway: Reviews evidence that testosterone is the main driver of male athletic advantage, suggesting that lowering it may erase that advantage in some sports, with more research needed.

35350393.takeaway: In 133 SGA newborns followed for a year, length caught up within a month and weight by three months, and IGFBP-3 and HOMA-IR predicted early catch-up, with weight and length defining distinct metabolic groups.

35350867.takeaway: In a mouse model of MCT8 deficiency, intravenous AAV9-MCT8 given at juvenile age improved locomotor and cognitive function and normalized brain T3, mainly in the central nervous system.

35353710.takeaway: Endo-ERN guideline recommends multidisciplinary puberty induction for congenital pituitary or gonadal deficiency, considered at 11 years in girls and 12 in boys, with careful transition planning.

35354138.takeaway: In 68 children in a GH deficiency trial, the oral GH secretagogue LUM-201 produced higher GH peaks (median 15 vs 5.5 ng/mL) than standard diagnostic stimuli, especially in those with higher IGF-I.

35355494.takeaway: In Turkish children with early-onset severe obesity and a family history, MC4R analysis found known variants in 3.5% and obesity-linked polymorphisms in 4.7%, with insulin resistance common in both groups.

35355500.takeaway: In 94 Turkish patients with PAH deficiency, mild hyperphenylalaninemia was most common (51%), missense variants were typically milder, and splice variants were linked to classical phenylketonuria.

35355556.takeaway: Across 20 observational studies, DKA risk in children with type 1 diabetes was 35% higher during COVID-19 than before, and severe DKA 76% higher, with the rise concentrated in new-onset cases.

35355559.takeaway: In 17 evaluable children with hypothalamic obesity, dextroamphetamine was followed by BMI decline or stabilization in 14, with less hyperphagia and higher resting energy expenditure, though two developed hypertension.

35355562.takeaway: A patient with Prader-Willi syndrome, severe obesity, type 2 diabetes and fatty liver developed hepatic adenomatosis, the first such case reported in this syndrome.

35356008.takeaway: In 15 Japanese children with X-linked hypophosphatemia, burosumab over about two years had a good safety profile, raised serum phosphorus, and tended to improve rickets severity.

35357097.takeaway: Of 28 children with adrenal insufficiency followed for 30 years in Portugal, panhypopituitarism and congenital adrenal hyperplasia were the main causes, with vomiting and weight loss the commonest presentation.

35357471.takeaway: In 103 mother-child pairs, prenatal cannabis exposure was linked to higher fat mass, adiposity and fasting glucose at about 4.7 years, a finding that needs validation in other cohorts.

35358968.takeaway: In a cohort of 75 patients with Laron syndrome, four had focal epilepsy with temporal epileptiform discharges, seemingly unrelated to childhood hypoglycemia.

35359001.takeaway: In 867 obese pregnant women, gestational diabetes was linked to higher plasma diglycerides and triglycerides consistent with de novo lipogenesis, and these lipids were associated with newborn abdominal circumference.

35359005.takeaway: In 189 children followed from age 3, higher habitual protein intake during growth was linked to greater adult height in girls but not boys, with a weaker inverse link to dietary acid load.

35360053.takeaway: In 2,634 non-diabetic Brazilian adults aged 34 to 59, low birth weight was associated with lower HOMA-beta, and after propensity matching with other insulin-sensitivity indices, suggesting early metabolic changes.

35360058.takeaway: In a cohort of 997 children, prepuberty BMI showed an inverted U-shaped link with early breast development in girls, with risk rising steeply between the 25th and 85th BMI percentiles.

35360062.takeaway: Reviews which young boys should bank testicular tissue for fertility preservation, recommending it for high-risk gonadotoxic treatment and bilateral cryptorchidism, but not for Klinefelter syndrome or lower-risk treatment.

35360067.takeaway: Testicular cells from 11 infant boys with cryptorchidism, transplanted without culture into mice, colonized seminiferous tubules at about 6%, suggesting a route to spermatogonial stem cell transplantation.

35360079.takeaway: Among 324 Egyptian children with type 1 diabetes, the COVID-19 waves brought more new diagnoses, more severe DKA at presentation (43% overall) and more hypokalemia than the pre-pandemic period.

35360083.takeaway: In 7,683 singleton pregnancies, paternal obesity was an independent predictor of small-for-gestational-age and macrosomic births and was linked to higher preeclampsia and cesarean rates.

35366046.takeaway: In 5,889 Danish children with type 1 diabetes followed from 1996 to 2019, HbA1c rose with age, and later diagnosis and low blood glucose monitoring frequency predicted worse trajectories.

35366047.takeaway: In German registry data, children diagnosed with type 1 diabetes during COVID-19 had higher HbA1c at diagnosis (+0.33%) and needed more insulin afterward, suggesting diagnostic delay.

35368070.takeaway: In 15,809 GH-treated patients with deficiency, adverse events were reported by 51%, de novo cancer incidence matched the general population, and lipids and glucose were neutral over a mean 5.3 years.

35368191.takeaway: Korean guidelines on bone health in children and adolescents cover bone acquisition, defining and evaluating low bone mineral density, causes of osteoporosis, lifestyle measures and drug treatments.

35368192.takeaway: Narrative review of endocrine comorbidities in children with Down syndrome, including thyroid, growth, puberty and diabetes disorders, with management recommendations for pediatricians.

35370939.takeaway: In 600 pregnant women, postpartum hemorrhage occurred in 6.9% with vitamin D deficiency and 6.7% with insufficiency, versus 1.5% with sufficient levels.

35370944.takeaway: In Atlantic salmon, pituitary fshb, lhb and gnrhr2bba expression rose as testis maturation began, and these genes responded to GnRH and sex steroids ex vivo, suggesting an upstream mechanism for FSH induction.

35370948.takeaway: A 22-year-old man with a novel activating GCK variant had hypoglycemia from neonatal life, with hyperplastic islets and insulin hypersecretion; hypoglycemia persisted after pancreatectomy but improved with pasireotide.

35370951.takeaway: In 524 children with obesity aged 10 to 16, the triglyceride-to-HDL ratio loaded strongly on insulin resistance and improved a metabolic syndrome model when used in place of fasting glucose.

35370980.takeaway: Among 21 children with type 1 diabetes using pumps or CGM, contact dermatitis was treated mainly with topical steroids and prevented with hydrocolloid adhesives, yet only 52% fully resolved and 38% stopped device use.

35370986.takeaway: Reviews congenital hypothyroidism in preterm infants, covering hypothyroxinemia of prematurity, screening thresholds that vary worldwide, and mixed trial evidence on treatment, with benefit seen mainly below 29 weeks.

35377436.takeaway: At Alabama's main pediatric center, new-onset type 2 diabetes rose during COVID-19 from 11.1 to 19.3 cases a month, mostly among Medicaid enrollees and males.

35378069.takeaway: In 72 people aged 10 to 24 with type 2 diabetes, dapagliflozin did not significantly lower HbA1c versus placebo in the intention-to-treat analysis, though a per-protocol analysis differed, with low severe hypoglycemia risk.

35380629.takeaway: US diabetes-specific hospital admissions fell 19% from 2008 to 2016, but rose 10% to 82% among adults aged 18 to 29 in individual states.

35380700.takeaway: At seven US centers, the share of people with type 1 diabetes presenting in DKA rose during COVID-19 surges, highest among non-Hispanic Black patients, and was less common among CGM or pump users.

35380983.takeaway: Reviews lifestyle and drug interventions for maternal metabolic health in pregnancy, noting short-term benefits but uncertain long-term maternal and offspring outcomes, and the case for early individualized risk scores.

35381090.takeaway: In 175,112 Chinese women, preconception TSH had a J-shaped link with large-for-gestational-age births, with 0.91 to 1.82 mIU/L the potential safe range, while lower TSH linked to preterm delivery and low birth weight.

35385843.takeaway: Reviews proposed mechanisms linking stress, glucocorticoids, autoimmunity, endocrine disruptors and oxidative DNA damage to thyroid dysregulation and thyroid cancer in children and adolescents.

35389477.takeaway: In 803 healthy young adults aged 22 to 35 with normal TSH, log TSH predicted fluid intelligence in women but not in men.

35390795.takeaway: In 47 children with SHOX haploinsufficiency, those treated with rhGH reached adult heights about 1 SD taller than untreated peers, and adding a GnRH analogue gave adult height similar to rhGH alone.

35390801.takeaway: Reviews the I-DSD registry, launched in 2008, which supports research, training and benchmarking for differences of sex development, and argues that standardized data sharing should be routine.

35390804.takeaway: Reviews psychological care for children with variations in sex development, favoring preventive, destigmatizing, team-based approaches and noting that pediatric psychological evidence from diabetes may apply.

35392135.takeaway: In Shanghai, monthly inpatient precocious puberty rates in March to August 2020 reached 27% to 48%, versus 11% to 18% in earlier years, with lower serum MKRN3 and ghrelin.

35393709.takeaway: Among 337 Jordanian children with type 1 diabetes, maternal involvement in insulin dosing, higher maternal education and income, and HbA1c at 6 months predicted better glycemic control at 12 months.

35393850.takeaway: Reviews how obesity affects bone in children, through PPAR-gamma-driven shifts from osteoblasts to adipocytes, inflammation and adipokines, raising osteoporosis risk.

35394098.takeaway: A child with neonatal diabetes, congenital hypothyroidism and other anomalies carried two novel heterozygous GLIS3 variants, making her only the second reported compound heterozygous GLIS3 case.

35394664.takeaway: A systematic review of 1,376 transgender individuals found Klinefelter syndrome in about 1%, and advises against routine karyotyping before hormone therapy unless clinical features are present.

35399922.takeaway: Reviews cardiometabolic risk in youth with classical congenital adrenal hyperplasia, where obesity, hypertension, high glucose and dyslipidemia are more common, although full metabolic syndrome is rare.

35399926.takeaway: In mice, holding immature testicular tissue at 4 degrees C for up to 24 hours did not change DNA methyltransferase expression or global DNA methylation after organotypic culture.

35399927.takeaway: In 9- to 11-year-olds, the positive link between fat mass and bone mineral content was largely not explained by insulin, leptin, adiponectin or sex steroids, though free leptin index and adiponectin modified it.

35399930.takeaway: In seven children with X-linked hypophosphatemia, a year of burosumab improved rickets, but femoral and tibial maltorsion and frontal-plane deviation persisted.

35399935.takeaway: In 115 children with idiopathic short stature, leptin did not correlate with TSH or free T4, and elevated TSH occurred in 7% regardless of weight status.

35399938.takeaway: A meta-analysis of 25 studies with 177,792 participants found normal-weight obesity linked to higher odds of hyperglycemia, high triglycerides, low HDL, hypertension and metabolic syndrome.

35399939.takeaway: Among 2,466 Sydney births to women with obesity, higher obesity class was linked to more caesarean sections, gestational diabetes and stillbirth, and class III raised the odds of large-for-gestational-age infants by about 50%.

35399956.takeaway: In beta-cell models and Wfs1-knockout mice, WFS1 deficiency increased pro-inflammatory cytokines and chemokines, causing ER stress and cell death, suggesting inflammation drives beta-cell loss in Wolfram syndrome.

35403376.takeaway: In 1,636 Finnish children under 10 with type 1 diabetes, the first islet autoantibody could be deduced in about half, and insulin-autoantibody-first disease was commoner in boys, young children and high-risk HLA groups.

35403448.takeaway: A meta-analysis of 34 RCTs found T3 improved cardiac index in adults after cardiac surgery but not in children, cardiac donors, heart failure or myocardial infarction, and it was safe.

35405011.takeaway: In a 12-month trial of 224 prepubertal children with GH deficiency, once-weekly somatrogon was noninferior to daily somatropin for height velocity (10.1 vs 9.8 cm/year), with similar tolerability.

35405042.takeaway: A woman with congenital generalized lipodystrophy type 4 from a novel PTRF variant had uncontrolled diabetes and severe hypertriglyceridemia; metreleptin allowed insulin to be stopped and triglycerides and liver size to improve.

35405047.takeaway: In 433 Turkish patients with phenylketonuria, five common PAH variants made up 46% of alleles, and nine novel variants were found, supporting pre-marriage screening.

35405772.takeaway: In six Pakistani children with primary hypertriglyceridemia, triglycerides exceeded 1,000 mg/dL in all, pancreatitis was the presenting event, and family history was linked to earlier symptoms.

35410112.takeaway: A male with neonatal diabetes, congenital hypothyroidism and congenital glaucoma carried a homozygous GLIS3 exon 10-11 deletion and had 17 years of follow-up without kidney, liver or pancreatic complications.

35411073.takeaway: Reviews management challenges in 21-hydroxylase-deficient CAH, including imperfect glucocorticoid replacement, 11-oxygenated androgen biomarkers, and emerging physiological cortisol and androgen-lowering therapies.

35411611.takeaway: In a phase 1 randomized trial of 23 adolescents with type 2 diabetes, once-daily lixisenatide up to 20 micrograms gave dose-dependent exposure, improved glycemia, and an adult-like safety profile with no symptomatic hypoglycemia.

35411762.takeaway: In 40 children with type 1 diabetes and 40 controls, Dkk-1 was higher while bone turnover markers and vitamin D were lower, suggesting reduced bone remodeling in type 1 diabetes.

35411763.takeaway: Two 46,XY siblings with a homozygous HSD17B3 splice variant differed in puberty and virilization at diagnosis, with dysgenetic gonadal histology in both, supporting early diagnosis.

35413716.takeaway: In a survey of 119 pediatric endocrine providers, 70% routinely discussed fertility in Turner syndrome, but only 19% often referred girls without spontaneous menarche to fertility preservation specialists.

35416981.takeaway: In 16 children with congenital hyperinsulinism, exendin-(9-39) raised fasting glucose area under the curve by about 20% and cut the likelihood of hypoglycemia by 76% to 84% at higher doses.

35417107.takeaway: A 16-year-old with congenital generalized lipodystrophy type 4 had severe hypertriglyceridemia controlled with icosapent ethyl, holding triglycerides near 4 mmol/L as an alternative to metreleptin.

35417110.takeaway: An 11-month-old boy with X-linked adrenal hypoplasia congenita and an NR0B1 variant had central precocious puberty that settled on hydrocortisone and fludrocortisone, with the HPG axis changing over follow-up.

35417909.takeaway: In 44 Japanese prepubertal children with GH deficiency, once-weekly somatrogon gave 12-month height velocity of 9.65 vs 7.87 cm/year with daily Genotropin, meeting noninferiority with similar tolerability.

35417912.takeaway: In 390 youths under 25 with COVID-19, preexisting diabetes, obesity or hypothyroidism were linked to higher risk of hospital and ICU admission, independent of socioeconomic status.

35418943.takeaway: In letrozole and high-fat-diet PCOS rats, mogroside V improved follicle development and ovulation, raising glycolytic enzymes and lactate in granulosa cells.

35418949.takeaway: An 8-year-old boy with isolated glucocorticoid deficiency carried compound heterozygous STAR variants plus a CYP11A1 variant, a possible tri-allelic cause of primary adrenal insufficiency; puberty was normal at 17.

35418950.takeaway: In 882 adolescents aged 12 to 16 in northeast China, insulin resistance was strongly tied to cardiometabolic risk, and an anthropometric nomogram using sex, age, waist-to-hip ratio, weight and BMI predicted it.

35419873.takeaway: Among 22 patients with adipsic hypernatremia, 16 had antibodies against the subfornical organ, and these patients had higher prolactin levels and more hypothalamic disorders.

35419896.takeaway: Reviews pediatric diabetes in China, including rising type 2 diabetes with urbanization, underestimated monogenic diabetes, and the management challenges and policy actions needed.

35419919.takeaway: An optimized 20-point severity score predicted DKA in children with type 1 diabetes in China (AUC 0.88), with a cutoff of 7 giving 90% sensitivity in validation, useful where blood gas testing is unavailable.

35419920.takeaway: In children with islet autoantibodies, gene set analysis showed upregulated antiviral and type I interferon pathways in monocytes, supporting a viral trigger hypothesis, though no single gene differed significantly.

35422762.takeaway: A 16-year-old Chinese girl with a novel PPARG variant (p.F310S) had partial lipodystrophy with diabetes, hypertriglyceridemia and fatty liver; a literature review found no feature differences by variant domain.

35422767.takeaway: Practical review of CYP21A2 genotyping for 21-hydroxylase deficiency, covering pseudogene and deletion pitfalls, a small panel of common variants, genotype-phenotype prediction and carrier counseling.

35428884.takeaway: Over two years of the open-label enliGHten extension, children on weekly lonapegsomatropin kept improving height SD scores, with no new safety signals and minimal bone age advancement.

35432186.takeaway: Proposes a theory of hyperlipidemic memory in which partial clinical remission in type 1 diabetes shapes early lipid phenotypes and later cardiovascular risk, drawing on four studies in children and adults.

35432199.takeaway: Among 964 women with type 2 diabetes and 263 controls, LH and FSH rose earlier than in controls, and estradiol was lower from age 45, with higher LH linked to worse LDL and total cholesterol.

35432203.takeaway: In 138 Taiwanese children with 22q11.2 deletion syndrome, 32% had hypoparathyroidism, often presenting before age one, and 40% had short stature, with airway anomalies a risk factor.

35432221.takeaway: In five males with NR0B1 variants, 12 months of recombinant FSH and hCG enlarged the testes but produced no sperm in semen or biopsies, so gonadotropin treatment did not restore fertility.

35434981.takeaway: A meta-analysis of 1,380 children with sporadic differentiated thyroid cancer found RET rearrangements (24%) and BRAF point mutations (21%) most common, with fusion oncogenes the main drivers.

35436365.takeaway: In 16 girls with pubertal delay and primary amenorrhoea, oestradiol-induced uterine and breast growth varied widely, and transverse uterine diameter tracked oestradiol levels, supporting individualized dose titration.

35437976.takeaway: Among 128 children with Prader-Willi syndrome on GH, morning cortisol was lower than in 128 controls but within normal range, with no sign of central adrenal insufficiency, so morning screening may precede dynamic testing.

35437977.takeaway: A systematic review found 30 Arab patients with severe early-onset monogenic obesity, all carrying homozygous pathogenic variants in LEP, LEPR, POMC, MC4R or CPE, mostly in consanguineous families.

35438268.takeaway: A Turkish family with hypochondroplasia carried a rare FGFR3 variant (Asn540Thr), the first reported in Turkey, with variable phenotypes among affected members.

35438269.takeaway: Comparing 60 rare variants from Turkish patients with idiopathic hypogonadotropic hypogonadism against public databases, the Turkish Variome correlated best, making it the most suitable reference for Turkish individuals.

35438270.takeaway: In Henan Province, China, childhood type 1 diabetes incidence (ages 0.5 to 14.9) was 2.19 per 100,000 person-years in 2017 to 2020, with female excess and lowest incidence in spring.

35438852.takeaway: Two siblings with iodide transport defect carried two novel SLC5A5 (NIS) variants, one inherited from each parent, in the first such family study of congenital hypothyroidism in China.

35444616.takeaway: Reviews fertility preservation by testicular tissue banking and spermatogonial stem cell therapies, noting these remain preclinical and need work before they can help boys treated in childhood.

35445422.takeaway: A meta-analysis of 18 trials with 883 adults with hypothyroidism found T4+T3 combination therapy did not improve depression, fatigue, pain, anxiety or anger versus T4 alone, though patients preferred it.

35445819.takeaway: In 15 healthy men, one night of sleep deprivation between hypoglycemic clamps prevented the usual blunting of adrenaline, GH and glucagon responses, suggesting sleep helps form counterregulatory memory.

35446449.takeaway: A five-session family behavioral intervention to support CGM use in young children with type 1 diabetes was delivered to 89% of participants with high fidelity, and over 80% rated their satisfaction very high.

35447623.takeaway: In 69 Chilean children with congenital hypothyroidism found by newborn screening and 68 matched controls, cognitive tests showed no difference, though higher family income and assets predicted better scores.

35451144.takeaway: Among 1,803 Chinese youths aged 15 to 29 with a type 2 diabetes phenotype, 9% had latent autoimmune diabetes, which showed more autoimmunity and poorer beta-cell function than autoantibody-negative peers.

35452119.takeaway: In 952 transgender people in the US military health system, 70% continued gender-affirming hormones for four years, with higher continuation for transfeminine people and those who started as minors.

35452574.takeaway: In 35 obese and 30 non-obese children, serum miR-218-5p rose with leptin levels, suggesting this microRNA may contribute to leptin resistance through the SOCS3 pathway.

35460250.takeaway: In children with new-onset type 1 diabetes across two cohorts, serum osteopontin was higher and IL-1 receptor antagonist lower than in type 2 diabetes and healthy children, marking candidate biomarkers.

35464054.takeaway: In 10 Dutch children with suprasellar low-grade glioma, the shift from diencephalic syndrome to hypothalamic obesity came at a median age of 4.5 years, seemingly linked to age rather than tumour or treatment.

35464063.takeaway: Reviews acquired hypothalamic obesity, mostly after craniopharyngioma, covering current options such as stimulants, octreotide, MetAP2 inhibitors and bariatric surgery, and the need for placebo-controlled trials.

35466665.takeaway: A boy with a novel hemizygous IGSF1 stop variant was diagnosed with IGSF1 deficiency only at transition, when IGF-I was high after GH was stopped, despite earlier TSH and GH deficiencies.

35466707.takeaway: In 127 children and adolescents aged 7 to 17 with type 1 diabetes, the G7 CGM was accurate when worn on the arm or abdomen, with MARD of 8.1% and 9.0%.

35468213.takeaway: In 702 TEDDY infants, a model combining metabolites, HLA, islet autoantibodies and genetic features predicted type 1 diabetes by age 6 with an AUC of 0.84, with metabolomics most useful at low false-positive rates.

35470463.takeaway: A 36-year-old man with infertility from a novel likely pathogenic LHB variant had low LH and testosterone; a review of published cases found delayed puberty typical, with hCG monotherapy the best option.

35470643.takeaway: A 5-year-old girl with ROHHAD(NET) syndrome had rapid obesity, central hypoventilation and diabetes insipidus; after rituximab her IL-6 normalized and her weight fell from above the 99.6th to the 50th centile in a year.

35475025.takeaway: A 5-month-old girl with ABCC8-related congenital hyperinsulinism had two PET-positive pancreatic foci, and resecting both gave long-term normoglycemia, with a second genetic hit in the atypical lesion.

35476140.takeaway: In 27,120 youths with type 1 diabetes in the SWEET database, hypertension prevalence was 10.8% with three or more BP visits versus 17.5% with fewer, so infrequent measurement can overestimate hypertension.

35476783.takeaway: In diet-induced obese mice, botulinum toxin injected into the proximal intestinal wall caused weight loss, less food intake, better glucose tolerance and slower absorption for about eight weeks.

35480479.takeaway: In 21 Italian newborns with congenital hypothyroidism, liquid levothyroxine Tifactor suppressed TSH by 15 days in 5 of 9 infants versus none of 12 on Tirosint, while free T4 and dose needs were similar.

35486388.takeaway: In 584 youths with type 2 diabetes in TODAY, baseline HbA1c of 6.2% or higher predicted later loss of glycemic control, and a rise of over 0.5% in HbA1c signalled loss within months.

35487031.takeaway: In 804 healthy Indian children aged 2 to 17, height age, bone age and chronological age were closely correlated, with bone age more delayed in boys and nutrition and puberty shaping the variation.

35488926.takeaway: In children with new-onset type 1 diabetes and positive coeliac screening, biopsy confirmation within six months versus 6 to 36 months gave similar HbA1c, cardiovascular markers, acute complications and growth at follow-up.

35498403.takeaway: In 31 adolescents with obesity, serum miR-21, miR-22, miR-150 and miR-155 were higher in those with both insulin resistance and fatty liver, and correlated with liver fat and triglycerides.

35498432.takeaway: In 35,829 Japanese mother-infant pairs, higher maternal urinary cotinine in pregnancy was linked to lower birth BMI but faster BMI gain from 6 to 36 months, in a dose-dependent pattern not seen with questionnaires.

35499511.takeaway: Among 31 Cameroonian children with CAH, 11-beta-hydroxylase deficiency was most common, largely due to a homozygous CYP11B1 p.Q356X variant in half of those affected.

35499624.takeaway: In UK GRID, the share with detectable C-peptide fell steeply in the first five years after diagnosis, and pancreas donor data showed the fastest beta-cell loss in those diagnosed youngest.

35500551.takeaway: Adding 3D T2 images to the FAST1 MRI protocol identified the pituitary stalk in 67% of individuals with ectopic posterior pituitary versus 19% with FAST1 alone, and in all controls.

35501400.takeaway: Only 5.4% of 242 people with monogenic neonatal diabetes had islet autoantibodies, similar to 1.4% of diabetes-free controls, suggesting beta-cell stress alone does not trigger autoimmunity.

35503504.takeaway: Argues for considering metformin in children with prediabetes who do not respond to lifestyle change, given their faster progression, metformin's approval for type 2 diabetes, and its limited toxicity.

35506147.takeaway: In 39 healthy children aged 1 to 6, CGM showed mean glucose of 103 mg/dL, 96% of time between 70 and 140 mg/dL, and under 1% of time below 70, providing normative reference ranges.

35506613.takeaway: Over 2007 to 2017, thyroid dysfunction became the commonest reason for referral (22%) to a Western Australian paediatric endocrine clinic, with thyroid diagnoses rising and short-stature diagnoses falling.

35508143.takeaway: In 57 children with adrenocortical carcinoma, the Wieneke histopathological classification predicted prognosis best (77% accuracy), though still not precisely enough for reliable prognosis.

35511700.takeaway: In NHANES adolescents aged 12 to 19, higher serum PFOA and urinary phthalate metabolites were linked to lower bone mineral density in boys, with a small positive association for some compounds in girls.

35518923.takeaway: In a nonrandomized study of 964 pregnant women with hypothyroxinemia, levothyroxine did not significantly reduce hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, though the authors reported fewer miscarriages and NICU admissions.

35518931.takeaway: In 17,713 patients undergoing craniotomy for tumours, low BMI in men under 18.5 kg/m2 was linked to higher 30-day mortality, with no association above that threshold.

35518932.takeaway: In mice, a high-fat diet during puberty and adulthood impaired male fertility through oxidative stress and lower StAR and WT-1 expression, but switching to a normal diet in adulthood restored fertility.

35518934.takeaway: In 234 youths with type 1 diabetes followed for 15 years, C-peptide fell steadily, detectable in only 26% at 15 years; those with residual C-peptide needed less insulin and had fewer ketoacidosis events.

35518939.takeaway: Of 70 Vietnamese infants with neonatal diabetes, 78.5% had a known genetic cause, and six different de novo INS mutations in 10 patients made INS the third most common cause of permanent NDM.

35521698.takeaway: At age 32, 170 adults born SGA with catch-up growth had lower insulin sensitivity, more fat mass and central adiposity, and adverse lipids than 117 adults born appropriate for gestational age.

35521767.takeaway: In 236 healthy infants aged 0 to 1.2 years, serum and urinary LH/FSH ratios discriminated sex with 93% to 100% sensitivity and specificity across the first year.

35521792.takeaway: Among over 300 probands screened for AIRE variants, biallelic changes were found in 35 with APS-1 and 5 with isolated hypoparathyroidism, including a novel homozygous p.His14Pro variant.

35521800.takeaway: In 102 short children born SGA treated with GH, height SD score rose by about 1 to 1.6 SD by adult height, with lower peak height velocity and earlier puberty in SGA boys.

35521999.takeaway: Youth-onset type 2 diabetes incidence in Israel rose from 0.63 to 3.41 per 100,000 between 2008 and 2019, and among 379 cases at diagnosis, 62% met metabolic syndrome criteria and 73% had a family history.

35522033.takeaway: In 14 children using a 780G hybrid closed loop, unannounced snacks up to about 20 g carbohydrate kept the 2-hour glucose rise below 50 mg/dL, with 30 g meals considered safe.

35524727.takeaway: Young people with type 1 diabetes had mild COVID-19; higher glucose levels and older age were linked to symptomatic infection and prolonged illness.

35524749.takeaway: OGTT measures, notably the C-peptide index and Index60, predicted type 1 diabetes about as well as IV testing, supporting OGTT for trial stratification.

35527997.takeaway: About two-thirds of parents at pediatric weight clinics were likely to try eating within 12 hours a day, but interest fell with shorter windows.

35533131.takeaway: Telemedicine for diabetes in pregnancy did not improve birth weight or other maternal and fetal outcomes compared with usual care; more research is needed.

35533340.takeaway: In children aged 1 to 12 with X-linked hypophosphatemia, burosumab improved rickets, deformity, growth and alkaline phosphatase versus phosphate and vitamin D in both age groups.

35533645.takeaway: Immunotherapies that preserve beta-cell function are advancing; teplizumab delays progression in high-risk people, and combination and earlier approaches may be needed.

35534911.takeaway: A child with rhabdomyosarcoma and ectopic PTH hypercalcemia responded to zoledronic acid and denosumab; the authors suggest zoledronic acid first, with denosumab for refractory cases.

35538692.takeaway: Most children with type 1 diabetes on conventional insulin in Addis Ababa had poor control (HbA1c above 7.5%); younger age, longer duration and urban residence predicted better control.

35544121.takeaway: After family-based treatment, children with obesity who lost weight showed weaker brain satiety responses to food cues, while gut hormones supported weight loss.

35546211.takeaway: Adding intermittently scanned CGM to usual care in pregnant women with type 1 diabetes gave an early HbA1c gain that was not sustained, and neonatal hypoglycaemia was more frequent.

35546999.takeaway: In the Netherlands, osteogenesis imperfecta patients had 2.9 times the general hospitalization rate, highest at ages 0 to 19, and life expectancy was reduced.

35547007.takeaway: Cord blood exosomal RNAs differed in gestational diabetes with macrosomia; a model combining maternal glycemia with exosomal RNA expression predicted macrosomia (AUC 0.86).

35549708.takeaway: In adults with type 1 diabetes, adaptive zone model predictive control automated insulin delivery did not significantly raise time in range over sensor-augmented pump; time below 70 mg/dL fell.

35549729.takeaway: Children with type 1 diabetes aged 0 to 17 had better glucose control than 18 to 25-year-olds; more physician, dietitian and psychologist visits were linked to better control.

35552681.takeaway: Iodine intake in lactating women and infants varies worldwide from deficient to excessive; the thyroid risk of mild deficiency in the first two years needs more data.

35554540.takeaway: Women with obesity and PCOS reached complete remission in 78% after sleeve gastrectomy versus 15% with metformin and an oral contraceptive; remission tracked final BMI.

35561056.takeaway: Only 12% of young people aged 16 to 25 with type 1 diabetes in Australasia had HbA1c below 7.0%, and control stayed suboptimal from 2011 to 2020.

35561070.takeaway: Among relatives of people with type 1 diabetes, 8% developed gastric parietal cell autoantibodies by age 20; risk was higher in females, DR4-DQ8 homozygotes and those with thyroid autoimmunity.

35561091.takeaway: Seven pediatric diabetes registries and SWEET together cover over 900 centers and about 100,000 patients, mostly with type 1 diabetes, but their definitions of the pediatric population differ.

35561092.takeaway: Parents of young children in a closed-loop trial supported clinicians' real-time remote access to glucose and insulin data, citing easier remote consultations, with privacy caveats.

35562186.takeaway: A room-temperature liquid glucagon autoinjector raised plasma glucose within 30 minutes in youth with type 1 diabetes aged 2 to under 18, with no clinically relevant age differences.

35567286.takeaway: A systematic review identified 20 pediatric growth hormone registries worldwide, most often industry-funded and mainly covering GH deficiency, Turner, Prader-Willi and small-for-gestational-age groups.

35569086.takeaway: Pregnant women with primary aldosteronism needed more antihypertensives and stayed longer postpartum than high-risk matched controls, with similar pre-eclampsia rates and no neonatal difference.

35569443.takeaway: Pediatric endocrinologists were confident in only 4 of 20 metabolic bone conditions, and 52% reported inadequate training; the authors call for dedicated education.

35569445.takeaway: Specialist centres in 27 countries varied in defining and managing adrenal insufficiency events in children with CAH but agreed on key items, such as stress dosing for fever and parenteral hydrocortisone for crisis.

35573986.takeaway: Describes the lived challenges of congenital hyperinsulinism and the programs of the patient organization CHI, including its registry, research grants and patient-focused research agenda.

35573994.takeaway: In prepubertal children with idiopathic short stature, 52 weeks of daily somatropin raised height SD score to 1.04 versus 0.20 in untreated controls, with similar adverse event rates.

35573998.takeaway: In young adults with type 2 diabetes, cognition improved with glycemic control while early brain hyperconnectivity decreased, suggesting an early window for cognitive reversal.

35574001.takeaway: In mud crab hepatopancreas, four juvenoid hormones changed lipid metabolism differently during ovarian maturation, with methyl farnesoate driving lipid accumulation and farnesoic acid promoting breakdown.

35574004.takeaway: Children with hyperuricemia had a shifted gut microbiota, with fewer short-chain fatty acid producers and more sulfidogenic bacteria, though causality could not be established.

35574020.takeaway: Heterozygous variants in leptin-melanocortin genes were found in 5.5% of 1508 children, and carriers were estimated to gain 7.6 to 8.4 kg more by age 18; the authors suggest early identification could help.

35574033.takeaway: Nuclear localization of IGF1R increased glioblastoma cell motility, metabolism and tumor formation in mice and sensitized cells to OSI906, suggesting a possible treatment target.

35575788.takeaway: Adolescents with obesity who moved to a fully video-based program during lockdown improved BMI SD score, insulin resistance and triglycerides, comparable to prior in-person results.

35580566.takeaway: In prepubertal children with obesity, more metabolic syndrome components were linked to progressively worse glucose, insulin, lipid and blood pressure values and altered gut hormone levels.

35581594.takeaway: Adult women with Turner syndrome reported lower breast satisfaction and sexual and psychosocial well-being than matched controls, with lower scores among those given estrogen replacement.

35583390.takeaway: Comprehensive genetic testing of 86 children born SGA with short stature gave a genetic diagnosis in 12; the authors advise it when the etiology is unknown.

35583678.takeaway: Among adults with type 2 diabetes, higher plasma MR-proADM predicted lower-limb amputation (HR 4.40 top vs bottom tertile), and ADM gene variants supported a causal role.

35584004.takeaway: CTNNB1-mutated adamantinomatous craniopharyngiomas had shorter telomeres, linking Wnt/beta-catenin signaling to telomere biology; mutations were more common in patients diagnosed under 15.

35586622.takeaway: In school-age children, lower fasting IGFBP-1 identified insulin resistance in those with BMI z-score 1 to 2, before triglyceride and HDL changes appeared.

35586630.takeaway: Most mothers engaged well with telephone support in an infant obesity prevention program; engagement was higher among Australian-born, employed and higher-income participants.

35587276.takeaway: In mice and obese youth, IgM-bound gut bacteria were linked to weight gain and impaired glucose tolerance after faecal transplant, suggesting a role in obesity-related type 2 diabetes.

35587448.takeaway: In 54 people with hyperinsulinism treated with lanreotide, fasting duration above 70 mg/dL rose from 5.1 to 8.6 hours, and 42% of those on other therapy stopped them.

35587453.takeaway: Reference ranges for DXA bone mineral content and density were built from healthy children aged 1 to 5, with height adjustment needed for accurate bone Z-scores.

35588001.takeaway: In a Hong Kong birth cohort, higher maternal vitamin D metabolite levels during pregnancy were associated with longer telomeres in 7-year-old offspring.

35588090.takeaway: Transient congenital hypothyroidism is becoming more common; genetic factors such as DUOX2 and DUOXA2 variants and environmental factors, including iodine and anti-TSHR antibodies, may cause it.

35591792.takeaway: In preterm infants, iodine-based skin antiseptics were linked to more low T4 and high TSH results and lower early neurobehavioral scores than alcohol, though clinical significance is unclear.

35592510.takeaway: A 12-year-old with bilateral slipped capital femoral epiphysis had primary hyperparathyroidism from an ectopic mediastinal parathyroid adenoma, cured by thoracoscopic resection; imaging should extend beyond the neck.

35592516.takeaway: In 59 UK patients with focal congenital hyperinsulinism, 40 of 55 operated patients had immediate resolution, and 15% were managed conservatively, showing outcome heterogeneity despite one genetic basis.

35592786.takeaway: Stimulated C-peptide above 300 pmol/L is a poor marker of partial remission in type 1 diabetes; the authors propose combining insulin-dose adjusted A1c with insulin sensitivity measures.

35592787.takeaway: Among 250 adult novice exercisers in Oslo fitness clubs, weight cycling and unhealthy weight-control strategies were common, more so in women, and self-classified overweight was the strongest predictor.

35592896.takeaway: In 151 children taking metformin for at least 3 months, mean vitamin B12 did not fall significantly over 36 months; one child became deficient, and his level later normalized.

35592897.takeaway: A 16-year-old with a macroprolactinoma and pituitary apoplexy presented with middle cerebral artery stroke; surgery and neurorehabilitation led to full motor and cognitive recovery.

35592898.takeaway: About 39% of Korean adolescents aged 10 to 18 with overweight or obesity were metabolically healthy; this share stayed stable from 2011 to 2019 while overweight prevalence rose.

35592899.takeaway: A 10-year-old Korean girl had a de novo PDX1 variant causing MODY type 4 with rising HbA1c, which improved after insulin degludec was added to metformin.

35592900.takeaway: In 113 short children treated with growth hormone for a year, height increased, but Cobb angles and scoliosis prevalence did not change significantly.

35592901.takeaway: Brain lesions were found in 17% of 257 girls with central precocious puberty, falling from 33% under age 2 to 4% at ages 6 to 8; the authors advise cautious MRI use at older ages.

35593530.takeaway: PCOS, affecting 8 to 13% of reproductive-aged women, can show features in early adolescence; the review addresses the difficulty of diagnosis and understanding its natural history.

35594057.takeaway: Retinopathy in adolescents with type 1 diabetes fell from 40% in the 1990s to about 20% in the 2000s and 2010s, while continuous insulin infusion use rose to 55%.

35596599.takeaway: PCOS was diagnosed in 0.7% of adolescent girls in a Northern California health system, rising with obesity and about twice as common in Asian/Pacific Islander as in White adolescents.

35598163.takeaway: Among 53 children and young people with type 1 diabetes in Laos, 57% presented in diabetic ketoacidosis and mean HbA1c was 8.7%, the first national report on T1D care there.

35598164.takeaway: Parents with clinically elevated depressive symptoms and stress soon after their young child's type 1 diabetes diagnosis reported lower diabetes self-efficacy at 12 and 18 months.

35600573.takeaway: In 133 Dutch children with thyroid carcinoma, recurrence occurred in 19% of papillary cancers and in none of the follicular cancers, and survival was very good for both.

35600578.takeaway: Children with lipodystrophy face insulin resistance and other metabolic complications; metreleptin is approved for generalized and partial lipodystrophy, but some patients lack access or respond poorly.

35600579.takeaway: Newborn genetic screening for VDDR1A tested 2000 infants in the Saguenay-Lac-Saint-Jean region; 96.5% of families accepted it, and one affected child was treated before symptoms appeared.

35600581.takeaway: In young adult mice, lowering NAD+ disrupted spermatogenesis and reduced sperm counts, and niacin restored it, suggesting NAD+ links aging to male fertility.

35600585.takeaway: A novel synonymous SLC5A5 variant found in children with dyshormonogenic congenital hypothyroidism disrupted NIS pre-mRNA splicing, causing exon skipping.

35600589.takeaway: Among 31 caregivers of children on growth hormone in Taiwan, a nurse-led support program reduced high-risk scores for emotional burden and anxiety and improved self-administration confidence.

35600592.takeaway: A 3-year-old with cutaneous-skeletal hypophosphatemia syndrome reached normal serum phosphate within 4 weeks of burosumab, with growth and rickets improvement sustained over 42 months.

35600600.takeaway: In rats, perinatal nicotine exposure altered sperm-borne RNA profiles, and rosiglitazone reversed much of this effect, suggesting a possible epigenetic route for inherited asthma risk.

35600602.takeaway: Four of 14 neonates with hyperthyroidism needed levothyroxine for central or primary hypothyroidism; the authors advise prolonged TSH monitoring because early hyperthyroidism can mask central hypothyroidism.

35600604.takeaway: In 102 Chinese adults, higher perirenal fat volume was independently associated with higher serum uric acid, suggesting it may be a risk factor for elevated uric acid.

35603554.takeaway: In 64 adolescents with long-standing type 1 diabetes, bone density was reduced at the femoral neck and arms but normal at the lumbar spine, and 50% reported fractures.

35604789.takeaway: Among 109 diabetes providers, 61% showed insurance-based implicit bias and 34% racial-ethnic bias when recommending diabetes technology, which the authors say must be addressed.

35606687.takeaway: Growth hormone after stem cell transplant in children improved adult height relative to predicted height versus matched untreated controls, though adult height stayed about 2 SD below target.

35607289.takeaway: In Jordan, fewer children were diagnosed with type 1 diabetes in the first pandemic year than in the prior year, and more presented in diabetic ketoacidosis (52% vs 35%).

35609533.takeaway: A 14-year-old girl with MIS-C was found to have new primary adrenal insufficiency and autoimmune hypothyroidism, a possible autoimmune polyglandular syndrome after COVID-19 whose causality is unknown.

35609555.takeaway: Fewer than half of 42 children with prolactinoma were eligible to stop dopamine agonists, and fewer than one-quarter of those who stopped achieved remission.

35610521.takeaway: High circulating CD137/4-1BB and PD-1 at type 1 diabetes diagnosis predicted later development of another autoimmune disease in children, suggesting possible prognostic biomarkers.

35611324.takeaway: In 200 adolescent girls, 11-oxyandrogens did not improve PCOS diagnosis beyond testosterone but correlated with hirsutism, and their levels were lower with oral contraceptive treatment.

35611983.takeaway: A novel heterozygous PAX8 variant caused familial congenital hypothyroidism in a 10-month-old girl, with complete penetrance among her affected father and half-brother.

35615720.takeaway: In 106 caregivers of children with craniopharyngioma, 57% reported obesity, few had tried weight-loss medication, and social function was impaired, most in children with obesity.

35617710.takeaway: A homozygous SMPD1 two-base-pair deletion caused acid sphingomyelinase deficiency in a five-month-old, and expression analysis in the family suggested SMPD1 was not imprinted there.

35618782.takeaway: Monogenic diabetes is the clearest model of precision diabetes care, with genotype-guided therapy proven for sulfonylurea responses in some forms and leptin in lipodystrophy, though implementation remains a challenge.

35619192.takeaway: In 157 children with type 1 diabetes followed through the pandemic, time in range improved after lockdown, and those on pump therapy or under 6 years old did best.

35620396.takeaway: In 98 preterm infants born before 33 weeks, free T4 was lower at 24 to 28 weeks than at 29 to 32 weeks gestation, supporting gestational-age-specific thyroid reference values.

35621990.takeaway: In infant umbilical cord stem cells, insulin action tracked maternal free fatty acid levels rather than maternal obesity, which may reflect intrauterine lipid exposure.

35622068.takeaway: In NOD mice, a single neonatal dose of anti-Langerin hybrid insulin peptide enhanced central tolerance and delayed autoimmune diabetes onset, suggesting an early prevention strategy.

35622127.takeaway: Children at type 1 diabetes onset had altered plasma and IgG N-glycan profiles, and a model using these glycans distinguished them from unaffected siblings with AUCs up to 0.915.

35633281.takeaway: Nearly 69% of parents of young children newly diagnosed with type 1 diabetes reported poor sleep, averaging 5.9 hours a night, and sleep did not differ by CGM use.

35633639.takeaway: A 12-year-old with neurofibromatosis-Noonan syndrome and short stature had a novel NF1 variant; growth hormone was withheld because it might enlarge skeletal lesions.

35633640.takeaway: The Turkish DSTAR-Teen, a 12-item two-factor resilience measure, showed good reliability (Cronbach alpha 0.85) and validity in 120 adolescents with type 1 diabetes.

35633642.takeaway: Among 89 girls with central precocious or rapidly progressive early puberty, most cases were diagnosed during the COVID-19 lockdown (79% of CPP and 74% of RPEP).

35633644.takeaway: Among 43 childhood ALL survivors, 9% had impaired adrenal function on ACTH testing, and DHEA-S was the best marker of adrenal function after therapy.

35633645.takeaway: In 104 children with type 1 diabetes and early nephropathy, cluster analysis suggested subgroups with hyperfiltration and low anti-apoptotic markers that might need added therapy; this remains a hypothesis.

35633646.takeaway: In normal-weight prepubertal girls with premature pubarche, glucose and insulin measures matched controls, so pubarche alone did not appear to raise metabolic risk before puberty.

35633647.takeaway: In eight adolescents with autoimmune primary adrenal insufficiency, presentations ranged from fatigue to seizures, and one had type 2 autoimmune polyglandular syndrome; the authors stress a high index of suspicion.

35634493.takeaway: Bradykinin peptides and their receptors rise in human amnion at labor and increase prostaglandin E2 production in amnion fibroblasts, a pathway that infection may enhance.

35634494.takeaway: In rat gonocytes, knocking down the ubiquitin ligase RNF149 reduced the response to a proliferative signal, supporting a role in early male germ-cell development.

35634497.takeaway: In adults hospitalized with diabetic ketoacidosis or hyperosmolar states, non-thyroidal illness was common, and thyroid hormone replacement is generally unnecessary without overt hypothyroid symptoms.

35634508.takeaway: Among matched extremely preterm infants, males had more respiratory distress syndrome and bronchopulmonary dysplasia than females, especially at birth weights of 750 to 999 g, with no survival difference.

35635485.takeaway: IGF-1, IGFBP-3 and basal LH distinguished central precocious puberty from premature thelarche in 116 girls, and combining them gave an AUC of 0.978.

35639981.takeaway: Adding GnRH analogues or aromatase inhibitors to growth hormone can extend growth in puberty; time-limited aromatase inhibitor use is viable for boys, and therapy should be individualized.

35643934.takeaway: Children with type 2 diabetes were hospitalized more often than matched controls and children with type 1 diabetes, most commonly for mental illness, unlike the endocrine causes seen in type 1.

35644029.takeaway: In 16 hospitalized children aged 4 months to 4 years with new-onset type 1 diabetes, FreeStyle Libre readings fell entirely within clinically acceptable zones A and B, with a short lag.

35644034.takeaway: Acute kidney injury occurred in 41.5% of 265 DKA episodes in children with type 1 diabetes; younger age, low admission GCS and rising serum chloride predicted moderate to severe injury.

35645222.takeaway: In 27 children on multiple daily injections, extra insulin for a high-fat high-protein meal given at 0, 1 or 2 hours produced no difference in post-meal glucose, and mild hypoglycemia was common.

35649171.takeaway: In 358 Croatian adolescents, the proportion abnormal for metabolic syndrome components differed by the criteria used, and sex-specific local percentile cut-offs may avoid misestimation.

35649383.takeaway: In 104 children with CAH, growth and disease-control indices were similar with three-times-daily hydrocortisone or other glucocorticoid regimens, though fewer than half used the TID regimen.

35649511.takeaway: In 572 children with dyslipidemia, insulin resistance was common and correlated with low HDL-C even after adjusting for triglycerides, so non-fasting HDL-C may flag insulin resistance.

35653732.takeaway: After evening exercise, automated insulin delivery improved overnight glucose versus usual care in adults and adolescents with type 1 diabetes; dual-hormone delivery beat single-hormone only in adults.

35653748.takeaway: In 46 people aged 4 to 25 with genetic risk for T1D, 10-day CGM and a home OGTT detected T1D stages, offering a possible remote way to confirm normoglycemia.

35655799.takeaway: In female mice, psychosocial stress during puberty delayed puberty and reduced LH pulse frequency, and activating medial amygdala Ucn3 neurons reproduced the delay.

35657808.takeaway: In KCNJ11 or ABCC8 neonatal diabetes, glibenclamide significantly improved neurological features in 114 patients, with hypotonia responding best and earlier treatment giving greater benefit.

35658604.takeaway: In adults with BRAF-mutated radioiodine-refractory thyroid cancer, adding trametinib to dabrafenib did not improve objective response rate (48% vs 42%) compared with dabrafenib alone.

35658634.takeaway: Among 758 youth with type 1 diabetes, Hispanic and Black youth had higher HbA1c than white youth one year after diagnosis (8.7% vs 7.7%), suggesting disparities emerge early.

35658967.takeaway: During India's COVID-19 lockdown, referrals for precocious puberty and diagnoses of idiopathic central precocious puberty rose, with children presenting in late puberty with more advanced bone age.

35660132.takeaway: Among 969 US adolescents, metabolic syndrome was linked to lower height-adjusted bone density, with abdominal obesity and insulin resistance playing a major role.

35661517.takeaway: A 25-item unidimensional Diabetes Device Confidence Scale was developed and validated in 310 Pennsylvania school nurses to measure confidence with insulin pumps and CGMs.

35662345.takeaway: In 951 Hispanic youths, adiposity was linked to lower bone mass, insulin resistance mediated much of this relation, and cardiorespiratory fitness partly attenuated it.

35663319.takeaway: In 2,916 Chinese children with severe obesity, cardiometabolic comorbidities were common, and several, including hypertension, rose markedly between 2008-2012 and 2013-2017.

35663328.takeaway: A 4-year-old boy with rickets had a homozygous CYP27B1 variant confirming vitamin D-dependent rickets type 1A, and was treated with alfacalcidol and oral calcium.

35665810.takeaway: In an exploratory CGM analysis of recent-onset type 1 diabetes patients with HLA DR3-DQ2, intralymphatic GAD-alum reduced the fall in time in range over 15 months versus placebo (-5.1% vs -16.7%).

35665825.takeaway: Among Israeli adolescents assessed before military conscription, higher BMI at ages 16 to 19 was linked to type 1 diabetes in young adulthood, with each BMI SD raising risk by 25%.

35666195.takeaway: In 161 transgender girls treated with GnRH analogues and estradiol, adult height was close to target height after regular-dose treatment, while high-dose ethinyl estradiol reduced it by about 3 cm.

35667385.takeaway: Over 4.5 years, arterial stiffness and heart rate variability worsened more in youth-onset type 2 than type 1 diabetes, with blood pressure, HbA1c, waist and triglycerides predicting decline.

35667691.takeaway: Among 19 boys with gynecomastia, three prepubertal males had local aromatase overexpression, one with a CYP19A1 rearrangement consistent with aromatase excess syndrome and two with unusual promoter use.

35667704.takeaway: In 364 Thai schoolchildren, higher urinary phthalate concentrations were associated with greater total fat mass, independent of BMI, suggesting chemical exposure may affect adiposity.

35668996.takeaway: New regression algorithms for predicting adult height in 292 children with idiopathic short stature were more accurate in validation than the Bayley-Pinneau and Roche-Wainer-Thissen methods.

35669683.takeaway: In 125 Chinese boys with congenital hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, 25 CHH-related genes were identified in 77 tested patients, and oligogenic mutations were more common than in an earlier study.

35669686.takeaway: In 1,648 US adolescents, testosterone and estradiol were positively linked to bone mineral density in boys, with SHBG negatively linked; in girls, only estradiol showed a positive association.

35669689.takeaway: A systematic review of 27 studies found consistent links between maternal obesity and offspring congenital heart disease, adverse cardiometabolic traits and adult cardiovascular disease, though causality is uncertain.

35669693.takeaway: In 23 children with pituitary stalk thickening, diabetes insipidus was the most common presentation and germinoma the most common diagnosis, so germinoma should be suspected even without neurological signs.

35670320.takeaway: Two Moroccan brothers with 46,XY disorder of sex development had Leydig cell hypoplasia from a novel homozygous LHCGR deletion, and testosterone treatment increased penile length.

35670597.takeaway: In 2030 children with isolated GH deficiency, reversal rates fell as retest GH cut-offs rose; the authors suggest reevaluating guidelines and considering earlier retesting.

35670776.takeaway: Among 33,482 Israeli mother-offspring pairs, higher levels of gestational glucose intolerance were linked to more offspring overweight and obesity in late adolescence, even below the gestational diabetes threshold.

35671033.takeaway: In women with type 2 diabetes in pregnancy, metformin use and chronic hypertension or nephropathy predicted small-for-gestational-age infants; SGA was 25% with metformin plus comorbidity versus 9.8% without.

35671155.takeaway: In 136 children with delayed puberty in Sudan, permanent and functional hypogonadotropic hypogonadism were the most common causes, while constitutional delay accounted for 14.7%.

35671204.takeaway: In 35 patients with alkaptonuria, 11 genetic variants were found, six of them novel, and nitisinone-treated patients had 88.7% lower urinary homogentisic acid.

35671713.takeaway: In a mixed-methods study of girls with Turner syndrome, families valued counselling on ovarian tissue cryopreservation, which raised hopes but made decisions hard for clinicians to guide.

35673402.takeaway: Routine IGF-I data showed US upper reference limits 14% to 35% higher than European ones while lower limits matched, so the authors suggest US-adapted reference intervals.

35674212.takeaway: In 12 children with localized islet nuclear enlargement hyperinsulinism, low-level mosaic ABCC8 or GCK mutations were found, and partial pancreatectomy gave euglycemia in 75% of cases.

35677718.takeaway: In 334 children followed from age 2 to 4, those who stayed in the highest BMI z-score quartile had higher fasting glucose and insulin resistance at age 4 than children whose BMI changed less.

35677721.takeaway: In Brazilian and Canadian cohorts, children and adolescents born small for gestational age showed altered brain connectivity linked to food value and decision-making, and Brazilian SGA adolescents spent less on snacks.

35677722.takeaway: In 97 prepubertal children with obesity, lower circulating leptin z-scores were linked to more hepatic steatosis on ultrasound and higher triglycerides and insulin, suggesting a partial leptin-deficient subgroup.

35678724.takeaway: In 80 children aged 2 to 5.9 with type 1 diabetes, 13 weeks of tubeless automated insulin delivery caused no severe hypoglycemia or DKA and lowered HbA1c by 0.55%.

35678764.takeaway: In Swedish children admitted with DKA over two years, pump users were overrepresented (74.7% vs 59.7% of the national population), mainly in mild DKA, while MDI users had higher admission HbA1c.

35678773.takeaway: Among 277 Danish children with type 1 diabetes, metabolic syndrome was more prevalent than in population controls and appeared at lower BMI and waist measures, so early prevention was advised.

35679098.takeaway: In 83 youths with type 2 diabetes, once-weekly exenatide lowered HbA1c by 0.85% more than placebo at 24 weeks and was well tolerated.

35685214.takeaway: In a New York series of adolescent and young adult transmen, 57% of those who consulted pursued oocyte cryopreservation, which was safe with no significant adverse events.

35686573.takeaway: In 12 women followed from before pregnancy through late gestation, late-pregnancy glycerol turnover correlated with neonatal adiposity and accounted for about 40% of its variance.

35689450.takeaway: A novel heterozygous KLF11 variant (p.Pro349Ser) segregated with MODY7 in a Chinese family, and in vitro it impaired insulin promoter activity and insulin secretion.

35689452.takeaway: Virtual structured education on dynamic glucose management with CGM was as effective as face-to-face teaching for children with type 1 diabetes and cost less to deliver.

35689539.takeaway: Type 1 diabetes incidence in Dominican children under 15 averaged 4.3 per 100,000 from 2010 to 2019 with no significant trend and a female predominance, about eight times the 1995-1999 estimate.

35689793.takeaway: In 64 youths with obesity, sleeve gastrectomy increased sclerostin and bone turnover markers versus controls, and hip bone loss was linked to changes in body composition, sex steroids and ghrelin.

35691284.takeaway: Parents of children with differences of sex development need health literacy and psychosocial support to weigh nonsurgical options, since limiting irreversible childhood surgery widens later choices.

35692072.takeaway: In a case-control study of 30 girls with precocious puberty and 46 prepubertal controls, urinary bisphenol A and two phthalate metabolites were higher in girls with precocious puberty.

35692388.takeaway: Prophylactic stable iodine can protect the thyroid from radioactive iodine in nuclear emergencies, but its use should be precisely indicated and age-adjusted, because unneeded iodine can harm the thyroid.

35695284.takeaway: XGBoost models trained on CGM data from 153 people with type 1 diabetes predicted hypoglycemia and hyperglycemia up to 60 minutes ahead, with AUROCs of 0.998 and 0.989.

35695701.takeaway: This review of Turner syndrome notes increased morbidity and delayed diagnosis, and covers multidisciplinary care, recent clinical advances and the genomic and epigenomic mechanisms behind its features.

35696191.takeaway: In 386 pregnant women with type 1 diabetes, CGM metrics diverged by 10 weeks of gestation, with lower mean glucose and higher time in range in those who delivered normal-birth-weight infants.

35700323.takeaway: Among Polish children with new-onset type 1 diabetes, DKA at diagnosis rose from 37.5% before to 49.4% during the first COVID-19 pandemic year, with more moderate and severe cases.

35700327.takeaway: In 50 children with type 1 diabetes versus 50 healthy controls, P300 and cortical auditory evoked potential latencies were prolonged and correlated with HbA1c, suggesting possible cognitive changes.

35700440.takeaway: Across 19 studies, orthopedic surgery for X-linked hypophosphatemic rickets averaged one complication per procedure, and the treatment goal was missed in 28% of surgeries.

35700451.takeaway: Aldosterone was detected in second-trimester fetal adrenals from 20 intrauterine death cases without correlation to gestational age, and levels may reflect stress before death.

35702057.takeaway: In 209 TEDDY children with multiple islet autoantibodies, higher moderate-to-vigorous physical activity was linked to better OGTT glucose and C-peptide responses, mainly in children 5 years and older.

35702604.takeaway: In pediatric Cushing disease, possible subclinical pituitary hemorrhage on MRI (7.1% of studies) was linked to higher morning ACTH and poorer cortisol suppression on dexamethasone.

35704034.takeaway: In 98 healthy term girls followed through their first year, reproductive hormones showed two peaks, and the authors provide age-related reference ranges for female minipuberty.

35705059.takeaway: In 181 Indian adolescents with type 1 diabetes, the SEARCH insulin sensitivity equation best identified metabolic syndrome at a cut-off of 5.485 mg/kg/min and may help detect double diabetes.

35707462.takeaway: Across 10 trials of 539 adolescents with type 1 diabetes, adding metformin to insulin lowered HbA1c by 0.5% at 12 months and daily insulin dose, but increased hypoglycemia and gastrointestinal side effects.

35708509.takeaway: Maternal dietary glycemic index and load were linked to cord blood DNA methylation at 41 sites, mostly in mothers with overweight or obesity, with little overlap with known metabolic traits.

35712236.takeaway: In 3,017 rural Chinese adults, sleep duration showed sex-specific nonlinear links to BMI, with the lowest BMI at about 9 hours in women and the highest at about 7 hours in men.

35712242.takeaway: In placentas of obese women, vitamin D receptor expression was lower, and calcitriol improved mitochondrial respiration and reduced inflammatory IL-18, suggesting vitamin D deficiency contributes to placental dysfunction.

35712255.takeaway: A nonnucleoside DNMT inhibitor depleted DNMT1 and slowed Ewing sarcoma cell growth, and it increased the effect of doxorubicin and PARP inhibitors through DNA damage.

35712256.takeaway: This review explains how FSH and sex steroids regulate AMH in the testis from fetal life through puberty, and why serum AMH reflects intratesticular steroid levels.

35712259.takeaway: In 31 children aged 6 to 14 on pumps, time in target glucose range was similar with predictive low-glucose-suspend therapy and with intermittently scanned CGM, and most families continued CGM.

35713886.takeaway: A truncated intron-derived neuropilin-1 isoform marked islet cells lacking insulin, and its genetic marker was more common in type 1 diabetes onset before age 4 (31.8%) than at older ages (16.1%).

35716175.takeaway: Umbilical cord blood DNA methylation did not differ between 43 children who later developed islet autoimmunity or type 1 diabetes and 79 controls, so no perinatal signature was detected.

35718890.takeaway: In a teenage boy with hypothyroidism-induced dilated cardiomyopathy, levothyroxine alone failed, but adding liothyronine restored heart function, with full recovery after six months.

35718891.takeaway: In 9,984 Korean youths aged 10 to 18, cardiometabolic risk and metabolic syndrome rose with obesity class, with adjusted metabolic syndrome odds up to 950 by IDF criteria in class II/III obesity.

35721709.takeaway: Across 18 studies, sarcopenic obesity in children was defined inconsistently, with prevalence from 5.7% to 81.3%, and was linked to cardiometabolic outcomes, fatty liver and inflammation.

35721728.takeaway: The CHI-run HI Global Registry, begun in 2018, had 344 respondents from 37 countries by January 2022, mostly parents, providing patient-reported data on living with hyperinsulinism.

35721735.takeaway: In 30 pairs of gestational diabetes and control placentas, 256 differentially methylated sites were found, but placental methylation did not correlate with cord blood metabolic markers.

35721737.takeaway: Among 9,894 singleton births, ART for female-factor infertility was linked to higher preterm birth and large-for-gestational-age risk than natural conception, suggesting these pregnancies need close attention.

35721739.takeaway: Two children with germinoma had generalized anhidrosis that partly or fully resolved after chemotherapy and radiation; all four reported cases needed ongoing hormone replacement.

35721740.takeaway: Human ovarian cortex encapsulated in PEG hydrogel survived up to three months after implantation in mice, similarly to unencapsulated grafts, suggesting a route to replace ovarian endocrine function.

35721754.takeaway: Among 656,396 Chinese children aged 3 to 19, obesity prevalence was stable, but COVID-19 lockdown in 2020 caused a significant 1.86% rise, mainly among primary and junior middle school children.

35721755.takeaway: A term SGA infant with hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia, treated with diazoxide, developed gaze preference and then infantile spasms; the authors suggest gaze preference may be an early epileptic sign.

35721761.takeaway: Across 17 human studies, triclosan showed inconsistent associations with thyroid hormones and TSH, and limited study designs mean its effect at current exposure levels cannot yet be determined.

35721764.takeaway: In 205 adolescents aged 12 to 14, the negative correlation between leptin and 25(OH)D varied by sex, and body composition patterns changed at 30% and 40% body fat.

35724644.takeaway: In 51 children having total thyroidectomy, pre-operative calcitriol modestly raised early calcium levels but did not reduce hypocalcaemia or symptoms compared with controls.

35727029.takeaway: In 10,598 German children with new type 1 diabetes, DKA at diagnosis rose from 20.6% in the least deprived regions to 26.9% in the most deprived, and was more frequent in rural areas.

35727737.takeaway: In 201 children with osteogenesis imperfecta, zoledronic acid raised femoral neck density more with autosomal dominant inheritance, while collagen structural defects gave poorer responses and more fractures.

35733779.takeaway: After propensity matching, women with PCOS undergoing frozen embryo transfer had higher rates of gestational diabetes, pregnancy hypertension and stillbirth than matched women without PCOS.

35735778.takeaway: A Chinese boy with congenital hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, presenting with micropenis and low gonadotropins in infancy, had a novel compound heterozygous KISS1R variant.

35735786.takeaway: An 8-month-old boy with congenital generalized lipodystrophy had hyperphagia and metabolic complications that improved after one year of metreleptin, with lower insulin, HbA1c and triglycerides.

35750929.takeaway: This review examines covert actions of growth hormone on fibrosis, cardiovascular function and cancer, drawing on patients with acromegaly or GH deficiency and on cellular and animal studies.

35752872.takeaway: Among 395 youth with type 2 diabetes, household food insecurity was linked to about three times the odds of DKA, but not to HbA1c control or severe hypoglycemia.

35752873.takeaway: In interviews with 13 adolescents with type 1 diabetes and 13 mothers, families valued psychosocial screening and wanted mental health care built into routine diabetes care, with more peer support.

35752878.takeaway: The Diabetes-Specific Risk-Taking Inventory showed good reliability (alpha 0.89) and validity in 224 US adolescents with type 1 diabetes and may help screen for risky self-management.

35757411.takeaway: In 14 Algerian patients with 3βHSD2 deficiency, presentation was with salt-wasting or genital anomalies, later adrenal tumors and PCOS reflected under-replacement, and mortality was high.

35757415.takeaway: This review of levothyroxine formulations explains factors that affect thyroid hormone levels and absorption in congenital hypothyroidism, offering a practical guide to follow-up in the first three years.

35757424.takeaway: In 44 men with obesity, moderate and high-intensity interval resistance training improved myokines and cardiometabolic risk factors more than low-intensity training.

35757428.takeaway: This review describes organochlorine pesticides that accumulate in breast milk, their estrogen-like effects on lactation, and the risks to breastfed infants, along with control measures.

35757429.takeaway: This review explains that growth hormone stimulation tests remain essential for diagnosing GH deficiency despite their flaws, with results affected by test length, assay, cut-off and patient factors.

35757432.takeaway: In 32 prepubescent children aged 4 to 8, those with idiopathic short stature had less diverse gut microbiota and lower short-chain fatty acids, including butyrate, than controls of normal height.

35757434.takeaway: In female mice, deleting the hepatic androgen receptor did not prevent androgen-induced reproductive dysfunction, suggesting it is independent of the metabolic effects of androgen.

35757975.takeaway: A novel ABCC8 variant in a 13-year-old with familial diabetes was confirmed as MODY12, and laboratory work suggests it affects protein degradation pathways.

35758857.takeaway: Genetically higher maternal testosterone was associated with about 37 g lower offspring birth weight and a higher risk of preterm delivery in this Mendelian randomization analysis.
