35761794.takeaway: In 76 people with PTEN hamartoma tumor syndrome, most with normal initial thyroid ultrasounds stayed free of actionable nodules for years, supporting less frequent surveillance than annual scans.

35763323.takeaway: In 5,575 Control-IQ users on Medicare or Medicaid, time in range rose from 64% to 74% and from 46% to 60%, with improved glucose management indicators, including in type 2 diabetes.

35766976.takeaway: Among 2,378 youths with obesity, four glucose-response classes emerged; insulin sensitivity drove movement between lower and higher classes, while beta-cell glucose sensitivity drove shifts between the two worst classes.

35769076.takeaway: In 144 children in an inpatient obesity program, higher BMI predicted dropout and less weight loss, and pre-treatment leptin and adiponectin levels predicted weight regain after discharge.

35769079.takeaway: In 500 Chinese children aged 9 to 14, overweight was linked to lower bone turnover markers, but the decline appeared only in boys, and marker-BMI links varied by sex and puberty.

35769084.takeaway: In 92 children with GH deficiency, SGA or Turner syndrome treated with growth hormone, IGF1 promoter P2 methylation did not correlate with GH response, so it is not a major marker here.

35769088.takeaway: After six months of vitamin D supplementation in 67 overweight or obese children, CRP fell significantly, and IL-10 was positively associated with 25(OH)D.

35769089.takeaway: In Chinese adolescents, those with tumor-induced rickets/osteomalacia had lower bone density and weaker bone strength than XLH patients and controls, most markedly at the distal tibia.

35769090.takeaway: Among 275 children diagnosed before 18 with insulin-treated diabetes, 10.5% of autoantibody-negative cases carried novel monogenic variants in NEUROD1 or INS, showing that targeted sequencing aids diagnosis.

35770839.takeaway: A boy with autosomal dominant cutis laxa type 3 and growth hormone deficiency improved from -4.14 to -1.48 height SD on somatropin over 4.5 years, without side effects.

35770944.takeaway: In prepubertal female rats, propolis advanced vaginal opening by about 7.5 days and increased ovarian, endometrial and mammary changes, suggesting an oestrogen-like effect that warrants caution.

35770945.takeaway: In 36 children with MIS-C compared with 72 healthy children, free T3 was lower, and low fT3 was linked to intensive care needs and steroid treatment.

35770950.takeaway: Among 228 children with celiac disease, 8.8% also had autoimmune glandular disease, mostly type 1 diabetes, and older age at celiac diagnosis was the only predictor found.

35771001.takeaway: This commentary on a G7 CGM accuracy study in youths with type 1 diabetes notes consistently high accuracy but few measurements in children aged 2 to 6.

35771004.takeaway: Over six months, adults starting the open-source Loop system reported less diabetes distress, better sleep and less fear of hypoglycemia, with some improvements also seen in children's sleep and parents' fear.

35771027.takeaway: Interviews with 118 Brazilian insulin pump users identified 159 adverse events, mostly involving the electrical and mechanical system and user interface, which led to a taxonomy of device failures.

35771030.takeaway: In 34 children using the MiniMed 780G, basal insulin needs followed a diurnal pattern consistent with dawn and reverse dawn phenomena, and auto-correction boluses peaked in the late evening.

35771737.takeaway: Among 305 preschoolers in China's cold region, stunting was uncommon, but overweight and obesity were common, and vitamin D deficiency affected 88.85%.

35771776.takeaway: In young adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes, household food insecurity was linked to higher fear of hypoglycemia, but not in adolescents with type 1 diabetes, whose parents' worry scores still rose.

35771937.takeaway: Among 534 children with obesity, those with arterial hypertension had higher fasting insulin, HOMA-IR and post-load glucose than those without, suggesting hypertension flags metabolic complications.

35772388.takeaway: In 51 children with GH deficiency on at least 20 months of treatment, those with the largest height SDS gains had the greatest improvements in glucose, lipid and insulin resistance indices.

35774143.takeaway: In 25 children with Prader-Willi syndrome and 25 matched children with common obesity, irisin levels were lower and tracked with insulin measures, suggesting a link between irisin and insulin sensitivity.

35774144.takeaway: In 297 children of short stature, peak GH and IGF-1 SDS predicted muscle density and fat mass index, and chest CT was a credible way to assess body composition.

35775453.takeaway: A Markov model of young Australians with type 1 diabetes estimated hybrid closed-loop therapy at AUD 32,789 per QALY gained, cost-effective at the AUD 50,000 threshold in 93.3% of simulations.

35775692.takeaway: Seven unrelated patients shared a 5'-UTR POMC splice-site variant that reduced POMC mRNA, a founder mutation causing adrenal insufficiency with obesity and hypoglycemia.

35779008.takeaway: In 1,322 children followed from 2017 to 2020, higher prepubertal body fat was linked to earlier puberty in both sexes, while higher fat-free mass relative to fat mass was protective.

35780775.takeaway: An ESPE-endorsed position statement notes that population islet autoantibody screening in children reduced DKA in some studies, while screening accuracy and cost-effectiveness remain debated.

35781728.takeaway: In 345 children with 21-hydroxylase deficiency across 14 countries, 17OHP and androstenedione varied widely between centres, and hydrocortisone dose per body surface area fell as weight rose.

35784525.takeaway: Children with type 1 diabetes who started intermittently scanned CGM within a month of diagnosis had lower HbA1c in the first year, longer honeymoon periods and better quality of life.

35784539.takeaway: An 18-year-old girl with Camurati-Engelmann disease gained spine and hip bone mass and started puberty after 28 months of prednisone plus losartan.

35784540.takeaway: An adult man with X-linked late-onset adrenal hypoplasia congenita had a novel hemizygous NR0B1 frameshift variant, with hyponatremia, high ACTH, pubertal failure and hypogonadotropic hypogonadism.

35784550.takeaway: Across Italian pediatric centers, DKA at type 1 diabetes diagnosis rose from 35.7% in 2017-2019 to 39.6% in 2020, and severe DKA rose from 10.4% to 14.2%.

35784566.takeaway: Deaths and disability-adjusted life years from diabetes-related kidney disease in China rose from 1990 to 2019 in absolute terms, with type 2 diabetes causing 83% of deaths and males most affected.

35784568.takeaway: Obesity is increasingly common in children with type 1 diabetes, where it is linked to earlier onset, worse glycemic control, higher insulin demand and microvascular risk, and treatment is difficult.

35784570.takeaway: In 15 children with adrenal tumors initially mistaken for neuroblastoma, diagnosis depended on specialized pathology, and the authors stress avoiding biopsy and achieving complete surgical resection.

35784571.takeaway: Among 750 Chinese patients with primary hyperparathyroidism, presentations were milder in 2010-2019, and famine exposure, especially in adulthood, was linked to higher PTH and calcium levels.

35784573.takeaway: Fertility preservation for prepubertal boys is mostly experimental; testicular tissue grafting and stem cell transplantation are the main options, and in vitro spermatogenesis remains unproven.

35784581.takeaway: This systematic review found Asian women at the highest GDM risk of all populations, with progression to type 2 diabetes, and their children at higher risk of macrosomia, congenital anomalies and later adiposity.

35789807.takeaway: This narrative review covers dynamic tests for childhood hypoglycemia, including functional in vivo tests, CGM-based metabolic profiling and stable isotope techniques, to define specific causes such as glycogen storage disease.

35793998.takeaway: This review describes the classic and backdoor routes of androgen synthesis, which both appear necessary for normal male development, with androsterone the main backdoor androgen.

35793999.takeaway: This review covers five FGFR3-related skeletal dysplasias, their complications, early diagnosis and emerging therapies for children presenting with short stature.

35794000.takeaway: Across five randomized trials of 195 adolescents, active video games reduced BMI percentile and total cholesterol, although the included trials were few and small.

35795139.takeaway: Among 780 women with gestational diabetes, the 24% without standard risk factors still had high rates of treatment need and glucose intolerance, and more risk factors meant worse postpartum metabolic outcomes.

35796289.takeaway: A child with Fanconi-Bickel syndrome developed multi-sutural craniosynostosis with raised intracranial pressure, and cranial vault expansion resolved his feeding intolerance.

35797970.takeaway: SLIT2 rare variants were found in 6.6% of 196 patients with idiopathic hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, with a burden odds ratio of 2.2, suggesting SLIT2 as a new associated gene.

35798296.takeaway: Two siblings with the same variant had different phenotypes of Seckel syndrome 5; the younger had a hypothalamic hamartoma with central precocious puberty and later a slipped capital femoral epiphysis.

35798297.takeaway: In 323 girls with breast budding before age 8, overweight girls reached central puberty before 9 less often than non-overweight girls (65% vs 84%), and advanced bone age predicted faster progression.

35798299.takeaway: In 33 patients with childhood-onset craniopharyngioma, more extensive hypothalamic involvement and longer time off growth hormone were linked to lower HDL cholesterol at adult GH retesting.

35798300.takeaway: In 24 children with GH deficiency after leukemia treatment, one year of GH raised height SDS by 0.35 versus a fall of 0.21 without GH, and treatment appeared safe.

35798302.takeaway: In 98 pediatric thyroid cancer patients, 43.9% developed hypoparathyroidism after total thyroidectomy, and about a third needed active vitamin D for over two years, predicted by young age and low preoperative calcium.

35798303.takeaway: In 117 children with secondary osteoporosis after treatment for blood, rheumatologic or bowel disease, higher cumulative glucocorticoid dose lowered lumbar spine BMD, and glucocorticoid accumulation was a risk factor for vertebral fracture.

35798304.takeaway: A 13-year-old with neurofibromatosis type 1 had a dopamine-secreting pheochromocytoma that was metanephrine-negative, found on imaging and confirmed at resection.

35798305.takeaway: Among late-preterm infants, delayed TSH elevation occurred in 15.7% of 70 SGA infants versus 3.5% of matched controls, supporting a second thyroid screen around one month for SGA infants.

35798306.takeaway: Among 109,282 Korean adolescents, overweight and obesity rose during COVID-19, especially in boys under 15, alongside less exercise, fruit intake and sleep, and more sitting time.

35798307.takeaway: In 1,247 Korean children and adolescents, higher hsCRP was associated with metabolic syndrome (OR 7.34 in the top quartile) and prediabetes (OR 2.70), mainly through abdominal obesity and low HDL.

35801942.takeaway: In a 23-day-old boy with consumptive hypothyroidism from infantile hepatic hemangioma, reverse T3 tracked tumor shrinkage, and liothyronine given in three divided daily doses stabilized thyroid function.

35801948.takeaway: Sequencing 154 children with early-onset severe obesity found variants in 12.3%, with MC4R variants the most common genetic cause, and c.496G>A the most frequent pathogenic change.

35803296.takeaway: Screening children for islet autoantibodies at ages 2 and 6 years gave 82% sensitivity and 79% positive predictive value for type 1 diabetes by age 15, supporting efficient public health screening.

35813621.takeaway: In 721 Chinese overweight or obese adults, equations using age, waist and neck circumference predicted visceral fat area well in a validation cohort, offering a simple screening tool.

35813624.takeaway: Among 108 youths with prediabetes, those with at most one nutrition visit a year had a hazard ratio of 3.88 for progressing to type 2 diabetes versus adherent youths.

35813630.takeaway: In prepubertal children with isolated idiopathic GH deficiency, three serum microRNAs rose after 3 months of GH and improved prediction of 12-month growth response beyond standard clinical measures.

35813638.takeaway: This literature review finds little data on Ramadan fasting in pregnant women with diabetes, so current advice is against fasting, and larger studies recording fasting status are needed.

35813640.takeaway: A chart review found 21 young adults with Klinefelter syndrome with gaps in care, and a mobile transition passport built for them was rated usable and highly actionable by 35 support-group members.

35813646.takeaway: Four infants with Mitchell-Riley syndrome and RFX6 mutations survived beyond two years with multidisciplinary care, and their RFX6 variants failed to activate insulin and calcium channel genes.

35813653.takeaway: Across seven cohort studies, treated maternal hyperthyroidism in pregnancy carried higher risks of preeclampsia, low birth weight, miscarriage and preterm birth than euthyroid pregnancy, though residual risk remains.

35813655.takeaway: Oocytes with agar-like zona pellucida had poorer fertilization and embryo development than controls, but ICSI produced healthy births, making it the preferred treatment in this series.

35813659.takeaway: This review links energy-dense maternal diets and obesity to higher insulin and IGF-1 levels, and notes altered IGF axis markers in gestational diabetes that may affect fetal growth.

35813663.takeaway: Maternal and cord blood Slit-2 was higher in 61 women with gestational diabetes than in 57 healthy pregnant women and tracked insulin resistance and neonatal weight, suggesting a possible biomarker.

35817008.takeaway: A female infant with antenatally diagnosed KCNJ11 neonatal diabetes started glibenclamide on day 2 of life, stabilized within 24 hours, and at 12 months had good development.

35821595.takeaway: This centennial review of 68 pediatric diabetes milestones from 1921 to 2021 traces how insulin, CGM and advocacy changed type 1 diabetes from a terminal illness, while access disparities persist.

35822348.takeaway: In youth with type 1 diabetes, higher physical activity on active days was associated with lower mean glucose and time above range and more time in range, without more hypoglycemia.

35822552.takeaway: From 2001 to 2020, inadequate iodine intake rose among US school-age children (15.4% to 27.6%) and adults, as urinary iodine fell, with milk consumption linked to adequate intake.

35822653.takeaway: In a German-Austrian registry of 93 people with ABCC8 or KCNJ11 variants, most switched from insulin to sulfonylurea and kept good glucose control for up to 11 years.

35822703.takeaway: In 56 children with central diabetes insipidus, organic causes were common, and one germinoma appeared a year after a normal MRI, so repeated cranial imaging matters.

35822708.takeaway: In 100 children with obesity, pubertal children had lower vitamin B12 and folate and higher homocysteine, and carotid intima-media thickness correlated with waist circumference and HOMA-IR.

35822709.takeaway: A 17-year-old Vietnamese girl with an LMNA p.G465D variant had severe fat loss in the limbs and buttocks, with insulin resistance and lipid problems that were hard to control over two years.

35822711.takeaway: Among 20 children with isolated GH deficiency compared with matched controls, waist-hip ratio, cholesterol, homocysteine and CRP were higher, while left ventricular mass was lower.

35822712.takeaway: In 56 adolescents with obesity, visceral fat area was independently associated with insulin measures, 1-hour glucose and inflammation, while subcutaneous fat was not associated with glycemia.

35822720.takeaway: Three children with Prader-Willi syndrome had severe symptomatic hyponatremia with convulsions in infancy, which resolved with fluids and fluid restriction, with no sequelae.

35822721.takeaway: In 1,562 Brazilian children and adolescents, cesarean delivery, pregnancy complications and birth weight were linked to offspring BMI, and breastfeeding was associated with lower BMI only where maternal BMI was high.

35830276.takeaway: In 81 adults with Langerhans cell histiocytosis and GH deficiency, one year of GH improved quality of life and cholesterol without new safety signals.

35832426.takeaway: In 142 children with type 1 diabetes, hypoglycemia often recovered into hyperglycemia; younger, leaner children had more frequent episodes, while teens and obese children had longer ones.

35832434.takeaway: In 99 Polish infants with congenital hypothyroidism, overtreatment affected about one in five children at 12 months and one in four at 3 years, and the authors suggest re-evaluating the diagnosis.

35833793.takeaway: Across 97 cases of ectopic Cushing syndrome from medullary thyroid cancer, most had metastatic disease at diagnosis, bilateral adrenalectomy was often needed, and prognosis was generally poor.

35837312.takeaway: Teprotumumab is not established for thyroid eye disease in children, and juvenile-animal toxicity and hearing risk argue against using it empirically in pediatric patients.

35837314.takeaway: This review covers kisspeptin signaling and KNDy neurons in regulating GnRH and the HPG axis, its role in puberty onset and reproduction, and how KISS1 disorders cause hypogonadism and precocious puberty.

35838140.takeaway: Compared with matched peers and with children who have type 1 diabetes, 528 children with type 2 diabetes had higher rates of mood and anxiety disorders, suicide attempts and antipsychotic prescriptions.

35844096.takeaway: Two children with diabetic ketoacidosis presented with alkalemia rather than acidosis, showing that a normal or alkalotic pH does not exclude DKA.

35846277.takeaway: This mini-review summarizes iodine requirements from fetal life through adolescence based on current guidelines, highlighting adolescents and pregnant women as vulnerable to deficiency.

35846278.takeaway: In a mouse model, IL-1 receptor antagonist reduced placental inflammation from group B streptococcus infection and alleviated fetal inflammation and offspring neurobehavioral impairment.

35846284.takeaway: Across 12 studies, two consecutive single embryo transfers gave a live birth rate similar to one double embryo transfer, with far fewer multiple births and better neonatal outcomes.

35846287.takeaway: In 5,527 Beijing schoolgirls, machine learning identified six parent and child factors, including maternal age at menarche and paternal BMI, that predicted precocious puberty with an AUROC of 0.79.

35846292.takeaway: In 5,583 US children aged 8 to 19, higher blood lead was linked to lower bone mineral density at several sites, even within the reference range, with stronger effects at the spine in girls.

35846295.takeaway: Among 49 Chinese children up to age 14 who underwent ovarian tissue cryopreservation, prior chemotherapy lowered AMH but not follicle counts, and the procedure was judged safe.

35846298.takeaway: An eight-month analysis of 399 tweets on oncofertility found discussion mostly among medical professionals, with only 4.5% aimed at children and no patient accounts.

35846300.takeaway: In 120 young adults with kidney or ureteral stones, subcutaneous fat accumulation was independently linked to stone occurrence and recurrence, more strongly than visceral fat.

35846310.takeaway: In 2,603 mother-child pairs, maternal gestational metabolic risks raised child BMI z-scores and obesity risk in both sexes, and polygenic risk interacted with these risks among girls.

35846331.takeaway: In medaka fish, rearing densities above 5 fish per litre reduced growth and mineralization and increased fin and vertebral anomalies, so rearing conditions must be considered in skeletal studies.

35846334.takeaway: Across 61 reported patients with MODY5 (HNF1B), diabetes often began before age 25 with low or normal BMI, renal cysts, hypomagnesemia and pancreatic dysplasia, which the authors suggest should prompt genetic testing.

35846336.takeaway: This retrospective account describes digital health devices and tools supporting growth hormone therapy in children across some 40 countries, and their evolution toward adherence prediction.

35846339.takeaway: In 793 TPO-antibody-negative mother-infant pairs, maternal subclinical hypothyroidism was associated with lower receptive communication scores at one year, and high TSH with lower gross motor scores.

35846340.takeaway: In 88 preterm infants, a high maternal sFlt-1/PlGF ratio did not predict motor outcome, but low birth weight, which correlated with the ratio, was linked to lower motor scores.

35848593.takeaway: A novel homozygous CYP11B2 variant caused severe aldosterone deficiency in a neonate, while his asymptomatic father, also homozygous, had subclinical enzyme impairment.

35848959.takeaway: A novel NR0B1 non-stop variant in two brothers caused adrenal hypoplasia congenita with an unusual course; the proband had neonatal growth failure and mild salt loss without raised ACTH.

35850931.takeaway: Two novel compound heterozygous ACAT1 variants were identified in a 9-month-old boy with beta-ketothiolase deficiency, who presented with acidosis and respiratory failure.

35850934.takeaway: Across 10 studies in children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, vitamin D supplementation improved HbA1c in only half, and the overall evidence is inconsistent.

35852811.takeaway: In 50 well-controlled children and adolescents switched to advanced hybrid closed loop, time in 70-140 mg/dL rose from 54% to 62% within two weeks, with larger gains at night.

35856740.takeaway: From 2010 to 2018, HbA1c stayed stable in German/Austrian DPV, fell in England and Wales NPDA and rose in US T1DX, while pump and CGM use rose in all three.

35856852.takeaway: In youth with diabetes followed to 2020, cardiovascular autonomic neuropathy was more common in type 2 than type 1 diabetes (47% vs 27%), and higher BMI and obesity were linked to it.

35857714.takeaway: A 21-year-old woman with congenital generalized lipodystrophy type 1 had face-sparing fat, early pubarche and nonclassical CAH, with metreleptin improving diabetes and triglycerides but not menstrual irregularity.

35859537.takeaway: In 24 children with Noonan syndrome followed for years, growth hormone did not change echocardiographic wall thickness or other cardiac measures, suggesting it is safe with close follow-up.

35859690.takeaway: In 98 children with obesity and 44 controls, BMD z-scores were higher in obesity and tended to rise with more metabolic risk factors, but serum FGF21 did not relate to BMD.

35859814.takeaway: In 120 term newborns, cord blood spexin and leptin were lowest in SGA infants and correlated with birth weight, length and head circumference.

35860376.takeaway: Thyroid screening of 509 neonates born before 31 weeks detected dysfunction in 33%, most resolving spontaneously, and only three had permanent congenital hypothyroidism at three years.

35860703.takeaway: Among 145 children in an obesity clinic, the pandemic did not change dropout rates but reduced weight loss and physical activity and increased screen time, lowering counseling effectiveness.

35860754.takeaway: This review argues that X-linked hypophosphatemia affects the whole body, life and family across adulthood, and calls for clinician education, multidisciplinary care and open communication.

35860974.takeaway: A 14-year-old with severe head trauma presented with refractory seizures from hypoglycemia, revealing post-traumatic hypopituitarism, and the authors propose a pituitary screening protocol for children with brain injury.

35861593.takeaway: In 1,853 Amsterdam pairs, maternal lipids at 13 weeks were largely unlinked to offspring adiposity at age 11-12; only triglycerides remained associated with waist-to-height ratio.

35862057.takeaway: A high-risk BMI growth trajectory by age 1 predicted overweight at age 7 (OR 6.5), and a model using birth metabolites, sex, birth weight and maternal BMI identified these children with an AUC of 0.87.

35865310.takeaway: In 6,143 US adolescents aged 8 to 19, BMI and bone mineral density were positively associated but reached a saturation point beyond which higher BMI added little bone gain.

35865311.takeaway: An infant treated with high-dose rapamycin before resection of an atypical choroid plexus papilloma developed dose-related hyperglycemia, controlled by adjusting the dose and adding insulin.

35867130.takeaway: Enterovirus RNA was detected more often in blood cells of people with islet autoimmunity and in carriers of the IFIH1 predisposing allele, supporting a role for enterovirus before type 1 diabetes onset.

35869788.takeaway: In a feasibility study of 35 adolescent girls with type 1 diabetes, an internet-based eating disorder prevention program was acceptable and feasible, with large effects on dieting, body dissatisfaction and diabetes distress.

35871517.takeaway: Among 114 children operated on for indeterminate thyroid cytology, malignancy rose with Bethesda category (23% to 100%), and molecular profiling helped separate benign from malignant nodules.

35872603.takeaway: Surveys of 234 former ISPAD science school attendees found perceived benefits for careers, research skills and networking, with 82% of physician participants reporting career support.

35872984.takeaway: This review explains that congenital hyperinsulinism is genetically heterogeneous, with over 30 genes, and that next-generation sequencing has changed diagnosis, though no single method detects all variant types.

35873001.takeaway: Overweight children had more circulating Th17 cells than normal-weight peers, and those who lost weight over three months showed a significant fall in these cells along with lower cholesterol.

35876145.takeaway: In 36 adults without diabetes on fixed meal times, mean premeal glucose was 92.8 mg/dL and mean postmeal peak 143.3 mg/dL, offering reference profiles for diabetes targets.

35876300.takeaway: Women with gestational diabetes had higher term serum ANGPTL6, and cord ANGPTL6 was raised in GDM neonates, while cord levels tracked neonatal fat mass only in normal pregnancies.

35876426.takeaway: Among 50 adults with small lymph node metastases from papillary thyroid cancer managed by surveillance, 24% grew over 29 months, and a thyroglobulin rise of 0.5 ng/mL or more predicted growth.

35876454.takeaway: Among 58 under-21s hospitalized with COVID-19 and diabetes in summer 2021, 88% of those with type 1 diabetes had DKA, 93% of eligible older patients were unvaccinated, and 46% to 59% needed ICU care.

35880797.takeaway: In Scotland, a SARS-CoV-2 positive test in the prior 30 days was linked to a 2.6-fold higher rate of type 1 diabetes, but earlier infection was not, suggesting infection itself did not drive the rise.

35880808.takeaway: In HAPO data, IADPSG criteria diagnosed more gestational diabetes than NICE criteria and predicted adverse outcomes better among Hispanic and Asian women, while performing comparably in White women.

35881919.takeaway: In 112 girls with central precocious puberty, brain MRI was normal in 42%, and significant intracranial lesions were uncommon after age 6 even without neurological signs.

35882216.takeaway: In 18 people exposed to first-trimester dexamethasone for CAH risk, resting-state brain connectivity at 16 to 26 years did not differ from 38 controls.

35894854.takeaway: An 8-year-old boy with biallelic QRSL1 variants had primary adrenal insufficiency from isolated glucocorticoid deficiency, with mitochondrial oxidative damage and the longest survival reported for this disorder.

35896083.takeaway: In 13 girls with suspected central precocious puberty, a GnRH analogue injection did not change ghrelin levels, but a protease inhibitor in sampling tubes preserved acylated ghrelin.

35898446.takeaway: CD163 was higher in 73 prepubertal children with obesity than in 47 lean controls, and after two years of diet and exercise, children who lost weight had higher TWEAK levels.

35898454.takeaway: Among 292 children with severe obesity, resting energy expenditure varied widely, decreased in 21% and elevated in 24%, and was lower in those with hypothalamic obesity.

35898458.takeaway: In US adults, a higher METS-IR index, a marker of insulin resistance, was associated with higher asthma prevalence and earlier asthma onset, although causality cannot be shown.

35900310.takeaway: Among 109 patients with cranial diabetes insipidus, hyponatraemia occurred in 44% of hospital admissions, and 53% of those admitted felt their team poorly understood CDI management.

35900314.takeaway: Early prepubertal germ cell neoplasia, including gonadoblastoma, dysgerminoma or undifferentiated gonadal tissue, was found in a cohort of 16 patients with 46,XX testicular or ovotesticular DSD.

35900321.takeaway: In a Danish register cohort of 2,671 transgender people, cardiovascular diagnoses were more frequent than in matched controls, most markedly in those assigned female at birth, partly explained by hormone treatment.

35900783.takeaway: A UK consensus guideline for children up to age 19 with differentiated thyroid carcinoma sets out 58 recommendations covering diagnosis, surgery, medical treatment, genetic counselling and follow-up.

35902207.takeaway: Reference values for pappalysins and stanniocalcins in 1,071 healthy people aged 1 to 30 and in newborns show these IGF regulators fall through childhood, with PAPP-A2 tracking free IGF-I.

35902734.takeaway: This review explains that monogenic obesity, often beginning in early childhood with hyperphagia, now has targeted melanocortin pathway treatments, so genetic testing is recommended for rapid infant weight gain.

35903274.takeaway: Pediatric pheochromocytomas and paragangliomas are more often genetic, extra-adrenal, multifocal or metastatic, and SDHB and SDHA variants carry the highest metastatic risk, so early genetic testing is advised.

35903281.takeaway: This review traces how enzyme therapy, newborn screening, antibiotics and CFTR modulators have changed nutrition, growth and puberty in children with cystic fibrosis over nine decades.

35908538.takeaway: In 991 short children undergoing GH stimulation tests, peak GH was lower with higher BMI-SDS regardless of test type, so weight status should inform interpretation but not decide treatment alone.

35909512.takeaway: Weekly PEGylated growth hormone caused dose-dependent, partly reversible vacuolation in monkey choroid plexus, and clinical data from about 3,360 children showed no excess adverse events versus daily GH.

35909515.takeaway: Among 2,222 full-term SGA infants in Japan, the highest maternal total cholesterol in mid-pregnancy was linked to about three times the odds of no catch-up growth at age 3.

35909526.takeaway: Among 1,486 matched patients who conceived after a first IUI cycle, those with secondary infertility had higher live birth rates overall, with the difference emerging after about 316 days of follow-up.

35909533.takeaway: This review proposes that prenatal pollutant exposure can disrupt hypothalamic development and metabolic programming, a possible route to later type 2 diabetes risk.

35909535.takeaway: This review explains how osteocytes regulate phosphate and bone mass through FGF23, sclerostin and RANKL, and how PHEX and DMP1 act as local brakes on FGF23 production.

35909539.takeaway: Children with short stature had lower ACE2 expression in blood mononuclear cells than controls, and ACE2 expression had moderate accuracy (AUC 0.73) for identifying short stature.

35909552.takeaway: Among 15,464 Japanese adults with normal glucose, higher baseline TyG-BMI predicted incident type 2 diabetes over 13 years, with the strongest associations in people aged 18 to 44 and in women.

35909557.takeaway: A boy with familial male-limited precocious puberty from an LHCGR variant approached adult height after long-term letrozole, triptorelin and spironolactone, with a predicted adult height near the target.

35909559.takeaway: A survey of 32 Italian centers treating childhood brain tumor survivors found disagreement between endocrinologists and oncologists on risk factors, diagnosis and when to start or stop growth hormone.

35909565.takeaway: In human fetal testis cultures, cisplatin reduced germ cells in mid and late second-trimester tissue after 240 hours but not in early tissue, defining a window of sensitivity relevant to fertility preservation.

35909572.takeaway: In 34 young children, plasma neudesin was higher in those with obesity or overweight than in normal-weight controls and correlated with blood glucose and glucose area under the curve.

35913075.takeaway: In a Swedish population cohort, childhood-onset type 1 diabetes was linked to higher risks of depression, anxiety and stress-related disorders, and relatives also had elevated risks, suggesting shared familial factors.

35917830.takeaway: Among 58 pregnancies complicated by DKA, mostly in type 1 diabetes, fetal loss occurred in 17%, and infants had high rates of neonatal hypoglycemia and ICU admission.

35918792.takeaway: A child with severe systemic pseudohypoaldosteronism type 1 was followed for ten years after genetic findings were identified, with a review of comparable pediatric cases.

35918802.takeaway: In 301 girls followed from age 7 to 13, higher DHEAS at age 7 was linked to more advanced puberty between ages 10 and 13 and earlier menarche, an association not seen in boys.

35920111.takeaway: In a birth cohort of 2,455 mother-child pairs, maternal TPO antibody positivity in pregnancy was linked to autism spectrum problems in boys, and third-trimester TPO antibodies to depressive problems in girls.

35920656.takeaway: In 12 British children with familial partial lipodystrophy type 2, diabetes, liver steatosis and cardiomyopathy developed mainly after age 10; the authors suggest formal screening before age 10 may not help.

35920822.takeaway: Pooled data from 485 people with diabetes showed CGM metrics improved within one to two weeks of starting unblinded use, so a 7-to-14-day run-in is enough before baseline in trials.

35923617.takeaway: Two pedigrees with type I hyperlipoproteinemia carried novel compound heterozygous LPL variants that reduced postheparin lipoprotein lipase activity by 55% to 72%.

35923618.takeaway: Gestational weight gain patterns were linked to venous thromboembolism differently by pre-pregnancy BMI and timing, with higher total gain tied to pulmonary embolism in underweight women.

35928891.takeaway: Interviews with nine families using CGM for congenital hyperinsulinism found it revealed more hypoglycemia than fingerpricks and prompted routine changes, though alarms and low-glucose accuracy were criticized.

35928892.takeaway: A 13-year-old with type 1 diabetes developed non-occlusive mesenteric ischemia after DKA had resolved, with persistent abdominal pain diagnosed at surgery, so clinicians should consider it in similar cases.

35928900.takeaway: In 301 people with new-onset type 1 diabetes, a partial remission definition using glycated albumin and insulin dose (IDAGA of 40 or less) fit all age groups, while stimulated C-peptide cut-offs varied by age.

35930274.takeaway: This review covers congenital and acquired causes of central precocious puberty, from hypothalamic hamartoma to MKRN3 and DLK1 mutations, and how genetic and epigenetic factors may guide diagnosis and treatment.

35931097.takeaway: In Ontario, the 50 g glucose challenge test predicted gestational diabetes differently in twin and singleton pregnancies, and large-for-gestational-age risk was lower in twins at the same result.

35932277.takeaway: This review summarizes pharmacotherapy for pediatric obesity in the United States, including drugs approved for children, medications for monogenic obesity, and off-label options before bariatric surgery.

35932482.takeaway: A mother and daughter with Kallmann syndrome shared a novel FGFR1 mutation, and the daughter also had syndactyly and oligodactyly of the feet, suggesting bone malformations should prompt FGFR1 testing.

35933324.takeaway: Across 46 randomized trials of 2,599 children with overweight or obesity, exercise reduced body weight by 1.46 kg and BMI by 1.09, with weight loss rising about 0.15 kg per MET-hour per week.

35935072.takeaway: Using three clinical vignettes, this article outlines investigation and management of girls with delayed puberty and high gonadotropins, including Turner syndrome, primary ovarian insufficiency and 46,XY DSD.

35937789.takeaway: This review explains that energy deficit can cause functional hypothalamic amenorrhea, with hypoestrogenism impairing peak bone mass and cognition, and recommends early recognition with multidisciplinary care.

35937791.takeaway: Among 17 gender-dysphoric adolescents assigned female at birth, 17 cisgender girls and 15 cisgender boys, brain network connectivity differed across groups, with the gender-dysphoric teens more similar to girls than boys.

35937794.takeaway: In 13,143 Chinese children followed from 2006 to 2016, earlier, less intense and shorter pubertal height spurts were linked to shorter final height and higher risk of overweight or obesity at age 18.

35937808.takeaway: In Japanese eel, neurokinin B and its receptor shaped gonadotropin and GnRH expression, and a receptor mutation shortened the protein, suggesting this system regulates eel puberty onset.

35937831.takeaway: Among 69 adults with 17-hydroxylase deficiency, glucose intolerance was common and was associated with high progesterone levels and hypokalemia, supporting routine glucose monitoring.

35937846.takeaway: In 584 Chinese children aged 6 to 11, gains in skeletal muscle mass predicted greater annual height gain, while fat mass gain was linked to less height gain.

35941818.takeaway: In 33 adolescents with classic 21-hydroxylase deficiency, a higher baseline CTX bone turnover marker predicted greater lumbar bone density gain, while higher glucocorticoid doses and prednisolone reduced it.

35942587.takeaway: A novel FBN1 missense variant caused a mild acromicric dysplasia phenotype in six members of a three-generation family, and growth hormone therapy was given to one affected child.

35942594.takeaway: A 3-month-old ex-preterm girl had breast enlargement, vaginal bleeding and an ovarian cyst from exaggerated mini-puberty, which regressed without treatment.

35942610.takeaway: In 244 girls with early breast development, high prolactin was less common in those with central precocious puberty (8.1% vs 17.6%), and high prolactin was linked to lower odds of CPP.

35943878.takeaway: In 49 children with thyroid nodules, robotic bilateral axillo-breast thyroidectomy matched open surgery for oncologic and hypoparathyroidism outcomes, with shorter stays and better cosmetic scores.

35944264.takeaway: In children with type 1 diabetes treated for DKA, those with COVID-19 had median tissue glucose disposal 46% lower than those without, suggesting the virus adds metabolic derangement beyond usual DKA factors.

35945152.takeaway: In 4,172 transgender and gender-diverse youth matched to 16,648 controls, overweight or obesity was more common, and testosterone use was linked to higher odds of dyslipidemia and liver dysfunction.

35946076.takeaway: In a nationwide German cohort of 4,118 adolescents followed for six years, subclinical hypothyroidism and TSH or free T4 quartiles were not associated with incident major depressive disorder.

35946480.takeaway: A child with pseudohypoaldosteronism type 1 due to an ELAC2 mutation had hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, hypertension and thrombocytosis, which improved on corticosteroids and salt replacement over five years.

35947079.takeaway: CGM use rose each year from 2017 to 2020 among youth with type 1 diabetes in both the German/Austrian DPV and US T1DX registries, with lower HbA1c in CGM users in every year.

35947635.takeaway: In 47 survivors of pediatric thyroid cancer followed for five years, diastolic function declined significantly, more than expected with normal aging, with age and BMI linked to the decline.

35948357.takeaway: Among 555 youths with type 1 diabetes using CGM, visit frequency rose during the first pandemic year, mostly virtually, and GMI improved slightly, especially in those with equal or more visits.

35950619.takeaway: In 385 children with thyroid nodules, autoimmune thyroiditis was independently associated with about twice the odds of thyroid cancer, mainly papillary cancer with the diffuse sclerosing variant.

35952631.takeaway: Low-level mosaic GLUD1 mutations, at 2.7% to 10.4% in blood and up to 28.9% in pancreas, explained hyperinsulinism-hyperammonemia syndrome in three children with negative blood genetic testing.

35952717.takeaway: A 7-year-old girl with nephrocalcinosis and high PTH looked like primary hyperparathyroidism but had Bartter syndrome type 2 from a homozygous KCNJ1 variant, so KCNJ1 should be tested.

35953302.takeaway: In 53 patients with Turner syndrome, microarray found copy number variations in 22% of 36 tested, helping explain unexpected findings, and FSH levels varied with karyotype.

35957817.takeaway: In blue crabs, estradiol and steroidogenic genes were found in female reproductive tissues, and knocking down the female sex hormone lowered estradiol, suggesting a steroid route for crustacean hormone action.

35957818.takeaway: In 418 women with gestational diabetes in Switzerland, the pandemic was not associated with clinically relevant worsening of cardiometabolic, mental health or neonatal outcomes, possibly thanks to continued hybrid follow-up.

35957820.takeaway: In 193,461 Chinese pregnancies, higher gestational PM2.5 and higher pre-pregnancy BMI were each linked to greater birthweight, with a negative interaction between the two.

35957826.takeaway: This review explains that plasma or urinary metanephrines, with methoxytyramine, are the most accurate tests for pediatric pheochromocytoma and paraganglioma, while neuroblastoma testing remains less accurate, with pediatric reference ranges a key challenge.

35960318.takeaway: In 22 children with CAH, salivary 17-hydroxyprogesterone levels did not distinguish normal from abnormal growth or prepubertal from pubertal status, so relying on it alone is not advised.

35961299.takeaway: Salivary cortisol and cortisone were stable for 72 hours at room temperature and 4 degrees C across three collection methods, and a pacifier-encased swab was well tolerated in young children.

35965384.takeaway: In 507 boys followed through puberty, SHBG and total testosterone were unrelated or negatively related at younger ages but positively related by ages 15 and 17, and Mendelian randomization suggested SHBG influences testosterone.

35966066.takeaway: Parents of youths with type 1 diabetes reported more fear of hypoglycemia and lower diabetes-specific quality of life than the children, especially parents of younger children.

35966067.takeaway: Among 523 German children who had adrenal surgery in 2009-2017, the overall complication rate was 27%, and cases were concentrated in a few high-volume hospitals.

35966072.takeaway: Serum proteomics and metabolomics in girls with central precocious puberty found 134 altered proteins and 103 altered metabolites, with phosphocholine (16:1/16:1) suggested as a possible biomarker.

35966074.takeaway: In a randomized trial in women with gestational diabetes, a higher complex-carbohydrate diet increased maternal bifidobacteria and gave infants more diverse gut microbiomes over four months.

35970147.takeaway: In 153 people with Turner syndrome, FISH on lymphocytes gave higher 45,X fractions than classical karyotyping, but cell-line fractions did not predict phenotype, and epithelial-cell FISH was a less invasive alternative.

35971681.takeaway: In 20 children and adolescents aged 2 to 18, smartphone-based automated insulin delivery was safe and feasible across three age cohorts, with time in range similar to sensor-augmented pump therapy.

35972261.takeaway: State-led payment reforms did not measurably change diagnosed diabetes prevalence or hospitalization among adults, and 30-day readmissions rose in reform states, suggesting unintended effects.

35972993.takeaway: In 98 Swedish boys born preterm, low-birth-weight boys had higher androgen levels at birth and in early infancy, and catch-up weight gain correlated with testosterone.

35973409.takeaway: Pooling 58 studies across 31 countries, classic CAH incidence was about 1 in 9,500 births, highest in Eastern Mediterranean and Southeast Asian countries and lowest in the Western Pacific.

35975939.takeaway: Markov modeling of 2,063 youths with type 1 diabetes supports less frequent retinopathy screening for those without retinopathy and short duration, since higher HbA1c speeds progression.

35976132.takeaway: In 1,191 North Macedonian children, socioeconomic status did not predict the iodine content of household salt, suggesting universal salt iodization helps reduce iodine inequality.

35978390.takeaway: A 3D imaging method measured breast volume change in 29 people undergoing estradiol-induced puberty with excellent reproducibility (ICC 0.99), offering a quantitative tool when no prior breast contours exist.

35978545.takeaway: Among 40 children with hypothalamic dysfunction, intracranial tumours were the leading cause, and 95% had metabolic disease, with higher lipids, uric acid and liver enzymes than matched controls.

35979433.takeaway: This review of adults with congenital adrenal hyperplasia highlights higher metabolic syndrome and cardiovascular risk, linked to hormone levels and glucocorticoid regimens, where under- and overtreatment may both harm.

35979442.takeaway: A five-year-old boy with arthralgia and genu valgum was found to have scurvy, with metaphyseal changes that mimicked rickets, attributed to malnutrition.

35981346.takeaway: This review sets out how to evaluate hypophosphatemic rickets, including serum phosphorus checks, FGF23 physiology, genetic testing, and treatment with active vitamin D and phosphate or burosumab for X-linked hypophosphatemia.

35982508.takeaway: In Czech children under 15, 956 new type 1 diabetes cases in 2020-2021 gave an incidence 16% above the 2010-2019 trend, with a dip during the first lockdown.

35983511.takeaway: In 225 children with osteogenesis imperfecta, osteocalcin levels fell with higher BMI and insulin resistance, and the undercarboxylated fraction tracked with grip strength.

35983751.takeaway: A 7-year-old boy with autoantibody-negative type 1B diabetes was diagnosed with Wolfram syndrome after ophthalmologic screening showed optic nerve pallor, before visual loss.

35984215.takeaway: A Tunisian girl with 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis had an Xp21.2 duplication including NR0B1 and MAGEB, suggesting these genes can cause XY gonadal dysgenesis when duplicated.

35984226.takeaway: In 105 young people with type 1 diabetes, ZnT8 antibody presence and titer were not linked to presentation or most outcomes, except a small difference in cumulative excess HbA1c between low- and high-titer groups.

35984227.takeaway: Among 37 Colombian children with 22q11 deletion syndrome, 37.8% had endocrinopathies, most often hypoparathyroidism (21.6%), with late severe hypocalcemia emphasizing continuous follow-up.

35984228.takeaway: Shear-wave elastography stiffness was higher in 46 newly diagnosed Hashimoto thyroiditis children than in 46 healthy controls, with a 9.68 kPa cut-off, and BMI SDS and age affected values in healthy children.

35984229.takeaway: This review covers diagnosis, investigation and management of childhood osteoporosis, including primary bone disorders with molecular diagnosis, secondary osteoporosis from underlying disease, and emerging therapies to reduce fractures.

35984419.takeaway: Among 100 adolescents with type 1 diabetes, commonly used depression screeners had low sensitivity at standard cut-offs, adjusted cut-offs improved sensitivity, and the CDI-2 Short performed best.

35992102.takeaway: In 13,183 children, later pubertal timing (age at peak height velocity) was linked to higher physical education grades in both sexes and to higher mathematics grades in girls.

35992104.takeaway: In 119 men with hypogonadism, those with primary hypergonadotropic hypogonadism had lower lumbar spine bone density than those with central hypogonadism, suggesting FSH excess may harm male bone.

35992116.takeaway: This mini-review summarizes epidemiologic links between PFAS chemicals and type 2 diabetes, noting consistent associations with glycemic markers but conflicting evidence on incident diabetes.

35992119.takeaway: This review explains the genetic causes of childhood adrenal hyperplasias, including PKA-pathway defects behind micronodular adrenal disease with Cushing syndrome, and 21-hydroxylase deficiency as the most common CAH.

35992134.takeaway: A patient with an HNF1B variant (MODY5) presented with diabetic ketosis, multiple renal cysts and hypokalemia, and the authors suggest insufficient insulin secretion may cause the ketosis.

35992135.takeaway: In three Chinese families with ABCC8 variants (MODY12), glimepiride 2 mg/day failed in children and 4 mg/day controlled glucose, and liraglutide worked in both children and adults.

35992140.takeaway: This review of paediatric endocrine conditions during COVID-19 finds limited data but supports vitamin D supplementation, caution in obesity, thyroid monitoring and awareness of rising precocious puberty.

35992151.takeaway: Among 411 people with Down syndrome from Poland, standard and specialized growth charts gave different results, and neither clearly detected developmental disorders earlier; combining both worked best.

35992154.takeaway: In 79 youths with type 1 diabetes, serum Klotho fell with longer diabetes and higher HbA1c, and miR-192 lowered Klotho in cells and tracked negatively with it in children with long-standing diabetes.

35993884.takeaway: Among 241 children at a paediatric obesity clinic, 61.8% had a metabolically healthy obesity phenotype, with higher HDL and lower systolic blood pressure the only independent predictors.

35994729.takeaway: In 78 children with new-onset type 1 diabetes followed for a year, CGM glycemic variability patterns distinguished those in partial remission from non-remitters better than residual C-peptide estimates did.

35994776.takeaway: Fetal adrenal involution occurs around term-equivalent age in preterm infants regardless of premature birth, while preterm infants have higher testosterone at birth that declines more slowly than in term infants.

35997261.takeaway: In a randomized trial of parents of young children newly diagnosed with type 1 diabetes, stepped-care parent coaching lowered depressive symptoms at 9 and 15 months but did not change child HbA1c.

35997303.takeaway: In 725 adolescents with type 1 diabetes, cardiac autonomic neuropathy predicted incident retinopathy and early kidney dysfunction independently of HbA1c and diabetes duration.

36001026.takeaway: In 101 UK children with classic CAH, overweight (27%) and obesity (22%) were more common than in controls, and school functioning scored lowest on quality-of-life measures.

36001345.takeaway: In 556 Hong Kong children with new-onset type 1 diabetes, 43% presented in DKA, and those with DKA were younger with shorter symptom duration, while acute management varied.

36001755.takeaway: In 14,616 young people with type 1 diabetes in the US, endocrinologist visits fell with age, while emergency visits and hospitalizations were higher in young adults than adolescents.

36001954.takeaway: A child with growth hormone deficiency and Chiari malformation type I developed headache and worsening Chiari after starting GH, and after decompression surgery could resume GH with marked growth.

36004353.takeaway: Among 2,169 Saudi children aged 6 to 13, overweight and obesity prevalence depended on the reference: 31.1% with IOTF, 31.7% with national Saudi references and 38.0% with WHO.

36004391.takeaway: In 39 adolescents and young adults with type 1 diabetes, a pragmatic 12-week low-carbohydrate diet changed neither carbohydrate intake nor HbA1c compared with standard diet or education.

36006612.takeaway: In Swedish adults with diabetes, higher HbA1c was associated with trigger finger, with odds ratios of about 1.1 to 1.4 in both type 1 and type 2 diabetes.

36007499.takeaway: In 327 children with self-limited delayed puberty, pubertal timing related to bone age, childhood height and midparental target height, but not to parental pubertal delay or testosterone treatment.

36007536.takeaway: In an international survey of 1,034 people with central diabetes insipidus, 26% of those on desmopressin had hyponatremia leading to hospitalization, 80% had it confused with diabetes mellitus, and 85% supported renaming it.

36017314.takeaway: In aged female fruit flies, ginsenosides restored ovarian steroid levels and fertility through the ecdysteroid receptor, with ginsenosides Rg1, Re and Rb1 the active components.

36028774.takeaway: Among 154,462 Bavarian children screened, a progression likelihood score split stage 1 type 1 diabetes into substages, with the high-risk substage carrying a 46% two-year risk of clinical diagnosis.

36030768.takeaway: Two adolescents developed severe hypercalcemia and kidney injury from vitamin D toxicity traced to a creatine supplement containing about 425,000 IU per serving, highlighting supplement risks.

36034420.takeaway: In Chinese adults aged 50 and over, age, smoking, homocysteine and glucose were independent risk factors for osteoporosis, while higher BMI, skeletal muscle mass and body fat percentage were associated with lower risk.

36034425.takeaway: This review describes genetic and epigenetic factors that make some women more prone than others to stress-induced functional hypothalamic amenorrhea, and suggests induced pluripotent stem cells as a research tool.

36034430.takeaway: Across 9 randomized trials and 13 cohorts of 11,273 pregnant women with subclinical hypothyroidism, levothyroxine did not significantly improve pregnancy, neonatal or childhood outcomes, though evidence was largely low quality.

36034431.takeaway: Among 525 preterm newborns, 14.9% had low free T4 on days 3 to 5, mostly from low-FT4 syndrome, and over 90% of cases were born before 32 weeks or weighed under 1,500 g.

36034433.takeaway: High glucose markedly inhibited glucagon secretion from porcine islets, more strongly than it affected insulin secretion, in both neonatal and adult pigs.

36034437.takeaway: Adults with metabolically obese normal weight were lighter in youth but gained more BMI later and lost more physical activity than metabolically healthy peers.

36034440.takeaway: GLP-1 receptor agonists did not significantly change arrhythmia risk in type 2 diabetes but reduced hypoglycemia and pneumonia.

36034448.takeaway: Once-weekly PEGylated GH at 120-140 μg/kg/week gave height velocity close to daily GH in children with GH deficiency, with similar safety.

36034451.takeaway: Hair trace-element levels differed between young wrestlers and non-athlete cadets, with wrestlers showing higher levels of several elements, including toxic ones.

36034458.takeaway: In youth with type 2 diabetes, saxagliptin plus metformin, liraglutide plus metformin and liraglutide gave the largest HbA1c reductions versus placebo across 12 trials.

36034464.takeaway: A toddler on a soy-based diet developed goiter and overt hypothyroidism from iodine deficiency, which resolved with iodine supplementation and diet diversification.

36039549.takeaway: Congenital hypothyroidism incidence in Guangzhou rose from 1:2,584 (2010-2014) to 1:1,086 (2015-2020); most cases were transient, with iodine deficiency and preterm birth suggested as contributors.

36041401.takeaway: A 20-month-old boy with peripheral precocious puberty improved after stopping a seasoning high in phytosterols, suggesting diet may have caused it.

36041412.takeaway: Reviews islet transplantation and emerging stem-cell-derived beta-cell therapies for type 1 diabetes, noting immune rejection as the main remaining challenge.

36044664.takeaway: In children with overweight or obesity, reduction of intermuscular abdominal fat explained about 21% of the improvement in liver fat after a lifestyle intervention.

36044665.takeaway: Men with type 2 diabetes met physical activity guidelines more often than women in adults and older adults, but not in adolescents; women did less vigorous activity across life.

36047484.takeaway: A 2-year-old with stress-induced hyperglycemia and a heterozygous NEUROD1 variant had MODY6 diagnosed; family history and features should guide molecular testing.

36047486.takeaway: A 16-year-old with brittle type 1 diabetes had severe gastroparesis that improved with metoclopramide and a hybrid closed-loop system; clinicians should consider it in poorly controlled diabetes.

36047503.takeaway: A 13-year-old girl with metastatic malignant insulinoma survived long term after pancreatic resection, liver transplantation and somatostatin analogue therapy.

36047647.takeaway: The factory-calibrated Dexcom G6 became less accurate during treadmill exercise in adolescents with type 1 diabetes, worst with sensors on the buttocks, and recovered afterward.

36048852.takeaway: Employees with type 2 diabetes lost about four more workdays a year and had roughly double the medical costs of employees without diabetes.

36051386.takeaway: A 16-year-old with drug-resistant hypertension had a somatic KCNJ5 aldosterone-producing adenoma, and her blood pressure improved significantly after unilateral adrenalectomy.

36051396.takeaway: In 10 children with X-linked hypophosphatemia, three years of burosumab healed rickets and improved height z-score, but dental pulp enlargement persisted and some had recurrent abscesses.

36053086.takeaway: Reviews melanocortin 3 receptor roles in appetite and weight control, growth, puberty and circadian rhythm, and its cellular mechanisms.

36053087.takeaway: The Bayley-Pinneau and Tanner-Whitehouse methods can estimate adult height in constitutionally tall children, even before puberty, though their errors should be kept in mind.

36054347.takeaway: Early-pregnancy plasma glycated CD59 was associated with neonatal hypoglycaemia in women with BMI of at least 29, but it was only a fair predictor (AUC 0.64-0.70).

36054435.takeaway: In SEARCH youth, about 83% of participants positive for autoantibodies at diagnosis stayed positive after about seven years; changes did not track HbA1c or complications.

36054578.takeaway: Among 651 young people with type 1 diabetes and COVID-19, having at least one comorbidity roughly doubled the odds of hospitalization (OR 2.0).

36054923.takeaway: In 975 pregnant women, thyroid antibody positivity did not clearly worsen pregnancy outcomes when thyroid function was kept under control with levothyroxine.

36056624.takeaway: In 48 patients with MEN2B, 38% had a fracture in childhood (0-19 years), a rate higher than in general US pediatric cohorts, including less common vertebral and pelvic sites.

36060934.takeaway: In 29 Chinese patients with X-linked hypophosphatemia, bowed legs and short stature were common, eight novel PHEX variants were found, and 7 of 9 operated patients had recurrence.

36060948.takeaway: Children with overweight or obesity had lower serum sRANKL than healthy peers, and sRANKL correlated negatively with uric acid.

36060951.takeaway: GDM prevalence in a Ningbo delivery cohort rose from 4% in 2010 to 21% in 2020, with the rise slowing after the two-child policy; older maternal age was a key risk factor.

36060956.takeaway: Authors recommend checking 25(OH)D at T1D diagnosis and supplementing vitamin D if levels are below 30 ng/mL, citing an RCT where supplementation slowed the rise in HbA1c.

36060958.takeaway: In 24 children with type 1 diabetes, advanced hybrid closed-loop insulin delivery reduced fear of hypoglycemia and emotional distress, and improved HbA1c and time in range.

36060959.takeaway: MIRAGE syndrome from SAMD9 variants is more varied than first described, with growth restriction and multisystem features often present without adrenal insufficiency; endocrinopathies may be overlooked.

36060964.takeaway: Reviews Noonan syndrome growth and GH/IGF biology; rhGH consistently increases height velocity, but treatment should be personalized with neoplasm surveillance given genotype-dependent risks.

36060976.takeaway: Narrative review linking placental lesions to neurological outcomes in fetal growth restriction and preterm infants, including periventricular leukomalacia, hemorrhage and autism spectrum disorder.

36060986.takeaway: Radiogenic and sporadic papillary microcarcinomas in young patients behaved similarly, and radiogenic tumors more often achieved complete remission after radioiodine therapy.

36062297.takeaway: In 25 children, the glucagon stimulation test with the new Roche cortisol II assay had poor accuracy for central adrenal insufficiency, so it cannot replace the metyrapone test.

36062303.takeaway: In 51 families of children with newly diagnosed type 1 diabetes, parents' marital relationship satisfaction at diagnosis predicted HbA1c 18-24 months later.

36062396.takeaway: In 132 youth with new diabetes in Mali, most were T1D with higher-than-expected C-peptide and lower autoantibody rates than in Europe; HLA-DRB1*04:05 raised risk and *15:03 was protective.

36062966.takeaway: In 200 treatment-naive children with GH deficiency, weekly somapacitan gave noninferior 52-week height velocity (11.2 vs 11.7 cm/y for daily GH), with similar safety.

36063807.takeaway: In short, lean peripubertal boys, a year of a protein-rich nutritional formula gave modest height and muscle gains that depended on consumption; poor consumers lost height-SDS relative to good consumers.

36066342.takeaway: In Fukushima youth aged 6-20, low TSH and reduced feedback indices were linked to thyroid nodules, mainly at ages 12-17, suggesting an age-dependent pituitary-thyroid set point.

36068006.takeaway: Newborn screening of 183,082 Chinese infants found MCADD in six (about 1 in 30,514), with four known and four novel ACADM variants; one infant died of vaccination-induced MCADD.

36068963.takeaway: In youth with GCK diabetes, beta-cell function was stable over two years but lower than controls; HNF1A and KCNJ11 patients improved beta-cell function and HbA1c after treatment optimization.

36069768.takeaway: Among 188 children seen in a Nigerian endocrine clinic over 11 years, thyroid disorders were most common, followed by type 1 diabetes, obesity and pubertal disorders.

36069769.takeaway: In 878 children, higher benzophenone-3 levels were associated with insulin resistance and obesity, and obesity partly mediated the association with insulin resistance.

36071550.takeaway: In Tokyo newborn screening by LC-MS/MS, 21-deoxycortisol, 11-deoxycortisol/17OHP and (androstenedione+17OHP)/cortisol outperformed 17OHP alone for detecting 21-hydroxylase deficiency.

36071555.takeaway: Two young men with familial male-limited precocious puberty from LHCGR variants developed testicular germ cell tumors; the authors suggest FMPP may raise tumor risk and recommend monitoring from mid-puberty.

36071648.takeaway: In 58 preterm boys, lower birth weight was associated with higher sex steroid concentrations from age 8 years, independent of clinical signs of puberty.

36072927.takeaway: Among 193 children with obesity, 30% were metabolically healthy; these were younger and prepubertal, with lower BMI and higher adiponectin and apolipoprotein A-1.

36072933.takeaway: Reviews hormonal influences on bone age progression before and during puberty, including sex differences, hypogonadism and Turner syndrome.

36072938.takeaway: Reviews long-acting growth hormone products, which matched daily GH height velocity in 52-week trials, and what clinicians need to select candidates and monitor therapy.

36073000.takeaway: In 1644 people with newly diagnosed T1D, GAD and IA-2 autoantibody levels were bimodal and linked to age, sex, HLA type and ZnT8 positivity, adding information beyond positivity alone.

36073163.takeaway: In 109 Finnish boys, those who had orchiopexy for cryptorchidism had higher FSH, lower inhibin B and smaller testes than controls during puberty, while testosterone and LH were similar.

36073965.takeaway: In 1036 offspring of women with gestational diabetes, maternal obesity was linked to ADHD, and only obesity combined with excessive gestational weight gain stayed significant after adjustment.

36074910.takeaway: In CLPB deficiency, premature ovarian insufficiency was a common postpubertal problem among patients who survived to adulthood, so affected females need prompt diagnosis and hormone replacement.

36074933.takeaway: Childhood hyperthyroidism incidence in France rose 30% from 2008 to 2017, mostly in girls (80%), with marked regional variation across départements.

36075246.takeaway: In 150 children with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolaemia, 80 weeks of evolocumab was well tolerated and sustained LDL cholesterol reduction (about 35% at week 80).

36082079.takeaway: Maternal gestational hypertension or preeclampsia was associated with offspring obesity from early childhood to adolescence, and preeclampsia exposure with higher BMI in girls.

36082496.takeaway: In TEDDY children, rising HbA1c predicted progression to type 1 diabetes and further autoantibodies, and HbA1c rose faster as autoantibody number increased from one to three.

36083343.takeaway: In high-risk children, seven or more infections in year one and some bacterial infections were linked to autoantibodies and clinical type 1 diabetes; viral infection evidence was weak.

36084251.takeaway: In hospitalized adults, length of stay was shorter during active periods of an alert-based glycemic decision-support tool, with significant reductions in some subgroups.

36089647.takeaway: The KAT-1 type 1 diabetes knowledge test correlated with a validated knowledge test and inversely with HbA1c in 200 participants, with strong internal consistency.

36093075.takeaway: In Swiss hospital data, DKA admissions rose from 2010 to 2018, peaking in adolescent girls with type 1 diabetes and in older adults with type 2 diabetes; mortality was high in the elderly.

36093078.takeaway: Narrative review of infections in pediatric type 1 diabetes, emphasizing that good metabolic control and recommended vaccination reduce infection risk and severity.

36093088.takeaway: In 88 children with differentiated thyroid cancer, tumor size over 4 cm and distant metastasis were independent predictors of worse event-free survival (10-year EFS 79%).

36093089.takeaway: In 23 children with Silver-Russell syndrome, puberty began earlier than in 21 children born SGA, earliest in maternal UPD7, and five developed central precocious puberty.

36093090.takeaway: Among 12,346 Chinese children aged 7-18, 2% had metabolically healthy obesity and about 26% were metabolically unhealthy with normal weight; the 2018 consensus definition flagged more cardiovascular risk.

36093091.takeaway: A 4.5-year-old girl with Cornelia de Lange syndrome had a vaginal obstruction causing recurrent urinary infections and reflux; surgical resection improved her symptoms.

36093098.takeaway: Reviews socioeconomic and racial disparities in the evaluation and treatment of children with growth hormone deficiency, and strategies proposed to reduce them.

36093099.takeaway: In Xenopus frogs, leptin doubled the rate of skin wound closure in explants and reduced bacterial infection, suggesting its wound-healing effect is conserved across vertebrates.

36093102.takeaway: In 284,937 Chinese adults, intraocular pressure was higher in men than women, declined with age and varied by region, providing age- and sex-specific reference intervals.

36093103.takeaway: Only about 8% of women with gestational diabetes had T1D-related autoantibodies, so routine screening is not warranted; postpartum antibody re-testing may help women with high levels.

36093106.takeaway: Reviews how misfolded GPCRs cause endocrine diseases and how pharmacological chaperones may restore their trafficking to the cell surface.

36093109.takeaway: In 200 newborns, higher linoleic acid and diHOME levels in cord blood were modestly associated with lower birth weight after adjusting for obstetric factors.

36094294.takeaway: Age-adjusted incidence of both new type 1 and type 2 diabetes in Florida youth under 18 increased after COVID-19 was declared a national emergency in March 2020.

36095049.takeaway: In a nested case-control study of 107 women with GDM and 214 matched controls, higher plasma total 18:1 monounsaturated fatty acids in early-to-mid pregnancy were linked to lower GDM risk.

36095276.takeaway: In children aged 7-11, early gestational diabetes (before 26 weeks) was associated with MRI evidence of mediobasal hypothalamic gliosis, a possible brain pathway to metabolic risk.

36096110.takeaway: Narrative review of evidence-based stress management techniques for children and adolescents, such as breathing exercises, mindfulness and CBT, for anxiety, depression and pain.

36097824.takeaway: Among 156,090 youth with type 1 diabetes in 11 countries, retinopathy prevalence was 5.8% overall and rose with diabetes duration, higher HbA1c, hypertension and smoking.

36098660.takeaway: In adults with type 2 diabetes, COVID-19 did not significantly change longer-term HbA1c or weight; mechanical ventilation was associated with a lower HbA1c afterward.

36098719.takeaway: USPSTF finds insufficient evidence to weigh benefits and harms of screening asymptomatic children and adolescents for type 2 diabetes (I statement).

36099499.takeaway: Among 5,698 children with birth data, SGA children who failed catch-up growth ended far shorter than those who caught up, and first-year height gain helped identify them early.

36100363.takeaway: In 87 Thai infants with congenital hypothyroidism, 36% became iatrogenically hyperthyroid on recommended levothyroxine doses; an initial dose of at least 10.2 μg/kg/day predicted it.

36100365.takeaway: A 6-year-old vegan girl with iodine deficiency goiter had thyroid tests mimicking thyroid hormone resistance alpha, which normalized after iodine supplementation.

36100371.takeaway: A female adolescent with genetically confirmed Wolfram syndrome had hypergonadotropic hypogonadism, supporting gonadal function assessment in both sexes.

36100423.takeaway: Genetic screening of Iranian youth with diabetes found MODY-related variants in 14 of 230 (6%), most often GCK; the authors recommend screening unusual diabetes even without family history.

36101713.takeaway: In 87 children with GH deficiency, once-weekly somatrogon caused significantly less treatment burden than daily somatropin, with greater convenience and satisfaction.

36102184.takeaway: In 83,803 children in the KIGS database, rhGH was generally safe, with serious adverse events in 3.7%, and increased height gain and adult height across GH deficiency and other conditions.

36103260.takeaway: About 7% of euthyroid TPO-antibody-positive women developed hypothyroidism within a year before conception or during pregnancy; treated women conceived less often but had similar live birth rates.

36103376.takeaway: In 42 pediatric follicular-patterned thyroid tumors, infiltrative variants had more lymph node and distant metastasis than encapsulated variants, which behaved indolently.

36103668.takeaway: Exome sequencing of six men with failed puberty found plausible variants in 16 genes of the hypothalamic-pituitary-testicular axis, eight of them novel candidates.

36106490.takeaway: Among 386 critically ill children, 36% had euthyroid sick syndrome; low free T3 (below 2.31 pg/mL) was associated with higher 28-day mortality.

36106528.takeaway: A 3.5-month-old boy with Rabson-Mendenhall syndrome from an INSR variant was managed with frequent feeding and long-acting insulin in a resource-limited setting.

36107673.takeaway: Sex-specific models predicted heart failure at diabetes onset in Ontario and performed similarly in UK patients, with one-year C-statistics of 0.78-0.81.

36107810.takeaway: Clinical review of congenital hypothyroidism covering diagnosis, thyroid development, newborn screening and replacement, with a case of thyroid ectopy and novel TUBB1 variants.

36108305.takeaway: In 47 adults and adolescents with type 1 diabetes switched to a MiniMed 780G hybrid closed-loop system, time in range rose from 65% to 74% over six months without severe hypoglycemia.

36111273.takeaway: A boy with gonadotropin-independent precocious puberty from infancy developed bilateral Leydig cell tumors from a somatic LHCGR gain-of-function variant; combined abiraterone therapy appeared effective.

36111298.takeaway: Among 97 family members of children with symptomatic vitamin D deficiency, 93% of mothers and 79% of siblings were deficient, and 10% of siblings had hypocalcaemia.

36112006.takeaway: Among 2,145 autoantibody-positive children followed from early life, those who progressed to type 1 diabetes more often had high autoantibody levels and earlier appearance than those who did not.

36112066.takeaway: A 4-year-old girl with acanthosis nigricans, hyperinsulinism and high testosterone had a stage 1A juvenile granulosa cell tumor; labs normalized after salpingo-oophorectomy.

36112170.takeaway: In mice, maternal metformin during obese pregnancy increased adiposity, liver fat and inflammation in male offspring and adiposity and hyperinsulinaemia in females at 12 months.

36112422.takeaway: In 28 people with X-linked hypophosphatemia, 17 of them children, blood immune cells showed increased inflammatory gene expression versus controls, with impaired osteoclast formation.

36112821.takeaway: Newborn screening of 588,793 infants in Madrid confirmed 19 cases of propionic or methylmalonic acidemia or cobalamin disorders, with many false positives from elevated C3 and maternal B12 deficiency.

36113507.takeaway: A global model estimated about 8.4 million people had type 1 diabetes in 2021, with 3.7 million missing prevalent cases, and projects 13.5-17.4 million by 2040.

36113970.takeaway: In a 2-month-old infant with panhypopituitarism and hypoglycemia, time in hypoglycemia fell from 4.9% to 0% after growth hormone therapy, with no hyperglycemia.

36114751.takeaway: In 20 girls with central precocious puberty, no pubertal growth spurt followed GnRH agonist withdrawal; bone age accelerated, and menarche came later in girls with younger bone age.

36120432.takeaway: Pooled analysis estimated PCOS prevalence at about 21% among women with type 2 diabetes, with higher rates in women aged 25-45 than under 25.

36120435.takeaway: In 178 patients with craniopharyngioma, higher postoperative hypothalamic injury scores were linked to recurrent and severe hypernatremia, and a score above 3 may predict adipsic diabetes insipidus.

36120450.takeaway: Women with placenta previa had about a 46% risk of birth before 37 weeks, versus 30% with low-lying placenta; progesterone, cerclage and pessary show possible benefit with limited data.

36120452.takeaway: Pooled data from 1,311 pregnancies in non-21-hydroxylase CAH found miscarriage in 18%, caesarean delivery in 68% and elective termination in 5.5%; glucocorticoids lowered miscarriage in non-classic CAH.

36120457.takeaway: In 3,216 children with obesity, a nomogram of eight anthropometric and laboratory markers predicted NAFLD with an AUROC of 0.913 and may serve as a screening tool.

36120459.takeaway: In mice, implanted neonatal bone-marrow endothelial cells improved endochondral bone formation during fracture healing only in aged animals.

36126177.takeaway: In 19,354 people with type 1 diabetes, switching from predictive low glucose suspend to automated insulin delivery raised time in range from 58% to 70%, most in those under 18.

36127305.takeaway: Across 15 trials in adolescents with obesity, exercise combined with diet reduced BMI and body fat more than other approaches, and lowered triglycerides and LDL more than diet alone.

36127837.takeaway: In 138 Egyptian adolescents with type 1 diabetes, 17% screened at risk for eating disorders by EAT-26 and 38% had orthorexia by ORTO-15; high-risk scores tracked with DKA and complications.

36130048.takeaway: In 360 Chinese children with idiopathic short stature, weekly PEG-rhGH for 52 weeks improved height SDS in a dose-dependent way, with similar adverse event rates across groups.

36131228.takeaway: Corneal confocal microscopy and nerve conduction showed lower nerve measures in 83 children with type 1 diabetes than matched controls, with subclinical neuropathy in only 3 of 83.

36131363.takeaway: In a pilot of 21 adolescents, those with obesity, with or without type 2 diabetes, scored lower on cognitive tests than lean peers, with scores tied to adiposity and insulin resistance rather than HbA1c.

36133310.takeaway: In 132 children and adolescents, those with NAFLD had higher fasting glucagon, best predicted by hepatic insulin resistance and visceral fat rather than liver fat itself.

36133316.takeaway: Starting levothyroxine at 10-12.5 versus 12.6-15 μg/kg/day gave similar growth and neurodevelopment in congenital hypothyroidism, with IQ below 85 in 13% regardless of arm.

36136319.takeaway: In 50 children with multiple pituitary hormone deficiency, prolactin was higher in those with pituitary stalk interruption syndrome (median 27.9 vs 5.6 ng/mL), so normal or high levels warrant attention.

36137169.takeaway: In 172 women with overweight or obesity, insulin and glycemic-index measures in pregnancy were linked to small methylation changes in newborn cord blood, and the lifestyle intervention had no effect.

36147568.takeaway: In 582 Montenegrin children under 15 diagnosed over 30 years, type 1 diabetes incidence rose about 3% a year to a mean of 15.2 per 100,000, with a jump in 2020.

36147577.takeaway: In 51 overweight women with PCOS, adding canagliflozin to metformin lowered total testosterone and glucose exposure more than metformin alone, without differences in menstrual frequency or weight.

36148598.takeaway: In Nigerian children with type 1 diabetes, compliance was poor: 39% followed insulin recommendations well and 20% followed diet advice, with maternal education the main correlate.

36149814.takeaway: Three Thai patients with NEUROG3 deficiency had novel homozygous variants, pituitary hypoplasia with multiple hormone deficiencies, and renal tubulopathy not previously reported.

36150053.takeaway: In 8,502 genetically high-risk TEDDY newborns, predictors differed by first autoantibody type, and younger age at first autoantibody predicted faster progression to diabetes.

36150054.takeaway: In 707 TEDDY children with islet autoantibodies, a 10% rise in HbA1c from baseline predicted progression to stage 3 type 1 diabetes about as well as an OGTT, and was validated in TrialNet.
