36598177.takeaway: A 4-year-old girl with mild aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase deficiency presented with recurrent hypoglycaemia and no neurological signs, managed with cornstarch.

36598841.takeaway: In adolescents using the MiniMed 780G, simplified meal announcement gave lower time in range than precise carbohydrate counting, 73.5% versus 80.3%.

36601002.takeaway: Infants of mothers with well-controlled GDM not on medication gained weight and BMI more slowly than controls between birth and 12 months.

36601007.takeaway: In 191 children followed from prepuberty to puberty, metabolic syndrome prevalence rose from 9.1% to 11.9%, with cardiometabolic changes during puberty.

36601010.takeaway: Systematic review of objectively measured sleep duration found short sleep linked to cardiometabolic disease, though findings remain inconsistent.

36607219.takeaway: Through June 2021, COVID-19 hospitalisation occurred in 0.71% of Swedish adults with type 1 diabetes and 2.31% with type 2, versus 0.53% without diabetes.

36607833.takeaway: New central precocious puberty diagnoses rose from 34 to 45 across two Italian centres during COVID-19 lockdown, alongside more suspected cases.

36607835.takeaway: A 3.5-year-old boy had precocious puberty from secondary exposure to his father's compounded testosterone cream, with testosterone normalising after stopping it.

36607840.takeaway: An 8-month-old boy with biallelic SC5D variants had lathosterolosis presenting with status epilepticus, raised transaminases and brain atrophy.

36611246.takeaway: Review of adrenocortical cell transplantation and gene therapy as future alternatives to oral cortisol replacement in adrenal insufficiency.

36611250.takeaway: Familial forms were found in 22% of 586 children with central precocious puberty, transmitted about equally by mothers and fathers.

36617246.takeaway: In 716 infants of the Boston Birth Cohort, cord leptin and adiponectin were higher in term than preterm infants, while childhood leptin did not differ by prematurity.

36617488.takeaway: Of 790 infants born to women with hypothyroidism, 99% had normal thyroid function at 2 weeks, so routine early testing found few cases.

36619545.takeaway: Maternal sFLT-1 and PlGF were lower in preterm birth, and the sFLT-1/PlGF ratio in extracellular vesicles was higher, suggesting a possible biomarker.

36619546.takeaway: Among 209 adults with severe COVID-19 given dexamethasone, 32% needed ventilation or ICU care, and 76% of those were patients with diabetes.

36619551.takeaway: Review of genetic, epigenetic and environmental factors in precocious and delayed puberty, highlighting MKRN3 and DLK1 as epigenetically regulated genes.

36619555.takeaway: In 191 ICSI couples, paternal MTHFR C677T genotype was not associated with differences in fertilisation or high-quality embryo rates.

36619556.takeaway: Review of how hyper- and hypoglycaemia affect brain development in children, with DKA linked to brain changes and screening for type 1 diabetes advocated.

36619558.takeaway: Serum metabolomics in 76 Chinese children with type 1 diabetes identified 70 differing metabolites across 11 pathways, consistent across age and sex.

36619560.takeaway: Systematic review of thyroid disorders after paediatric stem cell transplant, with risk-based follow-up recommendations, as thyroid disorders are reported in over 70% of survivors.

36619563.takeaway: Islets from 7-day-old pigs performed better than those from younger pigs and restored normoglycaemia faster in diabetic mice.

36619587.takeaway: Review of how genetic and epigenetic factors may influence susceptibility to nutritional rickets through vitamin D and calcium deficiency.

36620967.takeaway: Review of the neuroendocrine and molecular control of puberty, including kisspeptins and nutritional cues, and their alterations in precocious and delayed puberty.

36622842.takeaway: In 122 children after total thyroidectomy, a 6-hour postoperative PTH of 11.3 pg/mL or less predicted permanent hypoparathyroidism with 100% sensitivity.

36623517.takeaway: In 225 pregnant women with type 1 diabetes, degludec was non-inferior to detemir for HbA1c before delivery, with no additional safety issues.

36625262.takeaway: In 170 children with central precocious puberty, a single histrelin implant left in place for about 24 months kept puberty suppressed without more complications.

36626889.takeaway: In two infants with neonatal severe hyperparathyroidism from CASR mutations, subtotal parathyroidectomy controlled calcium where cinacalcet had failed.

36630599.takeaway: A child with olfactory neuroblastoma developed Cushing syndrome from ectopic ACTH secretion during follow-up, a rare complication.

36630604.takeaway: Review of the history of DSD and intersex care, outlining consensus on disclosure and continuing controversy over early genital surgery.

36630941.takeaway: A 7-year-old boy with a TSH-secreting pituitary adenoma required repeated surgery and radiosurgery after recurrences, then medical therapy.

36632209.takeaway: Youth with type 2 diabetes had higher fasting morning epinephrine than obese and lean peers, and males also showed a higher morning-to-24-hour ratio.

36633570.takeaway: Intranasal carbetocin was well tolerated, but primary hyperphagia and obsessive-compulsive endpoints were not significant; the 3.2 mg dose showed nominal benefits.

36633572.takeaway: Oral contraceptive users had higher aldosterone-to-renin ratios than non-users at ages 17 and 27, which matters for primary aldosteronism screening.

36635911.takeaway: International consensus guideline for children born small for gestational age covers etiology including epigenetic causes, growth-based diagnosis, GH and GnRHa treatment, and long-term metabolic health.

36636022.takeaway: Review of 50 years of progress in paediatric bone and mineral metabolism, covering PTH, vitamin D, FGF23 and the genetic causes of hypo- and hyperparathyroidism.

36637392.takeaway: In 1,681 paediatric DKA episodes, pH correlated strongly with bicarbonate but only loosely with PCO2, and glucose tracked with dehydration and kidney markers.

36637859.takeaway: New-onset youth type 2 diabetes nearly tripled in incidence during the pandemic, and more children presented with ketoacidosis or hyperosmolar states in the first year.

36640191.takeaway: In 2088 pregnancies in women with type 1 diabetes, pump treatment was not associated with fewer congenital malformations than injections, though pump users had lower HbA1c.

36646053.takeaway: Five years of recombinant IGF-1 in a boy with PAPP-A2 deficiency raised height velocity and height SDS, while a sibling stopped because of pseudotumor cerebri.

36648253.takeaway: A revised insulin sensitivity index from CGM and pump data correlated well with the gold standard in 10 youths with type 1 diabetes (R=0.83).

36649684.takeaway: Adolescent girls with PCOS had higher TSH than controls; TSH fell into the safe preconception range on spironolactone-pioglitazone-metformin but stayed raised on oral contraception.

36649687.takeaway: Among seven children with peroxisomal disorders, four of six with peroxisome biogenesis disorders had primary adrenal insufficiency.

36651155.takeaway: Commentary argues that the trial evidence for long-acting PEG-rhGH in idiopathic short stature may warrant reconsidering diagnostic and treatment policy.

36651161.takeaway: In 62 prepubertal children born SGA, weekly somapacitan raised height velocity with dose (8.9 to 11.3 cm/year), with safety similar to daily GH.

36652933.takeaway: Of 123 respondents, 74% of males with classic CAH and their parents were concerned about testicular adrenal rest tumours.

36655002.takeaway: A 12-year-old with INS-related monogenic diabetes and a heterozygous CFTR variant had three episodes of acute pancreatitis over seven months.

36655394.takeaway: Across 148 published pregnancy-related hypophysitis cases, recurrence after high-dose glucocorticoids was 33%, versus 2% after surgery or conservative care.

36656544.takeaway: Serum telomerase was lower in 45 non-obese girls with PCOS than in 45 controls and correlated inversely with BMI and triglycerides.

36659819.takeaway: A 2-year-old girl with hereditary fructose intolerance carried a novel homozygous ALDOB frameshift variant, found by targeted gene sequencing.

36662638.takeaway: Newborn screening of 36,590 infants in northern China found inborn errors of metabolism in about 1 in 3,539, most often propionic acidaemia.

36669772.takeaway: In 1,170 Chinese children with GH deficiency, long-term PEG-rhGH improved height SD score over 36 months, analysed by high and low dose.

36680759.takeaway: Among 305 pregnancies with Graves disease treated with antithyroid drugs to delivery, neonatal hypothyroidism occurred in 19% of methimazole and 13% of propylthiouracil cases.

36680781.takeaway: In 45,516 pregnant women in Foshan, higher fasting glucose in early pregnancy was linked to congenital heart defects, and later glucose to preterm birth and macrosomia.

36686428.takeaway: Network pharmacology identified 66 shared targets between resveratrol and preeclampsia genes, pointing to AGE-RAGE and HIF-1 pathways as possible mechanisms.

36686429.takeaway: In frozen-thawed single transfers, high-grade day 6 blastocysts gave higher live birth rates than low-grade day 5 blastocysts.

36686445.takeaway: Of 36 children aged 6 to 17 undergoing fertility preservation, most understood their treatment and its effect on fertility, and half did not mind hearing about options.

36686446.takeaway: Of 451 Egyptian children with DSD, 75% had 46,XY DSD, most often partial androgen insensitivity; an AMH cut-off of 14.5 ng/mL had 100% sensitivity for testicular tissue.

36686448.takeaway: Interviews with 22 people with type 1 diabetes identified strategies for staying physically active while managing hypoglycaemia and glucose variability.

36686449.takeaway: Review of fetal and adult Leydig cell origins, identifying distinct populations with different steroid output that govern testosterone production.

36686451.takeaway: Review comparing pig islet xenotransplantation and stem-cell-derived beta cells as future cures for type 1 diabetes, with immunosuppression and islet loss as main hurdles.

36686468.takeaway: A 56-year-old woman with idiopathic hypoparathyroidism and short stature was diagnosed with Kenny-Caffey syndrome type 2 through a FAM111A variant.

36686471.takeaway: A boy with permanent neonatal diabetes from a novel homozygous INS start-codon variant was followed for 10 years on insulin.

36686472.takeaway: Among 3948 US children in NHANES, 18% had headache, and overweight or obesity was not significantly associated with headache after full adjustment overall.

36686476.takeaway: In 119 women with GDM and 238 controls, elevated first-trimester serum microcystin-LR was associated with GDM (OR 1.92).

36686477.takeaway: Systematic review of the liver-alpha cell axis examining how glucose alters glucagon and amino acid dynamics in adults and children.

36688726.takeaway: A boy with IGF1R deletion improved in height velocity on 5.7 years of GH, but puberty was delayed and central hypothyroidism persisted.

36689621.takeaway: In 20 youth with high-risk type 1 diabetes switched from injections to advanced hybrid closed loop, HbA1c fell from 10.5% to 7.6% over 3 months.

36691942.takeaway: A young infant with a mosaic PRKACA duplication had early-onset Cushing syndrome, micronodular adrenal hyperplasia and acral cutaneous mucinosis, expanding the phenotype.

36696428.takeaway: In Danish adults from 1997 to 2017, hip fracture rates fell in all groups while vertebral fracture rates rose, and type 1 diabetes kept fracture risk elevated.

36696572.takeaway: Three children with ROHHAD presented at 4 to 6 years with rapid obesity, central hypoventilation and hyperprolactinaemia, and one developed a neuro-endocrine tumour.

36699035.takeaway: Review of early and precocious puberty during COVID-19, which reports more cases and faster puberty progression than in pre-pandemic years.

36700465.takeaway: Median age at menarche among 1,374 Istanbul schoolgirls was 12.04 years, 0.7 years lower than 12 years ago, and was linked to BMI and maternal factors.

36700484.takeaway: In 110 children with type 1 diabetes, family management was better with higher maternal education and income and insulin pump use, but worse with other chronic illness.

36700485.takeaway: Sequencing a 54-gene panel in 16 adolescents with normosmic idiopathic hypogonadotropic hypogonadism sought genetic causes, with protein modelling of variants.

36700969.takeaway: Systematic review of 90 studies (643,217 individuals) examining whether care and outcomes differ by sex in childhood type 1 diabetes.

36704033.takeaway: Among 761 children with type 1 diabetes followed prospectively, 5.5% developed autoimmune thyroid disease, with Graves disease more common than Hashimoto disease.

36704036.takeaway: Pre-pregnancy BMI was examined against depressive symptom scores on PHQ-9 and SCL-90 in 12,099 women at the first antenatal visit.

36704040.takeaway: Wavelet and entropy features of electrohysterogram signals were tested to classify preterm versus term birth in two open-access datasets.

36704042.takeaway: Protocol for a hybrid non-randomised trial testing a digital early-life nutrition resource for parents and childcare staff in Norway.

36710456.takeaway: GnRH analogue treatment improved predicted adult height in 134 Portuguese girls with idiopathic central precocious puberty, whether started before or after age 8.

36710473.takeaway: In 38 men with type 1 diabetes, the U500 insulin aspart formulation acted faster and gave higher early insulin exposure than standard U100 aspart.

36710502.takeaway: Copeptin rose moderately after arginine in 72 children, with peak values falling with age, providing pediatric reference data for AVP deficiency.

36714562.takeaway: Genetic testing of 52 children with diagnosed growth hormone deficiency and familial short stature sought the underlying cause of their growth failure.

36714590.takeaway: Review of glucose sensing and insulin delivery technology for women with pregestational diabetes, with real-time CGM linked to smaller infants and fewer NICU admissions.

36714599.takeaway: Review of growth in girls with Turner syndrome, describing smaller birth size, a sharp early growth decline and the missing pubertal spurt.

36714600.takeaway: Proposes adding glycaemic and physical activity metrics to an algorithm-enabled decision-support tool to help teams prioritise youth with type 1 diabetes for review.

36714602.takeaway: In 32 pregnant women, higher pre-pregnancy BMI was linked to lower urinary cortisol throughout gestation, though its rate of rise was similar across BMI groups.

36714607.takeaway: Mapped methylation at 32 CpG sites in the hypothalamic Mkrn3 promoter of female mice before, during and after puberty.

36714609.takeaway: Compared fetal autonomic responses to uterine contractions in 18 preterm and 19 term active labours using wavelet analysis of heart rate variability.

36715208.takeaway: In 18 matched pairs, adults with prediabetes had significantly different CGM glucose profiles from normoglycaemic peers, including time in range and time above range.

36721956.takeaway: Gonadal tissue from five 46,XY individuals with androgen defects showed foetal-type features, with HSD17B3 expressed in Sertoli cells rather than Leydig cells.

36724764.takeaway: Infants with classical CAH had smaller thalamic volumes than 14 control infants on MRI, and the difference persisted after adjusting for total brain volume.

36725676.takeaway: In 59 girls with Turner syndrome, cortical and trabecular bone density were normal, but bone area was greater than in idiopathic short stature peers, with altered geometry.

36726466.takeaway: Review of the genetic overlap between self-limited delayed puberty and congenital hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, seeking tests that distinguish the two.

36726472.takeaway: Review of PMM2-related congenital hyperinsulinism, a rare subtype with 18 reported families, covering genetics, diagnosis and treatment.

36727420.takeaway: In 80 adolescents with heavy menstrual bleeding at menarche, estrogen treatment was linked to 1.8 cm less height gain over two years than non-hormonal care.

36727475.takeaway: A three-session nurse-led counselling intervention for 50 parents of children with CAH was assessed for stress, stigma, knowledge and treatment adherence.

36728277.takeaway: A 3-year-old Indian boy with severe GH deficiency carried a novel 6 kb homozygous deletion spanning GH1, found by whole genome sequencing.

36728278.takeaway: An 18-year-old girl diagnosed late with Temple syndrome had growth and puberty problems and responded well to dehydrocortisone for hyperandrogenism.

36728292.takeaway: Serum MKRN3 was lower in 92 children with central precocious puberty than in controls, lowest in obese CPP, where it correlated negatively with BMI.

36730530.takeaway: In 105 relatives of people with type 1 diabetes, several CGM metrics, including time above 140 mg/dL, were associated with progression to stage 3 type 1 diabetes.

36730642.takeaway: In 399 young adults with youth-onset diabetes, higher arterial stiffness was associated with worse cardiac structure and function after adjusting for cardiovascular risk factors.

36731507.takeaway: Among 65 Thai youth with diabetes diagnosed before age 15, 12.3% had diabetic neuropathy on nerve conduction study, and all were asymptomatic.

36731508.takeaway: In 19 patients with androgen insensitivity, 74% had complete AIS and 7 of 19 AR variants were novel; one patient with CAIS developed a germ cell tumour at age 30.

36732285.takeaway: Up to five years of once-weekly somatrogon was well tolerated in children with GH deficiency, with height velocity sustained and height SDS improving toward the normal range.

36733529.takeaway: Review of insulin resistance and NAFLD in youth with obesity, describing how adolescent insulin resistance drives hepatic fat and metabolic complications.

36733795.takeaway: Review of pregnancy endocrine changes in healthy women and in pregnancies affected by PCOS, diabetes and obesity, focusing on insulin and androgen excess.

36733803.takeaway: A nomogram based on testicular circ_MGLL expression was built to predict successful sperm retrieval in 114 men with idiopathic non-obstructive azoospermia.

36733807.takeaway: Survey of 155 providers examined how widely gonadal tissue cryopreservation is offered to people with differences of sex development.

36738751.takeaway: In 158 young people with type 2 diabetes, empagliflozin lowered HbA1c by 0.84% more than placebo at 26 weeks, while linagliptin did not differ significantly.

36742384.takeaway: Three retrospective studies in children aged 8 months to 7 years examined whether the adrenal gland contributes to 11-ketotestosterone production before puberty.

36742402.takeaway: Pooled across 46 studies, childhood obesity was associated with a 33% higher hazard of adult cancer incidence and a 28% higher hazard of cancer mortality.

36742409.takeaway: In 46 boys followed through puberty, circulating miR-30b-5p rose with pubertal progression, supporting a role for these microRNAs in GnRH regulation.

36742413.takeaway: Pooled analysis of 12 GEO datasets and 5 articles examined GDF-15 expression in gestational diabetes.

36743911.takeaway: Placentas from 12 women with COVID-19 in pregnancy and 8 controls were compared for type I interferon pathway molecules by immunostaining.

36743912.takeaway: In bullfrog tadpoles and frogs, serum thyroid hormone levels and metabolites were measured across seven metamorphic stages and related to skin gene expression.

36743923.takeaway: One third of 100 caregivers of children with type 1 diabetes reported caregiver burden, with 19% mild and 14% severe.

36743932.takeaway: In 51 adult men with cryptorchidism from idiopathic hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, hormonal therapy achieved testicular descent in 19 of 32, not significantly different from surgery plus hormones (11 of 19).

36746160.takeaway: In 283 children of women with type 2 diabetes, in-utero metformin exposure did not change BMI z-score at 24 months compared with placebo.

36746909.takeaway: A finger-stick dried blood spot TSH method was validated against venous TSH on an automated analyser in 109 outpatients.

36749868.takeaway: In 7,961 children and young adults with type 1 diabetes, severe DKA at diagnosis was linked to higher long-term HbA1c, while insulin pump use predicted lower HbA1c.

36750758.takeaway: Compared glucagon stimulation and low-dose ACTH tests for diagnosing secondary adrenal insufficiency in 120 children with short stature.

36755913.takeaway: In 11 adolescents, dual-hormone closed loop did not reduce time below range compared with insulin-only closed loop over 26 hours.

36755920.takeaway: Review of CGM for childhood hypoglycaemia beyond type 1 diabetes, noting growing evidence but less certainty for rare hypoglycaemia disorders.

36758572.takeaway: Once-weekly basal insulin Fc was compared with insulin degludec in adults with type 2 diabetes previously on basal insulin over 32 weeks.

36758969.takeaway: Korean children with Turner syndrome were compared with age- and sex-matched controls on neurocognitive and psychosocial testing.

36758970.takeaway: Pooled analysis of 7 studies with 5,870 children estimated the prevalence of vitamin D deficiency in Indonesian children and adolescents.

36758971.takeaway: In 86 girls with idiopathic central precocious puberty, fixed and weight-based leuprolide dosing both suppressed puberty and gave final adult heights of about 161 cm.

36758973.takeaway: Five Korean adolescents with type 2 diabetes treated with once-weekly dulaglutide were reviewed for effects and side effects.

36758974.takeaway: Nationwide data on 210,902 Korean children compared height, weight and BMI over six years between those short and not short at age 3.

36761190.takeaway: Adiponectin did not differ between 101 sedentary and 100 endurance-trained Japanese women aged 18 to 23, but was linked to regional fat and insulin sensitivity.

36761200.takeaway: Bibliometric analysis of MAFLD publications from 2012 to 2021, identifying research hotspots and future directions.

36763040.takeaway: Survey of 324 women with premature ovarian insufficiency described how many built a family after diagnosis and which options they chose.

36763343.takeaway: In 111 children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, most achieved the main glycaemic targets after six months on MiniMed 780G in auto mode.

36763345.takeaway: Over 52 weeks, open-source automated insulin delivery kept time in range 12.2% higher than sensor-augmented pump therapy, reaching 69.1% versus 56.9%.

36777352.takeaway: Systematic review of 17 published cases of antithyroid drug-induced aplastic anaemia, 16 in women, examining presentation and outcome.

36777355.takeaway: In 52 pregnant women, galactooligosaccharide supplementation was tested against placebo for feasibility and effects on gut microbiota and metabolic markers.

36777356.takeaway: After one year, Tandem Control-IQ and MiniMed 780G both maintained the glycaemic improvement seen at one month in 74 Italian people with type 1 diabetes.

36777357.takeaway: Review of how low nephron number at birth, shaped by maternal malnutrition, may predispose to chronic kidney disease in later life.

36780885.takeaway: A 16-year-old boy with Hashimoto hypothyroidism presented with rhabdomyolysis, a rare complication, and the paediatric literature is reviewed.

36788666.takeaway: An infant developed iatrogenic Cushing syndrome after topical betamethasone cream for nappy rash, the first such case reported with that cream.

36788726.takeaway: A Lean Six Sigma bundle of provider education, faster A1c results and an EHR order set aimed to increase A1c testing in hospitalised adults with diabetes.

36790068.takeaway: In 50 women with acromegaly, menstrual disturbances were reported in 58% at diagnosis and 37% were infertile, with disturbances linked to higher IGF-I.

36790875.takeaway: In 153 people without diabetes, mean glucose management indicator was 0.59% higher than laboratory HbA1c, so GMI overestimated HbA1c.

36791687.takeaway: In 103 children on GnRH agonists for precocious puberty or gender dysphoria, suppression occurred in all but 2, and labs may be unnecessary if exams are used.

36792927.takeaway: Thyroid morphology and function were characterised in 103 adults diagnosed with congenital hypothyroidism through newborn screening, with a low fT3/fT4 ratio in dysgenesis.

36793270.takeaway: In 296 women with PCOS, pretreatment with drospirenone-ethinylestradiol before ovulation induction was associated with fewer adverse pregnancy and neonatal outcomes.

36793286.takeaway: Cardiorespiratory fitness was measured by exercise testing in 19 adolescents and young adults with Klinefelter syndrome, aged 9 to 25.

36793288.takeaway: In 151 women with gestational diabetes, metformin was linked to caesarean birth versus diet, though not after adjusting for elective caesareans; insulin-treated women had most small-for-gestational-age infants.

36794424.takeaway: Compared GH replacement started within 12 months of craniopharyngioma treatment with later starts in 71 children, examining progression or recurrence risk.

36794655.takeaway: Of 118 children with congenital hypothyroidism, 86% had developmental outcomes appropriate for age, and 14% had delays.

36794745.takeaway: A 22-month-old boy with Wiedemann-Steiner syndrome developed hypophosphataemic rickets, probably from low phosphate intake on elemental formula.

36794751.takeaway: A boy with a giant arachnoid cyst and hypothalamic injury developed reset osmostat, causing chronic hyponatraemia.

36794818.takeaway: In 202 people with type 1 diabetes, adults had higher HbA1c and lower time in range than children, and the glycaemia risk index was lower in children.

36794864.takeaway: Serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D was compared among 51 children with MIS-C, 57 with COVID-19 and 60 controls, to see whether levels predict MIS-C severity.

36794870.takeaway: Among 79 adolescent girls with abnormal uterine bleeding, 85% had menstrual irregularity in the two years after menarche, and 80% had anovulation.

36795602.takeaway: In 28 children with monosymptomatic nocturnal enuresis, baseline copeptin ratio improved prediction of response to desmopressin.

36798001.takeaway: Of 111 children with congenital hypothyroidism and an in-situ gland, 51% had transient disease, with prematurity, twin birth, low birth weight and low Apgar predicting it.

36798486.takeaway: Expert panel from seven European countries shares practice-based advice on burosumab for children with X-linked hypophosphataemia, covering patient selection and dosing.

36798662.takeaway: Neonatal thyroid function was measured in 57 offspring of women exposed to oil-based iodinated contrast within six months before conception.

36798669.takeaway: Prevalence and clustering of cardiometabolic risk factors were examined across BMI strata in 5 to 17-year-olds with overweight or class 1 obesity in an Israeli health organisation.

36800681.takeaway: Two unrelated 46,XX girls with combined 17-hydroxylase/17,20-lyase deficiency presented at 15 and 16 with amenorrhoea and hypergonadotropic hypogonadism.

36800682.takeaway: Among 92 children with type 1 diabetes, 47% avoided out-of-school leisure activity and 52% avoided activity during breaks, with fear of hypoglycaemia linked to avoidance.

36802847.takeaway: Among 5,930 preterm newborns screened for congenital hypothyroidism in Piedmont, the study examined whether a targeted screening strategy by birthweight is needed.

36806217.takeaway: In 109 women diagnosed with non-classical CAH in childhood, adult height fell short of target height.

36806620.takeaway: In 26 patients with PPARG-related lipodystrophy, diabetes and partial lipodystrophy were near-universal, with hypertriglyceridaemia, steatosis and hypertension common.

36810205.takeaway: In 944 young people with type 1 diabetes, WHO-5 well-being scores below 13 were associated with psychiatric comorbidity, particularly depression and ADHD, and poorer metabolic control.

36810613.takeaway: Genetic analysis of 59,655 Taiwanese females identified 27 novel loci shared between age at menarche and cardiometabolic traits, with hypertension as a link.

36810692.takeaway: Among childhood brain tumour survivors, advanced puberty occurred in 65% with untreated suprasellar glioma, and chemotherapy for medulloblastoma caused gonadal toxicity in 70%.

36812420.takeaway: Narrative review of youth-onset type 2 diabetes epidemiology, showing rising prevalence and incidence and an aggressive course compared with type 1 diabetes.

36812896.takeaway: A novel heterozygous CASR mutation caused autosomal dominant hypocalcaemia type 1 in seven members of a three-generation family.

36814577.takeaway: In 235 Sri Lankan children with type 1 diabetes, 79.1% were positive on the 3-Screen assay, and autoantibodies were also measured in unaffected siblings.

36814831.takeaway: Review of metformin in paediatric type 2 diabetes, covering its mechanisms, evidence for use in children, and effects on comorbidities.

36815512.takeaway: A newborn with hypernatraemia initially responded to desmopressin, then became unresponsive, pointing to congenital nephrogenic diabetes insipidus rather than central DI.

36817604.takeaway: Review of alkaline phosphatase in childhood, focusing on its use as a marker of rickets and bone mineralisation.

36817608.takeaway: Children with Down syndrome had higher antibody levels to bovine serum albumin than controls, which can confound insulin autoantibody assays.

36817610.takeaway: Remote glucose monitoring of youth with type 1 diabetes through a commercial population-health platform was shown to be feasible for patients and providers.

36818463.takeaway: In a randomised community trial in Iran of 28,771 pregnant women, one-step and two-step GDM screening were compared for prevalence and maternal and neonatal outcomes.

36819461.takeaway: Thirty ambulatory children with cerebral palsy had higher total and LDL cholesterol than matched typically developing controls.

36822744.takeaway: Rare heterozygous PCSK1 variants were examined in case-control data from French cohorts to assess their contribution to obesity risk.

36824585.takeaway: UK national surveys examined access to continuous glucose monitoring for children with recurrent hypoglycaemia who do not have diabetes.

36825476.takeaway: Two Turkish siblings with transaldolase deficiency had early-onset hypergonadotropic hypogonadism alongside liver, skin and cardiac involvement.

36826996.takeaway: Open-source AndroidAPS was tested in 16 adolescents and young adults with type 1 diabetes across three closed-loop scenarios, examining safety and feasibility.

36829271.takeaway: Epicardial fat thickness was compared in 38 youths with overweight or obesity and type 1 diabetes and 34 without type 1 diabetes.

36840481.takeaway: In 1,826 Chinese children followed prospectively, gut microbial enterotype was associated with puberty timing, with the link depending on age and body composition.

36840616.takeaway: In 46,043 people with type 1 diabetes in German-speaking registries, automated insulin delivery use rose from 3.5% to 16.6% between 2018 and 2021.

36843089.takeaway: Mendelian randomisation links childhood adiposity to all adult diabetes subtypes except mild age-related diabetes, most strongly to mild obesity-related diabetes (OR 7.3).

36843220.takeaway: Shear wave elastography stiffness rose with Hashimoto's stage in 130 children, from 9.6 kPa at stage 1 to 17.9 kPa at stage 3, versus 7.4 kPa in controls.

36843296.takeaway: Review of pathogenesis, clinical signs, investigation and management of nutritional rickets, a major global problem from vitamin D or calcium deficiency.

36843332.takeaway: A 31-month-old boy with drug-resistant epilepsy and developmental delay carried a novel ALG11 variant, causing a congenital glycosylation disorder.

36843579.takeaway: In 72 adolescent girls with PCOS, serum follistatin responded differently to randomised treatments, including oral contraception and insulin-sensitising regimens.

36843583.takeaway: In porcine prepubertal Sertoli cells, zinc counteracted cadmium-induced dysfunction through the Nrf2 pathway.

36843590.takeaway: In 34 patients with trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole-induced hypoglycaemia, most had renal dysfunction, and 97% had neuroglycopenic symptoms.

36843598.takeaway: In 2,188 US children aged 8 to 19, blood lead was positively associated with serum SHBG in females, particularly at higher lead quartiles.

36843601.takeaway: Literature review of case reports of thyroid hormone resistance coexisting with pituitary tumours, summarising clinical features and gene mutations to aid diagnosis.

36843603.takeaway: In 725 children with obesity, a SPISE cut-off of 5.4 predicted metabolic syndrome and insulin resistance, supporting it as a screening tool.

36843617.takeaway: Systematic review of growth hormone treatment effects on body composition in children with GH deficiency, assessing lean and fat mass changes.

36843618.takeaway: Review of glucocorticoid treatment monitoring in childhood 21-hydroxylase deficiency, aiming to maintain growth and maturation while suppressing androgens.

36846213.takeaway: In 703 children with short stature, whether a single IGF-1 measurement could replace a second growth hormone stimulation test was evaluated.

36857103.takeaway: In 709 children with craniopharyngioma, 45% had severe obesity at last visit, and survival and quality of life varied with age at diagnosis.

36859827.takeaway: In 251 infants under four months, random serum cortisol was compared between those with and without central adrenal insufficiency to find a diagnostic cut-off.

36860362.takeaway: Prevalence of suspected or incipient adrenal crisis was investigated in 51 children with adrenal insufficiency, by hydrocortisone formulation and treatment modality.

36860373.takeaway: In 439 six-year-old Korean children in an iodine-replete area, the relationship between urinary iodine excess and thyroid function was examined.

36862161.takeaway: A type 2 diabetes polygenic score was tested alongside clinical variables to predict diabetes incidence in birth, youth and adult cohorts of an Indigenous population.

36862942.takeaway: In 16,709 children with genetic risk for type 1 diabetes, 62% of the 865 with multiple islet autoantibodies progressed to diabetes, with risk depending on how positivity was defined.

36864831.takeaway: In 24 children having growth hormone stimulation tests, gene expression data with a random forest model were explored to predict GH deficiency status.

36864832.takeaway: In ex vivo human placenta, inhibiting diacylglycerol lipase beta altered lipid and endocannabinoid levels.

36864842.takeaway: In 16 Chinese patients from eight families with familial dysalbuminaemic hyperthyroxinaemia, half had earlier been misdiagnosed as hyperthyroid.

36867433.takeaway: In 7,770 genetically high-risk children, a U-shaped link between iron intake and islet autoimmunity appeared, with high intake raising risk in those with multiple iron risk alleles.

36868256.takeaway: Population-based SEARCH data over 2002 to 2018 quantify the incidence of youth-onset type 1 and type 2 diabetes in the USA.

36869831.takeaway: In 13 boys with Prader-Willi syndrome, lean body mass increased normally during spontaneous or induced puberty.

36869837.takeaway: In 73 mother-infant pairs, infants of mothers with gestational diabetes had lower gut microbial diversity at 6 months than controls.

36875449.takeaway: Six-month triptorelin in children with central precocious puberty was assessed for effects on predicted adult height and gonadotropin levels over 18 months.

36875471.takeaway: In 14,998 biparous women, prepregnancy overweight or obesity and prior GDM were each independently associated with GDM in a later pregnancy.

36875483.takeaway: Cord blood myostatin did not differ between GDM and euglycaemic pregnancies, but was higher in male than female newborns.

36875486.takeaway: Review of cellular mechanisms by which indoor and outdoor air pollution damages the placenta and affects pregnancy outcomes.

36879296.takeaway: In 99 girls with early breast development, serum kisspeptin, neurokinin B and inhibin B helped distinguish central precocious puberty from premature thelarche.

36879468.takeaway: In Dehal1-knockout mice, iodotyrosines were biomarkers for early stages of iodine-deficient hypothyroidism.

36879470.takeaway: Glucose oxidase test strips showed a bias within about 5% across oxygen partial pressures in capillary blood from 975 subjects.

36880866.takeaway: In 25 children aged 2 to 6 with type 1 diabetes, closed-loop insulin delivery with faster aspart was compared with standard aspart in two 8-week periods.

36881937.takeaway: Among 231,575 Chinese children surveyed in 2017 to 2019, Tanner 2 breast development and menarche occurred at similar ages to ten years earlier.

36883204.takeaway: MKRN3 sequencing in 102 Turkish children with central precocious puberty found possible pathogenic variants in only 3, two of them novel.

36883290.takeaway: Diabetes stigma was examined against HbA1c, treatment plan and complications in 1,608 adolescents and young adults with diabetes.

36883760.takeaway: Thyroid shear wave elastography was compared in 46 children with type 1 diabetes and normal thyroid ultrasound and 46 healthy controls.

36890856.takeaway: A novel pathogenic TBX19 variant was found in patients with isolated ACTH deficiency from distinct families of a common geographic origin.

36891055.takeaway: In 98,658 Chinese adults, outdoor light-at-night exposure was associated with obesity in a sex- and age-specific pattern.

36896176.takeaway: In 235 men with non-obstructive azoospermia, artificial oocyte activation after micro-TESE and ICSI was assessed for embryo development and live birth.

36896180.takeaway: In pediatric thyroid tumours, DICER1 RNase IIIb mutations caused widespread microRNA dysregulation and MAPK pathway activation.

36896184.takeaway: In a prospective cohort of 844 pregnant women, second-trimester thyroid hormone and free carnitine levels were associated with lower neonatal birth weight.

36905085.takeaway: Of 156 women with Turner syndrome, 5.8% had a recorded cancer diagnosis, with a range of tumour types, compared with population data.

36907892.takeaway: Genetic association analysis in 1,105 children with recent-onset type 1 diabetes validated plasma N-glycosylation loci and implicated complement genes.

36909337.takeaway: Breakfast-skipping was examined against prediabetes, defined as HbA1c 5.6 to 6.4%, in 1,510 Japanese eighth graders.

36909340.takeaway: A nomogram of early-pregnancy risk factors was developed in 824 Chinese women and validated in 392 others to predict later gestational diabetes.

36909343.takeaway: In a pilot randomised trial, a prebiotic was tested in youth with type 2 diabetes to reduce metformin gastrointestinal side effects, looking at feasibility and tolerability.

36909344.takeaway: Blinded and unblinded intermittently scanned CGM were compared for glycaemic control in 273 adults with type 1 diabetes over 12 weeks.

36912009.takeaway: Updated family conflict, responsibility and communication surveys with CGM items were psychometrically evaluated in youth with type 1 diabetes and their parents.

36913250.takeaway: In 42 children with obesity and vitamin D deficiency, 12 weeks of daily vitamin D was compared with no supplementation during a weight-loss programme.

36913487.takeaway: In 68 children with type 1 diabetes in Burkina Faso, HbA1c was compared across regular with NPH, premix and regular with premix insulin regimens.

36914759.takeaway: Perspective on managing early stage 3 type 1 diabetes in people who do not yet need insulin, with treatment aimed at delaying insulin dependence.

36916130.takeaway: Clinical approach to central precocious puberty, covering its definition, secular trends, and diagnosis and management.

36916482.takeaway: Screening 84 children with central precocious puberty identified eight MKRN3 mutations in nine girls, five of them novel, with distinct effects on ubiquitination.

36916886.takeaway: Post-hoc analysis of two randomised trials in 615 pregnant women with PCOS examined whether metformin alters maternal serum cytokine profiles.

36917647.takeaway: In 43 Finnish men with APECED, spontaneous puberty began at a median age of 13.3 years, and hypogonadism needed treatment in 14%.

36919239.takeaway: An 11-year-old girl with autoimmune polyglandular syndrome type 2 had Addison disease, coeliac disease and thyroid autoimmunity, diagnosed after a delay.

36919680.takeaway: Review arguing for continuous glucose monitoring in gestational diabetes among Medicaid-insured women, citing maternal and child risks of elevated glycaemia.

36923219.takeaway: In a multicentre cohort of pregnancies, thyroid autoimmunity was examined against pregnancy complications, with dose-dependent effects of thyroid autoantibodies.

36923225.takeaway: A young woman with metastatic pancreatic neuroendocrine tumour and a JAK2 mutation had portal vein thrombosis, and later had successful pregnancies.

36924297.takeaway: Meta-analysis of 21 studies found isolated hypothyroxinaemia in pregnancy linked to increased preterm and other adverse outcomes, with only four studies on levothyroxine.

36926023.takeaway: In rodents, neonatal testosterone abolished the usual sex differences in microglia morphology and behaviour.

36926037.takeaway: In rats, a maternal high-fat diet lowered breast milk endocannabinoids and produced sex-specific changes in offspring reward signalling and food preference.

36926039.takeaway: At one Rome paediatric endocrine centre, female precocious puberty consultations were compared across COVID-19 pandemic phases with the same months in other years.

36927054.takeaway: In 60 children with type 1 diabetes, hybrid closed loop was compared with sensor-augmented pump therapy to see whether it offsets missed or suboptimal meal boluses.

36928113.takeaway: In a cohort of 3-year-old children, early-life factors across the first 1,000 days were examined against metabolic phenotypes of obesity.

36929171.takeaway: In mice, islets transplanted into a biodegradable matrix under the skin formed vascular networks and reversed diabetes for over 150 days.

36930527.takeaway: Youth with CAH perceived emotions differently from 35 matched controls, and these differences related to brain volumes in emotion-processing regions.

36935567.takeaway: Peripheral arterial disease was assessed by ankle-brachial index in 45 Nigerian children with type 1 diabetes and 45 matched healthy controls.

36935568.takeaway: In 44 children after craniopharyngioma surgery, GH replacement raised growth velocity and height SDS from -3.20 to -1.51 by 36 months.

36935580.takeaway: A 7-year-old boy with autosomal dominant hypocalcaemia type 1 and intellectual disability is reported, alongside a review of 17 Chinese cases.

36936139.takeaway: Pooled analysis of 22 studies with 4,639 parents estimates the prevalence of depression among parents of children with type 1 diabetes.

36936144.takeaway: In 100 girls and women with Turner syndrome counselled for fertility preservation over 1999 to 2021, referral trends and outcomes were tracked.

36936146.takeaway: Retrospective review of the first 25 thyroidectomies in children aged 5 to 17 at a reference adult thyroid centre, covering indications and nerve monitoring.

36936151.takeaway: In 88 young adults with childhood-onset type 1 diabetes, HR-pQCT bone measures were compared with healthy controls and linked to risk factors.

36936152.takeaway: A prepubertal child with non-classic CAH was treated with anastrozole monotherapy instead of hydrocortisone.

36936154.takeaway: Breast milk hormones were measured over the first month in 48 women, 30 at term and 18 preterm, and related to maternal body composition, diet and infant growth.

36936161.takeaway: In infants followed from birth to 12 months, circulating meteorin-like levels were associated with active brown adipose tissue in early infancy.

36936162.takeaway: A man with Culler-Jones syndrome, first suspected to be Kallmann syndrome, had a novel GLI2 variant confirmed by sequencing.

36936713.takeaway: In a 5-year registry of 14,295 children on growth hormone for deficiency, Turner, Noonan or Prader-Willi syndromes, height SDS rose over time in all groups.

36938582.takeaway: Repeat HbA1c measurements in people at risk of dysglycaemia were more variable in youth than adults, with HbA1c the most reproducible measure.

36939558.takeaway: In UK Biobank and a Korean cohort, earlier age at type 2 diabetes diagnosis was associated with higher cardiovascular risk, with genetic risk effects strongest in those diagnosed youngest.

36943299.takeaway: In 240 mother-father-child trios from a pre-birth cohort, mother-daughter BMI and fat mass associations were positive.

36943311.takeaway: In 58 patients with MEN1, SSTR PET/CT detected three times as many pancreatic NETs as conventional imaging and changed management in 47%.

36947076.takeaway: Placental LRP5 and sclerostin were higher in gestational diabetes pregnancies than in controls.

36947589.takeaway: Across 2,377 girls with Turner syndrome treated with Norditropin, early GH was effective and well tolerated over up to 10 years, including 1,513 treatment-naive girls.

36947630.takeaway: Review of long-term outcomes after adolescent metabolic and bariatric surgery, which achieves substantial, sustained weight loss and improves associated conditions.

36948219.takeaway: Age-specific reference intervals for free T3 in children were derived, showing that 26% of children with normal TSH had FT3 outside the adult range.

36950738.takeaway: Review of how steroid biomarkers should be interpreted in 21-hydroxylase deficiency to titrate glucocorticoid treatment and balance androgen excess.

36950879.takeaway: Glycaemic patterns during the antenatal OGTT were explored as markers of GDM subtypes in 867 pregnant women with obesity from the UPBEAT trial.

36957988.takeaway: Nine Indian children with Laron dwarfism were extremely short, with a male predominance and diagnosis at a mean age of 3 years.

36958868.takeaway: Type 1 diabetes incidence in Finnish children under 15 during the first 18 months of COVID-19 was compared with pre-pandemic periods, to test whether SARS-CoV-2 drove any increase.

36964264.takeaway: In 1-year-old infants in a Swedish cohort, gut microbial composition differed between 16 children who later developed type 1 diabetes and matched controls, up to 20 years before diagnosis.

36967753.takeaway: Three probands and an elder brother with WFS1 variants had varied features, including dilated cardiomyopathy, with RNA sequencing used for comparison.

36967781.takeaway: In girls with central precocious puberty treated with GnRH analogues, the leptin to adiponectin ratio at diagnosis was studied as a predictor of weight gain at treatment end.

36971427.takeaway: Male adolescents with obesity had lower 12,13-diHOME than normal-weight peers, and the acute exercise response was measured in 28 of them.

36972018.takeaway: Among 262 at-risk Latino children with obesity, faster beta-cell function decline and adiposity gain were associated with conversion to type 2 diabetes.

36972207.takeaway: A 15-year-old girl with medium-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase deficiency presented with severe hypocalcaemia from hypoparathyroidism, a rare coexistence.

36972563.takeaway: Two children with hypercortisolism, a 9-year-old girl and a 13-year-old boy, showed cerebral cortical atrophy on MRI, a manifestation that may be overlooked.

36974356.takeaway: Two siblings with 4H leukodystrophy were described; the first also had hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, Hashimoto thyroiditis and type 1 diabetes.

36974729.takeaway: Weight-based and body surface area-based growth hormone dosing were compared in children with idiopathic GH deficiency to see which avoids under- or over-dosing.

36977392.takeaway: An 11-year-old girl with suprasellar tuberculoma developed hypothalamic obesity with pituitary dysfunction, which reversed after antituberculosis treatment.

36977395.takeaway: In 13 children with Temple syndrome, five years of growth hormone raised height SDS from -1.78 to 0.11, with reduced fat mass percentage.

36987773.takeaway: Adolescents made up 1.3% (23 of 1,897) of differentiated thyroid cancer patients treated with radioiodine at one centre, with a female to male ratio of 3.6 to 1.

36987787.takeaway: Adverse events after COVID-19 vaccination were compared between adolescents with endocrine disorders and healthy controls aged 12 to 18.

36987788.takeaway: Clinical features and treatment of 53 Turkish adolescents with gender dysphoria referred to a paediatric endocrine clinic from 2016 to 2022 were reviewed.

36987789.takeaway: DKA at presentation was similar in new-onset type 1 diabetes before and during the COVID-19 pandemic in 199 Turkish children, at 58% during the pandemic.

36987810.takeaway: A 16-year-old with a 46,XX karyotype and SRY double positivity had a Leydig cell tumour, a rare outcome without Y chromosome material.

36988326.takeaway: Infants with in-utero COVID-19 exposure gained weight faster over the first year than 127 unexposed controls.

36990068.takeaway: In a three-generation Chinese family with tricho-rhino-phalangeal syndrome I, whole-exome sequencing identified a TRPS1 variant, and growth hormone treatment was described.

36995872.takeaway: Four-year follow-up of weekly somapacitan in 50 children with GH deficiency who completed treatment, assessing efficacy, safety and treatment burden.

36998477.takeaway: Storage duration of vitrified embryos did not affect pregnancy or neonatal outcomes after frozen-thawed embryo transfer in this cohort.

36999890.takeaway: A statistical method adjusting for CGM wear time was applied to two six-month CGM trials, estimating the effect of full-time use alongside intent-to-treat analyses.

37000680.takeaway: In a randomised trial of 326 adults and children with type 1 diabetes, the insulin-only bionic pancreas lowered HbA1c by about 0.5% versus standard care, similarly in White and minority participants.

37004710.takeaway: In a population-based cohort of children and young adults with type 1 diabetes across 511 centres, continuous glucose monitoring was compared with blood glucose monitoring for severe hypoglycaemia and ketoacidosis.

37006164.takeaway: In 68 healthy children and adolescents, hydration status measured by urine specific gravity was examined against body fat and lean mass on DEXA.

37008898.takeaway: In 2,048 women with gestational diabetes, HbA1c of 5.5% or higher was associated with macrosomia, pregnancy-induced hypertension, preterm birth and caesarean section.

37008909.takeaway: Review of transition from paediatric to adult care for young people with metabolic bone diseases, as survival and adult life expectancy improve.

37008922.takeaway: In focus groups with 33 parents of children with isolated GH deficiency or idiopathic short stature, 26 reported mental stress from their child's growth disorder.

37008928.takeaway: Among 1,718 overweight or obese adults with first-episode, drug-naive major depression, risk factors for elevated fasting glucose were identified.

37008933.takeaway: In prepubertal mice, cryopreserved testicular tissue cultured in vitro was compared with fresh tissue for gene expression across the first spermatogenic wave.

37008942.takeaway: Four years of growth hormone plus a GnRH analogue were given to early pubertal girls with poor predicted height, with adult height followed in a case-control design.

37008947.takeaway: A real-time automated bone age system based on the RUS-CHN method was developed to estimate bone age from hand radiographs with less computation.

37008950.takeaway: In 104 patients with 21-hydroxylase deficiency from Slovakia and Slovenia, 64% had the salt-wasting form, and genotype was analysed against phenotype.

37008954.takeaway: In a human embryonic stem cell model of trophoblast, VTCN1/B7-H4 guided differentiation and suppressed inflammatory responses and MHC class I expression.

37011183.takeaway: Eight observational studies of GCK-MODY pregnancies were pooled to examine congenital anomaly risk and its link with fetal genotype.

37011646.takeaway: Among 177,241 Israeli women screened in pregnancy, varying degrees of glucose intolerance were examined for later risk of type 2 diabetes in young adulthood.

37013724.takeaway: Internet addiction scores were lower in 139 children with type 1 diabetes than in 273 controls during COVID-19.

37015214.takeaway: A 12-year-old boy with GH deficiency and obesity developed transient severe hyperglycaemia to 500 mg/dL during weekly lonapegsomatropin treatment.

37015215.takeaway: Reviews why orchidopexy is needed in boys with congenital hypogonadotropic hypogonadism and cryptorchidism, and when to perform it, given fertility and testicular cancer concerns.

37015775.takeaway: Review of ciliopathies, multi-organ genetic disorders, with focus on endocrine features and emerging genes and therapies.

37015776.takeaway: GnRH agonist treatment was analysed for final height preservation in 40 girls with central precocious puberty and 206 with early puberty, comparing predicted adult height.

37017079.takeaway: Among 251 children with obesity, surrogates of metabolic syndrome were compared between metabolically healthy and metabolically unhealthy obesity.

37018448.takeaway: In 458 girls followed from birth, plasma insulin at birth and in childhood was associated with the timing of menarche.

37019085.takeaway: Among 256 children born small for gestational age with persistent short stature treated with GH, genetic causes were sought in 176 with complete trio DNA.

37023293.takeaway: In 1,455 youth with type 1 diabetes at one centre, CGM use rose from 33% to 75% and hybrid closed loop use from 0.3% to 28%, with A1C falling from 8.9% to 8.6%.

37025410.takeaway: MRI porosity and suppression ratios of the tibial cortex were compared across normal, osteopenic and osteoporotic women.

37025411.takeaway: Among 212 anaemic term pregnant women in southern India, placental pathology and neonatal outcomes after COVID-19 were compared.

37025412.takeaway: Mendelian randomisation analysis examined whether earlier age at menarche causally relates to benign and malignant oesophageal neoplasia.

37025415.takeaway: Lipocalin-2 gene variants were screened in patients with anorexia nervosa or obesity and in lean people, with serum lipocalin-2 measured in variant carriers.

37026186.takeaway: An electronic dashboard was used to monitor diabetes management activities in children with type 1 diabetes at one hospital, to see whether this improves outcomes.

37029788.takeaway: Copeptin was measured in 29 critically ill infants and children with hypo- or hypernatraemia, 38% of them after neurosurgery for tumours or trauma.

37029975.takeaway: Meta-analysis of circulating CTRP9 in adults with type 2 diabetes, reassessing contradictory findings with and without complications.

37029976.takeaway: Review linking accelerated early growth, SGA catch-up growth and early puberty to metabolic syndrome, type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular risk in children.

37033213.takeaway: Ankle motion, power and quality of life were assessed in people with X-linked hypophosphataemia, showing reduced function.

37033216.takeaway: BoneXpert automated bone age showed root mean squared error of about 0.5 to 0.7 years against manual assessment in 1,202 children.

37033220.takeaway: Among 1,574 US adolescents in NHANES, the association between family income-to-poverty ratio and hepatic steatosis was examined using elastography.

37033222.takeaway: Hospital casebooks and programme statistics from Tanzania suggest type 1 diabetes incidence in children is low, possibly because many cases go undiagnosed.

37033233.takeaway: Meta-analysis of obstetric and neonatal outcomes after hysteroscopic adhesiolysis for intrauterine adhesions.

37033242.takeaway: Systematic review of pure androgen-secreting adrenal tumours in adults found mostly women with hirsutism as the commonest symptom, with incidence peaking at age 21 to 30.

37033247.takeaway: An audit of New Zealand monogenic diabetes testing evaluated diagnostic yield, referral by the MODY calculator, and referral equity for Māori and Pacific people.

37033270.takeaway: In a prospective cohort of 729 college students moving into adulthood, poorer sleep patterns were associated with metabolic disorder.

37040724.takeaway: Children and young people with cystic fibrosis-related diabetes showed improved glucose control after starting elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor.

37040726.takeaway: In 1,408 French children born SGA treated with GH in a real-world study, GH dose modulation was examined against final height.

37042746.takeaway: Clinical, molecular and biochemical features of patients with GM1-gangliosidosis were described, including novel GLB1 mutations.

37042760.takeaway: Clinical findings and follow-up in patients with several congenital disorders of glycosylation over 15 years showed multi-organ involvement with unusual presentations.

37043499.takeaway: In 155 people with 47,XXY, testicular development rose to Tanner stage 4 and then regressed, showing the natural history of testicular dysfunction.

37043518.takeaway: In Danish registries from 1996 to 2020, 128 children with congenital combined pituitary hormone deficiency were identified, 69% of them male, with a median of three deficiencies at diagnosis.

37043887.takeaway: In SEARCH, retinopathy prevalence and progression were tracked in 2,519 youth-onset type 1 and 447 type 2 diabetes participants, with modifiable risk factors identified.

37051202.takeaway: In children with pathology-confirmed thyroid nodules, the diagnostic efficacy and unnecessary fine-needle aspiration rate of ACR TI-RADS and ATA systems were compared.

37053526.takeaway: In 112 people using a Guardian CGM, body composition measures did not significantly affect sensor accuracy.

37054683.takeaway: Mini-review of nutritional assessment in the workup of growth failure, highlighting birth size and early feeding history as clues to deficits or genetic causes.

37056671.takeaway: In 193 GDM pregnancies, maternal and cord blood predictors of infant anthropometry to one year were assessed.

37056673.takeaway: In male rat offspring exposed to androgens in pregnancy, leptin and NPY pathways were studied as drivers of puberty onset.

37056677.takeaway: Review proposes that puberty induction in Turner syndrome could begin earlier, with lower-dose oestrogen than current practice.

37056678.takeaway: Review of KATP channel mutations in congenital hyperinsulinism, covering progress and challenges toward mechanism-based therapies.

37058353.takeaway: In nationwide Danish data, children were not at higher risk of type 1 diabetes 30 days or more after a positive SARS-CoV-2 test (HR 0.85).

37060353.takeaway: An 8-year-old girl with Graves disease presented with chorea and was also found to have acute rheumatic fever, managed as thyroid storm.

37060356.takeaway: In 323 adolescent girls with overweight or obesity, NAFLD prevalence was 19.1%, and it rose with type 2 diabetes among those with PCOS.

37061810.takeaway: In 813 healthy infants in a vitamin D trial, alkaline phosphatase was higher in boys, and its links with growth, infections and bone were examined.

37065743.takeaway: In porcine prepubertal Sertoli cells, nickel oxide nanoparticles were tested at subtoxic doses after acute and chronic exposure, to assess oxidative stress and male infertility risk.

37065748.takeaway: A family with two 46,XY patients with differences of sex development had a novel DHX37 mutation identified by exome sequencing.

37065759.takeaway: Review asks whether obesity can precipitate type 1 diabetes in children and young people, given the rising incidence of both conditions.

37065762.takeaway: Review of syndromic forms of congenital hyperinsulinism, where hypoglycaemia occurs alongside other features of a genetic syndrome.

37065767.takeaway: In 805 youths with overweight or obesity, central sensitivity to thyroid hormones was lower in those with impaired glucose tolerance or fasting glucose.

37067353.takeaway: Pooled RCT data from 369 people aged 2 to 72 with type 1 diabetes showed Control-IQ raised time in range by about 11.5% compared with control.

37071665.takeaway: Executive function and behavioural problems were compared in 50 adolescents with obesity and 50 matched controls, with insulin resistance examined as a factor.

37071811.takeaway: Adolescents who were physically active had adequate food choices regardless of maturation stage or adiposity.

37071846.takeaway: Three children with ABCC8-related MODY switched from insulin to sulphonylurea therapy, and the time needed to reach good metabolic control was examined.

37074078.takeaway: Pituitary stalk interruption syndrome in newborns can cause life-threatening combined pituitary insufficiency, and early recognition of its signs is needed.

37074092.takeaway: A seminoma arose in a patient with 46,XY complete gonadal dysgenesis (Swyer syndrome), highlighting germ cell tumour risk in gonadal dysgenesis.

37074093.takeaway: A 13-year-old girl with thyroid storm developed pancytopenia during sepsis, with features similar to methimazole-induced pancytopenia.

37074094.takeaway: A preterm infant with diazoxide-unresponsive hyperinsulinaemic hypoglycaemia had a heterozygous insulin receptor gene mutation, a mild form of insulin resistance.

37074225.takeaway: Endocrine findings in 17 patients with 22q11.2 deletion syndrome were reviewed, including hypoparathyroidism, diagnosed at a median of 45 days of age.

37074226.takeaway: Islet autoimmunity was found in 10.6% of 161 children with autoimmune thyroid disease, versus 1.9% of 155 controls.

37075730.takeaway: Systematic review and meta-analysis of 25 studies (1,433 children) examined whether growth hormone treatment changes pubertal timing.

37076640.takeaway: In 1.28 million Danish people followed into early adulthood, childhood adversity was examined as a risk factor for type 2 diabetes.

37077353.takeaway: In female rats, perinatal ketoconazole exposure altered hypothalamic control of puberty.

37077363.takeaway: Eight girls with rare diseases underwent ovarian tissue cryopreservation at China's largest cryobank, compared with age-matched children without rare diseases.

37077523.takeaway: Cardiorespiratory fitness at about 18.5 years was compared in 25 women with premature adrenarche and 36 matched controls followed from childhood.

37082116.takeaway: Review of mechanisms and treatment of glucocorticoid-induced bone disorders in children, which can impair growth and cause fractures.
